sections.title_en: Fuel states — what the whole body is doing, hour by hour
sections.title_zh: 燃料状态 —— 全身代谢的逐小时全景
sections.blurb_en: Ties the pathways of lectures 8-12 together into six whole-body states — fed, postabsorptive, fasting, prolonged starvation, refeeding and exercise — so that for any hour of the day you can name the dominant hormone, the enzymes that are phosphorylated, the source of blood glucose and the fuel of the brain.
sections.blurb_zh: 把第 8-12 讲的各条代谢途径串成六个整体状态——进食、吸收后、禁食、长期饥饿、再喂养与运动——使你对一天中的任意时刻，都能立刻说出主导激素、哪些酶被磷酸化、血糖来自何处、以及大脑正在烧什么。

cards.en: One molecule decides whether the liver makes glucose or burns it: fructose-2,6-bisphosphate. F-2,6-BP is not an intermediate of any pathway; it exists only as a signal, and it is made and destroyed by a single bifunctional polypeptide carrying a PFK-2 kinase domain and an FBPase-2 phosphatase domain. In the fed state that protein is dephosphorylated, the PFK-2 domain runs, F-2,6-BP is high, and it does two things at once: it is the most powerful allosteric activator of PFK-1, and it inhibits fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase, the gluconeogenic enzyme that would otherwise undo PFK-1's work. When glucagon raises cAMP and PKA phosphorylates the same polypeptide, the kinase domain shuts down and the phosphatase domain switches on, F-2,6-BP collapses, PFK-1 loses its dominant activator and FBPase-1 is released. A single phosphate on a single protein therefore reverses the direction of hepatic carbon flow, without changing the amount of either enzyme.
cards.zh: 一个分子就决定了肝脏是造糖还是烧糖：果糖-2,6-二磷酸 F-2,6-BP。F-2,6-BP 不是任何代谢途径的中间产物，它只作为信号存在；它的生成与降解由同一条双功能多肽承担，这条多肽上带着一个 PFK-2 激酶结构域和一个 FBPase-2 磷酸酶结构域。进食状态下这条多肽处于去磷酸化状态，PFK-2 结构域工作，F-2,6-BP 浓度高，它同时做两件事：既是 PFK-1 最强的别构激活剂，又抑制果糖-1,6-二磷酸酶——那个本来会把 PFK-1 的成果抵消掉的糖异生酶。当胰高血糖素升高 cAMP、PKA 磷酸化这同一条多肽时，激酶结构域关闭、磷酸酶结构域开启，F-2,6-BP 迅速崩塌，PFK-1 失去主要激活剂，FBPase-1 则被解除抑制。所以一个蛋白上的一个磷酸基就能把肝脏碳流的方向整个反过来，而两个酶的含量一点没变。

cards.en: Fed (absorptive) state, roughly the first 2-4 h after a meal. The insulin/glucagon ratio is high. Portal blood carries glucose to the liver first, where glucokinase (S0.5 about 10 mM, not inhibited by its product glucose-6-phosphate, transcriptionally induced by insulin) traps glucose only when glucose is genuinely abundant — the opposite design from muscle hexokinase (Km about 0.1 mM, feedback-inhibited by G6P), which is already saturated at any normal blood glucose. Insulin acting through protein phosphatase-1 dephosphorylates glycogen synthase (turning it on) and glycogen phosphorylase (turning it off), so glycogen is laid down. Glycolysis runs, pyruvate dehydrogenase is dephosphorylated and active, and acetyl-CoA beyond the citric acid cycle's needs leaves the mitochondrion as citrate for fatty-acid synthesis. Muscle inserts GLUT4 into its membrane and refills its own glycogen; adipose tissue makes lipoprotein lipase and keeps hormone-sensitive lipase dephosphorylated and silent, so triacylglycerol is stored rather than released. The brain runs entirely on glucose, about 120 g a day.
cards.zh: 进食（吸收）状态，大致是餐后头 2-4 小时。胰岛素／胰高血糖素比值高。门静脉血先把葡萄糖送到肝脏，肝脏的葡萄糖激酶（S0.5 约 10 mM，不被产物 G6P 反馈抑制，被胰岛素在转录水平诱导）只有在葡萄糖真正充裕时才把它锁住——这与肌肉己糖激酶的设计正好相反（Km 约 0.1 mM，受 G6P 反馈抑制），后者在任何正常血糖下都已经饱和。胰岛素通过蛋白磷酸酶-1 使糖原合酶去磷酸化（开启）、使糖原磷酸化酶去磷酸化（关闭），于是糖原被合成储存。糖酵解运转，丙酮酸脱氢酶处于去磷酸化的活性状态，超出三羧酸循环需要的乙酰CoA 以柠檬酸的形式运出线粒体去做脂肪酸合成。肌肉把 GLUT4 插到膜上、补充自己的糖原；脂肪组织合成脂蛋白脂肪酶，并让激素敏感脂肪酶保持去磷酸化的沉默状态，于是甘油三酯被储存而不是被释放。大脑完全靠葡萄糖，每天约 120 g。

cards.en: Postabsorptive state, roughly 4-12 h after the last meal — the state you are in every morning before breakfast. Insulin falls, glucagon rises, and the liver switches from consumer to producer. Early in this window most of the glucose entering the blood comes from hepatic glycogenolysis, with gluconeogenesis supplying a minority share that grows steadily; by about 12-16 h the two are roughly equal. The switch is the same PKA cascade running the opposite way from the fed state: PKA phosphorylates phosphorylase kinase, which phosphorylates glycogen phosphorylase b to the active a form, while the same PKA phosphorylates glycogen synthase and inactivates it — one signal, opposite outcomes, so the two directions can never run at once. Note what is not happening: muscle glycogen, four times larger than the liver's store, is being broken down for the muscle's own use only, because muscle has no glucose-6-phosphatase and therefore cannot release free glucose into blood. The brain is still on glucose alone.
cards.zh: 吸收后状态，大致是末次进餐后 4-12 小时——也就是你每天早餐前所处的状态。胰岛素下降、胰高血糖素上升，肝脏从消费者变成生产者。这个窗口早期，进入血液的葡萄糖大部分来自肝糖原分解，糖异生只占少数但比例稳步上升；到大约 12-16 小时两者大致持平。这个切换用的正是与进食状态方向相反的同一条 PKA 级联：PKA 磷酸化磷酸化酶激酶，后者把糖原磷酸化酶 b 磷酸化成活性的 a 型；而同一个 PKA 又磷酸化糖原合酶并使其失活——一个信号、相反的结果，所以两个方向绝不会同时开动。要注意「没有」发生的事：肌糖原的量是肝糖原的四倍，但它的分解只供肌肉自己使用，因为肌肉没有葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶，根本无法把游离葡萄糖释放进血液。此时大脑仍然只烧葡萄糖。

cards.en: The inventory that makes every transition inevitable, for a 70 kg adult. Hepatic glycogen: roughly 100 g, about 400 kcal, and it is the only glycogen that can leave the cell as glucose. Muscle glycogen: roughly 400 g, four times more, but locked in place because muscle lacks glucose-6-phosphatase. Adipose triacylglycerol: on the order of 10-15 kg, well over 100,000 kcal. Mobilisable protein: roughly 6 kg, about 24,000 kcal, but every gram of it is a working enzyme or a contractile filament, so spending it costs function. The brain alone demands about 120 g of glucose a day. Divide 100 g of liver glycogen by that demand and the answer is under a day — which is exactly why hepatic glycogen is essentially gone after about 24 h of fasting, and why the body must have a second and a third mechanism ready. The fat store is roughly a hundred times larger than the glycogen store in energy terms, but it cannot be converted into glucose, and that single asymmetry generates everything that follows.
cards.zh: 下面这份库存决定了每一次状态转换都是必然的，以 70 kg 成人计。肝糖原：约 100 g、约 400 kcal，而且它是唯一能以葡萄糖形式离开细胞的糖原。肌糖原：约 400 g，是肝糖原的四倍，但被锁死在原地，因为肌肉缺少葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶。脂肪组织的甘油三酯：约 10-15 kg 量级，远超 100,000 kcal。可动员的蛋白质：约 6 kg、约 24,000 kcal，但它的每一克都是正在工作的酶或收缩纤维，动用它就是在损失功能。单是大脑每天就要约 120 g 葡萄糖。用 100 g 肝糖原去除以这个需求，答案不到一天——这正是为什么禁食约 24 小时后肝糖原基本耗尽，也是为什么身体必须准备好第二套、第三套机制。以能量计，脂肪库大约是糖原库的一百倍，但它不能变成葡萄糖，这一个不对称就衍生出后面的一切。

cards.en: Fasting, day 1 to day 3: gluconeogenesis carries the load. With glycogen gone, every gram of blood glucose must be built from three-carbon precursors — lactate returning from red cells and working muscle by the Cori cycle, alanine exported by muscle in the glucose-alanine cycle after transamination of pyruvate, and glycerol released from adipose triacylglycerol. The four bypass enzymes taught in L11 do the work: pyruvate carboxylase and PEPCK around pyruvate kinase, fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase around PFK-1, glucose-6-phosphatase around glucokinase. Two controls run on different clocks. Fast, in seconds to minutes: PKA phosphorylates liver pyruvate kinase and inactivates it, so newly made PEP is not immediately pulled back to pyruvate, and F-2,6-BP collapses so that FBPase-1 is free. Slow, over hours: glucagon through cAMP-response elements, and cortisol through the glucocorticoid receptor, transcriptionally induce PEPCK and glucose-6-phosphatase while insulin represses them — which is why gluconeogenic capacity keeps rising over a day or two rather than jumping instantly.
cards.zh: 禁食第 1 天到第 3 天：糖异生挑起大梁。糖原耗尽后，血中每一克葡萄糖都必须由三碳前体重新造出来——经乳酸循环（Cori cycle）从红细胞和工作肌肉回流的乳酸、肌肉把丙酮酸转氨后经葡萄糖-丙氨酸循环输出的丙氨酸、以及脂肪组织甘油三酯水解释放的甘油。L11 讲过的四个旁路酶承担这项工作：丙酮酸羧化酶与 PEPCK 绕过丙酮酸激酶，果糖-1,6-二磷酸酶绕过 PFK-1，葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶绕过葡萄糖激酶。这里有两套走在不同时钟上的调控。快的（秒到分钟）：PKA 磷酸化肝型丙酮酸激酶并使其失活，于是新造出的 PEP 不会立刻被拉回丙酮酸；同时 F-2,6-BP 崩塌，FBPase-1 得到解放。慢的（数小时）：胰高血糖素经 cAMP 应答元件、皮质醇经糖皮质激素受体，在转录水平诱导 PEPCK 与葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶，而胰岛素抑制它们——这正是为什么糖异生的能力是在一两天里持续爬升，而不是一瞬间跳上去。

cards.en: Fat cannot become glucose, yet fat is what makes gluconeogenesis possible — both halves of that sentence are examinable. Why not: β-oxidation of an even-chain fatty acid yields only acetyl-CoA, and acetyl-CoA entering citrate synthase brings in two carbons that are matched exactly by the two lost as CO2 at isocitrate dehydrogenase and α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase, so the cycle regenerates oxaloacetate but never makes a net extra molecule of it. No net oxaloacetate means no net PEP and no net glucose. The two genuine exceptions are the glycerol backbone of triacylglycerol, which enters as dihydroxyacetone phosphate, and the terminal propionyl-CoA of an odd-chain fatty acid, which enters as succinyl-CoA; both are small contributions. Why fat is nevertheless indispensable: gluconeogenesis costs six high-energy phosphates plus two NADH per glucose, and fatty-acid oxidation pays that bill. More elegantly, the acetyl-CoA produced is itself the obligatory allosteric activator of pyruvate carboxylase, so the fuel that cannot become glucose is the signal telling pyruvate to go and make some.
cards.zh: 脂肪不能变成葡萄糖，但恰恰是脂肪让糖异生成为可能——这句话的两半都是考点。为什么不能：偶数碳脂肪酸的 β-氧化只产生乙酰CoA，而乙酰CoA 经柠檬酸合酶带进来的两个碳，正好被异柠檬酸脱氢酶和 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶脱掉的两个 CO2 抵消，所以循环能再生草酰乙酸，却永远多不出一分子草酰乙酸。没有净增的草酰乙酸，就没有净增的 PEP，也就没有净增的葡萄糖。真正的两个例外是：甘油三酯的甘油骨架，它以磷酸二羟丙酮的形式进入；以及奇数碳脂肪酸最后剩下的丙酰CoA，它以琥珀酰CoA 的形式进入；两者的贡献都不大。那为什么脂肪仍然不可或缺：每造一分子葡萄糖，糖异生要花六个高能磷酸键外加两个 NADH，这笔账由脂肪酸氧化来付。更漂亮的是，产生的乙酰CoA 本身就是丙酮酸羧化酶必需的别构激活剂——这个变不成葡萄糖的燃料，正是那个通知丙酮酸去造葡萄糖的信号。

cards.en: Malonyl-CoA inhibiting CPT-1 is the most economical piece of regulation in the whole metabolism block, because it prevents a futile cycle with one molecule. Acetyl-CoA carboxylase makes malonyl-CoA as the committed first step of fatty-acid synthesis; malonyl-CoA also binds and inhibits carnitine palmitoyltransferase-1, the outer-mitochondrial-membrane enzyme that is the committed first step of fatty-acid oxidation. So whenever the cell is building fatty acids, it is simultaneously locking the door those fatty acids would use to get into the mitochondrion and be burned. Fed state: insulin keeps ACC dephosphorylated and citrate allosterically activates it, malonyl-CoA is high, CPT-1 is shut, synthesis proceeds. Fasting or exercise: glucagon-driven PKA and, independently, AMPK phosphorylate ACC and inactivate it, malonyl-CoA falls, CPT-1 opens, acyl groups cross into the matrix and β-oxidation runs. Remember the compartments taught in L11 — synthesis in the cytosol, oxidation in the matrix — and the whole switch is just control of who may cross the membrane.
cards.zh: 丙二酰CoA 抑制 CPT-1，是整个代谢部分里最经济的一处调控，因为它用一个分子就杜绝了一次无效循环。乙酰CoA 羧化酶生成丙二酰CoA，这是脂肪酸合成的关键第一步；而丙二酰CoA 同时又结合并抑制肉碱脂酰转移酶-1（CPT-1）——线粒体外膜上那个作为脂肪酸氧化关键第一步的酶。所以只要细胞在合成脂肪酸，它就同时把这些脂肪酸进入线粒体被烧掉的那道门锁上了。进食状态：胰岛素让 ACC 保持去磷酸化，柠檬酸别构激活它，丙二酰CoA 高，CPT-1 关闭，合成进行。禁食或运动：胰高血糖素驱动的 PKA、以及独立作用的 AMPK 都磷酸化 ACC 使其失活，丙二酰CoA 下降，CPT-1 打开，脂酰基进入基质，β-氧化开动。把 L11 讲过的区室记牢——合成在胞质、氧化在基质——整个开关不过就是在管「谁被允许跨膜」。

cards.see: L11 · ketone bodies · L9 · TCA cycle
cards.en: Ketogenesis is what happens when the liver oxidises fat faster than its own citric acid cycle can accept the product. In fasting, oxaloacetate is continuously drained out of the mitochondrion toward gluconeogenesis, while β-oxidation floods the matrix with acetyl-CoA; acetyl-CoA that cannot find oxaloacetate to condense with is diverted instead to mitochondrial HMG-CoA synthase, the rate-limiting and fasting-induced enzyme of ketogenesis, giving HMG-CoA, then acetoacetate, then β-hydroxybutyrate by reduction, plus a little acetone by spontaneous decarboxylation — the smell on the breath. Two consequences are worth memorising. First, the liver cannot use what it makes: hepatocytes lack succinyl-CoA:3-oxoacid CoA transferase, so ketone bodies are an export-only product and the liver goes on burning fatty acids itself while shipping a water-soluble fuel to everyone else. Second, ketone bodies are water-soluble and cross the blood-brain barrier on monocarboxylate transporters, which albumin-bound fatty acids cannot do — this is the whole reason the brain can eventually stop demanding so much glucose.
cards.zh: 当肝脏氧化脂肪的速度超过它自己的三羧酸循环所能接收产物的速度时，就会发生生酮作用。禁食时草酰乙酸被源源不断地抽出线粒体去做糖异生，而 β-氧化又让基质里乙酰CoA 泛滥；找不到草酰乙酸缩合的乙酰CoA 只好转向线粒体型 HMG-CoA 合酶——生酮作用的限速酶，且在禁食时被诱导——生成 HMG-CoA，再变成乙酰乙酸，再被还原成 β-羟丁酸，另有少量因自发脱羧生成的丙酮，也就是呼气里那股味道。有两个后果值得背下来。第一，肝脏用不了自己造的东西：肝细胞缺乏琥珀酰CoA:3-酮酸 CoA 转移酶，所以酮体是只出不进的产品，肝脏自己继续烧脂肪酸，同时把一种水溶性燃料输送给所有其他组织。第二，酮体是水溶性的，能借单羧酸转运蛋白穿过血脑屏障，而与白蛋白结合的脂肪酸做不到——这就是大脑最终能不再那么依赖葡萄糖的全部原因。

cards.see: L12 · urea cycle · L11 · ketone bodies
cards.en: Prolonged starvation, beyond about one week, is defined by protein sparing, and the exam question is always why the body burns less protein when it is starving harder, not more. Measure it by urinary nitrogen: early fasting excretes roughly 10-12 g of nitrogen a day, equivalent to about 75 g of protein, and after several weeks this falls to roughly 3-4 g a day. The mechanism is the brain. Over about three days to two weeks the brain induces the transporters and enzymes needed to oxidise β-hydroxybutyrate and acetoacetate, which eventually supply the majority of its fuel, so its glucose requirement falls from about 120 g a day to about 40 g. That residual demand can be met by glycerol plus recycled lactate with only a small alanine contribution, so muscle proteolysis, and with it urea cycle flux, drops sharply. Read the logic in the right direction: the body does not choose to spare protein, it becomes able to, because ketone bodies removed the obligate glucose demand that protein was being destroyed to satisfy. Survival time is therefore set by fat mass; when fat runs out, nitrogen excretion rises again and death follows.
cards.zh: 长期饥饿（约一周以上）的标志是蛋白质节省效应，而考题问的永远是：为什么饿得更久，身体反而烧掉更少的蛋白质，而不是更多。用尿氮来衡量：禁食早期每天排出约 10-12 g 氮，相当于约 75 g 蛋白质；几周之后降到每天约 3-4 g。机制在大脑。大约三天到两周内，大脑诱导出氧化 β-羟丁酸和乙酰乙酸所需的转运蛋白与酶，酮体最终能供应它大部分的燃料，于是它的葡萄糖需求从每天约 120 g 降到约 40 g。这点剩余需求靠甘油加上回收的乳酸、再加少量丙氨酸就能满足，于是肌肉蛋白分解、以及随之而来的尿素循环通量都大幅下降。因果方向要读对：身体不是「选择」节省蛋白质，而是「变得有能力」节省，因为酮体消除了那份原本要靠拆蛋白质来满足的刚性葡萄糖需求。所以生存时间由脂肪量决定；脂肪耗尽时尿氮排出重新升高，死亡随之而来。

cards.en: Exercise splits into two quite different metabolic states, and the dividing variable is whether pyruvate can be handled aerobically. Low to moderate intensity, below roughly 60% of VO2max: epinephrine acting on adipose β-adrenergic receptors raises cAMP, PKA phosphorylates hormone-sensitive lipase and activates it, plasma free fatty acids rise, and working muscle oxidises them; muscle glycogen is spared, blood glucose stays nearly constant, and this is the state in which fat oxidation contributes its largest share. High intensity: fast-twitch glycolytic fibres are recruited and their glycogen is attacked from two directions at once. Hormonally, epinephrine and PKA activate phosphorylase kinase; locally and much faster, the Ca2+ released for contraction binds the calmodulin subunit of phosphorylase kinase and activates it directly, so contraction itself turns on fuel supply with no hormone needed, while AMP rising as ATP is consumed allosterically activates both muscle glycogen phosphorylase b and PFK-1. Pyruvate is then produced faster than pyruvate dehydrogenase and the electron transport chain can consume it, so it is reduced to lactate to regenerate NAD+ and exported to the liver for the Cori cycle.
cards.zh: 运动其实分成两种相当不同的代谢状态，分界的变量是丙酮酸能否被有氧地处理掉。低到中等强度，大约低于 60% VO2max：肾上腺素作用于脂肪细胞 β 肾上腺素受体、升高 cAMP，PKA 磷酸化激素敏感脂肪酶使其活化，血浆游离脂肪酸上升，工作肌肉将其氧化；肌糖原被节省，血糖几乎不变，这也是脂肪氧化占比最高的状态。高强度：快缩型糖酵解纤维被募集，它们的糖原同时从两个方向被攻击。激素层面，肾上腺素与 PKA 激活磷酸化酶激酶；局部层面而且快得多，为收缩而释放的 Ca²⁺ 结合磷酸化酶激酶的钙调蛋白亚基并直接将其激活——于是收缩这件事本身就打开了燃料供应，完全不需要激素；同时 ATP 消耗导致 AMP 升高，别构激活肌型糖原磷酸化酶 b 和 PFK-1。此时丙酮酸的生成速度超过丙酮酸脱氢酶和电子传递链的处理能力，于是被还原成乳酸以再生 NAD+，并输出到肝脏进入乳酸循环。

cards.en: Type 1 versus type 2 diabetes is best learned as one sentence with two readings: the liver is receiving fasting signals while fuel is abundant. In type 1 there is no insulin at all, so glucagon acts unopposed — hepatic glycogenolysis and gluconeogenesis run at full rate despite hyperglycaemia, and in adipose tissue nothing restrains hormone-sensitive lipase (insulin normally lowers cAMP by activating phosphodiesterase and so keeps the lipase dephosphorylated), so free fatty acids pour into the liver. With ACC inactive, malonyl-CoA is low, CPT-1 is wide open and ketogenesis is unrestrained: this is diabetic ketoacidosis, driven by β-hydroxybutyrate and acetoacetate, on top of an osmotic diuresis that dehydrates the patient. In type 2 insulin is present and often high, but the tissues respond poorly and the resistance is selective — the liver fails to suppress gluconeogenesis, giving fasting hyperglycaemia, yet remains responsive for lipogenesis, giving hypertriglyceridaemia and fatty liver. Because residual insulin is still enough to restrain lipolysis, ketoacidosis is uncommon in type 2; the characteristic decompensation is instead a hyperosmolar hyperglycaemic state with very high glucose and little ketosis.
cards.zh: 1 型与 2 型糖尿病最好当成一句话的两种读法来学：肝脏在燃料充裕的情况下收到了饥饿信号。1 型完全没有胰岛素，于是胰高血糖素毫无制衡——尽管已经高血糖，肝糖原分解和糖异生仍全速运转；脂肪组织里没有任何东西约束激素敏感脂肪酶（正常情况下胰岛素通过激活磷酸二酯酶降低 cAMP，使该酶保持去磷酸化），于是游离脂肪酸涌入肝脏。ACC 失活、丙二酰CoA 很低、CPT-1 敞开，生酮作用不受限制：这就是糖尿病酮症酸中毒，由 β-羟丁酸和乙酰乙酸驱动，再叠加一个使病人脱水的渗透性利尿。2 型里胰岛素是存在的、常常还偏高，但组织反应差，而且这种抵抗是选择性的——肝脏无法抑制糖异生，造成空腹高血糖；却对脂肪合成仍然敏感，造成高甘油三酯血症和脂肪肝。由于残余的胰岛素仍足以约束脂解，2 型很少出现酮症酸中毒；它典型的失代偿是高渗性高血糖状态，血糖极高而酮体不多。

cards.see: L8 · PFK-1 and the ATP/AMP ratio
cards.en: AMPK and the hormones answer two different questions, and confusing them is a common error. Glucagon, insulin, epinephrine and cortisol report the state of the whole organism: they arrive from outside the cell and tell it what the blood is doing. AMPK reports the state of this one cell: it is allosterically activated by AMP, which rises steeply when ATP is consumed because adenylate kinase converts 2 ADP into ATP plus AMP and so amplifies a small fall in ATP into a large rise in AMP. Activated AMPK phosphorylates acetyl-CoA carboxylase and switches it off, lowering malonyl-CoA and opening CPT-1; it phosphorylates HMG-CoA reductase and switches off cholesterol synthesis; and it promotes GLUT4 translocation and glucose uptake. The general rule is that AMPK turns off every ATP-consuming biosynthetic pathway and turns on every ATP-generating catabolic one. The clinically important consequence is that in contracting muscle AMPK increases glucose uptake without any insulin signal, which is why exercise lowers blood glucose in a type 2 diabetic whose insulin pathway is impaired — pair this with L8's point that PFK-1 itself reads the ATP/AMP ratio directly.
cards.zh: AMPK 与激素回答的是两个不同的问题，把它们混为一谈是常见错误。胰高血糖素、胰岛素、肾上腺素、皮质醇报告的是整个机体的状态：它们从细胞外抵达，告诉细胞血液里在发生什么。AMPK 报告的是「这一个细胞」的状态：它被 AMP 别构激活，而当 ATP 被消耗时 AMP 会陡然上升，因为腺苷酸激酶把 2 个 ADP 变成 ATP 加 AMP，从而把 ATP 的小幅下降放大成 AMP 的大幅上升。活化的 AMPK 磷酸化乙酰CoA 羧化酶并将其关闭，降低丙二酰CoA、打开 CPT-1；磷酸化 HMG-CoA 还原酶，关闭胆固醇合成；并促进 GLUT4 转位与葡萄糖摄取。总规律是：AMPK 关掉每一条耗 ATP 的合成途径，打开每一条产 ATP 的分解途径。临床上重要的推论是：收缩中的肌肉里，AMPK 不需要任何胰岛素信号就能增加葡萄糖摄取——这正是为什么运动能降低胰岛素通路受损的 2 型糖尿病患者的血糖；请把它与 L8 里「PFK-1 本身直接读取 ATP/AMP 比值」这一点放在一起记。

cards.en: Phosphorylation does not mean activation, and any student who memorises it that way will get half the metabolism questions wrong. Work through the fasting-signal list: glycogen phosphorylase phosphorylated is active; glycogen synthase phosphorylated is inactive; the PFK-2/FBPase-2 bifunctional enzyme phosphorylated runs as a phosphatase, so F-2,6-BP falls; liver pyruvate kinase phosphorylated is inactive; hormone-sensitive lipase phosphorylated is active; acetyl-CoA carboxylase phosphorylated is inactive; pyruvate dehydrogenase phosphorylated by PDH kinase is inactive. There is no chemical rule making a phosphate activating or inhibiting — the added negative charge simply shifts the conformational equilibrium in whatever direction that particular protein was built to shift. The rule that does work is directional rather than chemical: glucagon and epinephrine phosphorylate all of these enzymes at once, and each has been wired by evolution so that the phosphorylated form pushes the body toward releasing glucose into the blood and burning fat, while insulin, acting through protein phosphatase-1, dephosphorylates the same set and pushes the opposite way.
cards.zh: 磷酸化不等于活化，凡是这样背的人，代谢题会错掉一半。把饥饿信号下的清单过一遍：糖原磷酸化酶被磷酸化后是活性的；糖原合酶被磷酸化后是失活的；PFK-2/FBPase-2 双功能酶被磷酸化后作为磷酸酶工作，于是 F-2,6-BP 下降；肝型丙酮酸激酶被磷酸化后失活；激素敏感脂肪酶被磷酸化后活化；乙酰CoA 羧化酶被磷酸化后失活；丙酮酸脱氢酶被 PDH 激酶磷酸化后失活。并不存在什么化学规律让磷酸基天生是激活性或抑制性的——多出来的负电荷只是把构象平衡朝着「这个特定蛋白被造出来时就设定好的方向」推。真正管用的规律是方向性的而非化学性的：胰高血糖素和肾上腺素同时磷酸化上面所有这些酶，而每一个酶都被进化布线成「磷酸化型把机体推向释放葡萄糖入血、并燃烧脂肪」；胰岛素则通过蛋白磷酸酶-1 把这同一批酶去磷酸化，推向相反方向。

cards.en: Refeeding is not simply the fed state resumed, and refeeding syndrome is the clearest reason to understand fuel states rather than memorise them. Give a large carbohydrate load to someone starved for weeks and insulin surges from a suppressed baseline. Cells that have been catabolic suddenly start building glycogen and protein, and they drag phosphate, potassium and magnesium in with the glucose. In a body already depleted of these ions, the plasma concentrations crash. Hypophosphataemia is the dangerous one, because phosphate is needed to make ATP at all and to make 2,3-bisphosphoglycerate in the red cell — losing 2,3-BPG shifts the haemoglobin oxygen-binding curve to the left and impairs oxygen unloading in the tissues just as demand rises. Hypokalaemia and hypomagnesaemia give cardiac arrhythmia. At the same time thiamine is consumed rapidly, because pyruvate dehydrogenase and α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase both require thiamine pyrophosphate and both suddenly run at high flux, so a marginal thiamine store is exhausted and Wernicke encephalopathy can appear. Refeed slowly, replace phosphate, and give thiamine first.
cards.zh: 再喂养并不只是「回到进食状态」，而再喂养综合征正是「必须理解而不是死背燃料状态」的最好理由。给一个已经饥饿数周的人一次大量碳水负荷，胰岛素会从被抑制的基线上骤升。原本处于分解状态的细胞突然开始合成糖原和蛋白质，并且把磷酸、钾和镁跟着葡萄糖一起拖进细胞。在一个本已缺乏这些离子的身体里，血浆浓度会崩塌。低磷血症是最危险的，因为没有磷酸根本造不出 ATP，也造不出红细胞里的 2,3-二磷酸甘油酸——失去 2,3-BPG 会使血红蛋白氧结合曲线左移，恰在需氧上升之时损害组织的释氧。低钾与低镁则引起心律失常。与此同时硫胺素被迅速消耗，因为丙酮酸脱氢酶和 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶都需要焦磷酸硫胺素，而两者的通量同时骤增，于是本就勉强的硫胺素储备被耗尽，可能出现 Wernicke 脑病。处理原则是缓慢再喂养、补磷，并先给硫胺素。

quiz.q_en: A healthy adult wakes after a 12-hour overnight fast. Which statement best describes where the glucose in the blood is coming from at that moment?
quiz.q_zh: 一位健康成人在隔夜禁食 12 小时后醒来。此刻血中葡萄糖的来源，下列哪一项描述最准确？

options.en: Ketone bodies made in the liver overnight are reconverted to glucose in the kidney cortex, which is the reason the brain is not yet in any difficulty at this point.
options.zh: 夜间肝脏生成的酮体在肾皮质被重新转变为葡萄糖，这就是此时大脑尚未出现任何困难的原因。

options.en: Hepatic glycogenolysis still supplies the larger share, but gluconeogenesis from lactate, alanine and glycerol has been rising steadily and is approaching an equal contribution.
options.zh: 肝糖原分解仍然提供较大的份额，但由乳酸、丙氨酸和甘油进行的糖异生一直在稳步上升，正接近与之相当的贡献。

options.en: Muscle glycogenolysis supplies most of it, because the muscle store is roughly four times the hepatic store and is released as free glucose directly into the circulation by glucose-6-phosphatase.
options.zh: 肌糖原分解提供其中大部分，因为肌肉的储量大约是肝脏的四倍，并由葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶催化以游离葡萄糖的形式直接释放进入循环。

options.en: Acetyl-CoA derived from adipose fatty acids is condensed to oxaloacetate inside hepatocytes and carried onward to glucose through PEPCK and fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase.
options.zh: 来自脂肪组织脂肪酸的乙酰CoA 在肝细胞内缩合成草酰乙酸，再经 PEPCK 和果糖-1,6-二磷酸酶继续转变为葡萄糖。

quiz.explain_en: At 12 h, hepatic glycogen (about 100 g) is depleted but not yet exhausted, so glycogenolysis is still the larger single source while gluconeogenesis climbs toward parity — the two are roughly equal by about 12-16 h. Muscle glycogen cannot contribute free glucose at all because muscle lacks glucose-6-phosphatase. Acetyl-CoA cannot give net oxaloacetate, since the two carbons it brings in are lost as CO2 within one turn of the cycle. Ketone bodies are a terminal fuel, not a gluconeogenic substrate, and are barely elevated at 12 h in any case.
quiz.explain_zh: 禁食 12 小时时，肝糖原（约 100 g）已被消耗但尚未耗尽，因此糖原分解仍是单一最大来源，而糖异生正向持平攀升——到约 12-16 小时两者大致相当。肌糖原完全无法贡献游离葡萄糖，因为肌肉缺少葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶。乙酰CoA 不能带来净增的草酰乙酸，因为它带进来的两个碳在循环一圈内就以 CO2 形式丢掉了。酮体是终末燃料而不是糖异生底物，何况 12 小时时它几乎还没升高。

quiz.q_en: Glucagon raises hepatic cAMP and PKA phosphorylates the bifunctional PFK-2/FBPase-2 polypeptide. What follows for hepatic carbon flow?
quiz.q_zh: 胰高血糖素升高肝内 cAMP，PKA 磷酸化 PFK-2/FBPase-2 这条双功能多肽。肝脏碳流会发生什么？

options.en: Fructose-2,6-bisphosphate rises and inhibits both PFK-1 and fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase at the same time, so hepatic glucose metabolism is arrested in both directions at once.
options.zh: 果糖-2,6-二磷酸升高并同时抑制 PFK-1 和果糖-1,6-二磷酸酶，于是肝脏的葡萄糖代谢在两个方向上同时被阻断。

options.en: The kinase domain is stimulated, fructose-2,6-bisphosphate rises, PFK-1 is driven harder, and the liver consequently exports lactate to the periphery instead of glucose.
options.zh: 激酶结构域被激活，果糖-2,6-二磷酸升高，PFK-1 被推得更快，于是肝脏向外周输出乳酸而不是葡萄糖。

options.en: Fructose-2,6-bisphosphate concentration is unchanged, but the same PKA directly inhibits PFK-1 by phosphorylation and directly activates fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase by phosphorylation.
options.zh: 果糖-2,6-二磷酸的浓度不变，但同一个 PKA 通过磷酸化直接抑制 PFK-1，并通过磷酸化直接激活果糖-1,6-二磷酸酶。

options.en: The phosphatase domain takes over, fructose-2,6-bisphosphate falls, PFK-1 loses its strongest activator and fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase loses its inhibitor, so flux turns toward glucose.
options.zh: 磷酸酶结构域接管，果糖-2,6-二磷酸下降，PFK-1 失去最强的激活剂，果糖-1,6-二磷酸酶失去抑制剂，于是碳流转向生成葡萄糖。

quiz.explain_en: Phosphorylation of the bifunctional enzyme switches off the PFK-2 kinase activity and switches on the FBPase-2 phosphatase activity, so F-2,6-BP is destroyed. Because F-2,6-BP is simultaneously the strongest allosteric activator of PFK-1 and an inhibitor of FBPase-1, losing it turns off glycolysis and releases gluconeogenesis in one step. The claim that the kinase domain is stimulated inverts the effect of the phosphate; PKA does not phosphorylate PFK-1 or FBPase-1 themselves, so the version with unchanged F-2,6-BP is wrong on the mechanism; and F-2,6-BP inhibits FBPase-1 but activates PFK-1, so it cannot block both.
quiz.explain_zh: 双功能酶被磷酸化后，PFK-2 激酶活性关闭、FBPase-2 磷酸酶活性开启，于是 F-2,6-BP 被降解。由于 F-2,6-BP 同时是 PFK-1 最强的别构激活剂和 FBPase-1 的抑制剂，失去它就一步同时关掉糖酵解、放开糖异生。说激酶结构域被激活的说法把磷酸基的效果弄反了；PKA 并不磷酸化 PFK-1 或 FBPase-1 本身，所以「F-2,6-BP 浓度不变」那种说法在机制上就是错的；而 F-2,6-BP 对 FBPase-1 是抑制、对 PFK-1 是激活，不可能同时阻断两者。

quiz.q_en: During a 24-hour fast, muscle glycogen (about 400 g) is broken down but contributes nothing directly to blood glucose. What is the reason?
quiz.q_zh: 在 24 小时禁食期间，肌糖原（约 400 g）被分解，却对血糖没有任何直接贡献。原因是什么？

options.en: Muscle glycogen is branched at every fourth residue instead of every tenth and debranching enzyme is absent, so only a limit dextrin can ever be produced.
options.zh: 肌糖原每四个残基就有一个分支而不是每十个，而且肌肉缺少脱支酶，因此糖原分解只能停在极限糊精那一步。

options.en: Muscle GLUT4 transporters operate only in the inward direction, so any free glucose produced inside the myocyte is immediately taken back up by the same cell.
options.zh: 肌肉的 GLUT4 转运蛋白只能向内转运，所以肌细胞内产生的任何游离葡萄糖都会立刻被同一个细胞重新摄回。

options.en: Muscle glycogen phosphorylase is allosterically inhibited by AMP, so the store cannot be mobilised at all during the period when contraction is consuming ATP.
options.zh: 肌型糖原磷酸化酶被 AMP 别构抑制，所以在收缩消耗 ATP 的这段时间里，这个储库根本无法被动员。

options.en: Muscle has no glucose-6-phosphatase, so glucose-6-phosphate cannot be dephosphorylated and, being charged, cannot cross the plasma membrane.
options.zh: 肌肉没有葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶，所以葡萄糖-6-磷酸无法脱去磷酸；而它带电荷，因此不能穿过质膜。

quiz.explain_en: Glucose-6-phosphatase is expressed in liver and kidney but not in muscle, so muscle glycogen ends as glucose-6-phosphate, which is trapped by its negative charge and can only be used inside the myocyte. AMP activates rather than inhibits muscle phosphorylase b, which is exactly how contraction accelerates glycogenolysis. Muscle glycogen has normal branching and normal debranching enzyme. GLUT4 is a facilitative transporter and is not directional in that sense; the barrier is chemical, not directional.
quiz.explain_zh: 葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶只在肝和肾表达，肌肉没有，所以肌糖原的终点是葡萄糖-6-磷酸，它被自身的负电荷困住，只能在肌细胞内部使用。AMP 对肌型磷酸化酶 b 是激活而非抑制，这正是收缩加速糖原分解的方式。肌糖原的分支结构正常，脱支酶也正常。GLUT4 是易化扩散型转运蛋白，并没有那种方向性；这里的障碍是化学性的而非方向性的。

quiz.q_en: On the second day of a fast, β-oxidation raises hepatic mitochondrial acetyl-CoA sharply. What integrative consequence does this have for gluconeogenesis?
quiz.q_zh: 禁食第二天，β-氧化使肝脏线粒体内的乙酰CoA 大幅升高。这对糖异生有什么整合性的后果？

options.en: Acetyl-CoA inhibits pyruvate carboxylase, which protects oxaloacetate from withdrawal and keeps the citric acid cycle turning at its maximum rate throughout the fast.
options.zh: 乙酰CoA 抑制丙酮酸羧化酶，从而保护草酰乙酸不被抽走，使三羧酸循环在整个禁食期间保持最大速率运转。

options.en: Acetyl-CoA allosterically activates pyruvate carboxylase and at the same time inhibits pyruvate dehydrogenase, so pyruvate is committed to oxaloacetate and fat oxidation drives glucose synthesis.
options.zh: 乙酰CoA 别构激活丙酮酸羧化酶，同时又抑制丙酮酸脱氢酶，于是丙酮酸被引向草酰乙酸而不是乙酰CoA，脂肪氧化因而驱动了葡萄糖的合成。

options.en: Acetyl-CoA is carboxylated by pyruvate carboxylase to give oxaloacetate, providing the net four-carbon unit from which the new glucose is built, which is how the carbon of an even-chain fatty acid finally reaches glucose.
options.zh: 乙酰CoA 被丙酮酸羧化酶直接羧化生成草酰乙酸，从而提供合成一分子新葡萄糖所需的那个净四碳单位，偶数碳脂肪酸的碳正是通过这条途径到达葡萄糖的。

options.en: Acetyl-CoA allosterically activates pyruvate dehydrogenase, so a greater fraction of pyruvate is converted to acetyl-CoA and less of it is wasted by reduction to lactate.
options.zh: 乙酰CoA 别构激活丙酮酸脱氢酶，于是更大比例的丙酮酸被转变成乙酰CoA，被还原成乳酸而浪费掉的部分减少。

quiz.explain_en: Acetyl-CoA is the obligatory positive allosteric effector of pyruvate carboxylase and simultaneously inhibits pyruvate dehydrogenase, so a rising acetyl-CoA signal says at once 'fat is plentiful, stop burning pyruvate, turn it into glucose'. Pyruvate carboxylase carboxylates pyruvate, not acetyl-CoA, so acetyl-CoA never becomes a net four-carbon unit. Acetyl-CoA inhibits PDH rather than activating it. And it activates rather than inhibits pyruvate carboxylase, so the version that protects oxaloacetate has the sign reversed.
quiz.explain_zh: 乙酰CoA 是丙酮酸羧化酶必需的正性别构效应物，同时又抑制丙酮酸脱氢酶，因此乙酰CoA 升高这个信号同时说了两句话：脂肪充足、别再烧丙酮酸、把它变成葡萄糖。丙酮酸羧化酶羧化的是丙酮酸而不是乙酰CoA，所以乙酰CoA 永远不会变成净增的四碳单位。乙酰CoA 对 PDH 是抑制而不是激活。而它对丙酮酸羧化酶是激活而非抑制，所以「保护草酰乙酸」那种说法把符号弄反了。

quiz.q_en: Why can the carbon of an even-chain fatty acid not appear as a net gain of glucose, even though it enters the citric acid cycle?
quiz.q_zh: 偶数碳脂肪酸的碳明明进入了三羧酸循环，为什么不能表现为葡萄糖的净增加？

options.en: The two carbons entering as acetyl-CoA are exactly matched by the two lost as CO2 at isocitrate dehydrogenase and α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase, so no net oxaloacetate is ever generated.
options.zh: 以乙酰CoA 形式进入的两个碳，正好被异柠檬酸脱氢酶和 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶脱去的两个 CO2 精确抵消，所以永远不会出现净增的草酰乙酸。

options.en: Acetyl-CoA cannot cross the inner mitochondrial membrane in any form at all, so it never reaches the cytosolic enzymes fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase and glucose-6-phosphatase that finally finish glucose.
options.zh: 乙酰CoA 无论以哪一种形式都不能跨过线粒体内膜进入胞质，因此它永远到不了在胞质中最终完成葡萄糖合成的果糖-1,6-二磷酸酶和葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶那里。

options.en: The thioester bond of acetyl-CoA is too low in energy to drive the decarboxylation and phosphorylation that PEPCK catalyses using GTP as its phosphate donor.
options.zh: 乙酰CoA 的硫酯键能量太低，无法驱动 PEPCK 以 GTP 为磷酸供体所催化的脱羧与磷酸化。

options.en: Citrate synthase is an irreversible step, so once acetyl-CoA has condensed with oxaloacetate its carbon is committed to complete oxidation and cannot re-enter any anabolic route at all.
options.zh: 柠檬酸合酶是不可逆的一步，所以乙酰CoA 一旦与草酰乙酸缩合，它的碳就就被锁定于彻底氧化，完全不能再进入任何合成途径。

quiz.explain_en: The bookkeeping is what matters: two carbons in as acetyl, two carbons out as CO2 in the same turn, so oxaloacetate is regenerated but never increased, and gluconeogenesis needs a net gain of oxaloacetate. Acetyl-CoA does cross to the cytosol as citrate for lipogenesis, so the transport claim is false. PEPCK does use GTP, but the barrier is carbon accounting, not energy. And carbon from acetyl-CoA can certainly enter anabolic routes such as cholesterol and ketone body synthesis, so irreversibility of citrate synthase is not the issue.
quiz.explain_zh: 关键是记账：以乙酰基进来两个碳，同一圈里又以 CO2 出去两个碳，所以草酰乙酸只是被再生而从未增加，而糖异生需要的正是草酰乙酸的净增加。乙酰CoA 确实能以柠檬酸的形式运到胞质去做脂肪合成，所以那个「不能跨膜」的说法是假的。PEPCK 确实用 GTP，但这里的障碍是碳的收支而不是能量。而来自乙酰CoA 的碳完全可以进入胆固醇合成、酮体合成等合成途径，所以柠檬酸合酶的不可逆性也不是症结。

quiz.q_en: Urinary nitrogen excretion falls from roughly 10-12 g a day in early fasting to roughly 3-4 g a day after several weeks of starvation. What best explains the fall?
quiz.q_zh: 尿氮排出量从禁食早期的每天约 10-12 g，降到饥饿数周后的每天约 3-4 g。对这一下降最好的解释是什么？

options.en: The urea cycle enzymes are repressed by cortisol during prolonged starvation, so nitrogen is retained and excreted instead as ammonium salts by the kidney, and the fall reflects a change of route rather than of protein breakdown.
options.zh: 长期饥饿时尿素循环的酶被皮质醇抑制，于是氮被保留下来，改由肾脏以铵盐形式排出，因此这一下降反映的是排泄途径的改变而不是蛋白质分解的改变。

options.en: Muscle proteolysis continues at exactly the same rate, but the amino acids released are re-incorporated into hepatic acute-phase proteins and structural collagen instead of being deaminated and excreted.
options.zh: 肌肉蛋白分解速率完全不变，但释放出的氨基酸被重新掺入肝脏的急性期蛋白和结构性胶原，而不是在肝脏被脱氨后以尿素的形式排出。

options.en: The brain has adapted to oxidise ketone bodies, so its glucose demand falls from about 120 g to about 40 g a day and far less amino acid carbon is needed for gluconeogenesis.
options.zh: 大脑已经适应氧化酮体，于是其葡萄糖需求从每天约 120 g 降到约 40 g，需要用于糖异生的氨基酸碳因此大幅减少。

options.en: Adipose glycerol release rises far enough to supply the whole of the body's gluconeogenic carbon requirement, so alanine export from muscle stops completely after the first week and protein is no longer consumed.
options.zh: 脂肪组织释放的甘油上升到足以供应全身糖异生所需的全部碳，因此第一周之后，肌肉向肝脏输出丙氨酸这件事就完全停止了，蛋白质也不再被消耗。

quiz.explain_en: Protein sparing is a consequence, not a decision. Once the brain can oxidise β-hydroxybutyrate and acetoacetate, the obligate glucose requirement that muscle protein was being destroyed to satisfy shrinks by roughly two thirds, so proteolysis and therefore urea synthesis fall. Cortisol induces rather than represses gluconeogenic and urea cycle capacity. Proteolysis genuinely slows, so a claim that its rate is unchanged is wrong. Glycerol is a real but quantitatively small gluconeogenic substrate and cannot replace alanine entirely.
quiz.explain_zh: 蛋白质节省是一个结果，而不是一个决定。一旦大脑能够氧化 β-羟丁酸和乙酰乙酸，那份原本要靠拆肌肉蛋白来满足的刚性葡萄糖需求就缩小了约三分之二，于是蛋白分解、进而尿素合成都随之下降。皮质醇是诱导而不是抑制糖异生与尿素循环的能力。蛋白分解确实是变慢了，所以说它速率不变是错的。甘油确实是糖异生底物，但量上很小，不可能完全取代丙氨酸。
quiz.see: L12 · urea cycle · L11 · ketone bodies

quiz.q_en: The liver synthesises ketone bodies during fasting but cannot oxidise them. Which statement gives the reason and its consequence correctly?
quiz.q_zh: 肝脏在禁食时合成酮体，却不能氧化酮体。下列哪一项正确地给出了原因及其后果？

options.en: Hepatocyte mitochondria lack the monocarboxylate transporter that peripheral tissues use, so acetoacetate made in the matrix leaves the cell and can never be carried back across the inner membrane again.
options.zh: 肝细胞线粒体缺少外周组织所使用的那种单羧酸转运蛋白，所以在基质里生成的乙酰乙酸离开细胞后，再也无法被运回内膜之内，因此对肝脏自身的氧化过程是不可利用的。

options.en: Hepatocytes lack succinyl-CoA:3-oxoacid CoA transferase, so the liver cannot reactivate acetoacetate to acetoacetyl-CoA, and it burns fatty acids itself while exporting ketone bodies.
options.zh: 肝细胞缺乏琥珀酰CoA:3-酮酸 CoA 转移酶，因此肝脏无法把乙酰乙酸重新活化为乙酰乙酰CoA，于是它自己烧脂肪酸，同时把酮体输出去。

options.en: Hepatocytes lack HMG-CoA lyase acting in the reverse direction, so the liver converts β-hydroxybutyrate to acetone instead and loses that carbon in the expired breath.
options.zh: 肝细胞缺少能反向作用的 HMG-CoA 裂解酶，于是肝脏改把 β-羟丁酸转变成丙酮，那部分碳随呼气丢失。

options.en: Ketone bodies feedback-inhibit hepatic β-oxidation, so the liver switches to oxidising glucose and leaves the ketone bodies untouched for the peripheral tissues to use.
options.zh: 酮体反馈抑制肝脏的 β-氧化，于是肝脏转而氧化葡萄糖，把酮体原封不动地留给外周组织使用。

quiz.explain_en: Using a ketone body requires reactivating acetoacetate to acetoacetyl-CoA, and the transferase (thiophorase) that does it is absent from hepatocytes — an elegant division of labour that stops the liver consuming the fuel it manufactures for the brain and muscle. Hepatocytes do have monocarboxylate transporters, since the ketone bodies must get out. Acetone arises by spontaneous decarboxylation of acetoacetate, not from β-hydroxybutyrate via a lyase. And ketone bodies do not inhibit hepatic β-oxidation; the fasting liver oxidises fatty acids heavily, which is precisely why it makes them.
quiz.explain_zh: 利用酮体需要把乙酰乙酸重新活化成乙酰乙酰CoA，而催化这一步的转移酶（硫解酶转移酶）在肝细胞里是缺失的——这是一个漂亮的分工，使肝脏不会去消耗它为大脑和肌肉制造的燃料。肝细胞是有单羧酸转运蛋白的，否则酮体出不去。丙酮来自乙酰乙酸的自发脱羧，而不是由某个裂解酶从 β-羟丁酸生成。酮体也不抑制肝脏 β-氧化；禁食的肝脏正在大量氧化脂肪酸，这恰恰就是它生成酮体的原因。

quiz.q_en: A patient with untreated type 1 diabetes has a blood glucose of 25 mmol/L and heavy ketosis. Which chain of events accounts for the ketosis?
quiz.q_zh: 一位未经治疗的 1 型糖尿病患者血糖 25 mmol/L，并有明显酮症。下列哪条事件链解释了这种酮症？

options.en: The high blood glucose saturates hepatic glucokinase, and the surplus glucose-6-phosphate is diverted through the pentose phosphate pathway into the synthesis of ketone bodies in the cytosol.
options.zh: 高血糖使肝脏葡萄糖激酶饱和，多余的葡萄糖-6-磷酸被分流进磷酸戊糖途径，在胞质中转变为酮体。

options.en: Insulin deficiency blocks the carnitine shuttle directly, so long-chain fatty acids accumulate in the cytosol and are converted there to acetoacetate by a cytosolic form of HMG-CoA synthase.
options.zh: 胰岛素缺乏直接阻断肉碱穿梭，于是长链脂肪酸在胞质中堆积，并在那里被一种胞质型 HMG-CoA 合酶转变成乙酰乙酸。

options.en: Hyperglycaemia inhibits the citric acid cycle at citrate synthase, so acetyl-CoA generated by glucose oxidation accumulates in skeletal muscle and is diverted there into ketone body synthesis.
options.zh: 高血糖在柠檬酸合酶处抑制三羧酸循环，于是葡萄糖氧化产生的乙酰CoA 在骨骼肌中堆积，并在那里被分流去合成酮体。

options.en: Without insulin, hormone-sensitive lipase is unrestrained and fatty acids flood the liver, while inactive acetyl-CoA carboxylase leaves malonyl-CoA low, so CPT-1 is open and acetyl-CoA exceeds oxaloacetate.
options.zh: 没有胰岛素，激素敏感脂肪酶不受约束，脂肪酸涌入肝脏；同时失活的乙酰CoA 羧化酶使丙二酰CoA 处于低位，于是 CPT-1 敞开，乙酰CoA 超过了草酰乙酸。

quiz.explain_en: Ketoacidosis needs both an unlimited fatty acid supply and an open door into the mitochondrion. Insulin deficiency with unopposed glucagon delivers the first by activating hormone-sensitive lipase, and the second by inactivating acetyl-CoA carboxylase so that malonyl-CoA no longer inhibits CPT-1; oxaloacetate is meanwhile drained to gluconeogenesis. Glucose carbon is not the source of the ketone bodies, so the pentose phosphate route is wrong. The carnitine shuttle is regulated by malonyl-CoA rather than blocked by insulin lack, and HMG-CoA synthase for ketogenesis is mitochondrial. Muscle does not make ketone bodies.
quiz.explain_zh: 酮症酸中毒需要两个条件：无限的脂肪酸供应，以及一道通向线粒体的敞开的门。胰岛素缺乏加上无制衡的胰高血糖素，通过激活激素敏感脂肪酶提供了第一条，又通过使乙酰CoA 羧化酶失活、使丙二酰CoA 不再抑制 CPT-1 提供了第二条；与此同时草酰乙酸被抽去做糖异生。酮体的碳不来自葡萄糖，所以磷酸戊糖途径那条是错的。肉碱穿梭是由丙二酰CoA 调控的，并不是被胰岛素缺乏所阻断，而生酮用的 HMG-CoA 合酶位于线粒体。肌肉不生成酮体。
quiz.see: L11 · ketone bodies · L11 · carnitine shuttle

quiz.q_en: A patient with type 2 diabetes has fasting hyperglycaemia together with a high plasma triacylglycerol and a fatty liver, yet does not develop ketoacidosis. Which explanation fits all three findings?
quiz.q_zh: 一位 2 型糖尿病患者同时有空腹高血糖、血浆甘油三酯升高和脂肪肝，却不发生酮症酸中毒。哪一种解释能同时符合这三项发现？

options.en: Insulin secretion has ceased entirely, but glucagon secretion has ceased as well, so gluconeogenesis and ketogenesis are both driven by cortisol alone and remain at a moderate level.
options.zh: 胰岛素分泌已完全停止，但胰高血糖素分泌也停止了，于是糖异生和生酮都只由皮质醇驱动，维持在中等水平。

options.en: The liver has lost glucose-6-phosphatase activity, so glucose accumulates as glucose-6-phosphate and is diverted into triacylglycerol rather than being exported to the blood or oxidised.
options.zh: 肝脏丧失了葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶活性，于是葡萄糖以葡萄糖-6-磷酸的形式堆积，被分流去合成甘油三酯，而不是输出入血或被氧化。

options.en: Peripheral tissues have entirely normal insulin sensitivity, and the hyperglycaemia comes wholly from unabsorbed dietary carbohydrate that the portal vein delivers at all hours of the day.
options.zh: 外周组织的胰岛素敏感性完全正常，高血糖全部来自门静脉在一天中任何时刻都在输送的未吸收膳食碳水化合物。

options.en: Hepatic insulin resistance is selective: suppression of gluconeogenesis fails while stimulation of lipogenesis persists, and residual insulin still restrains lipolysis and ketogenesis.
options.zh: 肝脏的胰岛素抵抗是选择性的：对糖异生的抑制失效，而对脂肪合成的刺激仍然存在；同时残余的胰岛素仍足以约束脂解与生酮。

quiz.explain_en: Selective hepatic insulin resistance explains the paradox: the arm that would shut off gluconeogenesis is deaf, giving fasting hyperglycaemia, while the arm driving lipogenesis still hears the high insulin, giving hypertriglyceridaemia and steatosis, and residual insulin is enough to keep hormone-sensitive lipase dephosphorylated so ketogenesis stays modest. Type 2 diabetes does not abolish insulin secretion, and glucagon is if anything inappropriately high. Loss of glucose-6-phosphatase would cause hypoglycaemia rather than hyperglycaemia. And peripheral insulin resistance is a defining feature, so calling sensitivity normal contradicts the diagnosis.
quiz.explain_zh: 选择性肝脏胰岛素抵抗正好解释这个悖论：负责关掉糖异生的那一支「听不见」，于是出现空腹高血糖；而驱动脂肪合成的那一支仍然听得见高胰岛素，于是出现高甘油三酯血症与脂肪肝；同时残余胰岛素足以让激素敏感脂肪酶保持去磷酸化，生酮就保持轻微。2 型糖尿病并不使胰岛素分泌消失，而胰高血糖素反而偏高。丧失葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶会导致低血糖而不是高血糖。外周胰岛素抵抗更是本病的定义性特征，说敏感性完全正常与诊断相矛盾。

quiz.q_en: A sprinter's muscle glycogenolysis accelerates within a second of the start, before any hormonal signal could plausibly have acted. What accounts for this?
quiz.q_zh: 短跑运动员的肌糖原分解在起跑后一秒之内就加速了，这时任何激素信号都还来不及起作用。原因是什么？

options.en: Contraction lowers intracellular pH, and the protons protonate glycogen phosphorylase and convert the b form irreversibly into the a form without the involvement of any protein kinase.
options.zh: 收缩降低细胞内 pH，质子使糖原磷酸化酶质子化，不需要任何蛋白激酶参与就把 b 型不可逆地转变成 a 型。

options.en: The muscle glycogen store is continuously being broken down at its maximum rate at all times, and contraction merely increases the rate at which the products leave the cell.
options.zh: 肌糖原储库在任何时候都以最大速率被持续分解，收缩只是提高了产物离开细胞的速度。

options.en: The Ca2+ released from the sarcoplasmic reticulum for contraction binds the calmodulin subunit of phosphorylase kinase and activates it directly, coupling contraction to fuel supply.
options.zh: 为收缩而从肌浆网释放的 Ca²⁺ 结合磷酸化酶激酶的钙调蛋白亚基并直接将其激活，从而把收缩与燃料供应偶联起来。

options.en: Epinephrine is stored in vesicles inside the myocyte and is released into the cytosol by depolarisation, where it activates intracellular β-adrenergic receptors and PKA in under a second.
options.zh: 肾上腺素储存在肌细胞内的囊泡中，去极化时被释放到胞质，在那里于一秒之内激活细胞内的 β 肾上腺素受体和 PKA。

quiz.explain_en: Phosphorylase kinase has a δ subunit that is calmodulin itself, so the same Ca2+ transient that triggers contraction also switches on glycogen breakdown, with no hormone and no delay. Falling pH does not convert b to a; the b-to-a conversion is a covalent phosphorylation. Resting muscle glycogenolysis is very slow, not maximal. And epinephrine is a circulating hormone acting on surface receptors, not stored inside the myocyte.
quiz.explain_zh: 磷酸化酶激酶的 δ 亚基本身就是钙调蛋白，所以触发收缩的那一次 Ca²⁺ 瞬变同时打开了糖原分解，不需要激素，也没有延迟。pH 下降并不能把 b 转成 a；b→a 的转变是共价磷酸化。静息肌肉的糖原分解非常慢，远非最大速率。而肾上腺素是循环激素，作用于细胞表面受体，并不储存在肌细胞内部。

quiz.q_en: Lactate produced by sprinting muscle is converted back to glucose in the liver. What is the whole-body energetic consequence of this cycle?
quiz.q_zh: 短跑肌肉产生的乳酸在肝脏被转变回葡萄糖。这个循环对全身的能量学后果是什么？

options.en: The cycle is exactly energy-neutral, because the two ATP the muscle gains from glycolysis are precisely the two ATP the liver spends in converting that lactate back into glucose again.
options.zh: 这个循环在能量上恰好收支平衡，因为肌肉从糖酵解中获得的两个 ATP，正好等于肝脏把那些乳酸重新变成葡萄糖所花掉的两个 ATP。

options.en: The cycle costs energy overall: muscle gains two ATP per glucose while the liver spends six high-energy phosphates to rebuild it, and hepatic fat oxidation pays the difference.
options.zh: 这个循环整体上是耗能的：每分子葡萄糖肌肉获得两个 ATP，而肝脏要花六个高能磷酸键把它重建，这个差额由肝脏的脂肪氧化来支付。

options.en: The cycle yields energy overall, because lactate is oxidised back to pyruvate in the liver and the NADH so produced is worth 2.5 ATP each when it is passed to the electron transport chain.
options.zh: 这个循环整体上是产能的，因为乳酸在肝脏被氧化回丙酮酸，由此产生的 NADH 交给电子传递链时每一个价值 2.5 个 ATP，足以覆盖开销。

options.en: The cycle neither costs nor yields energy, because the lactate is converted back to glucose inside the very cell that produced it and no transport across any plasma membrane takes place, so there is no inter-organ transfer either.
options.zh: 这个循环既不耗能也不产能，因为乳酸是在产生它的那个细胞内部被变回葡萄糖的，全程不存在任何跨越质膜的转运环节，因此也谈不上器官之间的能量转移。

quiz.explain_en: Gluconeogenesis from two lactate costs 4 ATP plus 2 GTP, six high-energy phosphates in all, while glycolysis in muscle returned only 2 ATP; the Cori cycle therefore shifts a metabolic burden from muscle to liver at a net energetic loss, funded by hepatic fatty acid oxidation. That asymmetry is why it cannot be neutral. The liver does gain NADH from lactate dehydrogenase, but that NADH is consumed by glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase running in reverse within the same pathway. And the whole point of the cycle is inter-organ transport, so the claim that no transport occurs is false.
quiz.explain_zh: 由两分子乳酸进行糖异生要花 4 个 ATP 加 2 个 GTP，共六个高能磷酸键，而肌肉的糖酵解只收回 2 个 ATP；因此乳酸循环是以净能量损失为代价，把代谢负担从肌肉转移到肝脏，这笔开销由肝脏的脂肪酸氧化埋单。正是这种不对称使它不可能是收支平衡的。肝脏确实从乳酸脱氢酶获得 NADH，但这些 NADH 在同一条途径中被逆向运行的 3-磷酸甘油醛脱氢酶消耗掉了。而这个循环的全部意义就在于器官间的转运，所以说不存在转运是错的。

quiz.q_en: A severely malnourished patient is given a large glucose infusion and develops confusion, arrhythmia and a falling plasma phosphate. Which account of the mechanism is correct?
quiz.q_zh: 一位严重营养不良的病人接受了大量葡萄糖输注，随后出现意识模糊、心律失常和血磷下降。下列哪一种机制解释是正确的？

options.en: The glucose load drives an osmotic diuresis that washes phosphate and potassium out through the kidney, and the confusion is a direct osmotic effect of the hyperglycaemia on cortical neurons.
options.zh: 葡萄糖负荷引起渗透性利尿，把磷酸盐和钾经肾脏冲走，而意识模糊是高血糖对皮层神经元的直接渗透效应。

options.en: The insulin surge activates hormone-sensitive lipase, and the free fatty acids released chelate calcium and magnesium in the plasma, which produces both the arrhythmia and the encephalopathy.
options.zh: 胰岛素骤升激活激素敏感脂肪酶，释放出的游离脂肪酸在血浆中螯合钙与镁，从而同时造成心律失常和脑病。

options.en: Glucose oxidation generates so much ATP that inorganic phosphate is consumed to exhaustion inside the mitochondrial matrix, while lactate from anaerobic glycolysis produces the neurological signs.
options.zh: 葡萄糖氧化产生大量 ATP，把线粒体基质内的无机磷酸消耗殆尽，而无氧糖酵解产生的乳酸造成神经系统体征。

options.en: The insulin surge drives phosphate, potassium and magnesium into cells with the glucose, and the sudden flux through the thiamine-dependent PDH and α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase exhausts a marginal thiamine store.
options.zh: 胰岛素骤升把磷酸、钾和镁随葡萄糖一起驱入细胞，同时通过依赖硫胺素的 PDH 与 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶的通量骤增，耗尽了本已勉强的硫胺素储备。

quiz.explain_en: Refeeding syndrome is an intracellular shift, not a loss from the body: insulin moves glucose, phosphate, potassium and magnesium into cells at once, and in a depleted patient the plasma levels collapse. Hypophosphataemia cripples ATP and red-cell 2,3-BPG synthesis, hypokalaemia and hypomagnesaemia cause arrhythmia, and thiamine pyrophosphate is consumed as PDH and α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase suddenly run fast, giving Wernicke encephalopathy. Osmotic diuresis is a feature of uncontrolled diabetes, not of refeeding. Insulin inhibits rather than activates hormone-sensitive lipase. And phosphate is recycled, not consumed, during oxidative phosphorylation.
quiz.explain_zh: 再喂养综合征是离子向细胞内的转移，而不是从体内丢失：胰岛素同时把葡萄糖、磷酸、钾和镁驱入细胞，在一个储备已被耗竭的病人身上，血浆浓度随之崩塌。低磷血症使 ATP 与红细胞 2,3-BPG 的合成瘫痪；低钾与低镁引起心律失常；而 PDH 与 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶突然高速运转，消耗焦磷酸硫胺素，导致 Wernicke 脑病。渗透性利尿是失控糖尿病的特征，而不是再喂养的特征。胰岛素对激素敏感脂肪酶是抑制而不是激活。而在氧化磷酸化过程中磷酸是被循环利用的，并不会被消耗掉。

quiz.q_en: Two hours after a large carbohydrate meal, which set of hepatic enzyme states is correct?
quiz.q_zh: 一次大量碳水化合物餐后两小时，肝脏酶的状态组合哪一项是正确的？

options.en: Glycogen synthase phosphorylated and active, glycogen phosphorylase phosphorylated and inactive, pyruvate dehydrogenase phosphorylated and active, acetyl-CoA carboxylase phosphorylated and inactive.
options.zh: 糖原合酶磷酸化且有活性，糖原磷酸化酶磷酸化且无活性，丙酮酸脱氢酶磷酸化且有活性，乙酰CoA 羧化酶磷酸化且无活性。

options.en: Glycogen synthase dephosphorylated and inactive, glycogen phosphorylase phosphorylated and active, pyruvate dehydrogenase phosphorylated and inactive, acetyl-CoA carboxylase phosphorylated and inactive.
options.zh: 糖原合酶去磷酸化且无活性，糖原磷酸化酶磷酸化且有活性，丙酮酸脱氢酶磷酸化且无活性，乙酰CoA 羧化酶磷酸化且无活性。

options.en: Glycogen synthase phosphorylated and inactive, glycogen phosphorylase dephosphorylated and active, pyruvate dehydrogenase dephosphorylated and inactive, acetyl-CoA carboxylase dephosphorylated and active.
options.zh: 糖原合酶磷酸化且无活性，糖原磷酸化酶去磷酸化且有活性，丙酮酸脱氢酶去磷酸化且无活性，乙酰CoA 羧化酶去磷酸化且有活性。

options.en: Glycogen synthase dephosphorylated and active, glycogen phosphorylase dephosphorylated and inactive, pyruvate dehydrogenase dephosphorylated and active, acetyl-CoA carboxylase dephosphorylated and active.
options.zh: 糖原合酶去磷酸化且有活性，糖原磷酸化酶去磷酸化且无活性，丙酮酸脱氢酶去磷酸化且有活性，乙酰CoA 羧化酶去磷酸化且有活性。

quiz.explain_en: Insulin works through protein phosphatase-1, so in the fed state the whole set is dephosphorylated; what differs is the direction each enzyme takes. Glycogen synthase and acetyl-CoA carboxylase are switched on by dephosphorylation, glycogen phosphorylase is switched off by it, and pyruvate dehydrogenase is switched on because PDH phosphatase removes the phosphate that PDH kinase had added. The combinations pairing a phosphorylated synthase with activity, or a dephosphorylated phosphorylase with activity, invert the known wiring, and a dephosphorylated pyruvate dehydrogenase is active rather than inactive.
quiz.explain_zh: 胰岛素通过蛋白磷酸酶-1 起作用，所以进食状态下这一整套酶都是去磷酸化的；不同的是每个酶因此走向哪个方向。糖原合酶与乙酰CoA 羧化酶因去磷酸化而开启，糖原磷酸化酶因去磷酸化而关闭，丙酮酸脱氢酶则因 PDH 磷酸酶去掉了 PDH 激酶加上的磷酸而开启。那些把「磷酸化的合酶」配上有活性、或把「去磷酸化的磷酸化酶」配上有活性的组合，都把已知的布线弄反了；而去磷酸化的丙酮酸脱氢酶是有活性而不是无活性的。
quiz.see: L8 · covalent modification · L9 · PDH complex

quiz.q_en: One triacylglycerol molecule is hydrolysed in adipose tissue during a fast. What happens to its glycerol backbone, as distinct from its three fatty acids?
quiz.q_zh: 禁食时脂肪组织水解了一分子甘油三酯。它的甘油骨架与它的三个脂肪酸相比，去向有何不同？

options.en: The glycerol is phosphorylated inside the adipocyte by glycerol kinase and re-esterified locally, while the fatty acids travel to the liver bound to plasma albumin.
options.zh: 甘油在脂肪细胞内被甘油激酶磷酸化并就地重新酯化，而脂肪酸则与血浆白蛋白结合前往肝脏。

options.en: The glycerol is oxidised to CO2 within the adipocyte to power the lipolysis itself, while the fatty acids are converted to ketone bodies in that same adipose tissue.
options.zh: 甘油在脂肪细胞内被氧化成 CO2 以为脂解本身供能，而脂肪酸在同一脂肪组织内被转变成酮体。

options.en: The glycerol goes to the liver, which has glycerol kinase, and enters gluconeogenesis as dihydroxyacetone phosphate, while the fatty acids yield only acetyl-CoA and no net glucose.
options.zh: 甘油前往具有甘油激酶的肝脏，以磷酸二羟丙酮的形式进入糖异生；而脂肪酸只产生乙酰CoA，不产生净增的葡萄糖。

options.en: The glycerol is converted to glucose within the adipocyte itself and then exported to the blood, while the fatty acids are immediately re-esterified into new triacylglycerol in the same lipid droplet without leaving the cell.
options.zh: 甘油在脂肪细胞内部就被直接转变成葡萄糖然后输出到血中，而脂肪酸则立即在同一个脂滴里被重新酯化成新的甘油三酯而不离开细胞。

quiz.explain_en: Adipocytes have very little glycerol kinase, so the glycerol released by lipolysis cannot be reused locally and travels to the liver, where glycerol kinase and glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase deliver it as dihydroxyacetone phosphate — a genuine, if modest, gluconeogenic substrate. The fatty acids give only acetyl-CoA and therefore no net glucose. Adipose tissue does not make ketone bodies, that is a hepatic function. And adipose tissue cannot perform gluconeogenesis, lacking glucose-6-phosphatase and PEPCK-driven flux to glucose.
quiz.explain_zh: 脂肪细胞几乎没有甘油激酶，所以脂解释放的甘油无法就地再利用，而是前往肝脏，由甘油激酶和 3-磷酸甘油脱氢酶把它变成磷酸二羟丙酮——一个真实但量不大的糖异生底物。脂肪酸只产生乙酰CoA，因此不产生净增的葡萄糖。脂肪组织不生成酮体，那是肝脏的职能。脂肪组织也不能进行糖异生，它既缺葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶，也没有通向葡萄糖的 PEPCK 通量。

quiz.q_en: Hepatic PEPCK activity roughly doubles over the first day of a fast, whereas hepatic pyruvate kinase is inhibited within minutes of a rise in glucagon. What distinguishes the two controls?
quiz.q_zh: 禁食第一天里肝脏 PEPCK 的活性大约翻倍，而肝型丙酮酸激酶在胰高血糖素升高后几分钟内就被抑制。这两种调控的区别是什么？

options.en: PEPCK is regulated by covalent phosphorylation at several separate sites, which takes considerably longer than the single-site phosphorylation that the same protein kinase A places on pyruvate kinase, so the change needs a full day.
options.zh: PEPCK 由多个不同位点上的共价磷酸化调控，这比同一个蛋白激酶 A 在丙酮酸激酶上所进行的单位点磷酸化要慢得多，因此活性的改变需要整整一天才显现出来。

options.en: PEPCK is a mitochondrial enzyme that must be imported after synthesis, whereas pyruvate kinase is cytosolic, so the delay reflects protein transport rather than any difference in control mechanism.
options.zh: PEPCK 是必须在合成后被导入的线粒体酶，而丙酮酸激酶位于胞质，所以这段延迟反映的是蛋白转运所需的时间，而不是调控机制的差别。

options.en: PEPCK is controlled by allosteric binding of acetyl-CoA and pyruvate kinase by allosteric binding of AMP, and allosteric effects on an enzyme as large as PEPCK are intrinsically slower to develop.
options.zh: PEPCK 由乙酰CoA 的别构结合调控，丙酮酸激酶由 AMP 的别构结合调控，而在 PEPCK 这样较大的酶上，别构效应本质上需要更长时间才能发展出来。

options.en: PEPCK is regulated transcriptionally, induced by cAMP-response elements and by cortisol and repressed by insulin, whereas pyruvate kinase is regulated by direct PKA phosphorylation.
options.zh: PEPCK 在转录水平被调控，受 cAMP 应答元件与皮质醇诱导、受胰岛素抑制；而丙酮酸激酶是被 PKA 直接磷酸化调控的。

quiz.explain_en: The two enzymes are the standard example of the two timescales of metabolic control. PEPCK has no known allosteric or covalent regulation of consequence; its activity is set by how much enzyme exists, which glucagon and cortisol raise and insulin lowers over hours. Liver pyruvate kinase is a classic PKA substrate and responds in minutes. PEPCK is not allosterically controlled by acetyl-CoA — that is pyruvate carboxylase — and it is not a PKA substrate. Human PEPCK exists in both cytosolic and mitochondrial forms, but import time is not what sets the delay.
quiz.explain_zh: 这两个酶是代谢调控两种时间尺度的标准例子。PEPCK 没有已知的、有意义的别构或共价调控；它的活性取决于酶量的多少，而胰高血糖素与皮质醇在数小时内升高酶量、胰岛素则降低酶量。肝型丙酮酸激酶是经典的 PKA 底物，几分钟内即起反应。PEPCK 并不受乙酰CoA 的别构调控——那是丙酮酸羧化酶——它也不是 PKA 的底物。人的 PEPCK 确有胞质型与线粒体型两种，但导入所需的时间并不是这段延迟的原因。

quiz.q_en: Across the fed state, a 24-hour fast and three weeks of starvation, which description of the brain's fuel is correct?
quiz.q_zh: 在进食状态、禁食 24 小时和饥饿三周这三种情况下，关于大脑燃料的哪一项描述是正确的？

options.en: Ketone bodies in all three states, with glucose reserved for the pentose phosphate pathway so as to supply the NADPH needed for neurotransmitter synthesis in the neuron.
options.zh: 三种状态下都是酮体，葡萄糖只保留给磷酸戊糖途径，以提供神经元内神经递质合成所需的 NADPH。

options.en: Glucose when fed and at 24 hours, then ketone bodies supplying the majority of the requirement after several weeks, with the brain's glucose need falling to roughly 40 g a day.
options.zh: 进食时和禁食 24 小时时都用葡萄糖，几周之后由酮体供应其大部分需求，大脑的葡萄糖需求降至每天约 40 g。

options.en: Glucose in all three states, because the blood-brain barrier excludes every alternative fuel and glucose is defended at the expense of muscle protein for as long as life continues.
options.zh: 三种状态下都是葡萄糖，因为血脑屏障排除了所有替代燃料，而只要生命还在继续，葡萄糖就以牺牲肌肉蛋白为代价被优先保障到底。

options.en: Glucose when fed, fatty acids after 24 hours and ketone bodies after three weeks, the switch at each stage following the plasma free fatty acid concentration upwards.
options.zh: 进食时用葡萄糖，24 小时后用脂肪酸，三周后用酮体；每一次切换都跟随血浆游离脂肪酸浓度的上升。

quiz.explain_en: The brain has no meaningful fuel store and cannot oxidise albumin-bound long-chain fatty acids, which is why it is a strict glucose consumer in the fed and early fasted states. Only after days to weeks does it induce the transporters and enzymes for β-hydroxybutyrate and acetoacetate, at which point ketone bodies cover the majority of its needs and residual glucose demand falls to about 40 g a day; this is exactly what makes protein sparing possible. The claim that glucose is used throughout ignores ketoadaptation, fatty acids never become a brain fuel, and ketone bodies are absent in the fed state.
quiz.explain_zh: 大脑几乎没有燃料储备，也不能氧化与白蛋白结合的长链脂肪酸，所以在进食和禁食早期它是严格的葡萄糖消费者。只有在数天到数周之后，它才诱导出转运 β-羟丁酸和乙酰乙酸所需的转运蛋白与酶；此时酮体覆盖它的大部分需求，剩余的葡萄糖需求降到每天约 40 g——这正是蛋白质节省得以实现的原因。说全程都用葡萄糖忽略了酮适应；脂肪酸从来不会成为大脑燃料；而进食状态下根本没有酮体。

quiz.q_en: Exercise lowers blood glucose in a patient with type 2 diabetes whose insulin signalling is impaired. What is the mechanism?
quiz.q_zh: 运动能降低胰岛素信号通路受损的 2 型糖尿病患者的血糖。机制是什么？

options.en: Contraction raises the AMP:ATP ratio and activates AMPK, which promotes GLUT4 translocation to the sarcolemma independently of the insulin receptor pathway.
options.zh: 收缩提高 AMP:ATP 比值并激活 AMPK，后者不依赖胰岛素受体通路即可促进 GLUT4 向肌膜转位。

options.en: Contraction raises intramuscular glucose-6-phosphate, which allosterically stimulates hexokinase and thereby accelerates uptake down a steepened gradient.
options.zh: 收缩提高肌肉内葡萄糖-6-磷酸的浓度，别构激活己糖激酶，从而沿着变陡的梯度加速摄取。

options.en: Exercise raises plasma epinephrine, which acts on muscle β-receptors and PKA to insert GLUT2 transporters into the sarcolemma that function without needing any insulin.
options.zh: 运动升高血浆肾上腺素，后者作用于肌肉 β 受体和 PKA，向肌膜中插入无需任何胰岛素即可工作的 GLUT2 转运蛋白。

options.en: Exercise depletes hepatic glycogen, and the emptied glycogen particle allosterically inhibits glucose-6-phosphatase so that the liver ceases to export glucose.
options.zh: 运动耗尽肝糖原，排空的糖原颗粒别构抑制葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶，使肝脏停止输出葡萄糖。

quiz.explain_en: Contraction-stimulated glucose uptake runs through AMPK and Ca2+ signalling and converges on GLUT4 vesicle translocation without using the insulin receptor or Akt, which is why exercise remains effective when insulin signalling is defective. Glucose-6-phosphate inhibits hexokinase rather than stimulating it. Muscle expresses GLUT4 and GLUT1, not GLUT2, which is a liver and β-cell transporter. And there is no allosteric inhibition of glucose-6-phosphatase by an empty glycogen particle.
quiz.explain_zh: 收缩刺激的葡萄糖摄取经由 AMPK 与 Ca²⁺ 信号，最终汇聚到 GLUT4 囊泡的转位上，全程不使用胰岛素受体或 Akt，这正是胰岛素信号有缺陷时运动仍然有效的原因。葡萄糖-6-磷酸对己糖激酶是抑制而不是激活。肌肉表达的是 GLUT4 和 GLUT1，而不是 GLUT2——后者是肝脏和 β 细胞的转运蛋白。也不存在什么「排空的糖原颗粒别构抑制葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶」这回事。

quiz.q_en: Why is it the liver, rather than muscle, that takes up the bulk of a large oral glucose load and stores it as glycogen?
quiz.q_zh: 为什么摄入大量葡萄糖后，把其中大部分摄取并储存为糖原的是肝脏而不是肌肉？

options.en: The liver expresses GLUT4 and inserts it into the membrane in response to insulin, whereas muscle expresses only the low-capacity GLUT1 and cannot raise its uptake after a meal at all.
options.zh: 肝脏表达 GLUT4 并在胰岛素作用下把它插入膜中，而肌肉只表达低容量的 GLUT1，餐后完全无法提高其摄取。

options.en: Muscle hexokinase has a much higher Km than liver glucokinase, so muscle takes up glucose only once the blood concentration has already become very high indeed.
options.zh: 肌肉己糖激酶的 Km 远高于肝脏葡萄糖激酶，所以只有当血中浓度已经非常高时，肌肉才会摄取葡萄糖。

options.en: Muscle lacks glycogen synthase altogether and can therefore store incoming glucose only as glucose-6-phosphate, which strictly limits how much of a load it can absorb.
options.zh: 肌肉完全没有糖原合酶，因此只能把进来的葡萄糖以葡萄糖-6-磷酸的形式储存，这严格限制了它能吸收的负荷量。

options.en: Liver glucokinase has a high S0.5 and is not inhibited by glucose-6-phosphate, so its rate keeps rising with portal glucose, while muscle hexokinase is already saturated and product-inhibited.
options.zh: 肝脏葡萄糖激酶的 S0.5 高且不被葡萄糖-6-磷酸抑制，因此其速率随门静脉葡萄糖持续上升；而肌肉己糖激酶早已饱和且受产物抑制。

quiz.explain_en: The two kinases are built for opposite jobs. Hexokinase, with a Km near 0.1 mM and strong product inhibition by glucose-6-phosphate, is saturated at any normal blood glucose and cannot respond to a rise. Glucokinase, with an S0.5 near 10 mM and no product inhibition, has a rate that tracks portal glucose upward, and insulin induces more of it. The claim that muscle hexokinase has the higher Km reverses the two enzymes. Muscle certainly has glycogen synthase, holding about 400 g of glycogen. And GLUT4 is the muscle and adipose transporter, not a hepatic one.
quiz.explain_zh: 这两个激酶是为相反的任务设计的。己糖激酶 Km 约 0.1 mM，且受葡萄糖-6-磷酸强烈的产物抑制，在任何正常血糖下都已饱和，无法对升高作出反应。葡萄糖激酶 S0.5 约 10 mM 且无产物抑制，其速率随门静脉葡萄糖同向上升，而且胰岛素还会诱导更多的酶。说肌肉己糖激酶 Km 更高，是把两个酶弄反了。肌肉当然有糖原合酶，它储存着约 400 g 糖原。而 GLUT4 是肌肉和脂肪组织的转运蛋白，不是肝脏的。

quiz.q_en: On day 2 of a fast, plasma cortisol is elevated. Which of its actions on fuel metabolism is correctly described?
quiz.q_zh: 禁食第 2 天血浆皮质醇升高。它对燃料代谢的作用，下列哪一项描述正确？

options.en: Cortisol acts through a nuclear receptor over hours, inducing PEPCK and glucose-6-phosphatase and promoting muscle proteolysis, so more amino acid carbon reaches hepatic gluconeogenesis.
options.zh: 皮质醇通过核受体在数小时的尺度上起作用，诱导 PEPCK 与葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶并促进肌肉蛋白分解，于是更多氨基酸碳到达肝脏糖异生。

options.en: Cortisol stimulates insulin release from the pancreatic β cell, which is why fasting plasma insulin rises again on the second day and lean tissue is protected from further breakdown, despite the continuing absence of any dietary carbohydrate.
options.zh: 皮质醇刺激胰腺 β 细胞释放胰岛素，这就是禁食第二天血浆胰岛素重新升高、瘦组织免于进一步分解的原因，尽管此时仍然完全没有膣食碳水化合物摊入。

options.en: Cortisol inhibits hepatic gluconeogenesis while stimulating ketogenesis, and this is the mechanism by which prolonged fasting spares protein from being consumed as a fuel.
options.zh: 皮质醇抑制肝脏糖异生同时刺激生酮，这就是长期禁食把蛋白质从燃料消耗中节省下来的机制。

options.en: Cortisol phosphorylates hormone-sensitive lipase directly through the intrinsic kinase activity of its receptor, which gives the rise in plasma free fatty acids seen within minutes.
options.zh: 皮质醇通过其受体固有的激酶活性直接磷酸化激素敏感脂肪酶，从而在数分钟内造成血浆游离脂肪酸的升高。

quiz.explain_en: Cortisol is a steroid acting on a nuclear receptor, so its effects are transcriptional and appear over hours: it induces the gluconeogenic enzymes PEPCK and glucose-6-phosphatase and mobilises amino acids by promoting muscle proteolysis, and it is permissive for the catecholamine effects on adipose tissue. The glucocorticoid receptor has no kinase activity and cortisol does not phosphorylate anything directly. Cortisol opposes rather than stimulates insulin action, and fasting insulin stays low. And cortisol promotes gluconeogenesis rather than inhibiting it; protein sparing comes from brain ketoadaptation instead.
quiz.explain_zh: 皮质醇是作用于核受体的类固醇，因此其效应是转录性的、在数小时尺度上出现：它诱导糖异生酶 PEPCK 与葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶，并通过促进肌肉蛋白分解动员氨基酸，同时对儿茶酚胺在脂肪组织的作用起允许作用。糖皮质激素受体没有激酶活性，皮质醇也不直接磷酸化任何东西。皮质醇是对抗而不是刺激胰岛素作用的，禁食时胰岛素保持低位。而皮质醇促进而非抑制糖异生；蛋白质节省来自大脑的酮适应。
quiz.see: L11 · gluconeogenesis · L12 · amino acid catabolism

quiz.q_en: In fasting, glucagon causes PKA to phosphorylate the liver isoform of pyruvate kinase. Why does this matter specifically for gluconeogenesis?
quiz.q_zh: 禁食时胰高血糖素使 PKA 磷酸化肝型丙酮酸激酶。这对糖异生具体有什么意义？

options.en: It allows pyruvate kinase to run in the reverse direction and synthesise PEP from pyruvate, sparing the ATP and GTP that pyruvate carboxylase and PEPCK would otherwise have to consume.
options.zh: 它使丙酮酸激酶能够反向运行、由丙酮酸合成 PEP，从而省下丙酮酸羧化酶与 PEPCK 这两个酶本来必须消耗的 ATP 和 GTP。

options.en: It has no effect on hepatic flux but prevents the muscle isoform from being inhibited, which is necessary because skeletal muscle also performs gluconeogenesis during a fast and supplies glucose to the blood.
options.zh: 它对肝内碳流没有影响，但使肌型同工酶免于被抑制，这是必要的，因为骨骼肌在禁食时也同样进行糖异生作用并向血中供糖。

options.en: It inactivates the enzyme, so PEP made at some cost by pyruvate carboxylase and PEPCK is not immediately converted straight back to pyruvate in a futile cycle.
options.zh: 它使这个酶失活，于是由丙酮酸羧化酶和 PEPCK 付出代价造出的 PEP，不会立刻又被变回丙酮酸而形成无效循环。

options.en: It converts pyruvate kinase into a phosphatase that strips the phosphate from PEP and hands it to ADP, which happens to be exactly the reaction gluconeogenesis requires at that particular step.
options.zh: 它把丙酮酸激酶变成一个磷酸酶，从 PEP 上剥下磷酸并把它交给 ADP，而这恰好正是糖异生在那一步上所需要的那个反应。

quiz.explain_en: Pyruvate carboxylase plus PEPCK spend one ATP and one GTP to lift pyruvate up to PEP; if pyruvate kinase were left active it would drop PEP straight back to pyruvate and the liver would simply hydrolyse nucleotides in a circle. Phosphorylation therefore shuts that leak. Pyruvate kinase does not become a phosphatase, and its physiological reaction is far too exergonic to be reversed, which is exactly why the two-enzyme bypass exists. Muscle does not perform gluconeogenesis, having neither PEPCK-driven flux to glucose nor glucose-6-phosphatase.
quiz.explain_zh: 丙酮酸羧化酶加 PEPCK 要花掉一个 ATP 和一个 GTP 才把丙酮酸抬到 PEP；如果丙酮酸激酶仍然有活性，它会把 PEP 直接打回丙酮酸，肝脏就只是在原地兜圈子水解核苷酸。磷酸化因此堵住了这个漏洞。丙酮酸激酶不会变成磷酸酶，而它的生理反应放能太多、根本不可逆——这正是那条两酶旁路存在的理由。肌肉不进行糖异生，它既没有通向葡萄糖的 PEPCK 通量，也没有葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶。

sections.title_en: Where the carbons go - tracing atoms through metabolism
sections.title_zh: 碳原子的去向——在代谢网络中追踪单个原子
sections.blurb_en: Follow individual carbon atoms from glucose, fat and amino acids through pyruvate, the citric acid cycle and the urea cycle, so that you can say exactly what can and cannot be made from what, and answer any isotope-labelling question from first principles.
sections.blurb_zh: 跟着单个碳原子从葡萄糖、脂肪和氨基酸走过丙酮酸、三羧酸循环和尿素循环，从而能准确说出什么能变成什么、什么不能，并从原理出发回答任何同位素标记题。

cards.en: Map the six carbons of glucose onto pyruvate before tracing anything else. Aldolase cuts fructose 1,6-bisphosphate between C3 and C4, giving dihydroxyacetone phosphate from glucose C1-C2-C3 and glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate from glucose C4-C5-C6. Triose phosphate isomerase then converts DHAP to GAP, and in doing so the phosphate-bearing carbon stays phosphate-bearing: glucose C1 becomes C3 of GAP and glucose C3 becomes C1 of GAP. Because the three carbons of glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate keep their positions through 1,3-bisphosphoglycerate, 3-phosphoglycerate, phosphoenolpyruvate and pyruvate, the result is fixed: the carboxyl of pyruvate comes from glucose C3 and C4, the carbonyl carbon from glucose C2 and C5, and the methyl group from glucose C1 and C6. Every isotope question in this section starts from this map.
cards.zh: 在追踪任何同位素之前，先把葡萄糖的六个碳映射到丙酮酸上。醛缩酶在 C3 与 C4 之间切开果糖-1,6-二磷酸，上半段（葡萄糖 C1-C2-C3）成为磷酸二羟丙酮 DHAP，下半段（葡萄糖 C4-C5-C6）成为 3-磷酸甘油醛 GAP。磷酸丙糖异构酶把 DHAP 转成 GAP 时，带磷酸的碳仍然带磷酸：葡萄糖 C1 变成 GAP 的 C3，葡萄糖 C3 变成 GAP 的 C1。由于 3-磷酸甘油醛的三个碳在 1,3-二磷酸甘油酸、3-磷酸甘油酸、磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸直到丙酮酸的过程中位置不变，结论是固定的：丙酮酸的羧基来自葡萄糖 C3 和 C4，中间的羰基碳来自葡萄糖 C2 和 C5，甲基来自葡萄糖 C1 和 C6。本节所有同位素题目都从这张映射图出发。
cards.see: L8 · aldolase and the triose phosphates

cards.en: The first CO2 of glucose oxidation is released before the citric acid cycle begins. Pyruvate dehydrogenase removes the carboxyl carbon of pyruvate, so the first two CO2 per glucose carry glucose C3 and C4. What enters the cycle as the acetyl group is the remainder: the carbonyl carbon of acetyl-CoA is glucose C2 or C5, and the methyl carbon of acetyl-CoA is glucose C1 or C6. Counting the six CO2 of complete glucose oxidation, two leave at pyruvate dehydrogenase and four leave inside the cycle, two per turn across the two turns that one glucose supports. This is also why the pyruvate dehydrogenase step is the point of no return for carbohydrate carbon: once that decarboxylation has happened, the carbon cannot go back to glucose.
cards.zh: 葡萄糖氧化释放的第一个 CO2 发生在三羧酸循环之前。丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体脱去的是丙酮酸的羧基碳，因此每分子葡萄糖最先放出的两个 CO2 带的是葡萄糖 C3 和 C4。以乙酰基形式进入循环的是剩下的部分：乙酰CoA 的羰基碳来自葡萄糖 C2 或 C5，乙酰CoA 的甲基碳来自葡萄糖 C1 或 C6。把葡萄糖完全氧化产生的六个 CO2 算清楚：两个在丙酮酸脱氢酶这一步放出，四个在循环内部放出，一圈两个、一分子葡萄糖对应两圈。这也是为什么丙酮酸脱氢酶这一步是糖代谢碳原子的不归点——一旦这个脱羧发生，该碳原子就再也回不到葡萄糖。

cards.en: The molecule regenerated unchanged in every turn of the citric acid cycle is oxaloacetate, not acetyl-CoA. Acetyl-CoA is the fuel: its two carbons are consumed by condensation at citrate synthase and are not handed back. Oxaloacetate is the carrier: four carbons in at citrate synthase, four carbons out at malate dehydrogenase, acting catalytically, so a small pool can oxidise a large amount of acetyl group. The isotope consequence is the statement most often made backwards: the two CO2 released in a given turn, at isocitrate dehydrogenase and at alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase, come from carbons that were part of oxaloacetate, not from the acetyl group that has just entered.
cards.zh: 三羧酸循环中每转一圈原样再生的分子是草酰乙酸，而不是乙酰CoA。乙酰CoA 是燃料：它的两个碳在柠檬酸合酶那一步被缩合消耗掉，不会被交还。草酰乙酸才是载体：在柠檬酸合酶处以四碳进入，在苹果酸脱氢酶处以四碳退出，起的是催化剂式的作用，所以很小的草酰乙酸池就能氧化大量乙酰基。由此得出的同位素结论正是最常被说反的一句：某一圈中放出的两个 CO2，即异柠檬酸脱氢酶和 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶脱下的那两个，来自原本属于草酰乙酸的碳，而不是来自刚刚进入的那个乙酰基。

cards.en: Beyond the first turn the label is scrambled, and this is a structural fact rather than a bookkeeping convenience. The acetyl carbons that survive the first turn end up in succinate, and succinate and fumarate are symmetric molecules whose two halves are chemically indistinguishable, so no enzyme downstream can tell which end came from the acetyl group. From that step onward the label is distributed over both ends of the four-carbon skeleton. Acetyl-derived carbon therefore begins to appear in CO2 from the second turn, but a share of the label is retained at every turn, so complete release is approached asymptotically instead of being reached after some fixed number of turns.
cards.zh: 过了第一圈，标记就被打乱了，这是分子结构决定的事实，而不是记账上的方便处理。第一圈中幸存下来的乙酰基碳最终进入琥珀酸，而琥珀酸和延胡索酸都是对称分子，两端在化学上无法区分，下游的酶无法判断哪一端来自乙酰基。从这一步开始，标记就分布在四碳骨架的两端。因此来自乙酰基的碳从第二圈起才开始出现在 CO2 中，但每一圈都会有一部分标记被保留下来，完全释放是渐近逼近的，而不是在某个固定圈数之后就完成。

cards.en: Fatty acids are not broken down into pyruvate. Beta-oxidation cleaves the chain two carbons at a time directly to acetyl-CoA, which condenses with oxaloacetate at citrate synthase; pyruvate is never an intermediate on that route. The step that would be needed to run the flow backwards, pyruvate dehydrogenase, is physiologically irreversible, so acetyl-CoA cannot be turned back into pyruvate. And going the long way round the cycle gains nothing: two carbons enter as the acetyl group and two carbons leave as CO2 in the same turn, so oxaloacetate is regenerated but never increased. Acetyl-CoA can be oxidised, stored as fat, or converted to ketone bodies and cholesterol, but it cannot yield net glucose.
cards.zh: 脂肪酸并不是被分解成丙酮酸的。β-氧化每次切下两个碳，直接生成乙酰CoA，乙酰CoA 在柠檬酸合酶处与草酰乙酸缩合；这条路上根本没有丙酮酸这个中间物。要让碳流倒着走，必须逆转丙酮酸脱氢酶那一步，而这一步在生理条件下不可逆，所以乙酰CoA 不能变回丙酮酸。绕循环走一大圈也毫无收益：两个碳以乙酰基进入，同一圈里就有两个碳以 CO2 离开，草酰乙酸只是被再生，数量并没有增加。乙酰CoA 可以被氧化、可以存成脂肪、可以变成酮体和胆固醇，但不能净生成葡萄糖。

cards.en: Three routes really do move lipid carbon into glucose, and each deserves to be named precisely. First, the glycerol backbone: lipolysis frees glycerol, the liver phosphorylates it with glycerol kinase to glycerol 3-phosphate and oxidises that to dihydroxyacetone phosphate, a glycolytic intermediate; in tripalmitin this is 3 carbons out of 51. Second, odd-chain fatty acids: the last round of beta-oxidation leaves propionyl-CoA, which propionyl-CoA carboxylase converts to D-methylmalonyl-CoA using biotin, ATP and bicarbonate, an epimerase converts to the L isomer, and methylmalonyl-CoA mutase rearranges to succinyl-CoA using adenosylcobalamin — a genuine four-carbon addition. Third, in plants and many microorganisms the glyoxylate cycle: isocitrate lyase and malate synthase bypass both decarboxylations so that two acetyl-CoA yield one four-carbon succinate. Mammals have neither of those two enzymes, which is why a germinating oilseed turns its oil into sucrose and a starving human cannot.
cards.zh: 确实有三条路能把脂类的碳送进葡萄糖，每一条都要说准确。第一，甘油骨架：脂解释放甘油，肝脏用甘油激酶把它磷酸化成3-磷酸甘油，再氧化成磷酸二羟丙酮，直接进入糖酵解／糖异生；在三棕榈酸甘油酯里这只占 51 个碳中的 3 个。第二，奇数碳脂肪酸：β-氧化的最后一轮剩下丙酰CoA，丙酰CoA 羧化酶以生物素、ATP 和碳酸氢根把它变成 D-甲基丙二酰CoA，差向异构酶转成 L 型，甲基丙二酰CoA 变位酶再以腺苷钴胺素（维生素 B12）重排成琥珀酰CoA——这是真正的四碳净增加。第三，植物和许多微生物有乙醛酸循环：异柠檬酸裂解酶和苹果酸合酶绕过两次脱羧，使两分子乙酰CoA 生成一分子四碳琥珀酸。哺乳动物这两个酶都没有，所以萌发的油料种子能把油变成蔗糖，而挨饿的人做不到。

cards.en: The glucogenic/ketogenic rule is about the entry point, not about the name of the amino acid. A carbon skeleton that enters as pyruvate or as any citric acid cycle intermediate — alpha-ketoglutarate, succinyl-CoA, fumarate, oxaloacetate — is glucogenic, because a four-carbon intermediate can leave the cycle as malate, be oxidised to oxaloacetate and be decarboxylated to phosphoenolpyruvate. A skeleton that enters as acetyl-CoA or acetoacetyl-CoA is ketogenic, for exactly the reason fatty acids are: those two carbons are matched by two CO2. Leucine and lysine are the only two purely ketogenic amino acids, because their entire skeletons are degraded to acetoacetate and acetyl-CoA with no fragment reaching pyruvate or the cycle. Isoleucine, phenylalanine, tyrosine, tryptophan and threonine are both, splitting into a glucogenic and a ketogenic fragment; all the others are glucogenic.
cards.zh: 生糖／生酮的判断规则看的是碳骨架的入口，而不是氨基酸的名字。凡是以丙酮酸或任何三羧酸循环中间物（α-酮戊二酸、琥珀酰CoA、延胡索酸、草酰乙酸）形式进入的骨架都是生糖的，因为四碳中间物可以以苹果酸形式离开循环，氧化成草酰乙酸，再脱羧生成磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸。凡是以乙酰CoA 或乙酰乙酰CoA 形式进入的骨架都是生酮的，理由和脂肪酸完全一样：进去两个碳，同一圈就有两个 CO2 出去。亮氨酸和赖氨酸是仅有的两个纯生酮氨基酸，因为它们的整个碳骨架都降解成乙酰乙酸和乙酰CoA，没有任何片段能到达丙酮酸或循环中间物。异亮氨酸、苯丙氨酸、酪氨酸、色氨酸和苏氨酸兼有两性，会裂成一个生糖片段和一个生酮片段；其余全部是生糖的。

cards.en: The cycle is amphibolic, and its intermediates are being withdrawn all the time — this is cataplerosis. Citrate leaves the matrix on the tricarboxylate carrier and is cleaved by ATP citrate lyase to supply cytosolic acetyl-CoA for fatty acid and cholesterol synthesis. Alpha-ketoglutarate is transaminated to glutamate, and from glutamate come glutamine, proline and arginine, plus every amino group that a transaminase moves. Oxaloacetate is transaminated to aspartate, which donates one nitrogen to the urea cycle, nitrogen to the purine ring, and the carbon-plus-nitrogen framework of the pyrimidine ring. Succinyl-CoA condenses with glycine in the first, rate-limiting step of haem synthesis. And oxaloacetate is drawn off to phosphoenolpyruvate for gluconeogenesis. Each of these is a net removal of carbon from a pool that is supposed to be catalytic.
cards.zh: 三羧酸循环是双重（两用）代谢途径，它的中间产物一直在被抽走——这就是所谓的 cataplerosis（耗竭性外流）。柠檬酸经三羧酸转运体离开线粒体基质，被 ATP-柠檬酸裂解酶切开，为脂肪酸和胆固醇合成提供胞质乙酰CoA。α-酮戊二酸经转氨变成谷氨酸，再由谷氨酸衍生出谷氨酰胺、脯氨酸和精氨酸，以及转氨酶搬运的每一个氨基。草酰乙酸经转氨变成天冬氨酸，它向尿素循环提供一个氮、向嘌呤环提供氮，并提供嘧啶环的碳氮骨架。琥珀酰CoA 与甘氨酸缩合，构成血红素合成的第一步也是限速步骤。草酰乙酸本身还要被抽去做磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸用于糖异生。这每一项都是从一个本应保持催化量的池子里净抽走碳。

cards.en: Because the intermediates are catalytic, every withdrawal has to be matched by a topping-up reaction, and the main anaplerotic reaction in mammals is pyruvate carboxylase: pyruvate plus bicarbonate plus ATP gives oxaloacetate in the mitochondrial matrix, with biotin as the carboxyl carrier. Its regulation is the elegant part — the enzyme is essentially inactive without acetyl-CoA as an allosteric activator, so a rise in acetyl-CoA, whether because fuel is abundant or because oxaloacetate has run short, sends pyruvate towards oxaloacetate instead of towards more acetyl-CoA. Other anaplerotic inputs are the propionyl-CoA route to succinyl-CoA from odd-chain fatty acids and from valine, isoleucine, methionine and threonine; glutamate and glutamine feeding alpha-ketoglutarate; and aspartate feeding oxaloacetate. Note that pyruvate carboxylase is simultaneously the first committed step of gluconeogenesis from pyruvate.
cards.zh: 正因为中间产物是催化量的，每一次抽走都必须由回补反应补上，而哺乳动物最主要的回补反应（anaplerotic reaction）是丙酮酸羧化酶：丙酮酸 + 碳酸氢根 + ATP 在线粒体基质中生成草酰乙酸，由生物素充当羧基载体。它的调控是最精妙的部分——没有乙酰CoA 作为别构激活剂时这个酶基本没有活性，因此乙酰CoA 一升高，无论是因为燃料充足还是因为草酰乙酸不够，都会把丙酮酸导向草酰乙酸，而不是导向更多的乙酰CoA。其他回补途径包括：奇数碳脂肪酸以及缬氨酸、异亮氨酸、甲硫氨酸、苏氨酸经丙酰CoA 生成琥珀酰CoA；谷氨酸和谷氨酰胺补充 α-酮戊二酸；天冬氨酸补充草酰乙酸。注意丙酮酸羧化酶同时也是丙酮酸糖异生的第一个关键步骤。

cards.en: The Cori cycle is muscle anaerobic glycolysis plus hepatic gluconeogenesis, and nothing else. Working muscle converts glucose to lactate, the lactate travels in the blood to the liver, lactate dehydrogenase gives pyruvate back, and gluconeogenesis rebuilds glucose that returns to the muscle. It has no connection to the pentose phosphate pathway, which is a separate branch off glucose 6-phosphate that produces NADPH and ribose 5-phosphate and returns its carbon to glycolysis, not to muscle. The glucose-alanine cycle follows the same carbon route with a different carrier: muscle transaminates pyruvate with glutamate using ALT to make alanine, alanine travels to the liver, and there the transamination is reversed so that the carbon enters gluconeogenesis while the nitrogen is released for the urea cycle. Cori moves carbon only; glucose-alanine moves carbon and nitrogen at the same time.
cards.zh: 乳酸循环（Cori cycle）就是肌肉的无氧糖酵解加上肝脏的糖异生，没有别的成分。做功的肌肉把葡萄糖变成乳酸，乳酸经血液到肝脏，乳酸脱氢酶把它变回丙酮酸，糖异生再造出葡萄糖送回肌肉。它与磷酸戊糖途径没有任何关系——磷酸戊糖途径是从 6-磷酸葡萄糖分出去的另一条支路，产生 NADPH 和 5-磷酸核糖，其碳最终回到糖酵解，而不是回到肌肉。葡萄糖-丙氨酸循环走的是同一条碳路线，只是换了载体：肌肉用 ALT 把丙酮酸与谷氨酸转氨生成丙氨酸，丙氨酸到肝脏后转氨反向进行，碳进入糖异生，氮被释放出来交给尿素循环。乳酸循环只运碳；葡萄糖-丙氨酸循环同时运碳和运氮。

cards.en: Muscle glycolysis to lactate yields 2 ATP per glucose. Rebuilding that glucose in the liver from 2 lactate costs 2 ATP at pyruvate carboxylase, 2 GTP at phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase and 2 ATP at phosphoglycerate kinase, that is 6 high-energy phosphates. One turn of the Cori cycle therefore costs the organism a net 4 high-energy phosphates. That is not waste: it shifts the energetic burden to the liver, which is well oxygenated, lets muscle keep contracting while its own oxygen supply is limiting, and above all it keeps the carbon. No carbon is lost in a turn of the Cori cycle, because lactate has the same three carbons as pyruvate and nothing is decarboxylated. Compare this with roughly 30-32 ATP for the complete oxidation of one glucose to see how expensive the loop is.
cards.zh: 肌肉把葡萄糖酵解成乳酸，每分子葡萄糖净得 2 个 ATP。肝脏用 2 分子乳酸重建这分子葡萄糖，在丙酮酸羧化酶处耗 2 个 ATP、在磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸羧激酶处耗 2 个 GTP、在磷酸甘油酸激酶处耗 2 个 ATP，共 6 个高能磷酸键。因此乳酸循环转一圈，机体净支出 4 个高能磷酸键。这不是浪费：它把能量负担转移给供氧良好的肝脏，让肌肉在自身供氧受限时仍能持续收缩，而最关键的是把碳保住了。乳酸循环转一圈不丢碳，因为乳酸与丙酮酸同为三碳，全程没有脱羧。把它和一分子葡萄糖完全氧化的约 30–32 个 ATP 对照，就能看出这个环路有多昂贵。

cards.en: The carbon of urea comes from bicarbonate, not from an amino acid skeleton. Carbamoyl phosphate synthetase I in the mitochondrial matrix fixes bicarbonate together with free ammonium at a cost of 2 ATP; ornithine transcarbamoylase transfers the carbamoyl group to ornithine to give citrulline, and that carbon stays with the molecule through argininosuccinate and arginine until arginase releases it as urea. The two nitrogens arrive by different routes: the first as free ammonium fixed by CPS-1 in the matrix, largely from oxidative deamination of glutamate by glutamate dehydrogenase; the second from the amino group of aspartate when argininosuccinate synthetase acts in the cytosol. The fumarate released by argininosuccinate lyase is hydrated to malate and oxidised to oxaloacetate, which is transaminated back to aspartate — the link that makes the urea cycle and the citric acid cycle one connected system.
cards.zh: 尿素的碳来自碳酸氢根，而不是来自任何氨基酸的碳骨架。线粒体基质中的氨甲酰磷酸合成酶 I（CPS-1）耗 2 个 ATP 把碳酸氢根与游离铵离子固定成氨甲酰磷酸；鸟氨酸氨甲酰转移酶（OTC）把氨甲酰基转给鸟氨酸生成瓜氨酸，这个碳随后一直留在分子上，经精氨琥珀酸、精氨酸，直到精氨酸酶把它作为尿素释放出来。尿素的两个氮来路不同：第一个是基质中由 CPS-1 固定的游离铵，主要来自谷氨酸脱氢酶对谷氨酸的氧化脱氨；第二个来自胞质中精氨琥珀酸合成酶反应里天冬氨酸的氨基。精氨琥珀酸裂解酶放出的延胡索酸被水合成苹果酸、氧化成草酰乙酸，再转氨变回天冬氨酸——正是这一环把尿素循环和三羧酸循环连成一个整体。

cards.en: In prolonged fasting the liver drains oxaloacetate into gluconeogenesis at the same moment that beta-oxidation is flooding the matrix with acetyl-CoA. With too little oxaloacetate available for citrate synthase, acetyl-CoA is diverted into acetoacetate, D-beta-hydroxybutyrate and acetone. This is what the old phrase about fat burning in the flame of carbohydrate describes. The carbon-tracing consequence is what matters clinically: ketone bodies are built from acetyl-CoA and are therefore not glucogenic, so ketosis gives the brain an alternative fuel but never removes the glucose requirement, and that glucose still has to be made from amino acids, lactate and glycerol. In uncontrolled type 1 diabetes the same mechanism runs without the restraint of insulin and produces ketoacidosis.
cards.zh: 长期饥饿时，肝脏一方面把草酰乙酸抽去做糖异生，另一方面 β-氧化正在向基质里灌入大量乙酰CoA。草酰乙酸不足以供柠檬酸合酶缩合，乙酰CoA 就被转向乙酰乙酸、D-β-羟丁酸和丙酮这三种酮体。老话说的「脂肪在糖的火焰中燃烧」讲的就是这件事。真正有临床意义的是碳流的结论：酮体是由乙酰CoA 造出来的，因此不是生糖物质，酮症只能给大脑提供一种替代燃料，绝不能取消机体对葡萄糖的需求，那部分葡萄糖仍然必须由氨基酸、乳酸和甘油来生成。在失控的 1 型糖尿病中，同一机制在缺乏胰岛素制约的情况下运行，就产生酮症酸中毒。

cards.en: Two carbamoyl phosphate synthetases exist and they differ in compartment, nitrogen donor and regulation. CPS-1 is mitochondrial, uses free ammonium, requires N-acetylglutamate as an obligatory allosteric activator and opens the urea cycle. CPS-2 is cytosolic, uses the amide nitrogen of glutamine, needs no N-acetylglutamate and opens pyrimidine synthesis. The clinical picture that joins them is ornithine transcarbamoylase deficiency: carbamoyl phosphate cannot be used by the urea cycle, ammonia rises, and the accumulated carbamoyl phosphate leaks into the cytosol and enters the pyrimidine pathway below CPS-2, so the patient shows hyperammonaemia together with orotic aciduria. One carbon fixed as bicarbonate ends up either in urea or in a pyrimidine ring, depending only on which synthetase captured it.
cards.zh: 体内有两种氨甲酰磷酸合成酶，区别在于区室、供氮体和调控方式。CPS-1 位于线粒体，使用游离铵，必须有 N-乙酰谷氨酸作为别构激活剂，开启的是尿素循环。CPS-2 位于胞质，使用谷氨酰胺的酰胺氮，不需要 N-乙酰谷氨酸，开启的是嘧啶合成。把两者联系起来的典型临床图景是鸟氨酸氨甲酰转移酶（OTC）缺乏症：氨甲酰磷酸无法被尿素循环利用，血氨升高，而堆积的氨甲酰磷酸漏入胞质，从 CPS-2 的下游进入嘧啶合成途径，于是患者同时表现为高氨血症和乳清酸尿。同一个以碳酸氢根形式固定下来的碳，最终是变成尿素还是变成嘧啶环，只取决于它被哪一种合成酶抓住。
