quiz.q_en: A hepatocyte is given glucose labelled with 14C at C1 only and oxidises it completely through glycolysis, pyruvate dehydrogenase and the citric acid cycle. At which point does that labelled carbon first leave the cell as CO2?
quiz.q_zh: 给肝细胞提供只在 C1 位标记 14C 的葡萄糖，并让它经糖酵解、丙酮酸脱氢酶和三羧酸循环被完全氧化。这个被标记的碳最早在哪一步以 CO2 的形式离开？

options.en: At the aldolase step, because cleavage of fructose 1,6-bisphosphate releases the terminal carbon of the hexose as CO2 before either triose phosphate is formed.
options.zh: 在醛缩酶这一步，因为果糖-1,6-二磷酸的裂解会在两个丙糖磷酸生成之前先把己糖的末端碳以 CO2 放掉。

options.en: At the pyruvate dehydrogenase step, because C1 of glucose becomes the carboxyl carbon of pyruvate and that carboxyl is exactly the carbon the complex removes.
options.zh: 在丙酮酸脱氢酶这一步，因为葡萄糖 C1 在糖酵解中变成了丙酮酸的羧基碳，而丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体脱下的正是这个羧基碳。

options.en: At isocitrate dehydrogenase during the very first turn of the cycle, since the two acetyl carbons are decarboxylated as soon as citrate has been formed and isomerised.
options.zh: 在循环第一圈的异柠檬酸脱氢酶处，因为柠檬酸一旦生成并异构化成异柠檬酸，刚进来的乙酰基那两个碳就会被立刻脱羧掉。

options.en: Only from the second turn of the cycle onward, because C1 becomes the methyl carbon of acetyl-CoA and the first turn releases only carbons contributed by oxaloacetate.
options.zh: 要到循环第二圈才开始，因为 C1 变成了乙酰CoA 的甲基碳，而第一圈放出的只是由草酰乙酸提供的碳。

quiz.explain_en: Glucose C1 becomes C3 of glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate after triose phosphate isomerase, hence the methyl carbon of pyruvate and of the acetyl group, which survives the first turn intact. Pyruvate dehydrogenase removes only the carboxyl carbon, which comes from glucose C3 and C4. The claim that acetyl carbons are decarboxylated at isocitrate dehydrogenase in the first turn reverses the classic isotope result. Aldolase is a carbon-carbon lyase that cleaves a hexose into two trioses and releases no CO2 at all.
quiz.explain_zh: 经磷酸丙糖异构酶后葡萄糖 C1 变成 3-磷酸甘油醛的 C3，因而成为丙酮酸和乙酰基的甲基碳，第一圈中原封不动地保留下来。丙酮酸脱氢酶脱下的只是羧基碳，那来自葡萄糖 C3 和 C4。说乙酰基的碳在第一圈的异柠檬酸脱氢酶处被脱羧，正好把经典同位素实验的结论说反了。醛缩酶是把己糖裂成两个丙糖的碳碳裂解酶，根本不放出 CO2。
quiz.see: L8 · aldolase and the triose phosphates

quiz.q_en: Which two carbons of glucose end up as the carboxyl group of pyruvate?
quiz.q_zh: 葡萄糖的哪两个碳最终成为丙酮酸的羧基？

options.en: C3 and C4, the two carbons that flank the aldolase cleavage site and that become the aldehyde carbon of glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate in each half of the molecule.
options.zh: C3 和 C4，即醛缩酶切口两侧的那两个碳，它们在各自的半分子中成为 3-磷酸甘油醛的醛基碳。

options.en: C2 and C5, which become the middle carbon of glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate and are oxidised to the carboxyl group as the phosphate is transferred to ADP.
options.zh: C2 和 C5，它们成为 3-磷酸甘油醛的中间碳，并在磷酸转给 ADP 时被氧化成羧基。

options.en: C1 and C4, because the two halves of fructose 1,6-bisphosphate are numbered in the same direction, so the two original C1-type carbons stay equivalent.
options.zh: C1 和 C4，因为果糖-1,6-二磷酸的上下两半按同一方向编号，两个原本属于 C1 型的碳始终是等价的。

options.en: C1 and C6, because these are the phosphate-bearing carbons of the two triose phosphates and a phosphorylated carbon is oxidised to a carboxyl at the kinase step.
options.zh: C1 和 C6，因为这两个碳是两个丙糖磷酸上带磷酸的碳，而带磷酸的碳会在激酶那一步被氧化成羧基。

quiz.explain_en: Aldolase cuts between C3 and C4, so glucose C4 becomes the aldehyde carbon of the glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate from the lower half, and glucose C3 becomes the aldehyde carbon after triose phosphate isomerase acts on dihydroxyacetone phosphate. That aldehyde is oxidised by GAPDH and ends up as the carboxyl of pyruvate. C1 and C6 stay phosphate-bearing and become the methyl group; C2 and C5 become the carbonyl carbon; and the claim about C1 and C4 misreads the numbering, since the two halves are read in opposite directions relative to the phosphate.
quiz.explain_zh: 醛缩酶在 C3 与 C4 之间切开，所以葡萄糖 C4 成为下半段 3-磷酸甘油醛的醛基碳，而葡萄糖 C3 在磷酸丙糖异构酶把 DHAP 转成 GAP 之后成为醛基碳。这个醛基被 GAPDH 氧化，最终成为丙酮酸的羧基。C1 和 C6 始终带着磷酸，最后成为甲基；C2 和 C5 成为羰基碳；而说 C1 与 C4 的那种看法把编号读错了，两个半段相对于磷酸的方向恰恰是相反的。
quiz.see: L8 · aldolase and the triose phosphates

quiz.q_en: Acetyl-CoA labelled with 14C in both of its acetyl carbons is added to isolated mitochondria together with unlabelled oxaloacetate. How much of the label appears in the CO2 released during the first turn of the cycle?
quiz.q_zh: 把两个乙酰基碳都用 14C 标记的乙酰CoA 与未标记的草酰乙酸一起加入分离的线粒体。第一圈循环放出的 CO2 中含有多少标记？

options.en: Half of it, because isocitrate dehydrogenase removes an acetyl-derived carboxyl while alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase removes an oxaloacetate-derived one in the same turn.
options.zh: 一半，因为同一圈中异柠檬酸脱氢酶脱下的是来自乙酰基的羧基，而 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶脱下的是来自草酰乙酸的羧基。

options.en: All of it, because the acetyl group is the substrate being oxidised and the four-carbon carrier is regenerated completely intact at the end of every turn.
options.zh: 全部，因为被氧化的底物就是乙酰基，而四碳载体在每一圈结束时都完整无损地再生出来。

options.en: None of it: both of the CO2 released during the first turn come from carbons donated by oxaloacetate, and the two acetyl carbons stay in the four-carbon products.
options.zh: 一点也没有：第一圈的两个 CO2 都来自草酰乙酸提供的碳，乙酰基的碳留在四碳产物里。

options.en: Three quarters of it, because citrate is a symmetric molecule and aconitase distributes the label evenly over its three carboxyl arms before decarboxylation.
options.zh: 四分之三，因为柠檬酸是对称分子，顺乌头酸酶在脱羧之前把标记均匀分配到三个羧基臂上。

quiz.explain_en: This is the classic isotope result: in the first turn the CO2 released by isocitrate dehydrogenase and by alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase both carry oxaloacetate carbons, and the two acetyl carbons are still present in succinate. The idea that all of the label is released treats acetyl-CoA as the molecule regenerated unchanged, which is the role of oxaloacetate. The half-and-half answer and the three-quarters answer both assume scrambling at the citrate stage, but citrate is prochiral and aconitase acts stereospecifically, so no randomisation occurs until succinate.
quiz.explain_zh: 这是经典的同位素实验结论：第一圈中异柠檬酸脱氢酶和 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶放出的 CO2 带的都是草酰乙酸的碳，两个乙酰基碳此时仍留在琥珀酸里。认为标记全部被放出，等于把乙酰CoA 当成了每圈原样再生的分子，而那是草酰乙酸的角色。说一半或四分之三，都是假定在柠檬酸阶段标记就被打乱了；但柠檬酸是前手性分子，顺乌头酸酶具有立体专一性，直到琥珀酸之前都不会发生随机化。

quiz.q_en: Why does labelling the methyl carbon of acetyl-CoA fail to produce label at one single defined position of oxaloacetate after one turn of the cycle?
quiz.q_zh: 为什么把乙酰CoA 的甲基碳标记之后，循环转一圈并不能在草酰乙酸的某一个确定位置上得到标记？

options.en: Because succinate and fumarate are symmetric molecules whose two halves are chemically indistinguishable, so the label is distributed between two positions from that step onward.
options.zh: 因为琥珀酸和延胡索酸是对称分子，两端在化学上无法区分，从这一步起标记就分布到两个位置上。

options.en: Because aconitase moves the hydroxyl group between two adjacent carbons and randomises the label at the citrate stage, well before any decarboxylation takes place.
options.zh: 因为顺乌头酸酶把羟基在相邻两个碳之间移动，在柠檬酸阶段就把标记随机化了，远早于任何脱羧步骤。

options.en: Because malate dehydrogenase operates close to equilibrium and continually shuffles individual carbons between malate and oxaloacetate in both directions.
options.zh: 因为苹果酸脱氢酶接近平衡运行，不断地在苹果酸与草酰乙酸之间双向交换单个碳原子。

options.en: Because the methyl carbon of the acetyl group is released as CO2 during the first turn, so only the carbonyl carbon can be traced into oxaloacetate at all.
options.zh: 因为乙酰基的甲基碳在第一圈就以 CO2 放掉了，只有羰基碳还能被追踪进草酰乙酸。

quiz.explain_en: Succinate has a twofold axis of symmetry, and succinate dehydrogenase and the enzymes after it cannot distinguish the end that came from the acetyl group from the end that came from oxaloacetate, so the label is split between two positions of the four-carbon skeleton. Aconitase does not randomise anything: citrate is prochiral and the enzyme is stereospecific. Malate dehydrogenase interconverts whole molecules and never exchanges individual carbons. And no acetyl carbon leaves as CO2 in the first turn.
quiz.explain_zh: 琥珀酸具有二重对称轴，琥珀酸脱氢酶及其下游的酶无法区分哪一端来自乙酰基、哪一端来自草酰乙酸，因此标记被分摊到四碳骨架的两个位置上。顺乌头酸酶不会造成随机化：柠檬酸是前手性分子，酶具有立体专一性。苹果酸脱氢酶转换的是整个分子，从不交换单个碳原子。而在第一圈里，乙酰基的碳一个也没有以 CO2 离开。

quiz.q_en: Why can a mammal not obtain a net gain of glucose carbon from palmitate?
quiz.q_zh: 为什么哺乳动物无法从棕榈酸获得净增加的葡萄糖碳？

options.en: Because all the NADH produced by beta-oxidation is consumed by the respiratory chain, so the cytosolic reduction at glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate dehydrogenase cannot occur.
options.zh: 因为 β-氧化产生的 NADH 全部被呼吸链消耗掉，胞质中 3-磷酸甘油醛脱氢酶那一步的还原反应无法进行。

options.en: Because beta-oxidation runs in the mitochondrial matrix while gluconeogenesis is cytosolic, and no carrier exists that can move an acetyl group across the inner membrane.
options.zh: 因为 β-氧化在线粒体基质中进行而糖异生在胞质中进行，并且线粒体内膜上没有任何载体能够把乙酰基运到膜外的胞质里去。

options.en: Because pyruvate dehydrogenase is irreversible and the two carbons entering as acetyl-CoA are matched by two CO2 lost in the same turn, leaving no net carbon.
options.zh: 因为丙酮酸脱氢酶不可逆，而以乙酰CoA 进入的两个碳又被同一圈里放出的两个 CO2 抵消，没有净剩的碳。

options.en: Because palmitate cannot cross the inner mitochondrial membrane without carnitine, and the carnitine shuttle is switched off whenever gluconeogenesis is active.
options.zh: 因为棕榈酸如果没有肉碱就无法穿过线粒体内膜，而只要肝脏的糖异生在进行，肉碱穿梭系统就处于关闭状态。

quiz.explain_en: Two independent barriers are involved: the pyruvate dehydrogenase reaction cannot be run backwards, and even the long way round the cycle is carbon-neutral because each acetyl group is balanced by two decarboxylations. Acetyl groups do leave the matrix, as citrate on the tricarboxylate carrier, so the claim that no carrier exists is false. Carnitine palmitoyltransferase I is inhibited by malonyl-CoA in the fed state, not by gluconeogenesis, and fatty acid oxidation is in fact at its highest when gluconeogenesis runs. The NADH argument is also wrong, since beta-oxidation supplies the reducing equivalents and ATP that gluconeogenesis needs.
quiz.explain_zh: 这里有两道各自独立的屏障：丙酮酸脱氢酶反应不能倒着走；而且即使绕循环走一大圈，碳也是收支平衡的，因为每个乙酰基都被两次脱羧抵消。乙酰基其实是能离开基质的——以柠檬酸的形式经三羧酸转运体外运，所以说没有载体是错的。肉碱脂酰转移酶 I 在进食状态下受丙二酰CoA 抑制，而不是被糖异生关闭；恰恰相反，糖异生活跃时脂肪酸氧化最旺盛。NADH 的说法同样不成立，因为 β-氧化提供的正是糖异生所需的还原当量和 ATP。

quiz.q_en: A rat is fed heptadecanoate, a fatty acid with seventeen carbons, labelled uniformly with 14C. Which part of that molecule can contribute carbon to blood glucose?
quiz.q_zh: 给大鼠喂食均匀标记 14C 的十七碳脂肪酸（heptadecanoate）。这个分子的哪一部分的碳能进入血糖？

options.en: None of them, since fatty acid oxidation of any chain length yields only acetyl-CoA, and acetyl-CoA is not a glucogenic substrate in mammals.
options.zh: 一个也没有，因为任何链长的脂肪酸氧化都只产生乙酰CoA，而乙酰CoA 在哺乳动物中不是生糖底物。

options.en: The fourteen carbons released as seven acetyl-CoA, because the glyoxylate cycle converts them to succinate without any decarboxylation step.
options.zh: 以七分子乙酰CoA 形式放出的那十四个碳，因为乙醛酸循环能把它们不经脱羧地转变成琥珀酸。

options.en: Only the three carbons of the final propionyl-CoA, which is carboxylated to methylmalonyl-CoA and rearranged to succinyl-CoA, a four-carbon cycle intermediate.
options.zh: 只有最后剩下的丙酰CoA 的三个碳，它被羧化成甲基丙二酰CoA，再重排成四碳的循环中间物琥珀酰CoA。

options.en: All seventeen carbons, because every acetyl-CoA produced can be carboxylated to oxaloacetate and then decarboxylated to phosphoenolpyruvate by PEPCK.
options.zh: 全部十七个碳，因为生成的每一分子乙酰CoA 都能被羧化成草酰乙酸，再由 PEPCK 脱羧生成磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸。

quiz.explain_en: Seven rounds of beta-oxidation on a C17 chain leave seven acetyl-CoA plus one propionyl-CoA, and only the propionyl-CoA is glucogenic, through propionyl-CoA carboxylase and methylmalonyl-CoA mutase to succinyl-CoA. Acetyl-CoA cannot be carboxylated to oxaloacetate; pyruvate carboxylase acts on pyruvate, not on acetyl groups. The blanket answer that no carbon at all is glucogenic ignores the odd-chain remainder. And mammals have no isocitrate lyase or malate synthase, so the glyoxylate cycle is not available to a rat.
quiz.explain_zh: 十七碳链经七轮 β-氧化，剩下七分子乙酰CoA 加一分子丙酰CoA，其中只有丙酰CoA 是生糖的：经丙酰CoA 羧化酶和甲基丙二酰CoA 变位酶生成琥珀酰CoA。乙酰CoA 不能被羧化成草酰乙酸——丙酮酸羧化酶作用的底物是丙酮酸，不是乙酰基。笼统地说一个碳也进不去，则忽略了奇数碳留下的那三个碳。哺乳动物没有异柠檬酸裂解酶和苹果酸合酶，大鼠用不上乙醛酸循环。

quiz.q_en: A patient with vitamin B12 deficiency excretes large amounts of methylmalonate. Which reaction is blocked, and which carbon flow does the block interrupt?
quiz.q_zh: 一位维生素 B12 缺乏的患者尿中排出大量甲基丙二酸。被阻断的是哪一个反应？它中断了哪一条碳流？

options.en: Succinyl-CoA synthetase, which requires a nucleoside diphosphate, so the four-carbon unit cannot be released into the citric acid cycle as free succinate.
options.zh: 琥珀酰CoA 合成酶，它需要一个核苷二磷酸，于是四碳单位无法以游离琥珀酸的形式释放进三羧酸循环。

options.en: Propionyl-CoA carboxylase, a biotin enzyme, so propionate arising from odd-chain fatty acids can no longer be extended into a four-carbon unit at all.
options.zh: 丙酰CoA 羧化酶，一个以生物素为羧基载体的酶，于是来自奇数碳脂肪酸的丙酸再也无法被羧化延长成四碳单位，也就进不了循环。

options.en: Methylmalonyl-CoA mutase, which requires adenosylcobalamin, so propionyl-CoA from odd-chain fatty acids and from valine cannot reach succinyl-CoA.
options.zh: 甲基丙二酰CoA 变位酶，它需要腺苷钴胺素，于是来自奇数碳脂肪酸和缬氨酸的丙酰CoA 无法到达琥珀酰CoA。

options.en: Methylmalonyl-CoA epimerase, a pyridoxal phosphate enzyme, so the D isomer accumulates and can never be presented to the enzyme that follows it.
options.zh: 甲基丙二酰CoA 差向异构酶，一个磷酸吡哆醛酶，于是 D 型异构体堆积，永远无法交给它下游的那个酶。

quiz.explain_en: Methylmalonyl-CoA mutase is one of only two adenosylcobalamin-dependent enzymes in humans, and its substrate accumulates and is excreted when B12 is lacking; the interrupted flow is propionyl-CoA to succinyl-CoA, the route by which odd-chain fatty acids, valine, isoleucine, methionine and threonine become glucogenic. Propionyl-CoA carboxylase needs biotin, not B12, and a block there would raise propionate rather than methylmalonate. The epimerase requires no pyridoxal phosphate. Succinyl-CoA synthetase lies downstream of the lesion and is unaffected by B12.
quiz.explain_zh: 甲基丙二酰CoA 变位酶是人体中仅有的两个依赖腺苷钴胺素的酶之一，B12 缺乏时它的底物堆积并被排出；被中断的碳流正是丙酰CoA → 琥珀酰CoA，也就是奇数碳脂肪酸以及缬氨酸、异亮氨酸、甲硫氨酸、苏氨酸变成生糖物质的那条路。丙酰CoA 羧化酶需要的是生物素而不是 B12，它被阻断升高的是丙酸而不是甲基丙二酸。差向异构酶不需要磷酸吡哆醛。琥珀酰CoA 合成酶位于病变的下游，与 B12 无关。

quiz.q_en: A germinating oilseed converts stored triacylglycerol into sucrose in the dark. Which feature of its metabolism makes this possible, and why can mammalian liver not copy it?
quiz.q_zh: 萌发中的油料种子能在黑暗中把储存的三酰甘油变成蔗糖。它靠的是哪一项代谢特征？哺乳动物的肝脏为什么学不了？

options.en: Plants store their lipid as odd-chain fatty acids, so every round of beta-oxidation yields propionyl-CoA, while animal depot fat is made almost entirely of even-chain fatty acids.
options.zh: 植物把脂类储存成奇数碳脂肪酸，因此每一轮 β-氧化都产生丙酰CoA，而动物的储存脂肪几乎全部是偶数碳脂肪酸。

options.en: Plants oxidise fatty acids in peroxisomes rather than in mitochondria, and peroxisomal acetyl-CoA is exported straight to the cytosolic enzymes of gluconeogenesis.
options.zh: 植物在过氧化物酶体而不是线粒体中氧化脂肪酸，过氧化物酶体产生的乙酰CoA 可以直接输出给胞质的糖异生酶。

options.en: Plants run the citric acid cycle in reverse using ATP citrate lyase, so citrate is cleaved back to oxaloacetate and pyruvate, whereas animals run the cycle only forwards.
options.zh: 植物用 ATP-柠檬酸裂解酶让三羧酸循环倒转，把柠檬酸重新裂解成草酰乙酸和丙酮酸，而动物只能让循环正向运行。

options.en: Plants use isocitrate lyase and malate synthase inside the glyoxysome to bypass both decarboxylation steps, so that two acetyl-CoA yield a net four-carbon succinate; mammals possess neither enzyme.
options.zh: 植物用异柠檬酸裂解酶和苹果酸合酶绕过两次脱羧，使两分子乙酰CoA 净生成四碳的琥珀酸；哺乳动物这两个酶都没有。

quiz.explain_en: The glyoxylate cycle in the glyoxysome uses isocitrate lyase to split isocitrate into succinate and glyoxylate and malate synthase to condense glyoxylate with a second acetyl-CoA, so the two steps that would release CO2 are skipped and lipid carbon accumulates as a four-carbon acid. ATP citrate lyase exists in animals too and cleaves citrate to acetyl-CoA and oxaloacetate, which does not reverse the cycle. Seed oil is largely even-chain, so the odd-chain explanation is factually wrong. Plants do oxidise fatty acids in peroxisomes, but compartment alone would not solve the carbon-balance problem.
quiz.explain_zh: 乙醛酸循环发生在乙醛酸体中：异柠檬酸裂解酶把异柠檬酸切成琥珀酸和乙醛酸，苹果酸合酶再把乙醛酸与第二分子乙酰CoA 缩合，于是两个会放出 CO2 的步骤被跳过，脂类的碳以四碳酸的形式积累下来。ATP-柠檬酸裂解酶动物也有，它把柠檬酸切成乙酰CoA 和草酰乙酸，并不等于让循环倒转。种子油绝大部分是偶数碳，所以奇数碳的说法本身就与事实不符。植物确实在过氧化物酶体中氧化脂肪酸，但仅仅换个区室并不能解决碳收支的问题。

quiz.q_en: Which statement about ketogenic and glucogenic amino acids is correct?
quiz.q_zh: 关于生酮氨基酸和生糖氨基酸，下列哪一种说法是正确的？

options.en: Leucine and lysine are the only two whose skeletons yield acetoacetate and acetyl-CoA exclusively, with no fragment that reaches pyruvate or a cycle intermediate.
options.zh: 亮氨酸和赖氨酸是仅有的两个碳骨架只生成乙酰乙酸和乙酰CoA、没有任何片段能到达丙酮酸或循环中间物的氨基酸。

options.en: Alanine and glutamine are purely ketogenic because their carbon skeletons enter the cycle only after both of its decarboxylation steps have already taken place.
options.zh: 丙氨酸和谷氨酰胺是纯生酮的，因为它们的碳骨架要等到循环的两次脱羧都发生之后才进入。

options.en: Phenylalanine and tyrosine are purely ketogenic, since the aromatic ring is cleaved to acetoacetate and no four-carbon acid is produced from either of them.
options.zh: 苯丙氨酸和酪氨酸是纯生酮的，因为它们的芳香环在开环之后被裂解成乙酰乙酸，两者都不产生任何能够进入糖异生的四碳酸。

options.en: Isoleucine and threonine are purely ketogenic, because their degradation ends entirely in acetyl-CoA without passing through any citric acid cycle intermediate.
options.zh: 异亮氨酸和苏氨酸是纯生酮的，因为它们的降解全部终止于乙酰CoA，不经过任何三羧酸循环中间物。

quiz.explain_en: Leucine is degraded through HMG-CoA to acetoacetate plus acetyl-CoA, and lysine through the saccharopine and alpha-aminoadipate route to acetoacetyl-CoA, so neither yields any glucogenic fragment. Alanine gives pyruvate and glutamine gives alpha-ketoglutarate, making both strictly glucogenic. Phenylalanine and tyrosine yield fumarate as well as acetoacetate, so they are both glucogenic and ketogenic. Isoleucine yields succinyl-CoA in addition to acetyl-CoA, and threonine yields pyruvate or succinyl-CoA, so those are also mixed rather than purely ketogenic.
quiz.explain_zh: 亮氨酸经 HMG-CoA 降解为乙酰乙酸加乙酰CoA，赖氨酸经酵母氨酸和 α-氨基己二酸途径降解为乙酰乙酰CoA，两者都不产生任何生糖片段。丙氨酸给出丙酮酸，谷氨酰胺给出 α-酮戊二酸，二者都是严格生糖的。苯丙氨酸和酪氨酸除乙酰乙酸外还产生延胡索酸，所以既生糖又生酮。异亮氨酸除乙酰CoA 外还产生琥珀酰CoA，苏氨酸产生丙酮酸或琥珀酰CoA，因此它们同样是兼性的，而不是纯生酮的。

quiz.q_en: Phenylalanine and tyrosine are classified as both glucogenic and ketogenic. Which pair of degradation products accounts for that dual classification?
quiz.q_zh: 苯丙氨酸和酪氨酸被同时归为生糖和生酮氨基酸。是哪一对降解产物造成了这种双重归属？

options.en: Pyruvate, which is glucogenic because pyruvate carboxylase can act on it, together with acetoacetyl-CoA formed by thiolysis of the shortened aromatic side chain.
options.zh: 丙酮酸，因为丙酮酸羧化酶能作用于它而生糖，加上由缩短后的芳香族侧链经硫解生成的乙酰乙酰CoA。

options.en: Fumarate, a four-carbon cycle intermediate and therefore glucogenic, together with acetoacetate, a ketone body released when the aromatic ring is opened.
options.zh: 延胡索酸，它是四碳的循环中间物因而生糖，加上芳香环开环时释放出来的酮体乙酰乙酸。

options.en: Succinyl-CoA, which is glucogenic because it is a cycle intermediate, together with acetyl-CoA released from the side chain during the transamination step.
options.zh: 琥珀酰CoA，因为它是循环中间物而生糖，加上在转氨那一步从侧链上释放出来的乙酰CoA。

options.en: Alpha-ketoglutarate, which is glucogenic, together with acetone, which forms spontaneously from the aromatic ring once the ring has been hydroxylated by the monooxygenase.
options.zh: α-酮戊二酸，它是生糖的，加上芳香环被单加氧酶羟化之后自发生成的丙酮。

quiz.explain_en: Phenylalanine is hydroxylated to tyrosine, and the tyrosine pathway ends at fumarylacetoacetate, which fumarylacetoacetate hydrolase splits into fumarate and acetoacetate. Fumarate is a citric acid cycle intermediate and can leave as malate for gluconeogenesis, while acetoacetate is a ketone body. Succinyl-CoA comes from valine, isoleucine, methionine and threonine, not from the aromatic pair; alpha-ketoglutarate comes from glutamate, glutamine, proline, arginine and histidine; pyruvate comes from alanine, serine, glycine, cysteine and threonine.
quiz.explain_zh: 苯丙氨酸先被羟化为酪氨酸，酪氨酸途径终止于延胡索酰乙酰乙酸，延胡索酰乙酰乙酸水解酶把它切成延胡索酸和乙酰乙酸。延胡索酸是三羧酸循环中间物，可以以苹果酸形式离开循环去做糖异生；乙酰乙酸则是酮体。琥珀酰CoA 来自缬氨酸、异亮氨酸、甲硫氨酸和苏氨酸，与这对芳香族氨基酸无关；α-酮戊二酸来自谷氨酸、谷氨酰胺、脯氨酸、精氨酸和组氨酸；丙酮酸来自丙氨酸、丝氨酸、甘氨酸、半胱氨酸和苏氨酸。

quiz.q_en: Pyruvate carboxylase is almost inactive unless acetyl-CoA is bound as an allosteric activator. What is the metabolic logic of that control?
quiz.q_zh: 没有乙酰CoA 作为别构激活剂结合时，丙酮酸羧化酶几乎没有活性。这种调控的代谢逻辑是什么？

options.en: Rising acetyl-CoA means citrate synthase is saturated, so carboxylating pyruvate provides an alternative route by which acetyl groups can leave the matrix.
options.zh: 乙酰CoA 升高说明柠檬酸合酶已经饱和，于是把丙酮酸羧化就提供了另一条让乙酰基离开基质的出路。

options.en: Rising acetyl-CoA indicates a shortage of free coenzyme A, and carboxylating pyruvate is the quickest way to release coenzyme A back into the matrix pool.
options.zh: 乙酰CoA 升高说明游离辅酶 A 不足，而把丙酮酸羧化是让辅酶 A 回到基质池中最快的办法。

options.en: Rising acetyl-CoA signals either that fuel is abundant or that oxaloacetate has run short, so pyruvate is directed into oxaloacetate for anaplerosis and gluconeogenesis.
options.zh: 乙酰CoA 升高意味着要么燃料充足、要么草酰乙酸不足，于是丙酮酸被导向草酰乙酸，用于回补和糖异生。

options.en: Rising acetyl-CoA reports that ATP is abundant, so pyruvate is stored as oxaloacetate until the respiratory chain has capacity to oxidise it again.
options.zh: 乙酰CoA 升高报告 ATP 充足，于是丙酮酸被暂存为草酰乙酸，直到呼吸链重新有能力氧化它为止。

quiz.explain_en: Acetyl-CoA accumulates when beta-oxidation is fast or when there is not enough oxaloacetate for citrate synthase, and in both cases the correct response is to make more oxaloacetate, which is what pyruvate carboxylase does; the same reaction is also the first committed step of gluconeogenesis. Acetyl-CoA is not a direct report of ATP status, which is signalled by the ATP/AMP ratio at PFK-1 and by NADH. Carboxylating pyruvate consumes no acetyl-CoA at all, so it cannot be a route for acetyl groups to leave the matrix or a way of regenerating free coenzyme A.
quiz.explain_zh: 乙酰CoA 会在 β-氧化很快时、或在草酰乙酸不足以供柠檬酸合酶使用时堆积起来，这两种情况下正确的应答都是多造草酰乙酸，而这正是丙酮酸羧化酶所做的事；同一个反应也是糖异生的第一个关键步骤。乙酰CoA 并不直接报告 ATP 状态，那是由 PFK-1 处的 ATP/AMP 比值和 NADH 来报告的。羧化丙酮酸根本不消耗乙酰CoA，因此它既不可能成为乙酰基离开基质的通道，也不可能用来再生游离辅酶 A。

quiz.q_en: Haem synthesis begins by condensing succinyl-CoA with glycine. If an erythroid precursor sustains a high rate of haem synthesis, what must accompany it?
quiz.q_zh: 血红素合成的第一步是琥珀酰CoA 与甘氨酸缩合。如果一个红系前体细胞长时间维持高速的血红素合成，必须同时具备什么？

options.en: A higher flux through citrate synthase, because it is the acetyl-CoA that entered the cycle that is consumed by the withdrawal and therefore has to be replaced.
options.zh: 必须提高柠檬酸合酶的通量，因为被这次抽走所消耗掉的其实是进入循环的乙酰CoA，所以要靠更多的缩合反应把它补回来。

options.en: An increase in the glycine cleavage system, because glycine is the carbon donor that limits the rate while succinyl-CoA is regenerated intact at the end of the pathway.
options.zh: 必须增强甘氨酸裂解系统，因为甘氨酸才是真正限速的碳供体，而琥珀酰CoA 在血红素合成途径的末尾会被原样再生出来。

options.en: A fall in alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase activity, so that succinyl-CoA accumulates and the cycle is spared any further loss of its own intermediates.
options.zh: 必须降低 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶的活性，让琥珀酰CoA 在基质中积累起来，使循环不必再进一步损失自己的其他中间产物。

options.en: An anaplerotic input such as pyruvate carboxylase or the propionyl-CoA route, because the four-carbon unit withdrawn is not returned to the cycle by any later step.
options.zh: 必须有回补输入，例如丙酮酸羧化酶或丙酰CoA 途径，因为被抽走的那个四碳单位不会在后续任何一步被还给循环。

quiz.explain_en: Removing succinyl-CoA removes four carbons from a pool that works catalytically, so oxaloacetate falls unless something tops it up; pyruvate carboxylase and the propionyl-CoA route are the anaplerotic reactions that do so. Increasing citrate synthase flux does not help, because acetyl-CoA adds two carbons and loses two as CO2 in the same turn. Glycine is a substrate, not a regenerated carrier, and succinyl-CoA is consumed rather than returned. Slowing alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase would reduce the supply of succinyl-CoA, not protect the cycle.
quiz.explain_zh: 抽走琥珀酰CoA 就是从一个按催化量工作的池子里抽走四个碳，除非有东西补上，否则草酰乙酸会下降；丙酮酸羧化酶和丙酰CoA 途径正是承担回补的反应。提高柠檬酸合酶通量没有用，因为乙酰CoA 加进两个碳，同一圈里又以 CO2 丢掉两个碳。甘氨酸是底物而不是被再生的载体，琥珀酰CoA 是被消耗掉的、不会被还回来。降低 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶活性只会减少琥珀酰CoA 的供应，并不能保护循环。

quiz.q_en: What is the net high-energy phosphate balance of one complete turn of the Cori cycle, counting muscle and liver together?
quiz.q_zh: 把肌肉和肝脏一起算，乳酸循环转一整圈的高能磷酸键净收支是多少？

options.en: A net loss of four high-energy phosphates: two ATP are gained in the muscle, while six are spent in the liver to rebuild one molecule of glucose from two lactate.
options.zh: 净亏 4 个高能磷酸键：肌肉得到 2 个 ATP，而肝脏用 6 个高能磷酸键从 2 分子乳酸重建 1 分子葡萄糖。

options.en: Neutral overall, since the two ATP made by muscle glycolysis are exactly repaid by the two ATP that hepatic gluconeogenesis has to spend on the reverse route.
options.zh: 总体持平，因为肌肉糖酵解产生的 2 个 ATP 恰好抵偿肝脏糖异生在逆向路线上必须花掉的 2 个 ATP。

options.en: A net gain of two ATP for the organism, because the lactate carries reducing equivalents that the liver feeds into the respiratory chain for oxidative phosphorylation.
options.zh: 机体净得 2 个 ATP，因为乳酸携带了还原当量，肝脏把它们送入呼吸链进行氧化磷酸化。

options.en: A net loss of two high-energy phosphates, since the only extra cost the liver carries is the two GTP used by phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase per glucose made.
options.zh: 净亏 2 个高能磷酸键，因为肝脏多付出的仅仅是每合成一分子葡萄糖时磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸羧激酶用掉的 2 个 GTP。

quiz.explain_en: Gluconeogenesis from two pyruvate spends 2 ATP at pyruvate carboxylase, 2 GTP at PEPCK and 2 ATP at phosphoglycerate kinase, six in total, against the two ATP that muscle glycolysis yielded, hence a net cost of four. The neutral answer counts only one of the three bypass reactions, and the two-phosphate answer counts only PEPCK. The claim of a net gain misreads the direction of the reducing equivalents: the liver must supply NADH to reduce 1,3-bisphosphoglycerate, so lactate oxidation offsets part of that requirement rather than creating a surplus.
quiz.explain_zh: 从 2 分子丙酮酸做糖异生，要在丙酮酸羧化酶处耗 2 个 ATP、在 PEPCK 处耗 2 个 GTP、在磷酸甘油酸激酶处耗 2 个 ATP，共 6 个；而肌肉糖酵解只产生了 2 个，所以净支出是 4 个。说总体持平，只算了三个旁路反应中的一个；说净亏 2 个，只算了 PEPCK。说机体净得 2 个 ATP，则把还原当量的方向弄反了：肝脏必须提供 NADH 去还原 1,3-二磷酸甘油酸，乳酸的氧化只是抵消了这部分需要，而不是产生盈余。

quiz.q_en: What distinguishes the glucose-alanine cycle from the Cori cycle?
quiz.q_zh: 葡萄糖-丙氨酸循环与乳酸循环（Cori cycle）的区别在哪里？

options.en: The glucose-alanine cycle returns its carbon to the muscle as pyruvate rather than as glucose, which saves the liver the entire energetic cost of gluconeogenesis.
options.zh: 葡萄糖-丙氨酸循环把碳以丙酮酸而不是葡萄糖的形式送回肌肉，从而替肝脏省下了糖异生的全部能量代价。

options.en: The Cori cycle operates during exercise while the glucose-alanine cycle operates only after a meal, when dietary amino acids are abundant in the portal blood.
options.zh: 乳酸循环在运动时运行，而葡萄糖-丙氨酸循环只在餐后运行，此时门静脉血中的食源性氨基酸很丰富。

options.en: The Cori cycle uses lactate dehydrogenase in both organs, whereas the glucose-alanine cycle uses glutamate dehydrogenase in both organs to interconvert its carrier.
options.zh: 乳酸循环在两个器官中都用乳酸脱氢酶，而葡萄糖-丙氨酸循环在两个器官中都用谷氨酸脱氢酶来互变其载体。

options.en: The glucose-alanine cycle carries an amino group to the liver as well as three carbons, so it feeds gluconeogenesis and nitrogen disposal at the same time.
options.zh: 葡萄糖-丙氨酸循环除了运三个碳，还把一个氨基带到肝脏，因而同时服务于糖异生和含氮废物的处理。

quiz.explain_en: Both cycles move three carbons from muscle to liver and return glucose, but alanine also carries the amino group that muscle protein breakdown generates, and in the liver that nitrogen is released for the urea cycle while the carbon enters gluconeogenesis. Both cycles run during exercise and fasting, so the timing distinction is false. Alanine is made and consumed by transaminases such as ALT, not by glutamate dehydrogenase acting in both organs. And the liver returns glucose in both cycles, at the same energetic cost.
quiz.explain_zh: 两条循环都把三个碳从肌肉运到肝脏、再把葡萄糖送回去，但丙氨酸还额外携带了肌肉蛋白质分解产生的氨基；在肝脏中这个氮被释放出来交给尿素循环，而碳进入糖异生。两条循环在运动和饥饿时都在运行，所以按餐后／运动来区分是错的。丙氨酸的生成和消耗靠的是 ALT 这类转氨酶，而不是两个器官里的谷氨酸脱氢酶。而且两条循环里肝脏送回的都是葡萄糖，能量代价相同。

quiz.q_en: Where does the single carbon atom of urea come from?
quiz.q_zh: 尿素分子中那唯一的一个碳原子来自哪里？

options.en: From the carboxyl carbon of aspartate, donated in the cytosol when argininosuccinate synthetase joins aspartate to citrulline at the cost of one ATP.
options.zh: 来自天冬氨酸的羧基碳，在胞质中精氨琥珀酸合成酶耗 1 个 ATP 把天冬氨酸接到瓜氨酸上时供出。

options.en: From the alpha-carbon of glutamate, carried across with the amino group when glutamate is oxidatively deaminated by glutamate dehydrogenase in the matrix.
options.zh: 来自谷氨酸的 α-碳，在基质中谷氨酸脱氢酶对谷氨酸进行氧化脱氨时随氨基一起被带过去。

options.en: From the guanidinium carbon of dietary arginine, which arginase releases intact and which is therefore never rebuilt during a turn of the cycle.
options.zh: 来自食物中精氨酸的胍基碳，精氨酸酶把它原样释放出来，因此它在循环转一圈的过程中从未被重新造出。

options.en: From bicarbonate, fixed by carbamoyl phosphate synthetase I at a cost of two ATP before ornithine takes up the carbamoyl group to give citrulline.
options.zh: 来自碳酸氢根，由氨甲酰磷酸合成酶 I 耗 2 个 ATP 固定下来，随后鸟氨酸接过氨甲酰基生成瓜氨酸。

quiz.explain_en: CPS-1 condenses bicarbonate with ammonium to make carbamoyl phosphate, and that carbon passes through citrulline, argininosuccinate and arginine before arginase releases it as urea. The arginine explanation confuses one turn with the next: the guanidinium carbon of arginine was itself installed as carbamoyl phosphate. Aspartate donates a nitrogen, not the carbon, and its carbon skeleton leaves as fumarate. Oxidative deamination of glutamate supplies ammonium and leaves alpha-ketoglutarate behind, so no glutamate carbon enters urea.
quiz.explain_zh: CPS-1 把碳酸氢根与铵离子缩合成氨甲酰磷酸，这个碳依次经过瓜氨酸、精氨琥珀酸和精氨酸，最后由精氨酸酶作为尿素释放出来。用精氨酸来解释是把前后两圈混为一谈：精氨酸的胍基碳本身就是以氨甲酰磷酸的形式装上去的。天冬氨酸供出的是氮而不是碳，它的碳骨架以延胡索酸的形式离开。谷氨酸的氧化脱氨提供的是铵离子，留下的是 α-酮戊二酸，因此谷氨酸的碳不会进入尿素。

quiz.q_en: The two nitrogen atoms of urea reach the molecule by different routes. Which description is correct?
quiz.q_zh: 尿素的两个氮原子是通过不同途径进入分子的。下列哪一种描述是正确的？

options.en: One comes from free ammonium fixed by CPS-1 in the mitochondrial matrix, and the other from the amino group of aspartate incorporated in the cytosol.
options.zh: 一个来自基质中由 CPS-1 固定的游离铵，另一个来自胞质中掺入的天冬氨酸的氨基。

options.en: Both come from aspartate: one enters through the argininosuccinate synthetase reaction and the other is transferred to citrulline by ornithine transcarbamoylase.
options.zh: 两个都来自天冬氨酸：一个通过精氨琥珀酸合成酶反应进入，另一个由鸟氨酸氨甲酰转移酶转给瓜氨酸。

options.en: Both come from glutamate: one by oxidative deamination in the matrix and one transferred directly onto ornithine by a mitochondrial transaminase.
options.zh: 两个都来自谷氨酸：一个通过基质中的氧化脱氨获得，另一个由线粒体中的转氨酶直接转到鸟氨酸上。

options.en: One comes from the amide nitrogen of glutamine used by CPS-1, and the other from the epsilon-amino group of ornithine released in the cytosol by arginase.
options.zh: 一个来自 CPS-1 所使用的谷氨酰胺酰胺氮，另一个来自胞质中精氨酸酶释放的鸟氨酸 ε-氨基。

quiz.explain_en: CPS-1 fixes free ammonium, which comes largely from glutamate dehydrogenase and from glutaminase in the liver, while argininosuccinate synthetase brings in the second nitrogen as the amino group of aspartate. The version in which both nitrogens come from glutamate ignores aspartate entirely; ornithine is a carrier whose delta-amino group accepts the carbamoyl group and is regenerated, not a nitrogen donor. CPS-1 cannot use glutamine, which is the substrate of the cytosolic CPS-2 of pyrimidine synthesis, and ornithine transcarbamoylase transfers a carbamoyl group rather than an amino group.
quiz.explain_zh: CPS-1 固定的是游离铵，它主要来自肝内的谷氨酸脱氢酶和谷氨酰胺酶；第二个氮则由精氨琥珀酸合成酶以天冬氨酸氨基的形式引入。说两个氮都来自谷氨酸，完全忽略了天冬氨酸；鸟氨酸是载体，它的 δ-氨基接受氨甲酰基之后会被再生，并不是供氮体。CPS-1 不能利用谷氨酰胺，谷氨酰胺是胞质中嘧啶合成用的 CPS-2 的底物；而鸟氨酸氨甲酰转移酶转移的是氨甲酰基，不是氨基。

quiz.q_en: In prolonged fasting, hepatic acetyl-CoA is directed into ketone bodies rather than into the citric acid cycle. What is the immediate reason?
quiz.q_zh: 长期饥饿时，肝脏的乙酰CoA 被导向酮体而不是三羧酸循环。直接原因是什么？

options.en: Oxaloacetate is being withdrawn for gluconeogenesis, so too little of it remains to condense with the acetyl-CoA that beta-oxidation is supplying.
options.zh: 草酰乙酸正被抽去做糖异生，剩下的量太少，不足以与 β-氧化源源不断提供的乙酰CoA 缩合。

options.en: Ketone bodies are glucogenic in the liver, so exporting carbon in that form is the most efficient way for the liver to send fuel back for glucose synthesis.
options.zh: 酮体在肝脏中是生糖的，因此以酮体形式输出碳是肝脏把燃料送回去合成葡萄糖的最有效方式。

options.en: Citrate synthase is inhibited by the long-chain acyl-CoA that accumulates during rapid lipolysis, so acetyl-CoA cannot condense with oxaloacetate at all.
options.zh: 柠檬酸合酶被快速脂解时积累的长链脂酰CoA 抑制，于是乙酰CoA 根本无法与草酰乙酸缩合。

options.en: The respiratory chain is saturated by the NADH coming from beta-oxidation, so no citric acid cycle intermediate can be oxidised any further at that point.
options.zh: 呼吸链被 β-氧化产生的 NADH 饱和，此时任何三羧酸循环中间物都无法被进一步氧化。

quiz.explain_en: Gluconeogenesis and ketogenesis are driven by the same fasting signal, and the first drains oxaloacetate towards phosphoenolpyruvate while the second is what happens to the acetyl-CoA that can no longer be condensed. Long-chain acyl-CoA is a weak inhibitor and cannot account for the switch, and citrate synthase is not shut off, only substrate-limited. NADH does slow the cycle but is oxidised continuously by the well-supplied chain. And ketone bodies are made from acetyl-CoA, so they cannot be glucogenic in the liver or anywhere else.
quiz.explain_zh: 糖异生和生酮由同一个饥饿信号驱动：前者把草酰乙酸抽向磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸，后者正是那些再也无法缩合的乙酰CoA 的去路。长链脂酰CoA 只是弱抑制剂，不足以解释这种切换，柠檬酸合酶并没有被关闭，只是底物受限。NADH 确实会减慢循环，但在供氧充足时它会被呼吸链不断氧化掉。而酮体是由乙酰CoA 造出来的，所以无论在肝脏还是别处都不可能是生糖的。

quiz.q_en: A child with ornithine transcarbamoylase deficiency shows hyperammonaemia together with a high urinary orotate. What links the two findings?
quiz.q_zh: 一名鸟氨酸氨甲酰转移酶缺乏症的患儿同时出现高氨血症和尿乳清酸升高。这两个表现是怎样联系起来的？

options.en: Arginine can no longer be made, so pyrimidine salvage is switched off and de novo synthesis compensates by overshooting as far as the orotate intermediate.
options.zh: 精氨酸无法再合成，于是嘧啶的补救合成被关闭，从头合成代偿性地过度进行到乳清酸这一中间物。

options.en: Carbamoyl phosphate accumulates in the matrix and leaks into the cytosol, where it enters the pyrimidine pathway below CPS-2 and drives overproduction of orotate.
options.zh: 氨甲酰磷酸在基质中堆积并漏入胞质，从 CPS-2 的下游进入嘧啶合成途径，推动乳清酸过量生成。

options.en: Ammonia directly inhibits dihydroorotate dehydrogenase on the inner mitochondrial membrane, so the pyrimidine pathway stalls at orotate and that intermediate is excreted.
options.zh: 氨直接抑制线粒体内膜上的二氢乳清酸脱氢酶，于是嘧啶合成途径停在乳清酸这一步，该中间物无法继续向下走而被排出体外。

options.en: Ornithine accumulates and is converted to proline, and proline drives the pyrimidine pathway forward by supplying the ring nitrogen that orotate synthesis requires.
options.zh: 鸟氨酸堆积并转变成脯氨酸，脯氨酸提供乳清酸合成所需的环上氮，从而推动嘧啶途径向前进行。

quiz.explain_en: With ornithine transcarbamoylase missing, carbamoyl phosphate made by CPS-1 has nowhere to go in the urea cycle, ammonia rises, and the excess carbamoyl phosphate escaping to the cytosol joins the pyrimidine pathway at aspartate transcarbamoylase, bypassing the normal regulation at CPS-2 and producing orotate faster than it can be used. Ammonia does not inhibit dihydroorotate dehydrogenase. Ornithine accumulation is real but proline is not a pyrimidine precursor. And pyrimidine salvage is not controlled by arginine availability.
quiz.explain_zh: 鸟氨酸氨甲酰转移酶缺失后，CPS-1 造出的氨甲酰磷酸在尿素循环中无处可去，血氨升高，而外溢到胞质的多余氨甲酰磷酸在天冬氨酸氨甲酰转移酶那一步汇入嘧啶合成途径，绕过了 CPS-2 处的正常调控，使乳清酸的生成快于其被利用的速度。氨并不抑制二氢乳清酸脱氢酶。鸟氨酸确实会堆积，但脯氨酸不是嘧啶的前体。嘧啶的补救合成也不受精氨酸供应的控制。

quiz.q_en: Glucose labelled at C1 is supplied to a cell with a high flux through the oxidative pentose phosphate pathway. What happens to the label there, and how does that differ from its fate in glycolysis?
quiz.q_zh: 把 C1 标记的葡萄糖提供给一个氧化型磷酸戊糖途径通量很高的细胞。标记在那里的去向是什么？与它在糖酵解中的去向有何不同？

options.en: It is handed to sedoheptulose 7-phosphate by transketolase, whereas in glycolysis it becomes the phosphorylated carbon of the triose that never leaves the chain.
options.zh: 它由转酮酶交给 7-磷酸景天庚酮糖，而在糖酵解中它成为丙糖上那个始终不离开碳链的磷酸化碳。

options.en: It is released as CO2 by 6-phosphogluconate dehydrogenase, whereas in glycolysis the same carbon becomes the methyl group of pyruvate and of acetyl-CoA.
options.zh: 它由 6-磷酸葡萄糖酸脱氢酶以 CO2 的形式放出，而在糖酵解中同一个碳会成为丙酮酸和乙酰CoA 的甲基。

options.en: It is retained in ribose 5-phosphate as the anomeric carbon, whereas in glycolysis the same carbon becomes the carboxyl carbon that pyruvate dehydrogenase removes.
options.zh: 它作为异头碳保留在 5-磷酸核糖上，而在糖酵解中同一个碳会成为被丙酮酸脱氢酶脱去的羧基碳。

options.en: It is released as CO2 by glucose 6-phosphate dehydrogenase, whereas in glycolysis that carbon becomes the middle carbonyl carbon of the pyruvate molecule.
options.zh: 它由 6-磷酸葡萄糖脱氢酶以 CO2 的形式放出，而在糖酵解中这个碳会成为丙酮酸中间的羰基碳。

quiz.explain_en: In the oxidative branch, glucose 6-phosphate dehydrogenase oxidises C1 from an aldehyde to a lactone and the lactonase opens it, but the actual decarboxylation is performed by 6-phosphogluconate dehydrogenase, which releases C1 as CO2 and gives ribulose 5-phosphate plus the second NADPH. The glycolytic fate of the same carbon is the methyl group of pyruvate, which is why C1 is such a useful label for distinguishing the two routes. Ribose 5-phosphate therefore no longer contains that carbon, and its anomeric carbon derives from glucose C2.
quiz.explain_zh: 在氧化阶段，6-磷酸葡萄糖脱氢酶先把 C1 从醛氧化成内酯，内酯酶把环打开，但真正的脱羧由 6-磷酸葡萄糖酸脱氢酶完成，它把 C1 以 CO2 放出，同时生成 5-磷酸核酮糖和第二个 NADPH。同一个碳在糖酵解中的去向是丙酮酸的甲基，正因如此 C1 标记特别适合用来区分这两条路线。所以 5-磷酸核糖里已经不再含有这个碳，它的异头碳来自葡萄糖 C2。

quiz.q_en: A fasting subject is given tripalmitin uniformly labelled with 14C. Which carbons of that molecule can appear in blood glucose?
quiz.q_zh: 给一位处于饥饿状态的受试者服用均匀标记 14C 的三棕榈酸甘油酯。这个分子中的哪些碳能出现在血糖里？

options.en: All fifty-one of them, because during fasting the liver runs the citric acid cycle in the reverse direction and converts acetyl-CoA back into oxaloacetate.
options.zh: 全部五十一个碳，因为饥饿时肝脏让三羧酸循环反向运行，把乙酰CoA 变回草酰乙酸。

options.en: Forty-eight of them, since each palmitate gives eight acetyl-CoA and every acetyl-CoA condenses with oxaloacetate to make a six-carbon citrate molecule.
options.zh: 其中四十八个，因为每分子棕榈酸给出八分子乙酰CoA，而每分子乙酰CoA 都与草酰乙酸缩合成六碳的柠檬酸。

options.en: None of them, because triacylglycerol is completely hydrolysed in the intestinal lumen and only free fatty acids are ever delivered to the liver.
options.zh: 一个也没有，因为三酰甘油在肠腔中被完全水解，最终送到肝脏的只有游离脂肪酸。

options.en: The three carbons of the glycerol backbone, which glycerol kinase phosphorylates and which then enter gluconeogenesis at dihydroxyacetone phosphate.
options.zh: 甘油骨架上的三个碳，它们被甘油激酶磷酸化，并在磷酸二羟丙酮这一点上进入糖异生。

quiz.explain_en: Tripalmitin is three palmitate chains, all even-numbered, esterified to glycerol, so the only glucogenic part is the glycerol, 3 carbons out of 51. The citric acid cycle does not run backwards, and condensation with oxaloacetate makes citrate but does not add net carbon, because two CO2 leave in the same turn. The answer that no carbon at all reaches glucose overlooks the glycerol, which is absorbed and phosphorylated in the liver, where glycerol kinase is abundant.
quiz.explain_zh: 三棕榈酸甘油酯是三条偶数碳的棕榈酸链酯化在甘油上，唯一生糖的部分就是甘油，51 个碳中占 3 个。三羧酸循环不会反向运行；与草酰乙酸缩合确实生成柠檬酸，但并不增加净碳，因为同一圈里有两个 CO2 离开。说一个碳也进不了血糖，则忽略了甘油——它会被吸收并在富含甘油激酶的肝脏中被磷酸化。

sections.title_en: The control points — every regulated step in one place
sections.title_zh: 调控点总表 —— 把所有被调节的步骤放在一起
sections.blurb_en: One master picture of metabolic regulation: the committed or rate-limiting enzyme of every pathway in the course, what activates and inhibits it, by which of the three mechanisms and on what timescale, and the cross-cutting logic — reciprocal switches, irreversible steps, feed-forward versus feedback, and the ATP/AMP and NADH/NAD+ readouts.
sections.blurb_zh: 把代谢调控收拢成一张总图：本课程每条途径的关键步骤或限速酶、它的激活剂与抑制剂、属于三种机制中的哪一种、发生在什么时间尺度上，以及贯穿全局的逻辑 —— 互反开关、为什么调控落在不可逆步骤、前馈与反馈的区别，还有 ATP/AMP 与 NADH/NAD⁺ 这两个通用读数。

cards.en:
THREE WAYS TO CHANGE A FLUX — AND THREE DIFFERENT CLOCKS

The exam wants the mechanism named, not only the direction.

1 · ALLOSTERIC EFFECTOR — milliseconds to seconds
A small molecule binds a site away from the active site and shifts the enzyme between its tense (low-activity) and relaxed (high-activity) forms. Nothing on the enzyme is chemically changed, so the effect disappears the moment the effector concentration falls.
Examples: ATP inhibiting and AMP activating PFK-1; acetyl-CoA activating pyruvate carboxylase; NADPH inhibiting G6PD; N-acetylglutamate activating CPS-1.

2 · COVALENT MODIFICATION — seconds to minutes
Almost always phosphorylation of a Ser or Thr by a named kinase acting downstream of a named hormone, reversed by a phosphatase. It amplifies: one hormone molecule gives many cAMP, many active PKA, and thousands of modified enzyme molecules.
Examples: glucagon or epinephrine to PKA to phosphorylase kinase to glycogen phosphorylase; AMPK onto acetyl-CoA carboxylase; PDH kinase onto the E1 subunit of the PDH complex.

3 · CHANGED AMOUNT OF ENZYME — hours to days
Transcription, translation and degradation set how many copies exist. Slow to arrive, slow to leave, and it persists after the signal is gone.
Examples: insulin inducing glucokinase and ACC; glucagon and cortisol inducing PEPCK; sterols cutting HMG-CoA reductase transcription and accelerating its degradation.

A fourth control is not a property of the enzyme at all — SUBSTRATE SUPPLY AND COMPARTMENTATION: the citrate shuttle delivering acetyl groups to the cytosol, the carnitine shuttle delivering acyl groups to the matrix, oxaloacetate availability limiting citrate synthase.
cards.zh:
改变代谢流的三种方式 —— 以及三个不同的时间尺度

考试要的是「机制叫什么」，而不只是「往哪个方向变」。

1 · 别构效应物 allosteric effector —— 毫秒到秒
小分子结合在活性中心以外的位点，使酶在紧张态（低活性）与松弛态（高活性）之间切换。酶本身没有发生任何化学改变，所以效应物浓度一降下来，作用立刻消失。
例子：ATP 抑制、AMP 激活 PFK-1；乙酰CoA 激活丙酮酸羧化酶；NADPH 抑制 G6PD；N-乙酰谷氨酸激活 CPS-1。

2 · 共价修饰 covalent modification —— 秒到分钟
几乎都是某个特定激酶（位于某个特定激素的下游）对 Ser 或 Thr 的磷酸化，再由磷酸酶逆转。它有放大效应：一个激素分子产生大量 cAMP、大量活化的 PKA，最终修饰上千个酶分子。
例子：胰高血糖素或肾上腺素 → PKA → 磷酸化酶激酶 → 糖原磷酸化酶；AMPK → 乙酰CoA 羧化酶；PDH 激酶 → 丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体的 E1 亚基。

3 · 改变酶的量 —— 小时到天
转录、翻译与降解决定细胞里有多少个酶分子。来得慢，去得也慢，信号消失后效应仍然持续。
例子：胰岛素诱导葡萄糖激酶与 ACC；胰高血糖素与皮质醇诱导 PEPCK；固醇既减少 HMG-CoA 还原酶的转录，又加速它的降解。

还有第四种控制，它根本不是酶本身的性质 —— 底物供应与区室化：柠檬酸穿梭把乙酰基送到胞质，肉碱穿梭把酰基送进线粒体基质，草酰乙酸的可得性限制柠檬酸合酶。
cards.see: L2 · 酶活力调节 / L8 · 调控总论

cards.en:
WHY CONTROL SITS ON IRREVERSIBLE STEPS — AND THE TWO UNIVERSAL READOUTS

WHERE CONTROL GOES.
A reaction sitting near equilibrium inside the cell (phosphoglucose isomerase, aldolase, aconitase, malate dehydrogenase) runs in whichever direction the concentrations push it. Regulating such a step changes the substrate-to-product ratio, not the flux — the reaction simply keeps pace with whatever is delivered to it. A step with a large negative ΔG in the cell is effectively one-way, and only a one-way step can act as a valve. Three consequences:

• The COMMITTED step is the first irreversible step that is unique to that pathway — PFK-1 for glycolysis, ACC for fatty-acid synthesis, glutamine-PRPP amidotransferase for purines, CPS-1 for urea, G6PD for the oxidative pentose phosphate pathway.
• A pathway and its reverse must use DIFFERENT enzymes at those steps, or the pair would spin as a futile cycle burning ATP. This is exactly why the three irreversible glycolytic steps (hexokinase, PFK-1, pyruvate kinase) are the three bypassed in gluconeogenesis.
• That pairing is what makes RECIPROCAL regulation possible: one signal can switch one enzyme on and its opposite number off.

WHAT IS SENSED. Two ratios, read by nearly every pathway.
• ATP/AMP — the adenylate energy charge. AMP is the sensitive alarm, because adenylate kinase runs 2 ADP ⇌ ATP + AMP: a small percentage fall in ATP produces a large fold-rise in AMP. High AMP activates PFK-1, muscle glycogen phosphorylase b and AMPK. High ATP inhibits PFK-1, pyruvate kinase, citrate synthase and isocitrate dehydrogenase.
• NADH/NAD+ — the reducing charge, which means 'the respiratory chain is backed up'. High NADH inhibits the PDH complex, citrate synthase, isocitrate dehydrogenase, α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase, and the dehydrogenase steps of β-oxidation.
cards.zh:
为什么调控总落在不可逆步骤上 —— 以及两个通用读数

调控点放在哪里。
细胞内接近平衡的反应（磷酸葡萄糖异构酶、醛缩酶、顺乌头酸酶、苹果酸脱氢酶）沿着浓度推它的方向走。调节这样的一步只会改变底物与产物的比例，而不会改变通量 —— 这一步只是被动跟上前面送来的量。而细胞内 ΔG 大幅为负的一步实际上是单向的，只有单向的一步才能当阀门。三个推论：

• 关键步骤（committed step）就是该途径特有的第一个不可逆步骤 —— 糖酵解是 PFK-1，脂肪酸合成是 ACC，嘌呤是谷氨酰胺-PRPP 酰胺转移酶，尿素是 CPS-1，磷酸戊糖途径氧化阶段是 G6PD。
• 一条途径和它的逆向途径在这些步骤上必须用不同的酶，否则两者会形成无效循环（futile cycle）白白消耗 ATP。这正是糖酵解那三个不可逆步骤（己糖激酶、PFK-1、丙酮酸激酶）恰好就是糖异生绕开的那三步的原因。
• 正是这种成对关系使互反调节（reciprocal regulation）成为可能：一个信号可以同时开一个酶、关它的对手。

细胞感受的是什么。两个比值，几乎每条途径都在读。
• ATP/AMP —— 腺苷酸能荷。AMP 是灵敏的警报器，因为腺苷酸激酶催化 2 ADP ⇌ ATP + AMP：ATP 只下降百分之几，AMP 就会成倍上升。高 AMP 激活 PFK-1、肌肉糖原磷酸化酶 b 和 AMPK；高 ATP 抑制 PFK-1、丙酮酸激酶、柠檬酸合酶和异柠檬酸脱氢酶。
• NADH/NAD⁺ —— 还原当量的「能荷」，含义是「呼吸链堵住了」。高 NADH 抑制丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体、柠檬酸合酶、异柠檬酸脱氢酶、α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶，以及 β-氧化中的脱氢步骤。
cards.see: L8 · 不可逆步骤与调控 / L9 · TCA 调控

cards.en:
FEED-FORWARD ACTIVATION versus FEEDBACK INHIBITION

They point in opposite directions along the pathway, and the exam usually asks you to name which one you are looking at.

FEEDBACK — a downstream product inhibits an earlier step. Message: 'enough has been made, stop'.
• glucose 6-phosphate inhibits hexokinase — the immediate product acting on the enzyme that made it
• AMP, GMP and IMP inhibit glutamine-PRPP amidotransferase
• UTP inhibits CPS-II
• palmitoyl-CoA and other long-chain acyl-CoAs inhibit acetyl-CoA carboxylase
• citrate and ATP inhibit PFK-1 — a report from downstream that the cell is already full
• NADH and succinyl-CoA inhibit citrate synthase and α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase

FEED-FORWARD — an upstream metabolite activates a later step. Message: 'a load is coming, open the exit'.
• fructose 1,6-bisphosphate, the product of PFK-1, activates pyruvate kinase several steps downstream, so the payoff phase opens before triose phosphates pile up
• PRPP activates glutamine-PRPP amidotransferase, and also CPS-II
• acetyl-CoA activates pyruvate carboxylase — pyruvate is diverted to oxaloacetate exactly when acetyl-CoA is accumulating
• AMP activates glycogen phosphorylase b in working muscle
• citrate activates acetyl-CoA carboxylase — the very molecule that carried the acetyl group out of the mitochondrion

Note that one molecule can do both jobs in different places. Citrate feeds BACK onto PFK-1 to slow glycolysis and feeds FORWARD onto acetyl-CoA carboxylase to start fatty-acid synthesis, and both readings mean the same thing: carbon is arriving faster than it is being burned.
cards.zh:
前馈激活 feed-forward 与反馈抑制 feedback inhibition

两者在途径上的方向相反，考试常常就是要你判断眼前这个属于哪一种。

反馈抑制 —— 下游产物抑制上游的某一步。含义是「已经做够了，停」。
• 6-磷酸葡萄糖抑制己糖激酶 —— 直接产物反过来作用于生成它的酶
• AMP、GMP、IMP 抑制谷氨酰胺-PRPP 酰胺转移酶
• UTP 抑制 CPS-II
• 棕榈酰CoA 等长链脂酰CoA 抑制乙酰CoA 羧化酶
• 柠檬酸和 ATP 抑制 PFK-1 —— 来自下游的报告：细胞已经装满了
• NADH 与琥珀酰CoA 抑制柠檬酸合酶和 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶

前馈激活 —— 上游代谢物激活下游的某一步。含义是「有一批货要来了，先把出口打开」。
• 1,6-二磷酸果糖（PFK-1 的产物）激活好几步之后的丙酮酸激酶，使放能相在丙糖磷酸堆积之前就打开
• PRPP 激活谷氨酰胺-PRPP 酰胺转移酶，也激活 CPS-II
• 乙酰CoA 激活丙酮酸羧化酶 —— 恰恰在乙酰CoA 堆积的时候把丙酮酸引向草酰乙酸
• AMP 激活工作肌肉中的糖原磷酸化酶 b
• 柠檬酸激活乙酰CoA 羧化酶 —— 而柠檬酸正是把乙酰基运出线粒体的那个分子

注意同一个分子在不同位置可以扮演两种角色：柠檬酸对 PFK-1 是反馈抑制，减慢糖酵解；对乙酰CoA 羧化酶是前馈激活，启动脂肪酸合成。两种读法说的是同一件事：碳源进来的速度已经超过烧掉的速度。
cards.see: L8 · 前馈 F-1,6-BP / L12 · 嘌呤合成调控

cards.en:
GLYCOLYSIS — THREE IRREVERSIBLE STEPS, ONE TRUE VALVE

HEXOKINASE (steps in most tissues)
Inhibited by glucose 6-phosphate, its own product — allosteric feedback.
Low Km, so it is essentially saturated at normal blood glucose and works flat out.

GLUCOKINASE (hexokinase IV; liver and pancreatic β-cell)
NOT inhibited by glucose 6-phosphate. High Km, so its rate tracks blood glucose instead of saturating — the liver takes up glucose only when there is a surplus.
Sequestered in the nucleus on the regulatory protein GKRP when fructose 6-phosphate is high; released when glucose or fructose 1-phosphate rises.
Amount raised by insulin — transcription, hours.

PFK-1 (step 3) — THE COMMITTED AND RATE-LIMITING STEP
Activated by: AMP, ADP and, above all, fructose 2,6-bisphosphate, which works by relieving the ATP inhibition.
Inhibited by: ATP at an allosteric site distinct from the substrate site; citrate; and H+, so that falling pH in anaerobic muscle throttles glycolysis before the cell acidifies dangerously.
All allosteric — PFK-1 is not itself a substrate of a hormone-driven kinase.

PYRUVATE KINASE (step 10)
Activated by: fructose 1,6-bisphosphate — feed-forward, allosteric.
Inhibited by: ATP, acetyl-CoA, long-chain fatty acids, alanine.
Covalent, liver isoenzyme only: glucagon to PKA to phosphorylation to inactive; insulin to dephosphorylation to active. The muscle isoenzyme lacks this site, which is why exercising muscle does not shut its glycolysis down at the moment the liver shuts down its own.
cards.zh:
糖酵解 —— 三个不可逆步骤，一个真正的阀门

己糖激酶 hexokinase（大多数组织）
受产物 6-磷酸葡萄糖抑制 —— 别构反馈。
Km 低，所以在正常血糖下基本已经饱和，一直全速工作。

葡萄糖激酶 glucokinase（己糖激酶 IV；肝脏与胰腺 β 细胞）
不受 6-磷酸葡萄糖抑制。Km 高，所以它的速率跟着血糖走而不会饱和 —— 肝脏只在血糖有余量时才摄取葡萄糖。
当 6-磷酸果糖高时，它被调节蛋白 GKRP 扣留在细胞核内；葡萄糖或 1-磷酸果糖升高时被释放出来。
胰岛素提高它的量 —— 转录水平，小时级。

PFK-1（第 3 步）—— 关键步骤兼限速步骤
激活剂：AMP、ADP，尤其是 2,6-二磷酸果糖，其作用方式是解除 ATP 的抑制。
抑制剂：ATP（结合在与底物位点不同的别构位点上）、柠檬酸，以及 H⁺ —— 因此无氧肌肉中 pH 下降会在细胞酸化到危险程度之前先把糖酵解掐住。
全部是别构调节 —— PFK-1 本身不是激素驱动的激酶的底物。

丙酮酸激酶 pyruvate kinase（第 10 步）
激活剂：1,6-二磷酸果糖 —— 前馈，别构。
抑制剂：ATP、乙酰CoA、长链脂肪酸、丙氨酸。
共价修饰只见于肝脏同工酶：胰高血糖素 → PKA → 磷酸化 → 失活；胰岛素 → 去磷酸化 → 激活。肌肉同工酶没有这个位点，所以肝脏关掉自己糖酵解的同时，运动中的肌肉不会跟着关掉。
cards.see: L8 · PFK-1 / 己糖激酶与葡萄糖激酶

cards.en:
GLUCONEOGENESIS — THE FOUR BYPASS ENZYMES AND WHAT OPENS THEM

PYRUVATE CARBOXYLASE (pyruvate → oxaloacetate; mitochondrial; biotin + ATP)
Activated by acetyl-CoA — an OBLIGATORY allosteric activator: with none bound, the enzyme is essentially inactive.
The logic: acetyl-CoA piling up from fat oxidation in a fasting liver says fuel is plentiful but glucose is not, so pyruvate is pushed towards oxaloacetate rather than towards more acetyl-CoA. The same step is the main anaplerotic reaction refilling the TCA cycle.
Inhibited by ADP.

PEPCK (oxaloacetate → phosphoenolpyruvate)
Regulated almost entirely by ENZYME AMOUNT: transcription induced by glucagon through cAMP and by cortisol, repressed by insulin. Hours — the slow arm of the fasting response.

FRUCTOSE-1,6-BISPHOSPHATASE (FBPase-1) — the committed step, and the counterpart of PFK-1
Inhibited by AMP and by fructose 2,6-bisphosphate.
Activated by citrate.
Read it against PFK-1 and every sign is reversed: AMP activates PFK-1 and inhibits FBPase-1; citrate inhibits PFK-1 and activates FBPase-1; F-2,6-BP activates PFK-1 and inhibits FBPase-1.

GLUCOSE-6-PHOSPHATASE (glucose 6-phosphate → glucose; ER lumen of liver and kidney)
Regulated mainly by amount, induced in fasting and in diabetes. Its absence from muscle is the reason muscle glycogen cannot raise blood glucose.
cards.zh:
糖异生 —— 四个绕道酶，以及打开它们的信号

丙酮酸羧化酶 pyruvate carboxylase（丙酮酸 → 草酰乙酸；线粒体；生物素 + ATP）
被乙酰CoA 激活 —— 而且是必需的别构激活剂：没有乙酰CoA 结合时，这个酶基本没有活性。
逻辑是：饥饿肝脏中脂肪氧化产生的乙酰CoA 堆积，说明燃料充足而葡萄糖不足，于是丙酮酸被推向草酰乙酸，而不是再变成乙酰CoA。这同一步也是补充 TCA 循环的主要回补反应（anaplerotic reaction）。
被 ADP 抑制。

PEPCK（草酰乙酸 → 磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸）
几乎完全靠改变酶的量来调节：胰高血糖素经 cAMP、以及皮质醇诱导其转录，胰岛素抑制其转录。小时级 —— 这是饥饿反应中慢的那一条臂。

果糖-1,6-二磷酸酶 FBPase-1 —— 糖异生的关键步骤，PFK-1 的对手
被 AMP 和 2,6-二磷酸果糖抑制。
被柠檬酸激活。
和 PFK-1 对照着看，每一个符号都是反的：AMP 激活 PFK-1、抑制 FBPase-1；柠檬酸抑制 PFK-1、激活 FBPase-1；F-2,6-BP 激活 PFK-1、抑制 FBPase-1。

葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶（6-磷酸葡萄糖 → 葡萄糖；肝与肾的内质网腔）
主要靠酶量调节，饥饿与糖尿病时被诱导。肌肉里没有这个酶，这正是肌糖原不能升高血糖的原因。
cards.see: L11 · 糖异生的三个能垒与调节

cards.en:
FRUCTOSE 2,6-BISPHOSPHATE — THE SWITCH, AND THE ENZYME THAT IS TWO ENZYMES

F-2,6-BP is not an intermediate of anything. Nothing consumes it downstream. It exists purely as a signal. It is made from fructose 6-phosphate by PFK-2 and destroyed back to fructose 6-phosphate by FBPase-2 — and in mammals both activities sit on ONE bifunctional polypeptide, so a single phosphorylation event sets the balance between them.

FED LIVER, insulin high
The bifunctional enzyme is dephosphorylated → kinase domain active, bisphosphatase domain off → F-2,6-BP rises → PFK-1 activated, FBPase-1 inhibited → glycolysis runs, gluconeogenesis stops.

FASTING LIVER, glucagon high
Glucagon → cAMP → PKA phosphorylates the bifunctional enzyme → kinase domain off, bisphosphatase domain on → F-2,6-BP falls → PFK-1 loses its activator and FBPase-1 loses its inhibitor → gluconeogenesis runs, glycolysis stops.

Two points students miss.
• One metabolite acting on two enzymes with opposite signs is what makes the switch clean. If the cell merely inhibited PFK-1, the reverse enzyme would still be idle and flux would just fall towards zero. Reciprocal control MOVES flux; single-sided control only stops it.
• Isoenzymes of the bifunctional enzyme differ between tissues, so the same hormone need not have the same effect everywhere. The liver behaviour above is the one to quote in an answer.
cards.zh:
2,6-二磷酸果糖 —— 那个开关，以及「一个酶其实是两个酶」

F-2,6-BP 不是任何途径的中间产物，下游没有任何反应消耗它。它的存在纯粹是一个信号。它由 PFK-2 从 6-磷酸果糖生成，又由 FBPase-2 水解回 6-磷酸果糖 —— 而在哺乳动物中这两个活性位于同一条双功能多肽链上，所以一次磷酸化就决定了两者的平衡。

进食状态的肝，胰岛素高
双功能酶处于去磷酸化状态 → 激酶结构域有活性、二磷酸酶结构域关闭 → F-2,6-BP 升高 → PFK-1 被激活、FBPase-1 被抑制 → 糖酵解开、糖异生关。

饥饿状态的肝，胰高血糖素高
胰高血糖素 → cAMP → PKA 磷酸化双功能酶 → 激酶结构域关闭、二磷酸酶结构域打开 → F-2,6-BP 下降 → PFK-1 失去激活剂、FBPase-1 失去抑制剂 → 糖异生开、糖酵解关。

学生最常漏掉的两点。
• 一个代谢物以相反的符号作用于两个酶，这才让开关切得干净。如果细胞只是抑制 PFK-1，逆向的酶仍然闲着，通量只会趋近于零。互反调节是把通量「掉头」；单边调节只是把它「停下」。
• 这个双功能酶在不同组织有不同的同工酶，所以同一个激素不一定在所有组织产生同样的效果。答题时引用上面这套肝脏的行为。

cards.en:
GLYCOGEN — ONE KINASE CASCADE, TWO ENZYMES, OPPOSITE OUTCOMES

This is the purest example of covalent control in the whole course, and it is the part the lecture explicitly skipped.

GLYCOGEN PHOSPHORYLASE (breakdown)
Covalent: phosphorylase kinase phosphorylates a single serine, giving phosphorylase a, the active form. Phosphorylase kinase is itself activated by PKA (glucagon in liver, epinephrine in liver and muscle) and, independently of any hormone, by Ca2+ binding its calmodulin subunit — so contraction alone mobilises muscle glycogen.
Allosteric in muscle: AMP activates the b form; ATP and glucose 6-phosphate inhibit it.
Allosteric in liver: glucose binds phosphorylase a and pushes it into the tense form, which also makes it a better substrate for the phosphatase. The liver enzyme is a direct glucose sensor.

GLYCOGEN SYNTHASE (synthesis)
Covalent: phosphorylation by GSK3, and also by PKA and phosphorylase kinase, gives synthase b, which is inactive unless glucose 6-phosphate is present. Dephosphorylation gives the fully active synthase a.
Insulin acts two ways at once: through PKB/Akt it inhibits GSK3, and through protein phosphatase 1 it strips phosphates off both enzymes.

THE POINT. The same phosphate signal ACTIVATES breakdown and INACTIVATES synthesis. Phosphorylation does not mean 'on'; it means 'the fasting and stress programme is running'. PP1 is the counterweight, and the whole glycogen effect of insulin is to activate PP1.
cards.zh:
糖原 —— 一条激酶级联，两个酶，相反的结果

这是整门课里最纯粹的共价修饰调控例子，而恰恰是老师明确跳过的那一部分。

糖原磷酸化酶 glycogen phosphorylase（分解）
共价修饰：磷酸化酶激酶磷酸化一个丝氨酸，生成活性形式磷酸化酶 a。磷酸化酶激酶本身既可以被 PKA 激活（肝中是胰高血糖素，肝与肌肉中是肾上腺素），也可以完全不经激素、由 Ca²⁺ 结合它的钙调蛋白亚基而激活 —— 所以单是肌肉收缩就能动员肌糖原。
肌肉中的别构调节：AMP 激活 b 型；ATP 与 6-磷酸葡萄糖抑制它。
肝中的别构调节：葡萄糖结合磷酸化酶 a，把它推向紧张态，同时也使它更容易成为磷酸酶的底物。肝脏的这个酶就是一个直接的葡萄糖感受器。

糖原合酶 glycogen synthase（合成）
共价修饰：GSK3（以及 PKA 和磷酸化酶激酶）的磷酸化生成合酶 b，除非有 6-磷酸葡萄糖存在，否则它没有活性。去磷酸化则生成完全有活性的合酶 a。
胰岛素同时从两条路起作用：经 PKB/Akt 抑制 GSK3，经蛋白磷酸酶 1（PP1）把两个酶上的磷酸都去掉。

要点。同一个磷酸信号激活分解、抑制合成。磷酸化并不等于「开」，它的含义是「饥饿与应激程序正在运行」。PP1 是它的对手，而胰岛素对糖原的全部作用就是激活 PP1。
cards.see: L11 · 糖原分解与「被跳过的糖原调控」

cards.en:
THE PDH COMPLEX — THE IRREVERSIBLE GATE BETWEEN SUGAR AND FAT

Why it matters more than its position suggests: this step is not reversible in animals, so acetyl-CoA can never go back to pyruvate. That single fact is why humans cannot make glucose from fatty acids, however much fat they carry — the exam asks this every year.

ALLOSTERIC AND PRODUCT INHIBITION — seconds
Inhibited by NADH, acetyl-CoA and ATP: its own two products plus the energy signal.
Activated by NAD+, CoA, AMP and by pyruvate itself.

COVALENT — minutes
PDH kinase phosphorylates the E1 subunit → complex OFF.
PDH phosphatase removes the phosphate → complex ON.
And the two regulators are themselves regulated. PDH kinase is activated by NADH, acetyl-CoA and ATP, and inhibited by pyruvate, ADP, NAD+ and CoA. PDH phosphatase is activated by Ca2+ — contracting muscle demanding acetyl-CoA — and, in adipose tissue, by insulin.
So the same four molecules act TWICE and in the same direction: directly on the complex, and again through the kinase. That doubling is the standard exam point.

AMOUNT — hours
PDH kinase is induced by starvation and by a high-fat state, which is how a fasting liver keeps its pyruvate for gluconeogenesis instead of burning it.
cards.zh:
丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体 —— 糖与脂之间那道不可逆的闸门

它的重要性超过它在图上的位置：这一步在动物体内不可逆，乙酰CoA 永远回不到丙酮酸。就是这一条事实决定了人无论带多少脂肪都不能用脂肪酸造葡萄糖 —— 这是每年都考的点。

别构与产物抑制 —— 秒级
被 NADH、乙酰CoA 和 ATP 抑制：它自己的两个产物，加上能量信号。
被 NAD⁺、CoA、AMP，以及丙酮酸本身激活。

共价修饰 —— 分钟级
PDH 激酶磷酸化 E1 亚基 → 复合体关闭。
PDH 磷酸酶去掉这个磷酸 → 复合体打开。
而这两个调节者本身也受调节。PDH 激酶被 NADH、乙酰CoA、ATP 激活，被丙酮酸、ADP、NAD⁺、CoA 抑制；PDH 磷酸酶被 Ca²⁺ 激活（收缩中的肌肉需要乙酰CoA），在脂肪组织中还被胰岛素激活。
所以同样的四个分子作用了两次，方向一致：一次直接作用于复合体，一次通过激酶。这个「加倍」正是标准考点。

酶量 —— 小时级
饥饿和高脂状态诱导 PDH 激酶的表达，这正是饥饿肝脏把丙酮酸留给糖异生、而不是烧掉它的方式。
cards.see: L9 · 丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体的调控

cards.en:
THE TCA CYCLE — THREE CONTROL POINTS, NO HORMONE, NO PHOSPHORYLATION

CITRATE SYNTHASE — the entry step
Inhibited by NADH, succinyl-CoA, citrate and ATP.
But its dominant control is SUBSTRATE SUPPLY: the availability of acetyl-CoA and especially of oxaloacetate, which is normally far below saturating. Drain oxaloacetate into gluconeogenesis, as a fasting liver does, and the cycle slows whatever the allosteric effectors say. This is the step that lies behind ketogenesis.

ISOCITRATE DEHYDROGENASE — usually named the rate-limiting enzyme
Activated by ADP and Ca2+.
Inhibited by ATP and NADH.
The cleanest energy-charge sensor in the cycle.

α-KETOGLUTARATE DEHYDROGENASE
Inhibited by its own products succinyl-CoA and NADH, and by ATP.
Activated by Ca2+.
Architecturally a copy of the PDH complex — same E1/E2/E3 design, same five cofactors — but, and this is the exam point, it is NOT regulated by a kinase and phosphatase pair. PDH is; α-KGDH is not.

THE PATTERN. The cycle is controlled from inside the mitochondrion by the products of its own turning, not by hormones. Ca2+ is the exception and it is not a hormonal signal either: it is the contraction signal, and it activates PDH phosphatase, isocitrate dehydrogenase and α-KGDH together, so that a working muscle raises the whole cycle at once.
cards.zh:
三羧酸循环 —— 三个调控点，没有激素，没有磷酸化

柠檬酸合酶 citrate synthase —— 入口步骤
被 NADH、琥珀酰CoA、柠檬酸和 ATP 抑制。
但它最主要的控制来自底物供应：乙酰CoA 的可得性，尤其是草酰乙酸的可得性 —— 后者的浓度通常远低于饱和。像饥饿肝脏那样把草酰乙酸抽去做糖异生，无论别构效应物怎么说，循环都会慢下来。酮体生成的机制就藏在这一步。

异柠檬酸脱氢酶 isocitrate dehydrogenase —— 通常被称作限速酶
被 ADP 和 Ca²⁺ 激活。
被 ATP 和 NADH 抑制。
它是循环中最干净的能荷感受器。

α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶
被自身产物琥珀酰CoA 和 NADH 抑制，也被 ATP 抑制。
被 Ca²⁺ 激活。
它在结构上是 PDH 复合体的翻版 —— 同样的 E1/E2/E3 设计，同样的五种辅因子 —— 但考点在于：它不受激酶/磷酸酶这一对的调节。PDH 受，α-KGDH 不受。

规律。这个循环是由它自己转动产生的产物、在线粒体内部控制的，而不是由激素控制的。Ca²⁺ 是例外，而它也不是激素信号：它是收缩信号，同时激活 PDH 磷酸酶、异柠檬酸脱氢酶和 α-KGDH，让工作中的肌肉把整个循环一起提速。
cards.see: L9 · TCA 酶的产物抑制

cards.en:
MALONYL-CoA — THE SECOND RECIPROCAL SWITCH

ACETYL-CoA CARBOXYLASE (ACC): acetyl-CoA + CO2 + ATP → malonyl-CoA, with biotin on a BCCP domain. The committed and rate-limiting step of fatty-acid synthesis.
Activated by CITRATE — allosteric, and it works by driving inactive protomers into long active filaments. Citrate is the very molecule that carried the acetyl group out of the mitochondrion, so this is feed-forward by the substrate's own delivery vehicle.
Inhibited by PALMITOYL-CoA and other long-chain acyl-CoAs — feedback by the end product.
Covalent: AMPK phosphorylates ACC and switches it off; insulin leads to dephosphorylation and switches it on.
Amount: a high-carbohydrate, high-insulin state induces transcription of ACC and of fatty-acid synthase over hours to days.

CPT-1 (carnitine acyltransferase I, outer mitochondrial membrane): the rate-limiting step of β-oxidation, because it is what allows a long-chain acyl group to cross into the matrix.
Inhibited by MALONYL-CoA.

PUT THEM TOGETHER
Well fed: citrate high → ACC on → malonyl-CoA high → CPT-1 blocked → fatty acids cannot enter the mitochondrion → synthesis only.
Fasting: AMPK on → ACC off → malonyl-CoA falls → CPT-1 opens → oxidation only.
One metabolite, two pathways, opposite signs — structurally the same trick as fructose 2,6-bisphosphate, and the reason a cell never synthesises and oxidises fatty acids at the same time. Note also the compartments: synthesis in the cytosol, oxidation in the matrix.
cards.zh:
丙二酰CoA —— 第二个互反开关

乙酰CoA 羧化酶 ACC：乙酰CoA + CO₂ + ATP → 丙二酰CoA，生物素连在 BCCP 结构域上。这是脂肪酸合成的关键步骤兼限速步骤。
被柠檬酸激活 —— 别构调节，机制是把无活性的原聚体驱动成长的有活性丝状聚合体。柠檬酸正是把乙酰基运出线粒体的那个分子，所以这是「底物自己的运输车」发出的前馈信号。
被棕榈酰CoA 等长链脂酰CoA 抑制 —— 终产物反馈。
共价修饰：AMPK 磷酸化 ACC 使其关闭；胰岛素导致去磷酸化使其打开。
酶量：高糖、高胰岛素状态在数小时到数天内诱导 ACC 与脂肪酸合酶的转录。

CPT-1（肉碱脂酰转移酶 I，线粒体外膜）：β-氧化的限速步骤，因为正是它让长链酰基得以进入线粒体基质。
被丙二酰CoA 抑制。

把两者放在一起看
进食充足：柠檬酸高 → ACC 开 → 丙二酰CoA 高 → CPT-1 被封 → 脂肪酸进不了线粒体 → 只合成。
饥饿：AMPK 开 → ACC 关 → 丙二酰CoA 下降 → CPT-1 打开 → 只氧化。
一个代谢物、两条途径、相反的符号 —— 在结构上和 2,6-二磷酸果糖是同一个套路，也是细胞绝不会同时合成和氧化脂肪酸的原因。同时注意区室：合成在胞质，氧化在基质。
cards.see: L11 · ACC 的调控 / 肉碱穿梭

cards.en:
TWO ENZYMES THAT BOTH START FROM HMG-CoA — AND THEY ARE NOT THE SAME ENZYME

MITOCHONDRIAL HMG-CoA SYNTHASE (HMGCS2) — the committed step of KETOGENESIS, in liver mitochondria only.
It is driven mainly by substrate supply and by enzyme amount rather than by a classical allosteric effector. Fasting or untreated diabetes → high glucagon, low insulin → adipose lipolysis floods the liver with fatty acids → β-oxidation raises acetyl-CoA, while oxaloacetate is simultaneously drained into gluconeogenesis, so the acetyl-CoA cannot enter the TCA cycle and is condensed into acetoacetate instead.
Transcription of the gene is induced in fasting; succinyl-CoA inhibits the enzyme.
Clinically this is diabetic ketoacidosis: the trigger is not a lack of fuel but a lack of insulin.

HMG-CoA REDUCTASE, endoplasmic reticulum — the committed and rate-limiting step of CHOLESTEROL SYNTHESIS (HMG-CoA + 2 NADPH → mevalonate).
This is the course's best example of control by ENZYME AMOUNT, acting in two ways at once:
• sterols block the escort of the SREBP-2 transcription factor to the Golgi, so less enzyme is transcribed;
• sterols also accelerate the enzyme's own proteasomal degradation, so what already exists disappears faster.
Insulin and thyroid hormone raise the amount; glucagon and glucocorticoids lower it.
Covalent and faster: AMPK phosphorylates and inactivates it — the same switch that turns off ACC, because both are expensive biosynthesis.
Pharmacology: statins are competitive inhibitors of this enzyme, the standard illustration of why a rate-limiting step makes a good drug target.
cards.zh:
两个都从 HMG-CoA 出发的酶 —— 而它们不是同一个酶

线粒体 HMG-CoA 合酶（HMGCS2）—— 酮体生成的关键步骤，只在肝脏线粒体内。
它主要由底物供应和酶量驱动，而不是由经典的别构效应物驱动。饥饿或未经治疗的糖尿病 → 胰高血糖素高、胰岛素低 → 脂肪组织脂解把大量脂肪酸送进肝脏 → β-氧化抬高乙酰CoA，与此同时草酰乙酸被抽去做糖异生，于是乙酰CoA 进不了 TCA 循环，转而缩合成乙酰乙酸。
饥饿时该基因的转录被诱导；琥珀酰CoA 抑制这个酶。
临床上这就是糖尿病酮症酸中毒：触发它的不是缺燃料，而是缺胰岛素。

HMG-CoA 还原酶，位于内质网 —— 胆固醇合成的关键步骤兼限速步骤（HMG-CoA + 2 NADPH → 甲羟戊酸）。
这是全课程中「用酶量调控」最好的例子，而且同时从两条路起作用：
• 固醇阻止转录因子 SREBP-2 被护送到高尔基体，于是转录出来的酶变少；
• 固醇同时加速这个酶自身的蛋白酶体降解，于是已经存在的酶消失得更快。
胰岛素和甲状腺激素提高它的量，胰高血糖素和糖皮质激素降低它的量。
共价修饰、更快的一层：AMPK 磷酸化并使其失活 —— 和关掉 ACC 是同一个开关，因为两者都是昂贵的合成代谢。
药理学：他汀类是这个酶的竞争性抑制剂，也是「限速步骤适合做药物靶点」的标准例证。

cards.en:
THE REMAINING COMMITTED STEPS

CPS-1 (carbamoyl phosphate synthetase I) — urea cycle, mitochondrial matrix
Activated by N-ACETYLGLUTAMATE (NAG), and absolutely so: with no NAG bound the enzyme has essentially no activity.
NAG is made from glutamate plus acetyl-CoA by NAG synthase, which is itself activated by arginine. A protein meal raises glutamate, raises NAG and opens the cycle — the abundance of the substrate is itself the signal.
Amount: all five urea-cycle enzymes are induced together by a high-protein diet or by starvation, through glucagon and glucocorticoids, over days.
Clinical: loss of NAG synthase, or of ornithine transcarbamoylase, gives hyperammonaemia; carbamoyl glutamate, a NAG analogue, is used as treatment.

G6PD — pentose phosphate pathway, committed step of the oxidative branch
Controlled by NADP+ availability: NADP+ is the substrate and NADPH is a competitive inhibitor, so the branch runs exactly as fast as NADPH is being consumed — by fatty-acid and cholesterol synthesis, and by glutathione reductase.
Amount: induced by insulin and a high-carbohydrate diet.
Clinical: G6PD deficiency starves the red cell of NADPH, glutathione cannot be kept reduced, and an oxidant challenge (fava beans, primaquine, infection) causes haemolysis.

GLUTAMINE-PRPP AMIDOTRANSFERASE — committed step of de novo PURINE synthesis
Inhibited by AMP, GMP and IMP at two separate sites, so one purine of each class inhibits more than either does alone.
Activated by PRPP — feed-forward.
Downstream the branch is balanced twice: AMP inhibits its own branch and GMP inhibits its own, and making AMP requires GTP while making GMP requires ATP, so whichever nucleotide is scarce is the one that gets made.

CPS-II — committed step of de novo PYRIMIDINE synthesis in animals; cytosolic, part of the CAD polypeptide
Inhibited by UTP; activated by PRPP and ATP.
Do not confuse the two: CPS-II is cytosolic, takes its nitrogen from glutamine, needs no NAG and feeds pyrimidines. CPS-1 is mitochondrial, takes free ammonia, requires NAG and feeds urea.
cards.zh:
剩下的那些关键步骤

CPS-1（氨基甲酰磷酸合成酶 I）—— 尿素循环，线粒体基质
被 N-乙酰谷氨酸（NAG）激活，而且是绝对必需：没有 NAG 结合时，这个酶基本没有活性。
NAG 由 NAG 合酶以谷氨酸加乙酰CoA 合成，而 NAG 合酶本身又被精氨酸激活。一顿高蛋白餐提高谷氨酸、提高 NAG，从而打开这个循环 —— 底物本身的丰度就是信号。
酶量：高蛋白饮食或饥饿通过胰高血糖素和糖皮质激素，在数天内一起诱导尿素循环的全部五个酶。
临床：NAG 合酶或鸟氨酸氨甲酰转移酶（OTC）缺陷会造成高氨血症；氨甲酰谷氨酸（NAG 类似物）可用于治疗。

G6PD —— 磷酸戊糖途径，氧化阶段的关键步骤
由 NADP⁺ 的可得性控制：NADP⁺ 是底物，NADPH 是竞争性抑制剂，所以这条支路的速度恰好等于 NADPH 被消耗的速度 —— 消耗方是脂肪酸与胆固醇合成，以及谷胱甘肽还原酶。
酶量：被胰岛素和高糖饮食诱导。
临床：G6PD 缺乏使红细胞缺少 NADPH，谷胱甘肽无法维持还原态，遇到氧化压力（蚕豆、伯氨喹、感染）就发生溶血。

谷氨酰胺-PRPP 酰胺转移酶 —— 嘌呤从头合成的关键步骤
被 AMP、GMP、IMP 抑制，且作用于两个不同的位点，所以两类嘌呤各来一个时的抑制效果强于其中任何一个单独作用。
被 PRPP 激活 —— 前馈。
下游的分支还被平衡了两次：AMP 抑制自己那一支、GMP 抑制自己那一支；而合成 AMP 需要 GTP、合成 GMP 需要 ATP，于是哪个稀缺就优先做哪个。

CPS-II —— 动物体内嘧啶从头合成的关键步骤；位于胞质，是 CAD 多肽的一部分
被 UTP 抑制；被 PRPP 和 ATP 激活。
不要把两者搞混：CPS-II 在胞质、氮来自谷氨酰胺、不需要 NAG、供给嘧啶；CPS-1 在线粒体、用游离氨、必须有 NAG、供给尿素。
cards.see: L12 · CPS-1 与尿素循环调控 / L11 · PPP / L12 · 核苷酸合成

cards.en:
AMPK — THE CELL'S LOW-FUEL MASTER SWITCH

The course never names it, and an examiner reliably does.

WHAT ACTIVATES IT
A rising AMP/ATP (and ADP/ATP) ratio. AMP binding the γ subunit both activates the enzyme directly and makes its activating phosphorylation on Thr172 — placed there by the upstream kinase LKB1 — harder for a phosphatase to remove. A second, AMP-independent route runs through Ca2+ and CaMKK2. Exercise, hypoxia, glucose deprivation and the drug metformin all activate it.

WHAT IT DOES — one rule: switch off anything that spends ATP to build, switch on anything that makes ATP.
Phosphorylated and INACTIVATED by AMPK:
• acetyl-CoA carboxylase → malonyl-CoA falls → fatty-acid synthesis stops AND, because malonyl-CoA no longer blocks CPT-1, β-oxidation starts. One phosphorylation, both directions.
• HMG-CoA reductase → cholesterol synthesis stops
• glycogen synthase → glycogen storage stops
• mTORC1 signalling → protein synthesis and growth slow
Switched ON:
• glucose uptake, by moving GLUT4 to the muscle surface — insulin-independent, which is why exercise lowers blood glucose even in type 1 diabetes
• fatty-acid oxidation, as above
• over hours, mitochondrial biogenesis through PGC-1α

HOW TO PLACE IT IN AN ANSWER
Insulin and glucagon report what the whole organism is doing; AMPK reports what this one cell has left in the tank. They can disagree, and in exercising muscle they do.
cards.zh:
AMPK —— 细胞的「燃料不足」总开关

这门课从头到尾没有提它的名字，而考官几乎一定会问。

什么激活它
AMP/ATP（以及 ADP/ATP）比值升高。AMP 结合 γ 亚基，既直接激活这个酶，又使它 Thr172 上的活化磷酸（由上游激酶 LKB1 加上）更难被磷酸酶去掉。另有一条不依赖 AMP 的途径经 Ca²⁺ 与 CaMKK2。运动、缺氧、葡萄糖匮乏，以及药物二甲双胍都能激活它。

它做什么 —— 一条规则：凡是花 ATP 去建造的都关掉，凡是产生 ATP 的都打开。
被 AMPK 磷酸化并失活的：
• 乙酰CoA 羧化酶 → 丙二酰CoA 下降 → 脂肪酸合成停止；同时因为丙二酰CoA 不再封锁 CPT-1，β-氧化启动。一次磷酸化，两个方向。
• HMG-CoA 还原酶 → 胆固醇合成停止
• 糖原合酶 → 糖原储存停止
• mTORC1 信号 → 蛋白质合成与生长减慢
被打开的：
• 葡萄糖摄取，通过把 GLUT4 转移到肌细胞表面 —— 不依赖胰岛素，这正是运动即使在 1 型糖尿病中也能降低血糖的原因
• 脂肪酸氧化，如上
• 数小时尺度上，经 PGC-1α 促进线粒体生物合成

答题时怎么给它定位
胰岛素与胰高血糖素报告的是整个机体在干什么；AMPK 报告的是这一个细胞油箱里还剩多少。两者可以不一致，而在运动的肌肉中它们确实不一致。
cards.see: L11 · ACC 调控 / 跨讲整合

cards.en:
TRAPS THAT COST MARKS

• Phosphorylation is not a synonym for activation. The same PKA cascade ACTIVATES glycogen phosphorylase and INACTIVATES glycogen synthase, liver pyruvate kinase and ACC. Say which programme the phosphate marks — fasting and stress — rather than which way it moves 'the enzyme'.
• Hexokinase is inhibited by its product glucose 6-phosphate; glucokinase is not. Their difference in Km is what makes the liver a glucose buffer rather than a glucose consumer.
• PFK-1 is inhibited by ATP at an allosteric site distinct from the site where ATP acts as substrate. It is not substrate inhibition.
• PFK-2 is not a step of glycolysis. Its product fructose 2,6-bisphosphate is consumed by nothing; it is purely a signal.
• PDH is regulated by a kinase and a phosphatase. α-Ketoglutarate dehydrogenase, built to the same design, is not.
• 'Rate-limiting' and 'committed' are not synonyms. Hexokinase catalyses an irreversible step but is not committed to glycolysis, because glucose 6-phosphate can still go to glycogen or into the pentose phosphate pathway. PFK-1 is the first step whose product can do nothing else.
• Citrate inhibits PFK-1 and activates ACC. One molecule, two enzymes, opposite signs — that is the whole point of it.
• Acetyl-CoA activates pyruvate carboxylase but inhibits the PDH complex. Both effects push carbon towards oxaloacetate and away from making more acetyl-CoA.
• CPS-1: mitochondrial, ammonia, needs NAG, makes urea. CPS-II: cytosolic, glutamine, no NAG, makes pyrimidines.
• AMP, not ADP, is the sensitive alarm, because adenylate kinase amplifies a small fall in ATP into a large rise in AMP.
• The TCA cycle has no hormonally phosphorylated enzyme. If an answer has glucagon phosphorylating citrate synthase, it is wrong.
cards.zh:
容易失分的坑

• 磷酸化不等于激活。同一条 PKA 级联激活糖原磷酸化酶，却使糖原合酶、肝脏丙酮酸激酶和 ACC 失活。要说这个磷酸标记的是哪一套程序（饥饿与应激），而不是它把「酶」往哪个方向推。
• 己糖激酶被产物 6-磷酸葡萄糖抑制，葡萄糖激酶不被抑制。两者 Km 的差别正是肝脏成为血糖缓冲器而非葡萄糖消费者的原因。
• PFK-1 被 ATP 抑制，作用位点是别构位点，与 ATP 作为底物结合的位点不同。这不是底物抑制。
• PFK-2 不是糖酵解的一步。它的产物 2,6-二磷酸果糖不被任何反应消耗，它纯粹是一个信号。
• PDH 受一对激酶/磷酸酶调节；结构设计完全相同的 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶不受。
• 「限速」和「关键步骤（committed）」不是同义词。己糖激酶催化的是不可逆的一步，但它并不专属于糖酵解，因为 6-磷酸葡萄糖还可以去合成糖原或进入磷酸戊糖途径。PFK-1 才是产物再无别的去路的第一步。
• 柠檬酸抑制 PFK-1、激活 ACC。一个分子、两个酶、相反的符号 —— 这正是它存在的意义。
• 乙酰CoA 激活丙酮酸羧化酶，却抑制 PDH 复合体。两种效应都把碳推向草酰乙酸、而不是推向生成更多乙酰CoA。
• CPS-1：线粒体、游离氨、需要 NAG、做尿素。CPS-II：胞质、谷氨酰胺、不需要 NAG、做嘧啶。
• 灵敏的警报器是 AMP 而不是 ADP，因为腺苷酸激酶把 ATP 的小幅下降放大成 AMP 的大幅上升。
• 三羧酸循环里没有任何一个酶受激素驱动的磷酸化调节。如果答案里出现「胰高血糖素磷酸化柠檬酸合酶」，那是错的。
cards.see: 跨讲整合 · 常见失分点

quiz.q_en: A sprinter's muscle raises its glycolytic flux within about a second of the gun, long before any hormone could have acted. Which mechanism is doing the work?
quiz.q_zh: 短跑运动员的肌肉在发令枪响后大约一秒内就把糖酵解通量提上去了，这远早于任何激素可能起作用的时间。是哪一种机制在起作用？

options.en: Increased enzyme amount: the sudden demand for ATP induces transcription of the PFK1 gene, and the new enzyme molecules appear quickly because muscle transcription is unusually rapid.
options.zh: 改变酶量：突然的 ATP 需求诱导 PFK1 基因的转录，而由于肌肉的转录速度异常快，新的酶分子很快就出现了。

options.en: Covalent modification: protein kinase A phosphorylates PFK-1 directly on a serine residue, and this raises the enzyme's affinity for fructose 6-phosphate within a second while weakening its ATP inhibition.
options.zh: 共价修饰：蛋白激酶 A 直接在 PFK-1 的一个丝氨酸残基上加磷酸，从而在一秒之内提高该酶对 6-磷酸果糖的亲和力，同时削弱 ATP 对它的抑制。

options.en: Allosteric effectors: ATP is spent, AMP and ADP rise, and they bind PFK-1 and glycogen phosphorylase b at once, since binding requires no chemistry to be done to the enzyme.
options.zh: 别构效应物：ATP 被消耗，AMP 与 ADP 升高，它们立刻结合 PFK-1 和糖原磷酸化酶 b，因为这种结合不需要对酶做任何化学修饰。

options.en: Proteolytic activation: a protease clips an inhibitory propeptide off phosphofructokinase as intramuscular pH falls, converting an inactive zymogen into the mature enzyme.
options.zh: 蛋白水解激活：随着肌肉内 pH 下降，某种蛋白酶切掉磷酸果糖激酶上的一段抑制性前肽，把无活性的酶原转变成成熟的酶。

quiz.explain_en: Allosteric binding is the only mechanism on a sub-second timescale, because nothing has to be chemically changed on the enzyme. Adenylate kinase amplifies the small fall in ATP into a large rise in AMP, which activates both PFK-1 and glycogen phosphorylase b. PKA does not phosphorylate PFK-1 at all, and in any case a covalent cascade takes seconds to minutes. New transcription takes hours, not a second. Phosphofructokinase is not made as a zymogen; proteolytic activation belongs to digestive enzymes and clotting factors.
quiz.explain_zh: 别构结合是唯一能在亚秒尺度起作用的机制，因为不需要对酶做任何化学改变。腺苷酸激酶把 ATP 的小幅下降放大成 AMP 的大幅上升，而 AMP 同时激活 PFK-1 和糖原磷酸化酶 b。PKA 根本不磷酸化 PFK-1，何况共价级联需要几秒到几分钟。新的转录需要几小时而不是一秒。磷酸果糖激酶不是以酶原形式合成的，蛋白水解激活属于消化酶和凝血因子。

quiz.q_en: Insulin rises after a meal. Which enzyme ends up dephosphorylated and MORE active, by the mechanism stated?
quiz.q_zh: 餐后胰岛素升高。按照所述机制，哪一个酶最终处于去磷酸化状态并且活性更高？

options.en: Glycogen synthase, because insulin activates protein phosphatase 1 and inhibits GSK3, so the enzyme reverts to the a form and no longer needs glucose 6-phosphate to work.
options.zh: 糖原合酶，因为胰岛素激活蛋白磷酸酶 1 并抑制 GSK3，使该酶回到 a 型，不再需要 6-磷酸葡萄糖才能工作。

options.en: Glycogen phosphorylase, because protein phosphatase 1 converts it into the a form, and the a form is the one that attacks the glycogen chain and releases glucose 1-phosphate for glycolysis.
options.zh: 糖原磷酸化酶，因为蛋白磷酸酶 1 把它转变成 a 型，而 a 型正是进攻糖原链、释放 1-磷酸葡萄糖供糖酵解使用的那一型。

options.en: Hormone-sensitive lipase, because insulin removes the phosphate placed on it by protein kinase A, and the dephosphorylated enzyme mobilises stored triacylglycerol faster, releasing fatty acids into the blood.
options.zh: 激素敏感性脂肪酶，因为胰岛素去掉了蛋白激酶 A 加在它上面的磷酸，而去磷酸化的酶动员储存的三酰甘油更快，把脂肪酸释放进血液。

options.en: Pyruvate carboxylase, because an insulin-activated phosphatase strips an inhibitory phosphate from it, after which acetyl-CoA can activate it and gluconeogenesis accelerates, raising blood glucose as well.
options.zh: 丙酮酸羧化酶，因为被胰岛素激活的磷酸酶去掉了它上面的抑制性磷酸，之后乙酰CoA 就能激活它，糖异生随之加快，血糖也跟着升高。

quiz.explain_en: Insulin's whole glycogen effect runs through protein phosphatase 1 plus inhibition of GSK3 by PKB/Akt, and dephosphorylated glycogen synthase a is the fully active form. Glycogen phosphorylase is the mirror image: dephosphorylation gives the b form and switches breakdown off, not on. Hormone-sensitive lipase is activated by PKA phosphorylation, so insulin's dephosphorylation shuts lipolysis down. Pyruvate carboxylase is not regulated by phosphorylation at all, and insulin does not stimulate gluconeogenesis.
quiz.explain_zh: 胰岛素对糖原的全部作用都经由蛋白磷酸酶 1，再加上 PKB/Akt 对 GSK3 的抑制；去磷酸化的糖原合酶 a 正是完全有活性的形式。糖原磷酸化酶恰恰相反：去磷酸化得到的是 b 型，等于把分解关掉而不是打开。激素敏感性脂肪酶是被 PKA 磷酸化才激活的，所以胰岛素的去磷酸化是让脂解停下来。丙酮酸羧化酶根本不受磷酸化调节，而且胰岛素也不会促进糖异生。
quiz.see: L11 · 糖原调控 / 胰岛素

quiz.q_en: Glucagon rises in a fasting liver. What happens to fructose 2,6-bisphosphate, and by what mechanism?
quiz.q_zh: 饥饿状态的肝脏中胰高血糖素升高。2,6-二磷酸果糖会怎样变化，机制是什么？

options.en: It is unchanged, because its concentration is set by the cytosolic level of fructose 6-phosphate and responds to substrate supply rather than to any hormonal signal.
options.zh: 它不变，因为它的浓度由胞质中 6-磷酸果糖的水平决定，只对底物供应作出反应，而不对任何激素信号作出反应。

options.en: It rises, because protein kinase A phosphorylates the bifunctional enzyme, and this switches its kinase domain on while the bisphosphatase domain is switched off.
options.zh: 它升高，因为蛋白激酶 A 磷酸化这个双功能酶，从而打开它的激酶结构域，同时关闭二磷酸酶结构域。

options.en: It falls, because protein kinase A phosphorylates the bifunctional PFK-2/FBPase-2 enzyme, turning the kinase domain off and the bisphosphatase domain on, so the signal is destroyed faster than it is made.
options.zh: 它下降，因为蛋白激酶 A 磷酸化双功能酶 PFK-2/FBPase-2，关掉激酶结构域、打开二磷酸酶结构域，于是这个信号被破坏的速度快于生成的速度。

options.en: It falls, because glucagon induces transcription of a separate fructose-2,6-bisphosphatase gene, and the extra enzyme accumulates over the following two to three hours.
options.zh: 它下降，因为胰高血糖素诱导另一个独立的果糖-2,6-二磷酸酶基因的转录，多出来的酶在随后的两三小时内积累起来。

quiz.explain_en: In liver, one polypeptide carries both PFK-2 and FBPase-2 activities, and PKA phosphorylation reciprocally switches the kinase off and the bisphosphatase on, so F-2,6-BP falls: PFK-1 loses its activator and FBPase-1 loses its inhibitor, which is the glucose-sparing response. The claim that phosphorylation raises F-2,6-BP inverts the liver isoenzyme's behaviour. There is no separate glucagon-induced bisphosphatase gene, and the response is covalent and takes minutes, not hours. F-2,6-BP is not simply a passive reflection of fructose 6-phosphate; it is a regulated signal.
quiz.explain_zh: 在肝脏中，同一条多肽同时具有 PFK-2 与 FBPase-2 两种活性；PKA 的磷酸化以互反的方式关掉激酶、打开二磷酸酶，于是 F-2,6-BP 下降：PFK-1 失去激活剂、FBPase-1 失去抑制剂，这正是节省葡萄糖的反应。说磷酸化会升高 F-2,6-BP，是把肝脏同工酶的行为完全弄反了。并不存在另一个被胰高血糖素诱导的二磷酸酶基因，而且这个反应是共价修饰，只需要几分钟而不是几小时。F-2,6-BP 也不是 6-磷酸果糖的被动映射，它是一个受调控的信号。

quiz.q_en: Aconitase catalyses a reaction that sits close to equilibrium inside the mitochondrion. Why is it not a control point of the TCA cycle?
quiz.q_zh: 顺乌头酸酶催化的反应在线粒体内接近平衡。为什么它不是三羧酸循环的调控点？

options.en: Because it catalyses an isomerisation rather than a group transfer, and a cell can regulate only those reactions in which a phosphate or an acyl group is moved between two molecules.
options.zh: 因为它催化的是异构化而不是基团转移，而细胞只能调节那些在两个分子之间转移磷酸基或酰基的反应。

options.en: Because it is the third enzyme of the cycle, and regulation is always placed on the entry step of a pathway so that intermediates can never accumulate behind a closed valve.
options.zh: 因为它是循环中的第三个酶，而调控总是放在途径的入口步骤上，以免中间产物堆积在一个关闭的阀门后面。

options.en: Because a near-equilibrium step runs in whichever direction the concentrations push it, so changing its activity shifts the substrate-to-product ratio rather than the flux through the pathway.
options.zh: 因为接近平衡的一步沿着浓度推它的方向运行，所以改变它的活性只会改变底物与产物的比例，而不会改变通过该途径的通量。

options.en: Because it carries an iron-sulfur cluster rather than a nicotinamide cofactor, and only enzymes that use NAD+ or FAD are able to respond to the energy charge of the cell at all.
options.zh: 因为它带的是铁硫簇而不是烟酰胺辅因子，而只有使用 NAD⁺ 或 FAD 的酶才可能对细胞的能荷作出反应。

quiz.explain_en: A near-equilibrium enzyme is fast relative to its own reaction and simply keeps pace with what upstream steps deliver, so it can only set a ratio, never a rate; control needs a step with a large negative ΔG. The cofactor a step uses is irrelevant — succinate dehydrogenase uses FAD and is also not a control point, while citrate synthase uses no redox cofactor and is one. Isomerisations can be regulated in principle; what disqualifies aconitase is the thermodynamics, not the reaction type. And regulation is not confined to entry steps: isocitrate dehydrogenase and α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase both sit well inside the cycle.
quiz.explain_zh: 接近平衡的酶相对于它自己的反应而言速度很快，只是被动跟上上游送来的量，所以它只能决定一个比例，永远决定不了速率；调控需要一个 ΔG 大幅为负的步骤。用什么辅因子无关紧要 —— 琥珀酸脱氢酶用 FAD，同样不是调控点；柠檬酸合酶不用任何氧化还原辅因子，却是调控点。异构化反应原则上也可以被调节，取消顺乌头酸酶资格的是热力学而不是反应类型。调控也不限于入口步骤：异柠檬酸脱氢酶和 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶都位于循环内部。
quiz.see: L9 · TCA 调控 / L8 · 不可逆步骤

quiz.q_en: After 24 hours of fasting, β-oxidation has raised mitochondrial acetyl-CoA in the liver well above its fed level. What does that acetyl-CoA do to pyruvate carboxylase and to the PDH complex?
quiz.q_zh: 饥饿 24 小时后，β-氧化使肝脏线粒体内的乙酰CoA 远高于进食状态的水平。这些乙酰CoA 对丙酮酸羧化酶和丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体分别做了什么？

options.en: It activates both, so pyruvate is drawn into oxaloacetate and into citrate at the same time, and the cycle accelerates in order to dispose of the extra reducing equivalents.
options.zh: 它同时激活两者，于是丙酮酸既被拉向草酰乙酸又被拉向柠檬酸，循环加速以处理掉多出来的还原当量。

options.en: It inhibits both, so pyruvate accumulates in the matrix and is exported to the cytosol, where it is reduced to lactate and returned to the blood for the Cori cycle.
options.zh: 它同时抑制两者，于是丙酮酸在基质中堆积并被运出到胞质，在那里被还原成乳酸并回到血液，进入 Cori 循环。

options.en: It activates pyruvate carboxylase as an obligatory allosteric activator and inhibits the PDH complex as a product, so pyruvate is routed to oxaloacetate for gluconeogenesis.
options.zh: 它作为必需的别构激活剂激活丙酮酸羧化酶，又作为产物抑制 PDH 复合体，于是丙酮酸被引向草酰乙酸供糖异生使用。

options.en: It has no direct effect on either enzyme, since both of them respond to the NADH/NAD+ ratio alone, and the acetyl-CoA signal is read only by the enzymes of ketone-body synthesis.
options.zh: 它对两个酶都没有直接作用，因为两者都只对 NADH/NAD⁺ 比值起反应，而乙酰CoA 这个信号只被酮体合成的酶读取。

quiz.explain_en: Acetyl-CoA is an obligatory allosteric activator of pyruvate carboxylase and a product inhibitor of the PDH complex, acting on it both directly and by activating PDH kinase. The two effects point the same way: carbon goes to oxaloacetate for glucose rather than to more acetyl-CoA. Activating both would be self-defeating, and inhibiting both ignores the fact that a fasting liver needs oxaloacetate. Acetyl-CoA is not a silent metabolite here; the NADH/NAD+ ratio matters too but does not replace it.
