quiz.explain_zh: 乙酰CoA 是丙酮酸羧化酶必需的别构激活剂，同时又是 PDH 复合体的产物抑制剂 —— 既直接抑制，又通过激活 PDH 激酶抑制。两个效应指向同一个方向：碳流向草酰乙酸去做葡萄糖，而不是再变成更多乙酰CoA。同时激活两者是自相矛盾的；同时抑制两者则忽略了饥饿肝脏正需要草酰乙酸这一点。乙酰CoA 在这里不是一个沉默的代谢物；NADH/NAD⁺ 比值当然也重要，但取代不了它。
quiz.see: L11 · 丙酮酸羧化酶 / L9 · PDH 调控

quiz.q_en: Which set of conditions switches the PDH complex off through its kinase, and why is the signal often described as doubled?
quiz.q_zh: 哪一组条件通过 PDH 激酶关闭丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体？为什么说这个信号是「加倍」的？

options.en: High pyruvate, high CoA and high NAD+ activate PDH kinase, and these same three metabolites also bind the E1 subunit directly, so the complex is inhibited by two routes at once.
options.zh: 高丙酮酸、高 CoA 和高 NAD⁺ 激活 PDH 激酶，而这三个代谢物同时又直接结合 E1 亚基，所以复合体被两条路径同时抑制。

options.en: High NADH, acetyl-CoA and ATP activate PDH kinase, and the same three also inhibit the complex allosterically, so each of them acts both on the enzyme and on its kinase.
options.zh: 高 NADH、乙酰CoA 和 ATP 激活 PDH 激酶，而这三者同时又别构抑制复合体本身，所以每一个都既作用于酶、又作用于它的激酶。

options.en: High Ca2+ and high ADP activate PDH kinase in contracting muscle, and both of them also displace thiamine pyrophosphate from E1, so the complex is silenced by two independent routes.
options.zh: 高 Ca²⁺ 和高 ADP 在收缩的肌肉中激活 PDH 激酶，两者同时还把硫胺素焦磷酸从 E1 上置换下来，于是复合体被两条独立的途径关闭。

options.en: High insulin together with high glucagon activates PDH kinase through protein kinase A, which phosphorylates the E1 subunit and the E2 core of the complex in the same reaction.
options.zh: 高胰岛素与高胰高血糖素一起通过蛋白激酶 A 激活 PDH 激酶，后者在同一个反应中磷酸化复合体的 E1 亚基和 E2 核心。

quiz.explain_en: NADH, acetyl-CoA and ATP are the products-plus-energy signal: each inhibits the complex directly and each activates PDH kinase, which phosphorylates E1 and switches the complex off — the same message delivered twice, on two timescales. Pyruvate, CoA and NAD+ do the opposite: they inhibit the kinase and keep the complex on. Ca2+ activates the phosphatase, not the kinase, and ADP also keeps the complex active. PDH kinase is not a PKA target, and insulin activates PDH phosphatase in adipose tissue rather than the kinase.
quiz.explain_zh: NADH、乙酰CoA 和 ATP 就是「产物 + 能量」这一组信号：每一个都直接抑制复合体，每一个又都激活 PDH 激酶，后者磷酸化 E1 把复合体关掉 —— 同一条消息在两个时间尺度上被送了两遍。丙酮酸、CoA 和 NAD⁺ 的作用正相反：它们抑制激酶、让复合体保持开启。Ca²⁺ 激活的是磷酸酶而不是激酶，ADP 同样使复合体保持活性。PDH 激酶不是 PKA 的底物，而胰岛素在脂肪组织中激活的是 PDH 磷酸酶而不是激酶。
quiz.see: L9 · PDH 复合体的调控

quiz.q_en: A well-fed hepatocyte has abundant citrate in its cytosol. Trace the consequence for fatty-acid oxidation.
quiz.q_zh: 一个营养充足的肝细胞胞质中柠檬酸很丰富。请推出它对脂肪酸氧化的后果。

options.en: Citrate activates acetyl-CoA carboxylase, malonyl-CoA rises, and malonyl-CoA inhibits CPT-1, so acyl groups cannot cross into the matrix and oxidation is shut off while synthesis runs.
options.zh: 柠檬酸激活乙酰CoA 羧化酶，丙二酰CoA 升高，而丙二酰CoA 抑制 CPT-1，于是酰基无法进入基质，氧化被关闭而合成继续。

options.en: Citrate inhibits acetyl-CoA carboxylase, malonyl-CoA falls, CPT-1 is released from inhibition, and acyl groups enter the mitochondrion so that oxidation runs alongside synthesis, both drawing on one acetyl-CoA pool.
options.zh: 柠檬酸抑制乙酰CoA 羧化酶，丙二酰CoA 下降，CPT-1 的抑制被解除，酰基进入线粒体，于是氧化与合成同时进行，两条途径共用同一个乙酰CoA 库。

options.en: Citrate is cleaved to acetyl-CoA in the matrix, where it inhibits CPT-1 directly, so oxidation stops while cytosolic synthesis proceeds from an entirely separate pool of acetyl-CoA made from glucose.
options.zh: 柠檬酸在基质中被裂解为乙酰CoA，后者直接抑制 CPT-1，于是氧化停止，而胞质中的合成则由一个完全独立的、来自葡萄糖的乙酰CoA 库继续进行。

options.en: Citrate activates AMPK, AMPK phosphorylates acetyl-CoA carboxylase, malonyl-CoA rises, CPT-1 is blocked, and the acyl groups are stored as triacylglycerol instead of being burned.
options.zh: 柠檬酸激活 AMPK，AMPK 磷酸化乙酰CoA 羧化酶，丙二酰CoA 升高，CPT-1 被封锁，于是酰基被储存为三酰甘油而不是被烧掉。

quiz.explain_en: Citrate is the allosteric activator of ACC, driving it into active filaments; the malonyl-CoA it produces is both the substrate for fatty-acid synthase and the inhibitor of CPT-1, so synthesis automatically forbids oxidation. Citrate does not inhibit ACC, and it does not activate AMPK — AMP does, in the opposite nutritional state. Matrix acetyl-CoA is not the inhibitor of CPT-1; malonyl-CoA is, and it acts from the cytosolic face.
quiz.explain_zh: 柠檬酸是 ACC 的别构激活剂，把它驱动成有活性的丝状聚合体；它生成的丙二酰CoA 既是脂肪酸合酶的底物，又是 CPT-1 的抑制剂，所以合成自动禁止了氧化。柠檬酸不抑制 ACC，也不激活 AMPK —— 激活 AMPK 的是 AMP，出现在相反的营养状态下。抑制 CPT-1 的不是基质中的乙酰CoA，而是丙二酰CoA，且作用于面向胞质的一侧。

quiz.q_en: Between meals blood glucose falls below the range in which liver glucokinase works efficiently. What follows, and how does it differ from hexokinase in muscle?
quiz.q_zh: 两餐之间血糖降到肝脏葡萄糖激酶高效工作的范围以下。会发生什么，这与肌肉中的己糖激酶有何不同？

options.en: Both enzymes slow to the same extent, because they are isoenzymes with identical kinetics, and the difference between the two tissues lies entirely in how much enzyme each of them expresses.
options.zh: 两个酶减慢的程度相同，因为它们是动力学完全相同的同工酶，两种组织之间的差别完全在于各自表达了多少酶。

options.en: Liver glucokinase is released from its nuclear regulatory protein as glucose falls, so its activity rises instead, which is how the liver keeps its own glucose supply going during a fast.
options.zh: 随着血糖下降，肝脏葡萄糖激酶从核内的调节蛋白上被释放出来，活性反而上升，肝脏借此在饥饿期间维持自身的葡萄糖供应。

options.en: Liver glucokinase, which has a high Km, slows sharply and the liver stops removing glucose, while muscle hexokinase, which has a low Km, stays saturated and keeps phosphorylating what it takes up.
options.zh: 肝脏葡萄糖激酶的 Km 高，会急剧减慢，肝脏因此停止摄取葡萄糖；而肌肉己糖激酶的 Km 低，仍处于饱和状态，继续磷酸化它摄取到的葡萄糖。

options.en: Liver glucokinase, which has a low Km, keeps working at full rate, while muscle hexokinase is inhibited by the glucose 6-phosphate that accumulates once glycolytic flux has slowed down.
options.zh: 肝脏葡萄糖激酶的 Km 低，仍以最大速率工作；而肌肉己糖激酶被糖酵解通量减慢后积累起来的 6-磷酸葡萄糖抑制。

quiz.explain_en: The high Km of glucokinase makes hepatic uptake proportional to blood glucose, so the liver competes for glucose only when there is a surplus; the low Km of hexokinase keeps muscle and brain supplied at fasting concentrations. Reversing the Km values inverts the physiology. The two are not kinetically identical isoenzymes — the whole point is that they differ in Km and in product inhibition. GKRP releases glucokinase when glucose or fructose 1-phosphate RISES, so a falling glucose keeps the enzyme sequestered rather than freeing it.
quiz.explain_zh: 葡萄糖激酶的高 Km 使肝脏的摄取速率与血糖浓度成比例，因此肝脏只在有余量时才去争夺葡萄糖；己糖激酶的低 Km 则保证肌肉和脑在饥饿浓度下仍有供应。把两者的 Km 对调，整个生理学就反了。它们也不是动力学完全相同的同工酶 —— 关键正在于 Km 和产物抑制的差别。GKRP 是在葡萄糖或 1-磷酸果糖升高时才释放葡萄糖激酶，所以血糖下降只会让这个酶继续被扣留，而不是被放出来。
quiz.see: L8 · 己糖激酶与葡萄糖激酶

quiz.q_en: Which statement about the control of the TCA cycle is correct?
quiz.q_zh: 关于三羧酸循环调控的下列说法，哪一条是正确的？

options.en: Isocitrate dehydrogenase is activated by ADP and Ca2+ and inhibited by ATP and NADH, so the cycle is paced by the energy charge of the matrix rather than by any hormone.
options.zh: 异柠檬酸脱氢酶被 ADP 和 Ca²⁺ 激活、被 ATP 和 NADH 抑制，所以这个循环由基质的能荷、而不是由任何激素来定速。

options.en: Succinyl-CoA synthetase is the committed step of the cycle, because it carries out the only substrate-level phosphorylation, and it is inhibited allosterically by the GTP it makes as that GTP accumulates.
options.zh: 琥珀酰CoA 合成酶是循环的关键步骤，因为它执行了唯一一次底物水平磷酸化，而且随着 GTP 的积累，它被自己生成的 GTP 别构抑制。

options.en: α-Ketoglutarate dehydrogenase is switched off by a dedicated kinase during fasting, in the same way that the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex is switched off by PDH kinase.
options.zh: α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶在饥饿时被一个专门的激酶关闭，方式与丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体被 PDH 激酶关闭完全相同。

options.en: Citrate synthase is rate-limiting because glucagon causes it to be phosphorylated, and this is how a fasting liver slows the cycle and spares oxaloacetate for glucose synthesis.
options.zh: 柠檬酸合酶之所以是限速酶，是因为胰高血糖素使它被磷酸化，饥饿的肝脏借此减慢循环、把草酰乙酸省下来合成葡萄糖。

quiz.explain_en: Isocitrate dehydrogenase is the cycle's clearest energy-charge sensor and the enzyme usually named rate-limiting, and no TCA enzyme is hormonally phosphorylated. α-Ketoglutarate dehydrogenase shares the E1/E2/E3 architecture of PDH but has no kinase or phosphatase — it is held back by its products succinyl-CoA and NADH instead. Citrate synthase is controlled by product inhibition and by oxaloacetate supply, not by glucagon-driven phosphorylation. Succinyl-CoA synthetase carries out the only substrate-level phosphorylation, but a step in the middle of a closed cycle commits nothing, and it is not GTP-inhibited.
quiz.explain_zh: 异柠檬酸脱氢酶是循环中最清楚的能荷感受器，也是通常被称作限速酶的那一个；而 TCA 循环中没有任何酶受激素驱动的磷酸化调节。α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶虽然与 PDH 共享 E1/E2/E3 的结构，却没有配套的激酶和磷酸酶 —— 约束它的是产物琥珀酰CoA 和 NADH。柠檬酸合酶受产物抑制和草酰乙酸供应的控制，而不是受胰高血糖素驱动的磷酸化控制。琥珀酰CoA 合成酶确实执行唯一一次底物水平磷酸化，但一个封闭循环中间的步骤谈不上「关键步骤」，而且它也不被 GTP 抑制。

quiz.q_en: A cell begins synthesising fatty acids at a high rate. What happens to flux through the oxidative branch of the pentose phosphate pathway, and by which mechanism?
quiz.q_zh: 一个细胞开始高速合成脂肪酸。磷酸戊糖途径氧化阶段的通量会怎样变化，机制是什么？

options.en: It rises, because the malonyl-CoA made by acetyl-CoA carboxylase is a positive allosteric effector of G6PD, coupling the demand for reducing power to the enzyme that supplies it, much as citrate does for that carboxylase.
options.zh: 它升高，因为乙酰CoA 羧化酶生成的丙二酰CoA 是 G6PD 的正别构效应物，把对还原力的需求与供应它的酶偶联起来，与柠檬酸对该羧化酶的作用类似。

options.en: It falls, because glucose 6-phosphate is diverted into glycolysis to supply the acetyl-CoA that is needed, and the oxidative branch is left without enough substrate to sustain flux.
options.zh: 它下降，因为 6-磷酸葡萄糖被转入糖酵解以提供所需的乙酰CoA，氧化阶段因此缺少足够的底物来维持通量。

options.en: It is unaffected, because the oxidative branch runs at a constant rate fixed by the amount of G6PD present, and only the non-oxidative branch responds to changing metabolic demand.
options.zh: 它不受影响，因为氧化阶段以由现有 G6PD 数量决定的恒定速率运行，只有非氧化阶段才对代谢需求的变化作出反应。

options.en: It rises, because fatty-acid synthesis consumes NADPH, NADPH is a competitive inhibitor of G6PD, and removing it leaves more NADP+ available as substrate for the enzyme.
options.zh: 它升高，因为脂肪酸合成消耗 NADPH，而 NADPH 是 G6PD 的竞争性抑制剂，消耗它就留下更多 NADP⁺ 作为底物。

quiz.explain_en: G6PD is controlled by the NADP+/NADPH balance: NADPH competes with NADP+ and holds the enzyme back, so consuming NADPH is itself the signal that opens the pathway — supply is tied directly to demand. Malonyl-CoA is the CPT-1 inhibitor and has no role at G6PD. Substrate competition with glycolysis is not what sets the branch, since the pathway is demand-driven from the NADPH side. And the amount of G6PD does change, being induced by insulin, so calling its flux fixed is wrong twice over.
quiz.explain_zh: G6PD 由 NADP⁺/NADPH 的平衡控制：NADPH 与 NADP⁺ 竞争并压住这个酶，所以消耗 NADPH 本身就是打开这条途径的信号 —— 供给直接绑定在需求上。丙二酰CoA 是 CPT-1 的抑制剂，在 G6PD 这里没有任何角色。与糖酵解争夺底物并不是决定这条支路速率的因素，因为该途径是由 NADPH 一侧的需求驱动的。而且 G6PD 的量本身也会变化（受胰岛素诱导），所以说它的通量是固定的，错了两次。
quiz.see: L11 · 磷酸戊糖途径与 NADPH

quiz.q_en: A patient on a high-protein diet increases urea output within hours, before there is any change in the amount of urea-cycle enzyme. What explains the rise?
quiz.q_zh: 一名高蛋白饮食的患者在数小时内尿素排出量增加，而此时尿素循环酶的量还没有任何变化。如何解释这一升高？

options.en: Arginine made by arginase accumulates and allosterically activates CPS-1 directly, which is the reason arginine is described as the regulator of the entire urea cycle.
options.zh: 精氨酸酶生成的精氨酸积累起来，直接别构激活 CPS-1，这正是精氨酸被称为整个尿素循环调节者的原因。

options.en: More glutamate is available, so N-acetylglutamate synthase makes more N-acetylglutamate, and CPS-1 has essentially no activity at all unless that activator is bound to it.
options.zh: 可利用的谷氨酸增多，于是 N-乙酰谷氨酸合酶生成更多 N-乙酰谷氨酸；而除非结合了这个激活剂，CPS-1 基本上完全没有活性。

options.en: Free ammonia rises and directly activates ornithine transcarbamoylase, the committed step, which pulls carbamoyl phosphate forward and drags the rest of the cycle along with it.
options.zh: 游离氨升高并直接激活关键步骤鸟氨酸氨甲酰转移酶，后者把氨基甲酰磷酸往前拉，从而带动循环的其余部分。

options.en: The extra amino acids raise the liver's ATP demand, and the resulting fall in ATP relieves the ATP inhibition of argininosuccinate synthetase, which is the rate-limiting enzyme of the whole cycle.
options.zh: 多出来的氨基酸提高了肝脏的 ATP 需求，随之而来的 ATP 下降解除了 ATP 对整个循环的限速酶精氨琥珀酸合成酶的抑制作用。

quiz.explain_en: N-acetylglutamate is the short-term switch: it is built from glutamate and acetyl-CoA, so a flood of amino acid nitrogen raises glutamate, raises NAG and opens CPS-1, which without NAG is effectively dead. Arginine does act, but on NAG synthase, not on CPS-1 directly. CPS-1, not ornithine transcarbamoylase, is the committed step, and free ammonia is a substrate rather than an activator. Argininosuccinate synthetase is not the rate-limiting enzyme and is not switched on by falling ATP. Enzyme induction also occurs but takes days, which the question excludes.
quiz.explain_zh: N-乙酰谷氨酸是短期开关：它由谷氨酸和乙酰CoA 合成，所以大量氨基酸氮涌入会抬高谷氨酸、抬高 NAG，从而打开 CPS-1 —— 而 CPS-1 没有 NAG 时形同死酶。精氨酸确实起作用，但作用于 NAG 合酶，而不是直接作用于 CPS-1。关键步骤是 CPS-1 而不是鸟氨酸氨甲酰转移酶，游离氨是底物而不是激活剂。精氨琥珀酸合成酶既不是限速酶，也不会因 ATP 下降而被打开。酶的诱导确实存在，但需要数天，而题干已经把它排除了。

quiz.q_en: Which description correctly separates CPS-II from CPS-1?
quiz.q_zh: 下列哪一条描述正确地区分了 CPS-II 与 CPS-1？

options.en: CPS-II works in the mitochondrial matrix on free ammonia and requires N-acetylglutamate, while CPS-1 works in the cytosol on the amide nitrogen of glutamine and needs no allosteric activator of any kind.
options.zh: CPS-II 在线粒体基质中以游离氨为底物并需要 N-乙酰谷氨酸，而 CPS-1 在胞质中利用谷氨酰胺的酰胺氮，且不需要任何别构激活剂。

options.en: CPS-II and CPS-1 are the same protein made from one gene, and the two names refer only to whether the carbamoyl phosphate produced is used for urea or for pyrimidine synthesis.
options.zh: CPS-II 与 CPS-1 是同一个基因产生的同一个蛋白，两个名字只是指所生成的氨基甲酰磷酸被用于尿素还是用于嘧啶合成。

options.en: CPS-II is inhibited by N-acetylglutamate and activated by UTP, while CPS-1 is inhibited by arginine and activated by the carbamoyl phosphate that accumulates inside the matrix.
options.zh: CPS-II 被 N-乙酰谷氨酸抑制、被 UTP 激活，而 CPS-1 被精氨酸抑制、被基质内积累的氨基甲酰磷酸激活。

options.en: CPS-II is cytosolic, takes its nitrogen from glutamine, needs no N-acetylglutamate, is inhibited by UTP and activated by PRPP, and opens pyrimidine rather than urea synthesis.
options.zh: CPS-II 位于胞质，氮来自谷氨酰胺，不需要 N-乙酰谷氨酸，被 UTP 抑制、被 PRPP 激活，开启的是嘧啶合成而不是尿素合成。

quiz.explain_en: CPS-II is the cytosolic activity of the CAD polypeptide: glutamine as nitrogen donor, no NAG requirement, feedback-inhibited by the end product UTP and activated by PRPP. Swapping the compartments and nitrogen sources describes each enzyme as the other. They are distinct proteins from distinct genes, not one protein with two names. And the effectors in the third description are invented: NAG activates CPS-1 rather than inhibiting CPS-II, and UTP inhibits CPS-II rather than activating it.
quiz.explain_zh: CPS-II 是 CAD 多肽上的胞质活性：以谷氨酰胺为氮供体，不需要 NAG，被终产物 UTP 反馈抑制、被 PRPP 激活。把区室和氮源对调，等于把两个酶各自描述成了对方。它们是来自不同基因的不同蛋白，不是一个蛋白的两个名字。而那组「NAG 抑制 CPS-II、UTP 激活 CPS-II」的效应物是编造的：NAG 是激活 CPS-1 的，UTP 是抑制 CPS-II 的。

quiz.q_en: PRPP concentration rises sharply in a cell. What does the committed step of purine synthesis do, and what kind of control is that?
quiz.q_zh: 细胞内 PRPP 浓度急剧升高。嘌呤合成的关键步骤会怎样，这属于哪一类调控？

options.en: Glutamine-PRPP amidotransferase is activated, an example of feed-forward control in which an upstream substrate opens the committed step before intermediates can accumulate.
options.zh: 谷氨酰胺-PRPP 酰胺转移酶被激活，这是前馈调控的例子：上游底物在中间产物堆积之前先把关键步骤打开。

options.en: CPS-II is activated while glutamine-PRPP amidotransferase is unaffected, because PRPP is purely a pyrimidine signal and purine synthesis responds only to AMP, GMP and IMP.
options.zh: CPS-II 被激活而谷氨酰胺-PRPP 酰胺转移酶不受影响，因为 PRPP 纯粹是嘧啶途径的信号，嘌呤合成只对 AMP、GMP 和 IMP 起反应。

options.en: Glutamine-PRPP amidotransferase is inhibited, an example of feedback inhibition in which an early intermediate reports that the pathway is already saturated with its own substrate.
options.zh: 谷氨酰胺-PRPP 酰胺转移酶被抑制，这是反馈抑制的例子：一个早期中间物报告该途径已经被自身底物饱和。

options.en: Ribonucleotide reductase is activated, an example of feed-forward control in which the supply of ribose phosphate sets the rate at which deoxyribonucleotides are produced.
options.zh: 核糖核苷酸还原酶被激活，这是前馈调控的例子：核糖磷酸的供应决定脱氧核糖核苷酸生成的速率。

quiz.explain_en: PRPP is the substrate of glutamine-PRPP amidotransferase and also its allosteric activator, so a rising supply opens the committed step in advance — the definition of feed-forward. Calling the same event feedback inhibition reverses both the direction and the sign; the feedback inhibitors here are the end products AMP, GMP and IMP. Ribonucleotide reductase is controlled by dATP and the other nucleotide effectors, not by PRPP. PRPP does activate CPS-II as well, but it is not exclusive to pyrimidines, so denying any purine effect is wrong.
quiz.explain_zh: PRPP 既是谷氨酰胺-PRPP 酰胺转移酶的底物，又是它的别构激活剂，所以供应上升会提前打开关键步骤 —— 这正是前馈的定义。把同一件事说成反馈抑制，方向和符号都反了；这里的反馈抑制剂是终产物 AMP、GMP 和 IMP。核糖核苷酸还原酶由 dATP 等核苷酸效应物调控，而不是由 PRPP 调控。PRPP 确实也激活 CPS-II，但它并不专属于嘧啶途径，所以否认它对嘌呤的作用是错的。

quiz.q_en: AMPK is activated in an exercising muscle. Which combination of consequences follows?
quiz.q_zh: 运动中的肌肉里 AMPK 被激活。会出现下列哪一组后果？

options.en: Fatty-acid synthase is activated and cholesterol synthesis rises, because the cell needs membrane material for the mitochondrial biogenesis that AMPK initiates through PGC-1α.
options.zh: 脂肪酸合酶被激活、胆固醇合成上升，因为细胞需要膜材料来支持 AMPK 经 PGC-1α 启动的线粒体生物合成。

options.en: Glycogen synthase is activated and acetyl-CoA carboxylase is inhibited, so glucose is stored while fat is burned, and GLUT4 is withdrawn from the membrane to conserve glucose, while the rate of cholesterol synthesis is entirely unaffected.
options.zh: 糖原合酶被激活、乙酰CoA 羧化酶被抑制，于是葡萄糖被储存起来而脂肪被烧掉，同时 GLUT4 从膜上撤回以节省葡萄糖，而胆固醇的合成速率完全不受影响。

options.en: Acetyl-CoA carboxylase and HMG-CoA reductase are phosphorylated and inhibited, GLUT4 moves to the cell surface, and falling malonyl-CoA releases CPT-1 so β-oxidation accelerates.
options.zh: 乙酰CoA 羧化酶与 HMG-CoA 还原酶被磷酸化抑制，GLUT4 移到细胞表面，丙二酰CoA 下降解除对 CPT-1 的抑制，β-氧化加速。

options.en: Insulin secretion from the pancreatic β-cell is stimulated, glycogen synthase is dephosphorylated, and mTORC1 signalling rises so that the muscle rebuilds protein during the exercise.
options.zh: 胰腺 β 细胞的胰岛素分泌被刺激，糖原合酶被去磷酸化，mTORC1 信号升高，使肌肉在运动过程中重建蛋白质。

quiz.explain_en: AMPK's rule is to stop ATP-consuming synthesis and start ATP-yielding catabolism: it phosphorylates and inhibits ACC, HMG-CoA reductase and glycogen synthase, moves GLUT4 to the surface independently of insulin, and — through the fall in malonyl-CoA — opens CPT-1 so β-oxidation runs. Activating glycogen synthase or withdrawing GLUT4 reverses two of those. AMPK does not stimulate insulin secretion, and it suppresses mTORC1 rather than raising it. Mitochondrial biogenesis via PGC-1α is real but slow, and it does not come with activated fatty-acid or cholesterol synthesis.
quiz.explain_zh: AMPK 的规则是：停掉消耗 ATP 的合成，启动产生 ATP 的分解。它磷酸化并抑制 ACC、HMG-CoA 还原酶和糖原合酶，不依赖胰岛素地把 GLUT4 移到细胞表面，并通过丙二酰CoA 的下降打开 CPT-1 让 β-氧化运行。说糖原合酶被激活、或 GLUT4 被撤回，把其中两项弄反了。AMPK 不刺激胰岛素分泌，而且它抑制而非提高 mTORC1。经 PGC-1α 的线粒体生物合成确实存在，但很慢，也不会伴随脂肪酸合成与胆固醇合成被激活。
quiz.see: L11 · ACC 调控 / 跨讲整合

quiz.q_en: Cellular sterol levels rise. Which description of what happens to HMG-CoA reductase is correct, and on what timescale?
quiz.q_zh: 细胞内固醇水平升高。关于 HMG-CoA 还原酶会发生什么、以及在什么时间尺度上发生，哪一条描述是正确的？

options.en: Sterols have no effect on this enzyme, since cholesterol synthesis is controlled at squalene monooxygenase, and reductase activity is fixed by the amount of enzyme laid down in the fetal liver and never changes afterwards.
options.zh: 固醇对这个酶没有影响，因为胆固醇合成的调控点在角鲨烯单加氧酶，而还原酶的活性由胎肝时期就定下的酶量所固定，此后终生不再发生改变。

options.en: Sterols block processing of the SREBP-2 transcription factor and speed the enzyme's proteasomal degradation, so the amount of enzyme falls over hours — control by enzyme quantity.
options.zh: 固醇阻止转录因子 SREBP-2 的加工，同时加速该酶的蛋白酶体降解，于是酶的量在数小时内下降 —— 这是通过酶量进行的调控。

options.en: Sterols bind an allosteric site on the enzyme and inhibit it within seconds, which is why cholesterol synthesis responds to a meal faster than any other biosynthetic pathway does.
options.zh: 固醇结合该酶上的一个别构位点并在数秒内抑制它，这正是胆固醇合成对一餐饭的反应快于任何其他合成途径的原因。

options.en: Sterols activate protein kinase A, which phosphorylates the enzyme within minutes — the same covalent mechanism by which glucagon switches off liver pyruvate kinase during a fast.
options.zh: 固醇激活蛋白激酶 A，后者在数分钟内磷酸化该酶 —— 与胰高血糖素在饥饿时关闭肝脏丙酮酸激酶所用的共价机制相同。

quiz.explain_en: HMG-CoA reductase is the course's cleanest example of regulation by enzyme amount, and sterols act on both ends of it at once: less transcription because SREBP-2 is not escorted to the Golgi, and faster destruction because Insig recruits the enzyme for degradation. That is an hours-to-days response. There is no seconds-fast allosteric sterol site, and PKA is not the kinase here — AMPK is the covalent regulator, and it responds to energy charge rather than to sterols. Squalene monooxygenase is a secondary control point, not a replacement for the committed step.
quiz.explain_zh: HMG-CoA 还原酶是本课程中「用酶量调控」最干净的例子，而固醇同时从两端下手：SREBP-2 不再被护送到高尔基体，转录减少；Insig 招募该酶去降解，已有的酶消失得更快。这是小时到天的反应。并不存在秒级起效的固醇别构位点；这里的激酶也不是 PKA 而是 AMPK，而 AMPK 响应的是能荷而不是固醇。角鲨烯单加氧酶是次级调控点，取代不了关键步骤。
quiz.see: L11 · 胆固醇合成 / 酶量调控

quiz.q_en: Why does an untreated type 1 diabetic produce ketone bodies even though blood glucose is high?
quiz.q_zh: 为什么未经治疗的 1 型糖尿病患者血糖很高，却仍然生成酮体？

options.en: The high blood glucose saturates hexokinase in the liver, and the excess glucose 6-phosphate is diverted through the pentose phosphate pathway into acetoacetate and β-hydroxybutyrate.
options.zh: 高血糖使肝脏的己糖激酶饱和，多余的 6-磷酸葡萄糖经磷酸戊糖途径被转化为乙酰乙酸和 β-羟丁酸。

options.en: High glucose activates pyruvate dehydrogenase kinase, the acetyl-CoA that results cannot be oxidised, and the liver exports it as ketone bodies in order to spare its own coenzyme A.
options.zh: 高血糖激活丙酮酸脱氢酶激酶，由此产生的乙酰CoA 无法被氧化，肝脏就把它以酮体形式输出，以节省自身的辅酶 A。

options.en: Insulin normally inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, and in its absence the mevalonate pathway runs backwards, releasing acetoacetate from the HMG-CoA that accumulates in the cytosol.
options.zh: 胰岛素通常抑制 HMG-CoA 还原酶，在缺乏胰岛素时甲羟戊酸途径反向运行，从胞质中积累的 HMG-CoA 释放出乙酰乙酸。

options.en: Without insulin, lipolysis floods the liver with fatty acids while oxaloacetate is drained into gluconeogenesis, so acetyl-CoA cannot enter the TCA cycle and is condensed by HMG-CoA synthase.
options.zh: 没有胰岛素时，脂解把大量脂肪酸送进肝脏，同时草酰乙酸被抽去做糖异生，于是乙酰CoA 无法进入 TCA 循环，转而被 HMG-CoA 合酶缩合。

quiz.explain_en: Ketogenesis is driven by the hormonal state, not by the blood glucose reading: no insulin means unrestrained lipolysis and a glucagon-dominated liver, so β-oxidation piles up acetyl-CoA at exactly the moment oxaloacetate is being consumed by gluconeogenesis, and mitochondrial HMG-CoA synthase takes the overflow. Ketone bodies are not made from glucose 6-phosphate, and the pentose phosphate pathway produces NADPH and ribose 5-phosphate rather than acetoacetate. Glucose does not activate PDH kinase directly. The mevalonate pathway is cytosolic, irreversible and makes cholesterol, not ketone bodies.
quiz.explain_zh: 酮体生成由激素状态驱动，而不是由血糖读数驱动：没有胰岛素意味着脂解不受约束、肝脏被胰高血糖素主导，于是 β-氧化堆起乙酰CoA 的时刻，恰恰是草酰乙酸被糖异生消耗的时刻，线粒体 HMG-CoA 合酶接手了这些溢出的乙酰CoA。酮体不是由 6-磷酸葡萄糖做出来的，磷酸戊糖途径产生的是 NADPH 和 5-磷酸核糖而不是乙酰乙酸。葡萄糖也不会直接激活 PDH 激酶。甲羟戊酸途径在胞质、不可逆、产物是胆固醇而不是酮体。
quiz.see: L11 · 酮体生成 / 临床

quiz.q_en: Fructose 1,6-bisphosphate activates pyruvate kinase several steps further down glycolysis. What is this an example of, and what does it achieve?
quiz.q_zh: 1,6-二磷酸果糖激活位于糖酵解下游好几步的丙酮酸激酶。这是哪一类调控的例子，它达到了什么目的？

options.en: Covalent modification, since binding fructose 1,6-bisphosphate exposes the serine that protein kinase A phosphorylates when glucagon acts on the liver isoenzyme of the enzyme.
options.zh: 共价修饰，因为结合 1,6-二磷酸果糖会暴露出那个丝氨酸，当胰高血糖素作用于该酶的肝脏同工酶时，蛋白激酶 A 就磷酸化它。

options.en: Feed-forward activation, which opens the exit of the pathway in advance so that the flux committed at PFK-1 is carried through instead of accumulating as intermediates.
options.zh: 前馈激活，它提前打开途径的出口，使在 PFK-1 处已经投入的通量能够被送出去，而不是堆积成中间产物。

options.en: Substrate channelling, in which the intermediate is handed directly from one active site to the next without ever equilibrating with the bulk pool of cytosolic metabolites, so the downstream enzyme needs no separate activator.
options.zh: 底物通道效应，中间产物直接从一个活性中心传递到下一个，从不与胞质中大量代谢物库达成平衡，因此下游的酶不需要另外的激活剂。

options.en: Product inhibition, which ensures that the payoff phase can never outrun the preparatory phase and that triose phosphates are not allowed to build up inside the cytosol, since the exit rate is set by the entry rate.
options.zh: 产物抑制，它确保放能相不会跑到准备相前面，也不让丙糖磷酸在胞质中堆积起来，因为出口的速率始终由入口的速率决定。

quiz.explain_en: An upstream metabolite activating a downstream enzyme is the definition of feed-forward activation, and the point is that PFK-1 has already committed the carbon, so the exit must be opened before triose phosphates accumulate. Product inhibition runs the other way, from a later product back onto an earlier enzyme. Phosphorylation of liver pyruvate kinase is real but is a separate, glucagon-driven control that does not require F-1,6-BP binding. Substrate channelling describes physical transfer between active sites, which is not what an allosteric effector does.
quiz.explain_zh: 上游代谢物激活下游的酶，这就是前馈激活的定义；要点在于 PFK-1 已经把碳投进去了，所以必须在丙糖磷酸堆积之前把出口打开。产物抑制的方向正相反，是较晚的产物回过头作用于较早的酶。肝脏丙酮酸激酶的磷酸化确实存在，但那是另一套由胰高血糖素驱动的调控，并不需要 F-1,6-BP 的结合。底物通道效应指的是在活性中心之间的物理传递，这不是别构效应物做的事。

quiz.q_en: A muscle contracts with no rise in circulating epinephrine, and glycogen breakdown still accelerates. Which mechanism accounts for it?
quiz.q_zh: 肌肉在循环肾上腺素没有升高的情况下收缩，而糖原分解仍然加快。是哪一种机制造成的？

options.en: Glucose 6-phosphate accumulating during contraction binds glycogen phosphorylase b and shifts it into the relaxed conformation, which is the active form of the muscle enzyme.
options.zh: 收缩过程中积累的 6-磷酸葡萄糖结合糖原磷酸化酶 b，使它转入松弛构象，而松弛构象正是肌肉中该酶的活性形式。

options.en: Ca2+ released from the sarcoplasmic reticulum binds the calmodulin subunit of phosphorylase kinase and activates it without cAMP, and AMP also activates phosphorylase b allosterically.
options.zh: 肌质网释放的 Ca²⁺ 结合磷酸化酶激酶的钙调蛋白亚基，在没有 cAMP 的情况下将其激活；同时 AMP 也别构激活磷酸化酶 b。

options.en: Contraction lowers the intracellular pH, and the protons released activate phosphorylase kinase directly, the same effect by which a falling pH accelerates PFK-1 and glycogen phosphorylase b in working muscle.
options.zh: 收缩降低细胞内 pH，释放出的质子直接激活磷酸化酶激酶，这与 pH 下降在工作肌肉中加速 PFK-1 和糖原磷酸化酶 b 是同一种效应。

options.en: Protein phosphatase 1 is activated by contraction and dephosphorylates glycogen phosphorylase to the a form, which is how muscle avoids depending on a hormone during exercise.
options.zh: 收缩激活蛋白磷酸酶 1，把糖原磷酸化酶去磷酸化成 a 型，肌肉借此在运动时不必依赖激素。

quiz.explain_en: Phosphorylase kinase has calmodulin as an integral subunit, so the same Ca2+ transient that triggers contraction switches on glycogen breakdown with no hormone and no cAMP; AMP acting on phosphorylase b adds a second, purely allosteric route. Glucose 6-phosphate does the opposite — it inhibits phosphorylase b. Falling pH inhibits PFK-1 rather than accelerating it, and protons are not a phosphorylase kinase activator. PP1 dephosphorylates phosphorylase to the b form, the less active one, so it opposes breakdown instead of driving it.
quiz.explain_zh: 磷酸化酶激酶本身就以钙调蛋白作为组成亚基，所以触发收缩的那一次 Ca²⁺ 瞬变，在没有激素、没有 cAMP 的情况下同时打开了糖原分解；AMP 作用于磷酸化酶 b，提供了第二条纯别构的途径。6-磷酸葡萄糖的作用恰恰相反 —— 它抑制磷酸化酶 b。pH 下降是抑制 PFK-1 而不是加速它，质子也不是磷酸化酶激酶的激活剂。PP1 把磷酸化酶去磷酸化成活性较低的 b 型，因此它是对抗分解、而不是驱动分解。
quiz.see: L11 · 糖原磷酸化酶 / 钙信号

quiz.q_en: PFK-1 and fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase catalyse opposite reactions in the same cytosol. Why must they be regulated with opposite signs rather than simply coexisting?
quiz.q_zh: PFK-1 和果糖-1,6-二磷酸酶在同一个胞质中催化方向相反的反应。为什么它们必须被以相反的符号调节，而不能只是共存？

options.en: Because the two enzymes compete for the same magnesium ions, and running both at once would deplete the free Mg2+ that every other kinase in the cytosol also depends on.
options.zh: 因为这两个酶争夺同样的镁离子，两者同时运行会耗尽胞质中其他所有激酶同样依赖的游离 Mg²⁺。

options.en: Because fructose 1,6-bisphosphate is toxic above a low threshold, and the only way to keep its concentration safe is to guarantee that one of the two enzymes is completely inactive.
options.zh: 因为 1,6-二磷酸果糖超过一个很低的阈值就有毒性，而把它的浓度维持在安全范围的唯一办法就是保证两个酶中有一个完全没有活性。

options.en: Because the two enzymes share a common regulatory subunit, so activating one of them physically displaces the other from the complex in which both must be assembled to work.
options.zh: 因为这两个酶共用一个调节亚基，激活其中一个就会把另一个从两者都必须组装其中才能工作的复合体上挤下来。

options.en: Because running both at once would hydrolyse ATP and release only heat — a futile cycle — so one signal such as fructose 2,6-bisphosphate activates one enzyme and inhibits the other.
options.zh: 因为两者同时运行只会水解 ATP 并放出热量 —— 即无效循环 —— 所以像 2,6-二磷酸果糖这样的一个信号会激活一个酶、同时抑制另一个。

quiz.explain_en: The forward step spends ATP and the reverse step hydrolyses the phosphate away, so simultaneous operation returns the cell to where it started minus one ATP: a futile cycle. Reciprocal regulation by a single effector, above all F-2,6-BP, is the cell's answer. Magnesium is not limiting in this way. Fructose 1,6-bisphosphate is a normal glycolytic intermediate and is not toxic. And the two enzymes are separate soluble proteins, not partners in one complex — the bifunctional enzyme that does combine two opposed activities is PFK-2/FBPase-2, which makes and destroys the signal rather than the intermediate.
quiz.explain_zh: 正向那一步消耗 ATP，逆向那一步又把磷酸水解掉，所以两者同时运行只会让细胞回到原点、净亏一个 ATP：这就是无效循环。细胞的对策是由单一效应物（首先是 F-2,6-BP）进行互反调节。镁离子并不会以这种方式成为限制因素。1,6-二磷酸果糖是正常的糖酵解中间产物，没有毒性。这两个酶是各自独立的可溶性蛋白，不是同一个复合体的搭档 —— 真正把两个相反活性合在一起的双功能酶是 PFK-2/FBPase-2，而它生成和破坏的是信号，不是这个中间产物。
quiz.see: L8 · 互反调节 / L11 · 糖异生

quiz.q_en: Rotenone blocks Complex I and matrix NADH accumulates. Which effect on the TCA cycle and its entry step follows directly from the raised NADH/NAD+ ratio?
quiz.q_zh: 鱼藤酮阻断复合体 I，基质中 NADH 积累。NADH/NAD⁺ 比值升高会直接对三羧酸循环及其入口步骤产生下列哪一种影响？

options.en: Succinate dehydrogenase is inhibited, because it is the only enzyme of the cycle that reduces a flavin, so the cycle halts at succinate while all the earlier steps keep running and NADH goes on accumulating in the matrix.
options.zh: 琥珀酸脱氢酶被抑制，因为它是循环中唯一还原黄素的酶，于是循环停在琥珀酸，而前面所有步骤继续运行，NADH 也继续在基质中积累。

options.en: Citrate synthase, isocitrate dehydrogenase and α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase are all inhibited, and the PDH complex is inhibited both directly and through activation of PDH kinase.
options.zh: 柠檬酸合酶、异柠檬酸脱氢酶和 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶全部被抑制，而 PDH 复合体既被直接抑制、又通过激活 PDH 激酶而被抑制。

options.en: Only the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex is affected, because the enzymes of the cycle read the ATP/ADP ratio rather than the NADH/NAD+ ratio and are insensitive to a Complex I block.
options.zh: 只有丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体受影响，因为循环中的酶读的是 ATP/ADP 比值而不是 NADH/NAD⁺ 比值，对复合体 I 的阻断不敏感。

options.en: Citrate synthase is activated while isocitrate dehydrogenase is inhibited, so citrate accumulates and leaves the mitochondrion to start fatty-acid synthesis in the cytosol, while α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase is unaffected.
options.zh: 柠檬酸合酶被激活而异柠檬酸脱氢酶被抑制，于是柠檬酸积累并离开线粒体，在胞质中启动脂肪酸合成，同时 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶不受影响。

quiz.explain_en: NADH is a product of citrate synthase's cycle and a direct inhibitor of citrate synthase, isocitrate dehydrogenase and α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase, and at the PDH complex it acts twice — inhibiting the complex and activating PDH kinase. Citrate synthase is inhibited by NADH, not activated by it, so the first description has the sign wrong. Succinate dehydrogenase passes electrons into ubiquinone downstream of the Complex I block and is not the NADH-sensitive step. Confining the effect to PDH ignores that three cycle enzymes read the NADH/NAD+ ratio directly.
quiz.explain_zh: NADH 是这个循环自身转动的产物，同时直接抑制柠檬酸合酶、异柠檬酸脱氢酶和 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶；在 PDH 复合体处它作用了两次 —— 既抑制复合体，又激活 PDH 激酶。柠檬酸合酶是被 NADH 抑制而不是激活，所以那条描述符号弄反了。琥珀酸脱氢酶把电子交给泛醌，位于复合体 I 阻断点的下游，并不是对 NADH 敏感的那一步。把影响局限于 PDH，则忽略了循环中有三个酶直接读取 NADH/NAD⁺ 比值。
quiz.see: L9 · TCA 产物抑制 / L10 · 呼吸链抑制剂

sections.title_en: Where everything happens, and how things cross membranes
sections.title_zh: 各条途径在哪里进行，物质又怎样跨膜
sections.blurb_en: A single, unambiguous compartment map for every pathway in the course, plus every transport system that moves a metabolite across the mitochondrial inner membrane and why each one has to exist.
sections.blurb_zh: 把课程里每一条代谢途径的区室定位一次说清楚，并逐一交代跨线粒体内膜的各个转运系统：它们各自运什么、为什么非有不可。

cards.en: The compartment map you should be able to redraw from memory. Cytosol: glycolysis, the pentose phosphate pathway, fatty acid synthesis, glycogen synthesis and glycogen breakdown, and most of gluconeogenesis. Mitochondrial matrix: the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, the whole TCA cycle, beta-oxidation, ketone body synthesis, and the opening steps of the urea cycle. Inner mitochondrial membrane: the respiratory complexes, ATP synthase, and every metabolite carrier. Endoplasmic reticulum: cholesterol synthesis, fatty acid desaturation and elongation, and glucose-6-phosphatase. When a pathway looks as though it runs in two places at once, it is almost always two different enzymes doing the same chemistry in two compartments.
cards.zh: 这张区室图要能默画出来。胞质 cytosol：糖酵解 glycolysis、磷酸戊糖途径 pentose phosphate pathway、脂肪酸合成 fatty acid synthesis、糖原的合成与分解，以及糖异生 gluconeogenesis 的大部分步骤。线粒体基质 mitochondrial matrix：丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体 PDH complex、整个 TCA 循环、β-氧化 beta-oxidation、酮体生成 ketogenesis，以及尿素循环开头的两步。线粒体内膜 inner mitochondrial membrane：呼吸链各复合体、ATP synthase，以及所有代谢物载体 carrier。内质网 ER：胆固醇合成、脂肪酸的去饱和 desaturation 与延长 elongation、葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶 glucose-6-phosphatase。凡是看起来「同一条途径在两个地方跑」的，几乎都是两个不同的酶在两个区室里做同一种化学反应。

cards.en: Only one of the two mitochondrial membranes is a barrier. The outer membrane carries VDAC, the porin, which lets small metabolites and ions pass, so the intermembrane space has essentially the composition of cytosol; when a text says a site faces the cytosolic side of the inner membrane, it means the intermembrane space. The inner membrane has no porin, is unusually protein-rich and folded into cristae, and lets almost nothing through without a dedicated carrier of the SLC25 family. That is precisely why a proton gradient can exist across it at all: any general leak pathway would discharge it. So the question of whether a molecule gets into the mitochondrion always reduces to whether there is a carrier for it in the inner membrane.
cards.zh: 线粒体的两层膜里只有一层是真正的屏障。外膜上有 VDAC（porin，孔蛋白），小分子代谢物和离子都能通过，所以膜间隙 intermembrane space 的成分基本等同于胞质；书上说某个位点「朝向内膜的胞质侧」，指的就是膜间隙。内膜没有孔蛋白，蛋白含量特别高，折叠成嵴 cristae，几乎任何物质不经专门的载体（SLC25 家族）都过不去。正因如此，跨内膜的质子梯度才可能存在：只要有一条通用的漏路，梯度立刻塌掉。所以「这个分子能不能进线粒体」这个问题，永远等价于「内膜上有没有对应的载体」。

cards.en: Four molecules never cross the inner mitochondrial membrane, and each has a workaround that is usually the whole exam answer. NADH: carried across in effect by the malate-aspartate shuttle or the glycerol-3-phosphate shuttle. NADPH: not transported at all, it is generated separately in each compartment where it is needed. Acetyl-CoA: leaves the matrix disguised as citrate. CoA itself: never moves, so the acyl group is handed to carnitine and handed back to a matrix CoA on the far side. Add oxaloacetate to the list, which also has no carrier of its own and travels as malate or as aspartate. Naming the workaround, rather than simply saying it cannot cross, is what scores the mark.
cards.zh: 有四种分子从不跨过线粒体内膜，而每一种都有一条替代路线——考试要的答案通常就是这条替代路线的名字。NADH：靠苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭 malate-aspartate shuttle 或甘油-3-磷酸穿梭 glycerol-3-phosphate shuttle 等效地送过去。NADPH：根本没有转运，需要它的区室各自就地生产。乙酰CoA acetyl-CoA：以柠檬酸 citrate 的形式伪装着离开基质。CoA 本身：从不移动，脂酰基先交给肉碱 carnitine，到对面再交回给基质里的另一个 CoA。草酰乙酸 oxaloacetate 也要加进这份名单，它同样没有自己的载体，只能以苹果酸或天冬氨酸的形式走。只说「过不去」不得分，说出替代路线才得分。

cards.en: The carnitine shuttle, three proteins in order. A long-chain fatty acid is first activated on the outer mitochondrial membrane by acyl-CoA synthetase, at a cost of two high-energy phosphate bonds because ATP goes to AMP plus pyrophosphate. CPT-1, on the outer face of the inner membrane, transfers the acyl group from CoA onto carnitine. CACT, the carnitine-acylcarnitine translocase, antiports acylcarnitine inwards against free carnitine going outwards. CPT-2, on the matrix face, transfers the acyl group back onto a matrix CoA. The acyl group crosses; CoA never does, which is what keeps the cytosolic and the matrix CoA pools separate and separately regulated. CPT-1 is inhibited by malonyl-CoA, so fatty acids that are being synthesised cannot be burned at the same time.
cards.zh: 肉碱穿梭 carnitine shuttle，三个蛋白依次登场。长链脂肪酸先在线粒体外膜上被脂酰CoA 合成酶 acyl-CoA synthetase 活化，代价是两个高能磷酸键，因为 ATP 一路裂解到 AMP 加焦磷酸。CPT-1 位于内膜的外侧面，把脂酰基从 CoA 上转移到肉碱 carnitine 上。CACT（肉碱-脂酰肉碱转位酶）做反向转运：脂酰肉碱进来，游离肉碱出去。CPT-2 位于内膜的基质侧，把脂酰基再交回给基质里的 CoA。跨膜的是脂酰基，CoA 从来不过膜——这正是胞质 CoA 池与基质 CoA 池得以分开、并各自受调控的原因。CPT-1 受丙二酰CoA malonyl-CoA 抑制，所以正在合成脂肪酸的时候不会同时把它烧掉。

cards.en: The citrate shuttle carries acetyl units the other way, out to the cytosol. Matrix acetyl-CoA, from pyruvate or from beta-oxidation, condenses with oxaloacetate to citrate; when matrix citrate is plentiful the citrate carrier exports it in exchange for malate coming in. In the cytosol ATP-citrate lyase splits citrate, using CoA and ATP, back into acetyl-CoA and oxaloacetate. The acetyl-CoA feeds acetyl-CoA carboxylase and fatty acid synthase, and also cholesterol synthesis. The oxaloacetate is reduced to malate and then decarboxylated by malic enzyme to pyruvate, which generates NADPH and re-enters the mitochondrion. One shuttle therefore delivers both the carbon skeleton and part of the reducing power that fatty acid synthesis needs.
cards.zh: 柠檬酸穿梭 citrate shuttle 把乙酰基往相反方向送，运到胞质去。基质里的乙酰CoA（来自丙酮酸或 β-氧化）与草酰乙酸缩合成柠檬酸；当基质柠檬酸充裕时，柠檬酸载体 citrate carrier 把它换出去，同时把苹果酸换进来。到了胞质，ATP-柠檬酸裂解酶 ATP-citrate lyase 消耗 CoA 与 ATP，把柠檬酸重新劈成乙酰CoA 和草酰乙酸。乙酰CoA 供给乙酰CoA 羧化酶 ACC 与脂肪酸合酶 FAS，也供给胆固醇合成。草酰乙酸先被还原成苹果酸，再由苹果酸酶 malic enzyme 脱羧生成丙酮酸，这一步产出 NADPH，丙酮酸则重新进入线粒体。也就是说，一条穿梭同时送来了脂肪酸合成所需的碳骨架和一部分还原力。

cards.en: The two shuttles for cytosolic NADH, side by side. Malate-aspartate, in liver, kidney and heart: cytosolic malate dehydrogenase puts the electrons into malate, the malate/alpha-ketoglutarate carrier brings malate in, and matrix malate dehydrogenase remakes a genuine matrix NADH, so the electrons enter at Complex I and are worth 2.5 ATP. Because oxaloacetate cannot come back out, it is transaminated to aspartate, which returns through the glutamate-aspartate carrier. Glycerol-3-phosphate, in skeletal muscle and brain: a cytosolic dehydrogenase reduces dihydroxyacetone phosphate to glycerol-3-phosphate, and the mitochondrial isoenzyme, sitting in the inner membrane with its active site facing the intermembrane space, passes the electrons through FAD to ubiquinone, downstream of Complex I, so they are worth only 1.5 ATP. The malate-aspartate route is reversible and depends on the membrane potential; the glycerol-3-phosphate route is effectively one-way and fast.
cards.zh: 两条胞质 NADH 穿梭途径的对照。苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭（肝、肾、心）：胞质苹果酸脱氢酶把电子存进苹果酸，苹果酸/α-酮戊二酸载体把苹果酸送进基质，基质苹果酸脱氢酶再造出一个货真价实的基质 NADH，电子因而从 Complex I 进入呼吸链，折合 2.5 个 ATP。由于草酰乙酸出不来，它被转氨成天冬氨酸，经谷氨酸-天冬氨酸载体返回胞质。甘油-3-磷酸穿梭（骨骼肌、脑）：胞质脱氢酶把磷酸二羟丙酮 DHAP 还原成甘油-3-磷酸，线粒体上的同工酶嵌在内膜里、活性中心朝向膜间隙，把电子经 FAD 交给泛醌 ubiquinone，位置在 Complex I 的下游，所以只折合 1.5 个 ATP。苹果酸-天冬氨酸这条路可逆、依赖膜电位；甘油-3-磷酸这条路实际上是单向的，但速度快。

cards.en: Where the fractional ATP numbers come from. A matrix NADH is counted as 2.5 ATP, and an FADH2, or anything else entering at ubiquinone, as 1.5; that is why one glucose is quoted as 30 to 32 ATP, the lower figure when cytosolic NADH goes through the glycerol-3-phosphate shuttle and the higher when it goes through the malate-aspartate shuttle. The values are fractional because the proton-motive force is not spent on ATP synthase alone: bringing phosphate in on the phosphate carrier and sending ATP out on the adenine nucleotide translocase also cost protons, so the protons consumed per ATP delivered to the cytosol is not a whole number. Compartment logic, not sloppy arithmetic, is the reason.
cards.zh: 那些带小数的 ATP 数字是怎么来的。基质里的一个 NADH 记 2.5 个 ATP，FADH2 或任何从泛醌位置进入的电子记 1.5 个；所以一分子葡萄糖记作 30–32 个 ATP，走甘油-3-磷酸穿梭时取下限，走苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭时取上限。之所以是小数，是因为质子动力势 proton-motive force 并非只花在 ATP synthase 上：磷酸经磷酸载体 phosphate carrier 进来、ATP 经腺苷酸转位酶 ANT 出去，同样要消耗质子，于是「每送到胞质一个 ATP 要用掉几个质子」就不是整数。这是区室逻辑的结果，不是算术上的马虎。

cards.see: L10 · ANT, phosphate carrier and MPC
cards.en: Three carriers make oxidative phosphorylation possible at all. MPC, the mitochondrial pyruvate carrier, brings pyruvate in as a symport with a proton, delivering the substrate for the PDH complex. The phosphate carrier brings inorganic phosphate in together with a proton, driven by the pH difference across the inner membrane. ANT, the adenine nucleotide translocase, exchanges matrix ATP for cytosolic ADP one for one; because ATP carries one more negative charge than ADP, the exchange is electrogenic and is driven by the membrane potential, which is also why it can be blocked by atractyloside. Substrate in, phosphate in, product out: remove any one of the three and the matrix machinery stops even though every enzyme inside it is intact.
cards.zh: 三个载体是氧化磷酸化能够运转的前提。MPC（线粒体丙酮酸载体）以「丙酮酸 + 质子同向转运」的方式把丙酮酸送进基质，为 PDH 复合体提供底物。磷酸载体 phosphate carrier 把无机磷酸连同一个质子一起带进来，动力来自跨内膜的 pH 差。ANT（腺苷酸转位酶）把基质里的 ATP 与胞质里的 ADP 一比一交换；由于 ATP 比 ADP 多带一个负电荷，这个交换是生电的 electrogenic，动力来自膜电位，这也是它能被苍术苷 atractyloside 阻断的原因。底物进来、磷酸进来、产物出去：三者缺一，哪怕基质里每个酶都完好，整套机器也会停摆。

cards.en: The urea cycle is the clearest split-compartment pathway in the course. CPS-1 and ornithine transcarbamylase work in the matrix, making carbamoyl phosphate from ammonia and bicarbonate and then handing it to ornithine to give citrulline. Argininosuccinate synthetase, argininosuccinate lyase and arginase work in the cytosol. The cycle is closed across the membrane by a single antiporter: citrulline goes out while ornithine comes in. The aspartate that supplies the second nitrogen atom reaches the cytosol on the glutamate-aspartate carrier, the very carrier the malate-aspartate shuttle uses, which is why one transporter defect can disturb both nitrogen disposal and cytosolic NADH handling. Note also that CPS-1 is in the matrix and uses ammonia, while CPS-2 of pyrimidine synthesis is in the cytosol and uses glutamine: compartment is the cleanest way to tell the two apart.
cards.zh: 尿素循环是全课程里区室分工最清楚的一条途径。CPS-1 与鸟氨酸氨甲酰转移酶 OTC 在基质里工作，先用氨和碳酸氢根做出氨甲酰磷酸，再交给鸟氨酸生成瓜氨酸 citrulline。精氨琥珀酸合成酶 ASS、精氨琥珀酸裂解酶 ASL 和精氨酸酶 arginase 在胞质里工作。整个循环靠一个反向转运体跨膜闭合：瓜氨酸出去的同时鸟氨酸 ornithine 进来。提供第二个氮原子的天冬氨酸则经谷氨酸-天冬氨酸载体到达胞质，而这正是苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭所用的同一个载体——所以一个转运体出问题，可以同时扰乱氮的处置和胞质 NADH 的处理。另外记住：CPS-1 在基质、用游离氨，嘧啶合成的 CPS-2 在胞质、用谷氨酰胺；区分这两者最干净的判据就是区室。

cards.en: HMG-CoA appears in two compartments and belongs to two different pathways. In the liver mitochondrial matrix, acetoacetyl-CoA and acetyl-CoA are joined by mitochondrial HMG-CoA synthase and then cleaved by HMG-CoA lyase to acetoacetate, the first ketone body. In the cytosol, the same intermediate is made by a cytosolic synthase and reduced by HMG-CoA reductase, an integral protein of the ER membrane and the rate-limiting step of cholesterol synthesis, which is the statin target. Same metabolite, two compartments, two enzymes, two fates. It follows that a statin does not suppress ketone body formation, and that fasting ketosis does not drive cholesterol synthesis.
cards.zh: HMG-CoA 出现在两个区室里，分属两条不同的途径。在肝细胞的线粒体基质中，乙酰乙酰CoA 与乙酰CoA 由线粒体型 HMG-CoA 合酶缩合，再由 HMG-CoA 裂解酶切成乙酰乙酸——第一个酮体。在胞质中，同一个中间物由胞质型合酶生成，再被 HMG-CoA 还原酶还原；这个还原酶是内质网膜的整合膜蛋白，是胆固醇合成的限速步骤，也是他汀 statin 的作用靶点。同一个代谢物，两个区室，两个酶，两种去路。由此可知：他汀不会抑制酮体生成，饥饿性酮症也不会推动胆固醇合成。

cards.see: L11 · the ER and the peroxisome
cards.en: What happens outside the cytosol and the mitochondrion. Fatty acid synthase releases palmitate at C16 and stops; all further elongation, and all desaturation, take place on the endoplasmic reticulum membrane, with Delta-9 the main human desaturase, which is why humans cannot place a double bond beyond C9 and why linoleate and alpha-linolenate must come from the diet. Both gluconeogenesis and glycogen breakdown end in the ER lumen, where glucose-6-phosphatase strips off the phosphate that had trapped glucose inside the cell; muscle lacks this enzyme, which is why muscle glycogen cannot raise blood glucose. Omega-oxidation is an ER cytochrome P450 route, while alpha-oxidation of branched-chain fatty acids such as phytanate, and the first rounds of oxidation of very-long-chain fatty acids, are peroxisomal.
cards.zh: 胞质和线粒体之外还发生了什么。脂肪酸合酶做到棕榈酸 C16 就停手；此后所有的延长与去饱和全部在内质网膜上进行，人体主要的去饱和酶是 Δ9，所以人不能在 C9 之外引入双键，亚油酸与 α-亚麻酸必须从食物获得。糖异生和糖原分解最终都止于内质网腔：葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶在那里卸掉当初把葡萄糖锁在细胞内的那个磷酸基；肌肉没有这个酶，所以肌糖原不能升高血糖。ω-氧化是内质网上的细胞色素 P450 途径；而支链脂肪酸（如植烷酸 phytanate）的 α-氧化，以及极长链脂肪酸最初几轮的氧化，都发生在过氧化物酶体 peroxisome 里。

cards.see: L9 · Complex II is the exception
cards.en: Every enzyme of the TCA cycle is a soluble matrix protein except one. Succinate dehydrogenase is Complex II, an integral protein of the inner membrane, positioned there so that it can pass electrons straight to ubiquinone within the lipid bilayer. Citrate synthase, aconitase, both dehydrogenase complexes, succinyl-CoA synthetase, fumarase and malate dehydrogenase all work free in the matrix. So if a question asks which step of the cycle happens on the membrane, the answer is succinate to fumarate and no other; and the same fact explains why Complex II pumps no protons and why the electrons it delivers are worth 1.5 rather than 2.5 ATP.
cards.zh: TCA 循环的酶全部是基质中的可溶性蛋白，只有一个例外。琥珀酸脱氢酶就是 Complex II，是内膜的整合膜蛋白，之所以待在那里，是为了能在脂双层内部把电子直接交给泛醌。柠檬酸合酶、顺乌头酸酶、两个脱氢酶复合体、琥珀酰CoA 合成酶、延胡索酸酶、苹果酸脱氢酶，全都游离在基质中工作。所以题目若问「循环里哪一步发生在膜上」，答案只能是琥珀酸→延胡索酸，别无他选；同一个事实也解释了为什么 Complex II 不泵质子、它送出的电子只值 1.5 而不是 2.5 个 ATP。

cards.en: The chloroplast is the mirror image, and stating it that way answers the comparison question cleanly. Mitochondrion: protons are pumped out of the matrix into the intermembrane space, so the matrix becomes the alkaline compartment; they flow back in through ATP synthase, whose catalytic head faces the matrix, and the ATP appears in the matrix where the TCA cycle runs. Chloroplast: protons are pumped into the thylakoid lumen, and the splitting of water releases more protons there, so the lumen becomes the acidic compartment; they flow out into the stroma through the chloroplast ATP synthase, whose catalytic head faces the stroma, and ATP together with NADPH appears in the stroma where the Calvin cycle runs. Same machine, opposite geometry, and in both cases the ATP is made in the compartment that will spend it.
cards.zh: 叶绿体是线粒体的镜像，把它这样表述出来，比较题就能答得干净。线粒体：质子被从基质泵到膜间隙，于是基质成为偏碱的一侧；质子经 ATP synthase 回流进基质，其催化头部朝向基质，ATP 就出现在跑 TCA 循环的基质里。叶绿体：质子被泵进类囊体腔 thylakoid lumen，水的光解又在腔内释放更多质子，于是腔内成为偏酸的一侧；质子经叶绿体 ATP synthase 流出到基质 stroma，其催化头部朝向基质，ATP 连同 NADPH 出现在跑卡尔文循环 Calvin cycle 的基质里。同一台机器，相反的几何取向；而且两种情况下，ATP 都是在将要花掉它的那个区室里合成的。

cards.en: Compartment and transporter failures make recognisable clinical pictures. CPT-2 deficiency presents as rhabdomyolysis with myoglobinuria after prolonged exercise or fasting: long-chain fatty acids cannot reach the matrix, while medium-chain fatty acids, which enter without needing carnitine, are still oxidised normally. Primary carnitine deficiency is a different lesion, a defect of the plasma-membrane carnitine transporter rather than of the shuttle enzymes. Ornithine transcarbamylase deficiency, the commonest urea cycle disorder and the only X-linked one, traps carbamoyl phosphate in the matrix; it escapes into the cytosol and is drawn into pyrimidine synthesis, giving hyperammonaemia with raised orotic acid and low citrulline. Failure of the ornithine/citrulline carrier gives hyperornithinaemia together with hyperammonaemia and homocitrullinuria.
cards.zh: 区室与转运体的缺陷会造成可以辨认的临床表现。CPT-2 缺乏症表现为长时间运动或禁食后的横纹肌溶解伴肌红蛋白尿：长链脂肪酸进不了基质，而中链脂肪酸不需要肉碱就能进入，仍能正常氧化。原发性肉碱缺乏 primary carnitine deficiency 则是另一种病变，缺的是质膜上的肉碱转运体，而不是穿梭系统的酶。鸟氨酸氨甲酰转移酶 OTC 缺乏症是最常见的尿素循环缺陷，也是其中唯一 X 连锁的，它把氨甲酰磷酸困在基质里；氨甲酰磷酸漏进胞质后被拉进嘧啶合成途径，于是出现高氨血症伴乳清酸 orotic acid 升高、瓜氨酸降低。鸟氨酸/瓜氨酸载体失灵则表现为高鸟氨酸血症、高氨血症与高同型瓜氨酸尿三联征。

quiz.q_en: A drug blocks CPT-1 in the liver of a fasting person. What accumulates, and what stops?
quiz.q_zh: 一种药物阻断了禁食者肝脏中的 CPT-1。什么会堆积，什么会停下来？

options.en: Long-chain acylcarnitine piles up inside the matrix, and the citrate shuttle therefore stops carrying acetyl units out to the cytosol for fatty acid synthesis.
options.zh: 长链脂酰肉碱在基质内部堆积，柠檬酸穿梭因此停止把乙酰基运往胞质、供脂肪酸合成之用。

options.en: Free carnitine piles up inside the matrix, and cytosolic fatty acid synthesis stops for want of malonyl-CoA to extend.
options.zh: 游离肉碱在基质内堆积，胞质脂肪酸合成因缺少可供延长的丙二酰CoA 而停止。

options.en: Free CoA piles up in the cytosol, and the TCA cycle stops because oxaloacetate can no longer be regenerated.
options.zh: 游离 CoA 在胞质中堆积，TCA 循环因草酰乙酸无法再生而停止。

options.en: Long-chain acyl-CoA piles up on the cytosolic side, and both mitochondrial beta-oxidation and hepatic ketone body production fall.
options.zh: 长链脂酰CoA 在胞质一侧堆积，线粒体 β-氧化与肝脏的酮体生成同时下降。

quiz.explain_en: CPT-1 is the committed entry step, so activated long-chain fatty acids are stranded as acyl-CoA on the cytosolic side and the matrix acetyl-CoA that would have fed ketogenesis is never made. Acylcarnitine cannot build up in the matrix because it is never formed. Malonyl-CoA is made by acetyl-CoA carboxylase in the cytosol and does not depend on this shuttle at all; if anything, blocking CPT-1 mimics a high malonyl-CoA state. Oxaloacetate regeneration is a matter of the citrate shuttle and anaplerosis, not of carnitine.
quiz.explain_zh: CPT-1 是脂肪酸入线粒体的关键限速步骤，被阻断后活化好的长链脂酰CoA 就滞留在胞质一侧，本该供给酮体生成的基质乙酰CoA 也就无从产生。脂酰肉碱堆积在基质是不可能的，因为它根本没被生成。丙二酰CoA 由胞质的乙酰CoA 羧化酶合成，与这条穿梭无关；阻断 CPT-1 反而是在模拟高丙二酰CoA 的状态。草酰乙酸的再生属于柠檬酸穿梭与回补反应的范畴，与肉碱无关。

quiz.q_en: You radioactively label the cytosolic pool of CoA and then feed the cell a long-chain fatty acid. Where does the label end up?
quiz.q_zh: 你把胞质中的 CoA 池做了放射性标记，然后给细胞喂长链脂肪酸。标记最终出现在哪里？

options.en: In neither pool, because CoA is degraded at the outer membrane and resynthesised inside the matrix from free pantothenate.
options.zh: 两个池子里都不出现，因为 CoA 在外膜上被降解，再由游离泛酸在基质内重新合成。

options.en: In cytosolic acyl-CoA only, because CPT-1 strips the CoA off before transport and CPT-2 attaches a fresh matrix CoA on the far side, so the two pools never mix.
options.zh: 只出现在胞质脂酰CoA 中，因为 CPT-1 在转运前把 CoA 卸下，CPT-2 在对面再接上一个基质的 CoA，两个池子从不混合。

options.en: In matrix acetyl-CoA only, because CoA crosses the inner membrane freely and is re-acylated there by the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex.
options.zh: 只出现在基质乙酰CoA 中，因为 CoA 可以自由跨过内膜，并在那里由丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体重新酰化。

options.en: In matrix acyl-CoA as well as cytosolic acyl-CoA, because the carnitine shuttle carries the intact acyl-CoA thioester across the inner membrane.
options.zh: 既出现在胞质脂酰CoA 中，也出现在基质脂酰CoA 中，因为肉碱穿梭把完整的脂酰CoA 硫酯运过了内膜。

quiz.explain_en: The whole point of the carnitine shuttle is that the acyl group crosses and CoA does not: CPT-1 transfers the acyl group to carnitine, CACT moves acylcarnitine, and CPT-2 re-forms acyl-CoA using CoA that was already in the matrix. So the two CoA pools stay chemically separate and separately regulated. The intact-thioester answer describes a transporter that does not exist; CoA crossing freely contradicts the impermeability of the inner membrane; and there is no degradation-and-resynthesis step at the outer membrane.
quiz.explain_zh: 肉碱穿梭的要义正在于：过膜的是脂酰基，CoA 不过膜。CPT-1 把脂酰基交给肉碱，CACT 转运脂酰肉碱，CPT-2 再用基质里原有的 CoA 重新生成脂酰CoA。因此两个 CoA 池在化学上彼此隔离、各自受调控。说完整硫酯被运过去，等于虚构了一个并不存在的转运体；说 CoA 自由跨膜，与内膜的不透性矛盾；外膜上也没有什么降解再合成的步骤。

quiz.q_en: The same cytosolic NADH is worth 2.5 ATP in liver but only 1.5 ATP in skeletal muscle. Why?
quiz.q_zh: 同样一个胞质 NADH，在肝脏折合 2.5 个 ATP，在骨骼肌却只折合 1.5 个。为什么？

options.en: Muscle mitochondria have fewer cristae, so Complex I is limiting there and part of the NADH is oxidised by cytosolic lactate dehydrogenase instead of by the respiratory chain.
options.zh: 肌肉线粒体的嵴较少，Complex I 在那里成为限速环节，一部分 NADH 便改由胞质中的乳酸脱氢酶氧化掉，而不是交给呼吸链。

options.en: Liver uses the malate-aspartate shuttle, so the electrons enter at Complex I; muscle uses the glycerol-3-phosphate shuttle, which delivers them to ubiquinone.
options.zh: 肝脏走苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭，电子从 Complex I 进入；肌肉走甘油-3-磷酸穿梭，电子被直接交给泛醌。

options.en: Liver ATP synthase needs fewer protons per ATP than the muscle isoform does, so the very same electron flow yields more ATP in liver tissue than in muscle.
options.zh: 肝脏的 ATP synthase 每合成一个 ATP 所需的质子比肌肉的同工型少，所以同样一股电子流在肝组织里产出的 ATP 比在肌肉里多。

options.en: Muscle exports the NADH itself on a dedicated inner-membrane carrier that consumes one ATP for every NADH molecule it moves.
options.zh: 肌肉用一个专门的内膜载体直接把 NADH 运出去，每运一个 NADH 消耗一个 ATP。

quiz.explain_en: The difference is where the electrons join the chain. The malate-aspartate shuttle regenerates a real matrix NADH, so Complex I, III and IV all pump and the yield is 2.5; the glycerol-3-phosphate shuttle hands electrons through FAD to ubiquinone, bypassing Complex I, so only two pumps operate and the yield is 1.5. Cristae number does not change the stoichiometry, ATP synthase is not tissue-specific in its proton requirement, and no carrier transports NADH itself.
quiz.explain_zh: 差别在于电子从哪里汇入呼吸链。苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭在基质里重新生成一个真正的 NADH，Complex I、III、IV 都泵质子，因此记 2.5；甘油-3-磷酸穿梭把电子经 FAD 交给泛醌，绕过了 Complex I，只剩两处泵质子，因此记 1.5。嵴的多少不改变化学计量；ATP synthase 的质子需求不存在组织特异性；也没有任何载体能直接转运 NADH 本身。

quiz.q_en: A compound inhibits ATP-citrate lyase. Which two processes are hit first, and in which compartment?
quiz.q_zh: 某化合物抑制了 ATP-柠檬酸裂解酶。最先受影响的是哪两个过程，发生在哪个区室？

options.en: Beta-oxidation and ketogenesis in the mitochondrial matrix, because the enzyme normally returns acetyl-CoA to the matrix pool.
options.zh: 线粒体基质中的 β-氧化与酮体生成，因为这个酶本来负责把乙酰CoA 送回基质池。

options.en: The TCA cycle and the urea cycle in the matrix, because citrate can no longer be split to regenerate matrix oxaloacetate.
options.zh: 基质中的 TCA 循环与尿素循环，因为柠檬酸不能再被裂解以再生基质草酰乙酸。

options.en: Glycolysis and glycogen synthesis in the cytosol, because the cytosolic acetyl-CoA that normally activates pyruvate kinase and glycogen synthase disappears.
options.zh: 胞质中的糖酵解与糖原合成，因为平时激活丙酮酸激酶与糖原合酶的那份胞质乙酰CoA 消失了。

options.en: Fatty acid synthesis and cholesterol synthesis in the cytosol, because both draw on the cytosolic acetyl-CoA that this enzyme supplies.
options.zh: 胞质中的脂肪酸合成与胆固醇合成，因为两者都取用这个酶所提供的胞质乙酰CoA。

quiz.explain_en: ATP-citrate lyase is the cytosolic step of the citrate shuttle: it splits citrate into acetyl-CoA and oxaloacetate, and that acetyl-CoA is the starting material for both fatty acid synthesis, through acetyl-CoA carboxylase, and cholesterol synthesis, through HMG-CoA. It works in the cytosol, not the matrix, so beta-oxidation, ketogenesis, the TCA cycle and the urea cycle are unaffected. Cytosolic acetyl-CoA regulates neither pyruvate kinase nor glycogen synthase; it is matrix acetyl-CoA that activates pyruvate carboxylase.
quiz.explain_zh: ATP-柠檬酸裂解酶是柠檬酸穿梭在胞质一端的步骤：它把柠檬酸劈成乙酰CoA 与草酰乙酸，而这个乙酰CoA 既是脂肪酸合成（经乙酰CoA 羧化酶）的起始原料，也是胆固醇合成（经 HMG-CoA）的起始原料。它在胞质工作而不在基质，所以 β-氧化、酮体生成、TCA 循环与尿素循环都不受影响。胞质乙酰CoA 既不调节丙酮酸激酶也不调节糖原合酶；激活丙酮酸羧化酶的是基质里的乙酰CoA。

quiz.q_en: In the citrate shuttle, what crosses the inner membrane in each direction, and what becomes of the four-carbon piece left in the cytosol?
quiz.q_zh: 在柠檬酸穿梭中，内膜两个方向上各是什么在过膜？留在胞质里的那个四碳片段又有什么去向？

options.en: Citrate goes out and malate comes in; the oxaloacetate is reduced to malate and then decarboxylated by malic enzyme to pyruvate, with NADPH.
options.zh: 柠檬酸出去、苹果酸进来；草酰乙酸先被还原成苹果酸，再由苹果酸酶脱羧成丙酮酸并产出 NADPH。

options.en: Acetyl-CoA goes out and free CoA comes back in; the oxaloacetate is carboxylated in the cytosol and returned to the matrix as citrate for another turn.
options.zh: 乙酰CoA 出去、游离 CoA 进来；草酰乙酸在胞质中被羧化，并以柠檬酸的形式送回基质，供下一轮使用。

options.en: Isocitrate goes out and alpha-ketoglutarate comes back in; the four-carbon piece leaves the cell altogether as succinate.
options.zh: 异柠檬酸出去、α-酮戊二酸进来；四碳片段以琥珀酸的形式彻底离开细胞。

options.en: Citrate goes out and pyruvate comes back in unchanged; the oxaloacetate is transaminated to aspartate and then consumed by the urea cycle in the cytosol.
options.zh: 柠檬酸出去、丙酮酸原样回来；草酰乙酸被转氨成天冬氨酸，随后供胞质中的尿素循环消耗。

quiz.explain_en: The citrate carrier exchanges citrate for malate, and ATP-citrate lyase then splits the exported citrate into acetyl-CoA and oxaloacetate in the cytosol. Because oxaloacetate has no carrier of its own, it is reduced to malate, and malic enzyme converts that to pyruvate with NADPH, which is exactly the reducing power fatty acid synthesis needs. Acetyl-CoA itself cannot cross, isocitrate is not the exported species here, and the aspartate route belongs to the malate-aspartate shuttle and the urea cycle.
quiz.explain_zh: 柠檬酸载体以柠檬酸换苹果酸，随后 ATP-柠檬酸裂解酶在胞质把运出的柠檬酸劈成乙酰CoA 与草酰乙酸。由于草酰乙酸没有自己的载体，它先被还原成苹果酸，苹果酸酶再把它转成丙酮酸并产出 NADPH，而这正是脂肪酸合成所需的还原力。乙酰CoA 本身不能跨膜；这里运出的也不是异柠檬酸；天冬氨酸那条路属于苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭与尿素循环。

quiz.q_en: Which statement about where the five enzymes of the urea cycle work is correct?
quiz.q_zh: 关于尿素循环五个酶各自的工作部位，哪一项说法正确？

options.en: CPS-1 works in the cytosol and the other four in the matrix, so that ammonia is captured before it can enter the mitochondrion.
options.zh: CPS-1 在胞质工作，其余四个在基质，这样氨在进入线粒体之前就被固定下来。

options.en: CPS-1 and ornithine transcarbamylase work in the matrix; argininosuccinate synthetase, argininosuccinate lyase and arginase work in the cytosol.
options.zh: CPS-1 与鸟氨酸氨甲酰转移酶在基质工作；精氨琥珀酸合成酶、精氨琥珀酸裂解酶与精氨酸酶在胞质工作。

options.en: CPS-1, ornithine transcarbamylase and argininosuccinate synthetase work in the matrix and the other two in the cytosol, so argininosuccinate is what crosses the membrane.
options.zh: CPS-1、鸟氨酸氨甲酰转移酶与精氨琥珀酸合成酶在基质里工作，另外两个酶在胞质里工作，因此跨过内膜的分子是精氨琥珀酸。

options.en: All five work in the matrix, and urea is carried out to the cytosol by the ornithine carrier before it leaves the cell.
options.zh: 五个酶全在基质里工作，尿素在离开细胞前由鸟氨酸载体带到胞质。

quiz.explain_en: The split falls after ornithine transcarbamylase: carbamoyl phosphate and citrulline are made in the matrix, and the rest of the cycle, including the release of urea by arginase, is cytosolic. The molecule that crosses is citrulline going out on the ornithine/citrulline antiporter, with ornithine coming back in, not argininosuccinate. CPS-1 is a matrix enzyme, and no version of the cycle is confined entirely to one compartment.
quiz.explain_zh: 分界线落在鸟氨酸氨甲酰转移酶之后：氨甲酰磷酸与瓜氨酸在基质中生成，其余步骤（包括精氨酸酶释放尿素）都在胞质中进行。跨膜的分子是瓜氨酸，经鸟氨酸/瓜氨酸反向转运体出去、同时把鸟氨酸换进来，而不是精氨琥珀酸。CPS-1 是基质酶；这个循环也不存在完全局限于单一区室的版本。

quiz.q_en: A boy has hyperammonaemia, raised urinary orotic acid and low plasma citrulline. What is the compartmental explanation?
quiz.q_zh: 一名男孩出现高氨血症、尿乳清酸升高、血浆瓜氨酸降低。从区室角度该如何解释？

options.en: Argininosuccinate synthetase is missing from the cytosol, so citrulline accumulates in the blood and the surplus nitrogen is excreted in the urine as orotate.
options.zh: 胞质中缺少精氨琥珀酸合成酶，瓜氨酸因而在血中堆积，多余的氮以乳清酸的形式随尿排出。

options.en: Ornithine transcarbamylase is missing from the matrix, so carbamoyl phosphate escapes into the cytosol and is drawn into pyrimidine synthesis.
options.zh: 基质中缺少鸟氨酸氨甲酰转移酶，氨甲酰磷酸漏入胞质后被拉进嘧啶合成途径。

options.en: CPS-1 is missing from the matrix, so ammonia is diverted to cytosolic CPS-2 and the whole nitrogen load leaves the body as orotate rather than as urea.
options.zh: 基质中缺少 CPS-1，氨被转向胞质的 CPS-2，全部氮负荷以乳清酸而不是尿素的形式排出体外。

options.en: Arginase is missing from the cytosol, so arginine accumulates and is degraded through a pyrimidine route whose final excreted product is orotate.
options.zh: 胞质中缺少精氨酸酶，精氨酸因而堆积，并经一条最终排出乳清酸的嘧啶途径被降解掉。

quiz.explain_en: This triad is the signature of ornithine transcarbamylase deficiency. With the matrix enzyme gone, carbamoyl phosphate cannot be handed to ornithine, so it leaks into the cytosol and enters pyrimidine synthesis at aspartate transcarbamoylase, and orotate spills into the urine while citrulline is never made. Argininosuccinate synthetase deficiency raises citrulline rather than lowering it; CPS-1 deficiency gives hyperammonaemia without an orotate rise, because carbamoyl phosphate is never formed; arginase deficiency raises arginine.
quiz.explain_zh: 这三联征正是鸟氨酸氨甲酰转移酶缺乏症的标志。基质里的酶没有了，氨甲酰磷酸无法交给鸟氨酸，于是漏入胞质，在天冬氨酸氨甲酰转移酶那一步进入嘧啶合成，乳清酸随尿排出，而瓜氨酸根本没被生成。精氨琥珀酸合成酶缺乏会使瓜氨酸升高而非降低；CPS-1 缺乏表现为高氨血症但乳清酸不升高，因为氨甲酰磷酸压根没生成；精氨酸酶缺乏则表现为精氨酸升高。

quiz.q_en: What does the adenine nucleotide translocase move, and what drives it?
quiz.q_zh: 腺苷酸转位酶（ANT）转运什么？它的动力来自哪里？

options.en: It exchanges matrix ATP for cytosolic ADP one for one, and because ATP is the more negative of the two, the exchange is driven by the membrane potential.
options.zh: 它把基质 ATP 与胞质 ADP 一比一交换；由于两者当中 ATP 带的负电荷更多，这个交换由膜电位驱动。

options.en: It carries ATP outwards together with a proton, and is driven by the same proton gradient that drives ATP synthase.
options.zh: 它把 ATP 连同一个质子一起带出去，动力与驱动 ATP synthase 的是同一个质子梯度。

options.en: It exchanges matrix ATP for cytosolic AMP one for one, and is driven by the pH difference across the inner membrane.
options.zh: 它把基质 ATP 与胞质 AMP 一比一交换，动力来自跨内膜的 pH 差。

options.en: It carries ADP inwards together with phosphate, and is driven by the hydrolysis of one ATP for each pair of molecules moved.
options.zh: 它把 ADP 与磷酸一起带进基质，每转运一对分子消耗一个 ATP 的水解能。

quiz.explain_en: ANT is a strict one-for-one antiporter of ATP out against ADP in, and the charge difference between the two nucleotides makes the exchange electrogenic, so the membrane potential pulls ATP out and pushes ADP in. It does not use AMP, does not co-transport a proton, and does not hydrolyse ATP. Phosphate entry is a separate job, done by the phosphate carrier as a symport with a proton, driven by the pH component of the gradient.
quiz.explain_zh: ANT 是严格一比一的反向转运体：ATP 出、ADP 进；两种核苷酸的电荷差使这个交换带电荷净移动，因而膜电位把 ATP 拉出去、把 ADP 推进来。它不使用 AMP，不共转运质子，也不水解 ATP。磷酸的进入是另一项工作，由磷酸载体以「磷酸+质子同向转运」完成，动力来自梯度中的 pH 分量。
quiz.see: L10 · ANT and the phosphate carrier

quiz.q_en: Why is the ATP yield of one matrix NADH quoted as 2.5 rather than as a whole number?
quiz.q_zh: 为什么一个基质 NADH 的 ATP 产量被写成 2.5 而不是一个整数？

options.en: About one NADH in every four is oxidised instead by an alternative oxidase that releases the energy as heat rather than making ATP.
options.zh: 大约每四个 NADH 里就有一个改由交替氧化酶氧化，其能量以热的形式释放，而不用于合成 ATP。

options.en: Complex I pumps a different number of protons depending on whether the electrons reaching it came from NADH or from succinate dehydrogenase.
options.zh: Complex I 泵出的质子数目取决于到达它的电子究竟来自 NADH 还是来自琥珀酸脱氢酶，因而并不固定。

options.en: Half of the ATP that is produced is spent on importing pyruvate, so the figure is an average taken over the fed and the fasting state.
options.zh: 产生出来的 ATP 有一半用在丙酮酸的转运上，因此这个数字是进食态与禁食态之间的一个平均值。

options.en: Part of the proton-motive force is spent importing phosphate and exporting ATP, so the protons per ATP is not a whole number.
options.zh: 质子动力势有一部分花在磷酸的输入与 ATP 的输出上，所以每个 ATP 摊到的质子数不是整数。

quiz.explain_en: The fractional figure is a transport cost, not a rounding convention: the phosphate carrier brings Pi in with a proton and ANT exports ATP electrogenically, so some of the gradient pays for delivery rather than for synthesis. Mammalian mitochondria are not using an alternative oxidase as a routine route; Complex I pumps a fixed number of protons and never receives electrons from succinate dehydrogenase; and pyruvate import is a proton symport, not an ATP-consuming step.
quiz.explain_zh: 这个小数反映的是转运成本，而不是取整的约定：磷酸载体带着一个质子把 Pi 送进来，ANT 又以生电方式把 ATP 送出去，梯度的一部分因此花在「交付」而不是「合成」上。哺乳动物线粒体并不把交替氧化酶当作常规通路；Complex I 泵出的质子数是固定的，也从不接收来自琥珀酸脱氢酶的电子；丙酮酸的转运是质子同向转运，不消耗 ATP。

quiz.q_en: What follows from the fact that the outer mitochondrial membrane carries VDAC?
quiz.q_zh: 线粒体外膜上有 VDAC，这一点意味着什么？

options.en: The intermembrane space is acidic relative to the cytosol, which is exactly what lets the phosphate carrier work without any proton gradient.
options.zh: 膜间隙相对于胞质呈酸性，正是这一点让磷酸载体在没有质子梯度的情况下也能工作。

options.en: The proton gradient is established across the outer membrane, while the inner membrane merely holds the respiratory complexes in position.
options.zh: 质子梯度建立在外膜的两侧，而内膜只不过是把呼吸链的各个复合体固定在原来的位置上。

options.en: Small metabolites and ions equilibrate between cytosol and intermembrane space, so that space is chemically an extension of the cytosol and the inner membrane is the real barrier.
options.zh: 小分子代谢物与离子在胞质和膜间隙之间达成平衡，膜间隙因此在化学上是胞质的延伸，真正的屏障是内膜。

options.en: Folded proteins of up to about sixty kilodaltons enter the matrix unaided, so matrix enzymes need no targeting sequence of their own.
options.zh: 约六十千道尔顿以下的折叠蛋白可以无需协助进入基质，所以基质酶不需要自己的定位信号序列。

quiz.explain_en: VDAC is a large, relatively non-selective pore, so the intermembrane space has essentially cytosolic composition for small solutes; that is why every specific transport problem in metabolism is a problem about the inner membrane. It also means no gradient can be held across the outer membrane, and it says nothing about protein import, which still requires targeting sequences and the TOM and TIM translocases.
quiz.explain_zh: VDAC 是一个孔径较大、选择性不强的通道，因此就小分子溶质而言，膜间隙的成分基本等同于胞质；这正是代谢中一切具体的转运问题都归结为内膜问题的原因。这也意味着外膜两侧无法维持任何梯度；同时它与蛋白质的转运无关——蛋白进入基质仍需定位序列以及 TOM、TIM 转位酶。

quiz.q_en: An inhibitor of the mitochondrial pyruvate carrier is added to a cell respiring on glucose. What happens?
quiz.q_zh: 向一个以葡萄糖进行呼吸的细胞中加入线粒体丙酮酸载体的抑制剂，会发生什么？

options.en: Cytosolic pyruvate accumulates and is reduced to lactate, while the PDH complex and the TCA cycle are starved of substrate.
options.zh: 胞质丙酮酸堆积并被还原成乳酸，同时 PDH 复合体与 TCA 循环因缺乏底物而空转。

options.en: Glycolysis halts at phosphofructokinase-1, because cytosolic NAD+ can no longer be regenerated by any route available to the cell.
options.zh: 糖酵解停在磷酸果糖激酶-1 这一步，因为细胞已没有任何可用的途径来再生胞质中的 NAD+。

options.en: Acetyl-CoA accumulates in the matrix and is exported as citrate, so cytosolic fatty acid synthesis rises sharply.
options.zh: 乙酰CoA 在基质中堆积并以柠檬酸的形式输出，胞质脂肪酸合成因而急剧上升。

options.en: Matrix pyruvate accumulates and is carboxylated to oxaloacetate, so gluconeogenesis speeds up while glycolysis in the cytosol shuts down completely.
options.zh: 基质中的丙酮酸堆积并被羧化成草酰乙酸，糖异生因此加快，而胞质中的糖酵解则完全停止下来。

quiz.explain_en: The carrier is the only way pyruvate reaches the matrix, so pyruvate backs up in the cytosol and lactate dehydrogenase disposes of it while regenerating NAD+, which is exactly why glycolysis itself keeps running rather than stopping at phosphofructokinase-1. Nothing accumulates inside the matrix, since neither pyruvate nor the acetyl-CoA made from it can be produced there, and pyruvate carboxylase is a matrix enzyme that is equally cut off from its substrate.
quiz.explain_zh: 这个载体是丙酮酸进入基质的唯一途径，因此丙酮酸在胞质中积压，由乳酸脱氢酶把它变成乳酸并同时再生 NAD+——这也正是糖酵解本身仍能继续、而不会停在磷酸果糖激酶-1 的原因。基质内不会有任何堆积，因为丙酮酸以及由它生成的乙酰CoA 都无从产生；丙酮酸羧化酶本身也是基质酶，同样被切断了底物来源。

quiz.q_en: Fatty acid synthesis in the cytosol needs NADPH, yet NADPH cannot cross the inner membrane. How does the cytosol get it?
quiz.q_zh: 胞质中的脂肪酸合成需要 NADPH，而 NADPH 又不能跨过内膜。胞质是怎么拿到它的？

options.en: It is made in the cytosol itself, by the oxidative branch of the pentose phosphate pathway and by malic enzyme.
options.zh: 它就在胞质中生产：来自磷酸戊糖途径的氧化分支，以及苹果酸酶那一步。

options.en: It is imported as NADP+ through the phosphate carrier and is then reduced on arrival by the glycerol-3-phosphate shuttle.
options.zh: 它以 NADP+ 的形式经磷酸载体输入，到达胞质之后再由甘油-3-磷酸穿梭把它还原。

options.en: It is made in the matrix by isocitrate dehydrogenase and is exported by the very same carrier that exports citrate.
options.zh: 它由基质中的异柠檬酸脱氢酶生成，并经与输出柠檬酸完全相同的那个载体运送出来。

options.en: It is generated from cytosolic NADH by an inner-membrane transhydrogenase that can work in either direction as needed.
options.zh: 它由胞质中的 NADH 经内膜上的转氢酶生成，该酶可以按需要向任一方向工作。

quiz.explain_en: NADPH has no transporter at all, so each compartment makes its own; in the cytosol that means the oxidative branch of the pentose phosphate pathway plus the malic enzyme step of the citrate shuttle, which is why the shuttle supplies carbon and reducing power together. The citrate carrier exchanges citrate for malate and moves no nucleotides, the phosphate carrier moves inorganic phosphate, and the inner-membrane transhydrogenase works on matrix nucleotides, not on cytosolic NADH.
quiz.explain_zh: NADPH 根本没有转运体，所以每个区室各自生产；在胞质里就是磷酸戊糖途径的氧化分支，加上柠檬酸穿梭中苹果酸酶那一步——这也是这条穿梭同时提供碳源与还原力的原因。柠檬酸载体交换的是柠檬酸与苹果酸，不转运任何核苷酸；磷酸载体转运的是无机磷酸；内膜上的转氢酶作用于基质中的核苷酸，而不是胞质 NADH。
quiz.see: L11 · NADPH for fatty acid synthesis

quiz.q_en: In the glycerol-3-phosphate shuttle, what actually crosses the inner mitochondrial membrane?
quiz.q_zh: 在甘油-3-磷酸穿梭中，真正跨过线粒体内膜的是什么？

options.en: NADH crosses bound to a small carrier protein and is oxidised by Complex I on the matrix face of the inner membrane.
options.zh: NADH 结合在一个小的载体蛋白上跨膜，由内膜基质侧的 Complex I 将其氧化。

options.en: Dihydroxyacetone phosphate crosses and is reduced in the matrix, and the glycerol-3-phosphate so formed then returns to the cytosol.
options.zh: 磷酸二羟丙酮跨膜后在基质中被还原，生成的甘油-3-磷酸再返回胞质。

options.en: Nothing does; the mitochondrial dehydrogenase faces the intermembrane space and passes the electrons through FAD to ubiquinone inside the membrane.
options.zh: 什么都没有跨过去；线粒体上的那个脱氢酶朝向膜间隙，把电子经 FAD 交给膜内部的泛醌。

options.en: Glycerol-3-phosphate crosses on its own dedicated carrier and is then oxidised back to dihydroxyacetone phosphate by a soluble dehydrogenase inside the matrix.
options.zh: 甘油-3-磷酸经一个专门的载体跨膜，再由基质中一个可溶性的脱氢酶重新氧化成磷酸二羟丙酮。

quiz.explain_en: This shuttle is the exception that proves the rule: it moves reducing equivalents without moving any metabolite across the membrane. The mitochondrial glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase is an inner-membrane flavoprotein whose active site is on the intermembrane-space side, so it oxidises cytosolic glycerol-3-phosphate in place and delivers the electrons to ubiquinone. No carrier for glycerol-3-phosphate, dihydroxyacetone phosphate or NADH is involved, and the electrons never reach Complex I.
quiz.explain_zh: 这条穿梭是「例外反而证明规则」的典型：它把还原当量送了过去，却没有任何代谢物真的跨膜。线粒体型甘油-3-磷酸脱氢酶是内膜上的黄素蛋白，活性中心朝向膜间隙一侧，因此它就地氧化胞质中的甘油-3-磷酸，并把电子交给泛醌。整个过程不涉及甘油-3-磷酸、磷酸二羟丙酮或 NADH 的任何载体，电子也从未到达 Complex I。

quiz.q_en: Which enzyme of the TCA cycle is not a soluble matrix protein, and what follows from that?
quiz.q_zh: TCA 循环中哪一个酶不是基质里的可溶性蛋白？由此可以推出什么？

options.en: Alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase, which is anchored to the inner membrane just as the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex it resembles is.
options.zh: α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶，它像与它相似的丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体一样锚定在内膜上。

options.en: Succinate dehydrogenase, which is Complex II of the chain, so its electrons enter at ubiquinone and are worth 1.5 ATP.
options.zh: 琥珀酸脱氢酶，它就是呼吸链的 Complex II，电子从泛醌进入，折合 1.5 个 ATP。

options.en: Citrate synthase, which is anchored beside the citrate carrier so that new citrate can be exported directly.
options.zh: 柠檬酸合酶，它锚定在柠檬酸载体旁边，好让新生成的柠檬酸直接输出。

options.en: Fumarase, which sits in the inner membrane with its active site facing the intermembrane space, so fumarate is hydrated outside the matrix.
options.zh: 延胡索酸酶，它嵌在内膜里面、活性中心朝向膜间隙的一侧，所以延胡索酸的水合反应其实发生在基质之外。

quiz.explain_en: Succinate dehydrogenase is the single membrane-embedded enzyme of the cycle, and it is embedded precisely because it must hand electrons to ubiquinone within the bilayer; that is also why it pumps no protons and why its electrons yield 1.5 rather than 2.5 ATP. Fumarase, alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase and citrate synthase are all soluble matrix proteins, and the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex is likewise free in the matrix, not membrane-anchored.
quiz.explain_zh: 琥珀酸脱氢酶是循环中唯一嵌在膜上的酶，而它之所以嵌在膜上，正是因为它必须在脂双层内部把电子交给泛醌；这也解释了它为什么不泵质子、它的电子为什么只值 1.5 而不是 2.5 个 ATP。延胡索酸酶、α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶与柠檬酸合酶都是基质中的可溶性蛋白；丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体同样游离于基质，并未锚定在膜上。
quiz.see: L9 · Complex II is the exception

quiz.q_en: How does the geometry of the chloroplast compare with that of the mitochondrion?
quiz.q_zh: 叶绿体的几何取向与线粒体相比是怎样的？

options.en: Protons accumulate in the thylakoid lumen and flow out into the stroma, but the ATP that is made is spent inside the lumen on carbon fixation.
options.zh: 质子积聚在类囊体腔中并流出到基质，但合成出来的 ATP 是在腔内被用于碳固定的。

options.en: Protons accumulate in the stroma and flow into the thylakoid lumen, where the ATP synthase head sits and where the Calvin cycle runs.
options.zh: 质子积聚在叶绿体基质中并流入类囊体腔，ATP synthase 的头部就在腔内，卡尔文循环也在腔内进行。

options.en: Protons accumulate in the thylakoid lumen and flow out into the stroma, where the synthase head sits and the Calvin cycle runs.
options.zh: 质子积聚在类囊体腔中并流出到基质，合酶头部在基质一侧，卡尔文循环也在基质中进行。

options.en: Protons accumulate between the two envelope membranes and flow into the stroma, while the thylakoid holds only the light-harvesting pigments.
options.zh: 质子积聚在叶绿体两层被膜之间并流入基质，而类囊体里装着的只有捕光色素而已。

quiz.explain_en: The chloroplast mirrors the mitochondrion: protons are pumped into the thylakoid lumen and water splitting adds more, so the lumen is the acidic compartment, and they return to the stroma through an ATP synthase whose catalytic head faces the stroma, where ATP and NADPH are then used by the Calvin cycle. Protons do not accumulate in the stroma, the envelope intermembrane space is not the site of the gradient, and no carbon fixation takes place inside the lumen.
quiz.explain_zh: 叶绿体与线粒体互为镜像：质子被泵入类囊体腔，水的光解又在腔内补充质子，因此腔内是偏酸的一侧；质子再经 ATP synthase 回到基质，该合酶的催化头部朝向基质，ATP 与 NADPH 在基质中供卡尔文循环使用。质子不会积聚在基质中，被膜之间的膜间隙也不是梯度所在之处，腔内更不进行任何碳固定。

quiz.q_en: A patient taking a statin fasts overnight and produces ketone bodies normally. Why does inhibiting HMG-CoA reductase not block ketogenesis?
quiz.q_zh: 一位正在服用他汀的病人过夜禁食后酮体生成完全正常。为什么抑制 HMG-CoA 还原酶不会阻断酮体生成？

options.en: Statins inhibit only the cytosolic pool of HMG-CoA, while ketogenesis draws on a separate cytosolic pool supplied by the citrate shuttle.
options.zh: 他汀只抑制胞质中的 HMG-CoA 池，而酮体生成取用的是柠檬酸穿梭供给的另一个胞质池。

options.en: HMG-CoA reductase is an ER enzyme of cholesterol synthesis, whereas ketogenesis uses matrix HMG-CoA and cleaves it with a lyase.
options.zh: HMG-CoA 还原酶是内质网上负责胆固醇合成的酶，而酮体生成用的是基质中的 HMG-CoA，由裂解酶切开。

options.en: Ketone bodies are made from acetoacetyl-CoA without ever passing through HMG-CoA, so the two pathways share no intermediate at all.
options.zh: 酮体是由乙酰乙酰CoA 直接生成的，中途根本不经过 HMG-CoA，两条途径没有任何共用的中间物。

options.en: Ketogenesis uses HMG-CoA reductase as well, but the hepatic isoform inside the matrix is one that statins cannot reach.
options.zh: 酮体生成同样要用 HMG-CoA 还原酶，只是基质里的肝型同工酶是他汀够不到的那一种。

quiz.explain_en: HMG-CoA is made in both compartments, but only the cytosolic pool meets HMG-CoA reductase, which is an integral ER membrane protein; the matrix pool is cleaved by HMG-CoA lyase to acetoacetate and never encounters the reductase at all. So the two pathways do share the intermediate, contrary to the claim that ketogenesis bypasses it; there is no matrix isoform of the reductase; and ketogenesis is not cytosolic.
quiz.explain_zh: HMG-CoA 在两个区室里都会生成，但只有胞质里的那一份会遇到 HMG-CoA 还原酶——它是内质网膜的整合膜蛋白；基质里的那一份由 HMG-CoA 裂解酶切成乙酰乙酸，从头到尾都不会碰到还原酶。所以两条途径确实共用这个中间物，「酮体生成绕过 HMG-CoA」的说法不成立；也不存在什么基质型的还原酶同工酶；酮体生成更不在胞质进行。

quiz.q_en: Gluconeogenesis from lactate in the liver passes through three compartments. Which sequence is right?
quiz.q_zh: 肝脏以乳酸为原料进行糖异生时会经过三个区室。下面哪一条顺序是对的？

options.en: Pyruvate carboxylase acts in the matrix, the four-carbon unit leaves as malate, and glucose-6-phosphatase acts in the ER lumen.
options.zh: 丙酮酸羧化酶在基质中作用，四碳单位以苹果酸的形式离开，葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶在内质网腔中作用。

options.en: Pyruvate carboxylase acts in the cytosol, oxaloacetate then enters the matrix on the citrate carrier, and free glucose is released inside the matrix.
options.zh: 丙酮酸羧化酶在胞质中作用，草酰乙酸随后经柠檬酸载体进入基质，游离葡萄糖在基质内部被释放出来。

options.en: The pathway is entirely cytosolic apart from glucose-6-phosphatase, which acts on the outer face of the plasma membrane as the glucose leaves.
options.zh: 除葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶之外整条途径都在胞质中进行，而该酶在葡萄糖离开细胞时作用于质膜的外表面。

options.en: Pyruvate carboxylase acts in the matrix and oxaloacetate then leaves on its own dedicated carrier, after which the pathway finishes in the cytosol.
options.zh: 丙酮酸羧化酶在基质中作用，草酰乙酸随后经自己专属的载体离开，此后整条途径都在胞质中完成。

quiz.explain_en: Pyruvate must enter the matrix to be carboxylated, oxaloacetate has no carrier of its own and so leaves as malate or as aspartate, and the phosphate that trapped glucose in the cell is removed by glucose-6-phosphatase in the ER lumen, which is the enzyme muscle lacks. The version with a dedicated oxaloacetate carrier is the common trap; a cytosolic pyruvate carboxylase and a plasma-membrane glucose-6-phosphatase are both misplacements.
quiz.explain_zh: 丙酮酸必须先进入基质才能被羧化；草酰乙酸没有自己的载体，只能以苹果酸或天冬氨酸的形式出来；而当初把葡萄糖锁在细胞里的那个磷酸基，由内质网腔中的葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶卸掉——肌肉正是缺这个酶。「草酰乙酸有专属载体」是最常见的陷阱说法；把丙酮酸羧化酶放在胞质、把葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶放在质膜上，也都是定位错误。

quiz.q_en: Where are fatty acids desaturated and elongated in humans, and what limits the product?
quiz.q_zh: 人体在什么部位对脂肪酸进行去饱和与延长？产物又受什么限制？

options.en: In the cytosol on fatty acid synthase itself, which inserts double bonds once the chain has reached C16 and can go as far as Delta-12.
options.zh: 就在胞质的脂肪酸合酶上完成：链长达到 C16 后由该酶插入双键，最远可以做到 Δ12。

options.en: In the mitochondrial matrix, by running the first dehydrogenation of beta-oxidation backwards, which is why the products are trans rather than cis.
options.zh: 在线粒体基质中，通过把 β-氧化的第一步脱氢反向进行来完成，所以产物是反式而不是顺式的。

options.en: On the endoplasmic reticulum membrane; the main human desaturase acts at Delta-9, so no double bond can be placed beyond C9 and linoleate must come from the diet.
options.zh: 在内质网膜上；人体主要的去饱和酶作用于 Δ9，因此双键无法安放在 C9 之外，亚油酸必须从食物中摄取。

options.en: In peroxisomes, alongside very-long-chain beta-oxidation, which is why peroxisomal disease raises only the saturated fatty acids in plasma.
options.zh: 在过氧化物酶体中，与极长链脂肪酸的 β-氧化并行，所以过氧化物酶体病只会使血浆中的饱和脂肪酸升高。

quiz.explain_en: Fatty acid synthase stops at palmitate, and everything after that happens on the ER membrane: elongases add two carbons at a time and Delta-9 desaturase introduces the one double bond humans can make. Because no human desaturase acts beyond C9, linoleate and alpha-linolenate are essential. Fatty acid synthase itself makes no double bonds, desaturation is not reversed beta-oxidation in the matrix, and peroxisomes shorten very-long-chain fatty acids rather than desaturating them.
quiz.explain_zh: 脂肪酸合酶做到棕榈酸就停手，此后的一切都在内质网膜上进行：延长酶每次加两个碳，Δ9 去饱和酶引入人类唯一能引入的那个双键。由于人体没有作用于 C9 之外的去饱和酶，亚油酸与 α-亚麻酸才成为必需脂肪酸。脂肪酸合酶本身不产生双键；去饱和也不是在基质里把 β-氧化倒着做；过氧化物酶体的工作是缩短极长链脂肪酸，而不是给它们去饱和。
quiz.see: L11 · the ER and the peroxisome

quiz.q_en: Why does the malate-aspartate shuttle involve a transamination step at all?
quiz.q_zh: 苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭为什么非要包含一步转氨反应？

options.en: Malate has no inner-membrane carrier, so it must first be transaminated to aspartate before the malate/alpha-ketoglutarate carrier will accept it.
options.zh: 苹果酸在内膜上没有载体，所以必须先转氨成天冬氨酸，苹果酸/α-酮戊二酸载体才肯接受它。

options.en: Oxaloacetate has no carrier of its own, so it is converted to aspartate to leave the matrix and back to oxaloacetate outside.
options.zh: 草酰乙酸没有自己的载体，只能先变成天冬氨酸才能离开基质，出来后再变回草酰乙酸。

options.en: The transamination supplies the energy the shuttle needs, since moving reducing equivalents inwards is an endergonic process.
options.zh: 这步转氨为穿梭提供所需的能量，因为把还原当量往里送本身是一个吸能的过程。

options.en: Aspartate is the only amino acid the glutamate-aspartate carrier will bind, so it has to be made in order to carry glutamate inwards.
options.zh: 天冬氨酸是谷氨酸-天冬氨酸载体唯一肯结合的氨基酸，只有先做出它，才能把谷氨酸带进基质。

quiz.explain_en: The shuttle has to return its four-carbon carrier to the cytosol, and oxaloacetate cannot cross, so aspartate aminotransferase converts it to aspartate on the way out and the reverse transamination regenerates oxaloacetate on arrival. Malate does have its own carrier, which is how the reducing equivalents get in. The energy for the shuttle comes from the membrane potential acting on the electrogenic glutamate-aspartate exchange, not from the transamination, which is close to equilibrium.
quiz.explain_zh: 这条穿梭必须把四碳载体送回胞质，而草酰乙酸无法跨膜，于是天冬氨酸氨基转移酶在出发前把它转成天冬氨酸，到达胞质后再反向转氨变回草酰乙酸。苹果酸本身是有载体的，还原当量正是靠它进入基质。穿梭的能量来自膜电位作用于生电的谷氨酸-天冬氨酸交换，而不是来自这步转氨——后者接近平衡。

quiz.q_en: Compare three agents: a protonophore uncoupler, oligomycin, and an inhibitor of the adenine nucleotide translocase. What distinguishes their effects?
quiz.q_zh: 比较三种试剂：质子载体型解偶联剂、寡霉素，以及腺苷酸转位酶抑制剂。它们的作用有何区别？

options.en: The uncoupler stops electron transport at Complex IV, oligomycin blocks the phosphate carrier, and the translocase inhibitor blocks the entry of pyruvate.
options.zh: 解偶联剂在 Complex IV 处终止电子传递，寡霉素阻断磷酸载体，转位酶抑制剂则阻断丙酮酸进入基质。

options.en: The uncoupler lets protons bypass the synthase so respiration accelerates without ATP; oligomycin plugs the synthase and respiration slows; blocking the translocase also slows it.
options.zh: 解偶联剂让质子绕过合酶回流，呼吸加快却不产 ATP；寡霉素堵住合酶，呼吸随之减慢；阻断转位酶同样使呼吸减慢。

options.en: All three stop respiration outright, but only oligomycin also collapses the proton gradient, because it opens a conducting channel through the FO subunit.
