options.zh: 三者都会让呼吸彻底停止，但只有寡霉素同时使质子梯度塌陷，因为它在 FO 亚基上打开了一条可以导通质子的通道。

options.en: The uncoupler and oligomycin both slow respiration down, while blocking the translocase changes nothing at all, because ATP can also leave through VDAC.
options.zh: 解偶联剂与寡霉素都会让呼吸减慢，而阻断转位酶则完全没有影响，因为 ATP 同样可以经由 VDAC 离开线粒体。

quiz.explain_en: An uncoupler provides an alternative route for protons, so the gradient is dissipated as heat and electron transport runs faster than ever while ATP output collapses. Oligomycin blocks the FO proton channel, the gradient builds up and respiratory control slows electron transport; blocking ANT does the same indirectly, by leaving no ADP inside to phosphorylate. Oligomycin plugs a channel rather than opening one, ATP cannot leave through VDAC because it must first cross the inner membrane, and none of the three acts at Complex IV or on the pyruvate carrier.
quiz.explain_zh: 解偶联剂给质子提供了一条替代回路，梯度以热的形式耗散，电子传递比平时更快，而 ATP 产量崩塌。寡霉素堵住 FO 的质子通道，梯度累积，呼吸控制使电子传递减慢；阻断 ANT 则通过「基质内没有 ADP 可供磷酸化」间接达到同样效果。寡霉素是堵住通道而不是打开通道；ATP 也不可能经 VDAC 离开，因为它首先得跨过内膜；这三者中也没有任何一个作用于 Complex IV 或丙酮酸载体。

sections.title_en: Cofactors and vitamins — which chemistry needs which helper
sections.title_zh: 辅因子与维生素——哪种化学需要哪个帮手
sections.blurb_en: Organised by reaction type, not by vitamin number, so that a question naming a reaction, an enzyme or a deficiency can be answered in one step with the coenzyme, the vitamin and the chemical group being carried.
sections.blurb_zh: 按反应类型而不是按维生素编号来组织，使得题干无论给出的是一个反应、一个酶还是一种缺乏症，都能一步答出辅酶、维生素和被携带的化学基团。

cards.en:
Read the exam question backwards. The reaction type names the coenzyme; the coenzyme names the vitamin. Learn the table in that direction and most cofactor questions collapse to one step.

reaction type → coenzyme → vitamin

oxidative decarboxylation of an α-keto acid → TPP → B1
acyl group swung between active sites → lipoamide → lipoic acid (taught with the vitamins, but humans make their own)
one- and two-electron redox → FAD, FMN → B2
hydride transfer → NAD+, NADP+ → B3 (niacin / PP)
acyl activation as a thioester → CoA, ACP → B5 (pantothenate)
anything that moves an amino group → PLP → B6
carboxylation from bicarbonate + ATP → biotin → B7
transfer of a single carbon → THF → B9 (folate)
1,2-rearrangement, methyl transfer → B12 coenzymes → B12
hydroxylation of Pro and Lys → ascorbate → C
γ-carboxylation of Glu → vitamin K hydroquinone → K
cards.zh:
把考题倒着读。反应类型决定辅酶，辅酶决定维生素。按这个方向记这张表，大多数辅因子题都能一步到位。

反应类型 → 辅酶 → 维生素

α-酮酸的氧化脱羧 → TPP → B1
酰基在活性中心之间摆渡 → 硫辛酰胺 → 硫辛酸（与维生素同章讲，但人体可自行合成）
单电子与双电子氧化还原 → FAD、FMN → B2
氢负离子转移 → NAD+、NADP+ → B3（烟酸 / PP）
酰基以硫酯形式活化 → CoA、ACP → B5（泛酸）
凡是搬动氨基的反应 → PLP → B6
以碳酸氢根 + ATP 进行的羧化 → 生物素 → B7
一碳单位的转移 → THF → B9（叶酸）
1,2-重排与甲基转移 → B12 辅酶 → B12
Pro 与 Lys 的羟化 → 抗坏血酸 → C
Glu 的 γ-羧化 → 维生素K 氢醌 → K

cards.en:
TPP (from B1) is the carbanion carrier. Its thiazolium C2 loses a proton, attacks a carbonyl, and stabilises the negative charge left behind when CO2 or an aldehyde departs.

Where this course meets it:
· PDH E1 — pyruvate to hydroxyethyl-TPP; the CO2 comes off here
· α-KGDH E1 — the same chemistry, one carbon larger
· branched-chain α-ketoacid dehydrogenase — the same design again
· transketolase — non-oxidative pentose phosphate pathway; moves a two-carbon unit, no decarboxylation, but the same stabilised carbanion

Deficiency: beriberi (wet, cardiac; dry, neuropathic) and Wernicke–Korsakoff in alcoholics. Red-cell transketolase activity is the classical assay — which is why a pentose phosphate enzyme reports on a TCA problem.
cards.zh:
TPP（来自 B1）是碳负离子的载体。噻唑环 C2 上的质子解离后进攻羰基，并在 CO2 或醛离去时稳定住剩下的负电荷。

本课程中出现的地方：
· PDH E1 —— 丙酮酸变为羟乙基-TPP，CO2 就在这一步脱去
· α-KGDH E1 —— 同样的化学，只是碳链长一个碳
· 支链 α-酮酸脱氢酶 —— 又是同一套设计
· 转酮酶 —— 磷酸戊糖途径的非氧化支路，搬运二碳单位，不脱羧，但用的是同一个被稳定的碳负离子

缺乏症：脚气病（湿型偏心脏，干型偏神经）与酗酒者的 Wernicke–Korsakoff 综合征。经典检测是红细胞转酮酶活性——所以一个磷酸戊糖途径的酶反而在报告 TCA 的问题。

cards.en:
The pyruvate dehydrogenase complex is the exam's favourite cofactor question, because one reaction uses five cofactors across three enzymes.

E1 (pyruvate dehydrogenase) — TPP
E2 (dihydrolipoyl transacetylase) — lipoamide, CoA
E3 (dihydrolipoyl dehydrogenase) — FAD, NAD+

vitamins: B1, B5, B2, B3, plus lipoic acid

Only two of the five leave the complex: CoA carries the acetyl group out, NAD+ carries the electrons out. TPP, lipoamide and FAD stay bound — they are prosthetic groups.

α-KGDH is the same three-enzyme design with the same five cofactors, and its E3 is the same gene product. That is why one vitamin deficiency, or one dose of arsenite, takes out both complexes at once.
cards.zh:
丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体是辅因子考题的宠儿：一个反应在三个酶上用掉五种辅因子。

E1（丙酮酸脱氢酶）—— TPP
E2（二氢硫辛酰转乙酰酶）—— 硫辛酰胺、CoA
E3（二氢硫辛酰脱氢酶）—— FAD、NAD+

涉及维生素：B1、B5、B2、B3，外加硫辛酸

五个当中只有两个会离开复合体：CoA 把乙酰基带走，NAD+ 把电子带走。TPP、硫辛酰胺、FAD 始终结合在酶上——它们是辅基。

α-KGDH 是同样的三酶设计、同样的五种辅因子，而且它的 E3 就是同一个基因产物。所以一种维生素缺乏、或一剂亚砷酸盐，就能同时废掉两个复合体。

cards.en:
Arsenic appears twice in this course, as two species hitting two targets. Keep them apart.

arsenate, As(V)
· a phosphate analogue
· substitutes for Pi at GAPDH, giving 1-arseno-3-phosphoglycerate
· that acyl-arsenate hydrolyses spontaneously, so the 1,3-BPG step yields no ATP; glycolysis runs on, uncoupled from its first substrate-level phosphorylation

arsenite, As(III), and organic arsenicals
· a dithiol reagent
· chelates the two sulfhydryls of reduced lipoamide
· blocks E2 of PDH and of α-KGDH, so pyruvate and α-ketoglutarate both accumulate

Same element, two mechanisms. The lecture told the GAPDH story; the lipoamide story is the one that explains why arsenic poisoning looks like thiamine deficiency, and why dimercaprol (a competing dithiol) is the antidote.
cards.zh:
砷在本课程里出现两次，是两种价态打两个不同靶点。务必分开。

砷酸盐 arsenate，As(V)
· 磷酸类似物
· 在 GAPDH 这一步顶替 Pi，生成 1-砷酰-3-磷酸甘油酸
· 这个酰基砷酸酯会自发水解，于是 1,3-BPG 那一步产不出 ATP；糖酵解照跑，但与第一次底物水平磷酸化脱了钩

亚砷酸盐 arsenite，As(III)，以及有机砷
· 二硫醇试剂
· 螯合还原型硫辛酰胺上的两个巯基
· 封锁 PDH 与 α-KGDH 的 E2，于是丙酮酸和 α-酮戊二酸一起堆积

同一个元素，两套机制。课上讲的是 GAPDH 那条；硫辛酰胺这条才解释了为什么砷中毒看起来像硫胺素缺乏，也解释了为什么二巯基丙醇（一个来竞争的二硫醇）是解毒剂。

cards.en:
Flavins (from B2, riboflavin) are the only common coenzymes that do both one-electron and two-electron chemistry, because the semiquinone FADH· is stable. So flavins sit at every junction where a two-electron donor must hand over to a one-electron carrier.

FMN — Complex I, the entry point for NADH; passes electrons on to Fe–S clusters, which take one at a time
FAD — Complex II / succinate dehydrogenase, covalently bound to a histidine; acyl-CoA dehydrogenase in β-oxidation; the E3 subunit of PDH and α-KGDH; glutathione reductase; xanthine oxidase

A useful sorting rule: a flavin dehydrogenates across a C–C bond to create a double bond (succinate → fumarate; acyl-CoA → trans-Δ2-enoyl-CoA). NAD+ takes a hydride from a C–O or C–N centre (malate → oxaloacetate; the E3 step). If the product carries a new C=C, look for a flavin.
cards.zh:
黄素（来自 B2 核黄素）是常见辅酶里唯一既能做单电子、又能做双电子化学的，因为半醌 FADH· 是稳定的。所以凡是双电子供体要交给单电子载体的路口，站着的都是黄素。

FMN —— Complex I，NADH 的入口；往下把电子交给铁硫簇，而铁硫簇一次只接一个
FAD —— Complex II / 琥珀酸脱氢酶，共价连在一个组氨酸上；β-氧化的脂酰CoA 脱氢酶；PDH 与 α-KGDH 的 E3 亚基；谷胱甘肽还原酶；黄嘌呤氧化酶

一条好用的判别规则：黄素跨 C–C 键脱氢生成双键（琥珀酸 → 延胡索酸；脂酰CoA → 反式-Δ²-烯脂酰CoA）。NAD+ 则从 C–O 或 C–N 中心取走一个氢负离子（苹果酸 → 草酰乙酸；E3 那一步）。产物里多了一个 C=C，就去找黄素。

cards.en:
Coenzyme or prosthetic group? The distinction is about binding, not chemistry — and the lecture stated it the wrong way round, so fix it now.

coenzyme — loosely bound, dissociates after each turnover, diffuses away and is regenerated on another enzyme. It behaves like a second substrate.
  NAD+, NADP+, CoA, THF, and free FAD in solution

prosthetic group — tightly or covalently bound, stays on the enzyme through the whole cycle, regenerated in place.
  the FAD of succinate dehydrogenase (covalent to His); TPP and lipoamide in PDH; biotin amide-linked to a BCCP lysine; PLP as a Schiff base to an active-site lysine; haem; Fe–S clusters; metal ions

Both are cofactors — that is the umbrella term, and it covers metal ions too.

The same molecule can change class: FAD is a prosthetic group in Complex II but a dissociable coenzyme for some soluble flavoenzymes. The question is always how this particular enzyme holds it.
cards.zh:
辅酶还是辅基？区别在于结合方式，不在于化学性质——而且课上讲反了，现在纠正过来。

辅酶 coenzyme —— 结合疏松，每转一轮就解离，扩散离开并在另一个酶上再生。行为像第二个底物。
  NAD+、NADP+、CoA、THF，以及游离在溶液里的 FAD

辅基 prosthetic group —— 紧密结合甚至共价连接，整个催化循环都不离开酶，就地再生。
  琥珀酸脱氢酶的 FAD（与 His 共价）；PDH 中的 TPP 与硫辛酰胺；以酰胺键连在 BCCP 赖氨酸上的生物素；与活性中心赖氨酸形成 Schiff 碱的 PLP；血红素；铁硫簇；金属离子

两者都是辅因子——这是上位概念，而且把金属离子也包含在内。

同一个分子可以换类别：FAD 在 Complex II 里是辅基，在某些可溶黄素酶里却是可解离的辅酶。要问的永远是「这个具体的酶怎么拿着它」。

cards.en:
NADH and NADPH differ by one phosphate on the 2ʹ-OH of the adenosine ribose. Chemically they transfer the same hydride. Biologically they are two separate currencies, and enzymes read that phosphate as an address label. The lecture ran them together; do not.

              NADH             NADPH
made by       glycolysis,      PPP oxidative branch,
              PDH, TCA,        malic enzyme,
              β-oxidation      cytosolic IDH
kept mostly   oxidised, NAD+   reduced, NADPH
so it is a    hydride sink     hydride source
goes to       Complex I,       fatty acid synthase,
              then ATP         cholesterol synthesis,
                               glutathione reductase,
                               thioredoxin reductase, P450

The consequence to be able to say out loud: a cell can be rich in ATP and still die of oxidative stress, because NADH cannot substitute for NADPH at glutathione reductase. G6PD deficiency is exactly that situation.
cards.zh:
NADH 与 NADPH 只差腺苷核糖 2ʹ-OH 上的一个磷酸。化学上它们转移的是同一个氢负离子。生物学上它们是两套独立的货币，酶把那个磷酸当作地址标签来读。课上把两者混为一谈了，你不要。

              NADH             NADPH
来源          糖酵解、         PPP 氧化支路、
              PDH、TCA、       苹果酸酶、
              β-氧化           胞质 IDH
主要形式      氧化型 NAD+      还原型 NADPH
因此它是      氢负离子受体     氢负离子供体
去向          Complex I，      脂肪酸合酶、
              然后产 ATP       胆固醇合成、
                               谷胱甘肽还原酶、
                               硫氧还蛋白还原酶、P450

有一个推论要能脱口而出：细胞可以 ATP 充足却死于氧化应激，因为在谷胱甘肽还原酶那里 NADH 顶替不了 NADPH。G6PD 缺乏症正是这种情形。

cards.en:
Coenzyme A (from B5, pantothenate) does one thing: it makes a thioester. Sulfur overlaps poorly with carbon, so the thioester gets little resonance stabilisation — the carbonyl stays electrophilic, the α-carbon stays acidic enough to form an enolate, and hydrolysis is strongly exergonic. That single trick is why CoA appears in every acyl pathway of this course.

· acetyl-CoA — product of PDH, entry to the TCA cycle
· succinyl-CoA — its thioester hydrolysis drives the only substrate-level phosphorylation of the TCA cycle
· acyl-CoA — fatty acid activation by acyl-CoA synthetase, at the cost of ATP → AMP + PPi
· the four steps of β-oxidation, ending in thiolysis by a second CoA
· malonyl-CoA from acetyl-CoA carboxylase
· HMG-CoA for ketone bodies and for cholesterol

In fatty acid synthase the same business end appears without the whole CoA: acyl carrier protein carries a phosphopantetheine arm, built from pantothenate, attached to a serine. Same thioester, tethered to the enzyme instead of diffusing.
cards.zh:
辅酶A（来自 B5 泛酸）只做一件事：形成硫酯。硫与碳的轨道重叠很差，硫酯得不到多少共振稳定——羰基保持亲电，α-碳酸到足以形成烯醇负离子，水解强烈放能。就靠这一个本事，CoA 出现在本课程每一条酰基途径里。

· 乙酰CoA —— PDH 的产物，TCA 循环的入口
· 琥珀酰CoA —— 其硫酯水解驱动 TCA 循环中唯一一次底物水平磷酸化
· 脂酰CoA —— 脂酰CoA 合成酶完成脂肪酸活化，代价是 ATP → AMP + PPi
· β-氧化的四步，最后由第二个 CoA 完成硫解
· 乙酰CoA 羧化酶生成的丙二酰CoA
· 生成酮体与胆固醇的 HMG-CoA

在脂肪酸合酶里，同一个「工作端」不带整个 CoA 出现：酰基载体蛋白 ACP 上挂着一条由泛酸构建、连在丝氨酸上的磷酸泛酰巯基乙胺臂。同样的硫酯，只是被拴在酶上而不再扩散。

cards.en:
PLP (from B6) is held to the enzyme as a Schiff base with an active-site lysine, and swaps it for a Schiff base with the incoming amino acid. The protonated pyridine ring then acts as an electron sink, stabilising the carbanion left behind by whichever bond breaks. Which bond breaks is decided by the enzyme, not by PLP.

break Cα–H → transamination
  ALT (GPT): alanine + α-KG ⇌ pyruvate + glutamate
  AST (GOT): aspartate + α-KG ⇌ oxaloacetate + glutamate
  both leak into serum when hepatocytes are damaged

break Cα–COOH → decarboxylation to a biogenic amine
  histidine → histamine
  glutamate → GABA
  5-hydroxytryptophan → serotonin
  DOPA → dopamine

break a Cβ or Cγ bond → serine dehydratase, cystathionine β-synthase

Also PLP-dependent: glycogen phosphorylase, and δ-aminolevulinate synthase, the first committed step of haem — so B6 deficiency can give a neuropathy and a sideroblastic anaemia at the same time.
cards.zh:
PLP（来自 B6）以 Schiff 碱与活性中心赖氨酸结合，再把这个键换成与进来的氨基酸形成的 Schiff 碱。质子化的吡啶环随后充当电子阱，无论哪根键断裂，都由它稳定留下的碳负离子。断哪根键由酶决定，不由 PLP 决定。

断 Cα–H → 转氨基
  ALT（GPT）：丙氨酸 + α-KG ⇌ 丙酮酸 + 谷氨酸
  AST（GOT）：天冬氨酸 + α-KG ⇌ 草酰乙酸 + 谷氨酸
  肝细胞损伤时两者一起漏入血中

断 Cα–COOH → 脱羧生成生物活性胺
  组氨酸 → 组胺
  谷氨酸 → GABA
  5-羟色氨酸 → 5-羟色胺
  DOPA → 多巴胺

断 Cβ 或 Cγ 上的键 → 丝氨酸脱水酶、胱硫醚 β-合酶

同样依赖 PLP 的还有：糖原磷酸化酶，以及血红素合成第一个关键步骤的 δ-氨基乙酰丙酸合酶——所以 B6 缺乏可以同时给出神经病变和铁粒幼细胞性贫血。

cards.en:
Biotin (B7) is the CO2 carrier, and every biotin enzyme runs the same two half-reactions on a long lysine-linked arm:

1. biotin + HCO3- + ATP → carboxybiotin + ADP + Pi
2. carboxybiotin swings across and hands the CO2 to the substrate

Note what is consumed: bicarbonate, not CO2 gas, and one ATP to make the carboxyl transferable. See ATP plus bicarbonate in a mechanism and think biotin.

· pyruvate carboxylase — pyruvate to oxaloacetate; both the anaplerotic reaction of the TCA cycle and the first step of gluconeogenesis; allosterically activated by acetyl-CoA
· acetyl-CoA carboxylase — acetyl-CoA to malonyl-CoA; the committed, rate-limiting step of fatty acid synthesis; the biotin sits on the BCCP domain
· propionyl-CoA carboxylase — propionyl-CoA to D-methylmalonyl-CoA, the route by which odd-chain fatty acids reach the TCA cycle

Avidin in raw egg white binds biotin about as tightly as any protein–ligand pair known and makes it unabsorbable; cooking denatures avidin. That same affinity is what streptavidin resin is sold for.
cards.zh:
生物素（B7）是 CO2 的载体，而且每一个生物素酶都在一条连于赖氨酸的长臂上跑同样的两个半反应：

1. 生物素 + HCO3- + ATP → 羧基生物素 + ADP + Pi
2. 羧基生物素摆过去，把 CO2 交给底物

注意消耗的是什么：碳酸氢根而不是 CO2 气体，外加一个 ATP 把羧基做成可转移的形式。机制里看到 ATP 加碳酸氢根，就想生物素。

· 丙酮酸羧化酶 —— 丙酮酸变草酰乙酸；既是 TCA 循环的回补反应，又是糖异生第一步；受乙酰CoA 别构激活
· 乙酰CoA 羧化酶 —— 乙酰CoA 变丙二酰CoA；脂肪酸合成的关键限速步骤；生物素挂在 BCCP 结构域上
· 丙酰CoA 羧化酶 —— 丙酰CoA 变 D-甲基丙二酰CoA，奇数碳脂肪酸进入 TCA 循环的必经之路

生鸡蛋清里的亲和素与生物素的结合，紧密程度在已知蛋白–配体对里数一数二，使生物素无法吸收；加热可使亲和素变性。链霉亲和素层析柱卖的正是同一份亲和力。

cards.en:
Tetrahydrofolate (from B9) carries one carbon at whatever oxidation level the recipient needs — on N5, on N10, or bridging both. Learn the level, then the customer.

most reduced
  N5-methyl-THF → methionine synthase (needs B12)
  N5,N10-methylene-THF → thymidylate synthase, dUMP to dTMP
  N5,N10-methenyl-THF → the interconversion hub
  N10-formyl-THF → purine ring atoms C2 and C8
most oxidised

Serine is the main donor into the pool: serine + THF → glycine + N5,N10-methylene-THF.

Two drug classes, two different places:
· methotrexate and related antifolates inhibit dihydrofolate reductase inside human cells. Thymidylate synthase leaves the folate as DHF, so with DHFR blocked the whole pool oxidises out and DNA synthesis stops first in the fastest-dividing cells.
· sulfonamides are PABA analogues and inhibit dihydropteroate synthase, a bacterial enzyme. Humans have no folate synthesis pathway to hit — we absorb folate from the diet — and that is where the selectivity comes from.
cards.zh:
四氢叶酸（来自 B9）按受体所需的氧化水平携带一个碳——挂在 N5、挂在 N10，或架在两者之间。先记氧化水平，再记客户。

最还原
  N5-甲基-THF → 甲硫氨酸合酶（需要 B12）
  N5,N10-亚甲基-THF → 胸苷酸合酶，dUMP 变 dTMP
  N5,N10-次甲基-THF → 互变的中转站
  N10-甲酰基-THF → 嘌呤环的 C2 与 C8
最氧化

一碳单位库的主要供体是丝氨酸：丝氨酸 + THF → 甘氨酸 + N5,N10-亚甲基-THF。

两类药，作用在两个不同的地方：
· 甲氨蝶呤等抗叶酸药抑制人细胞内的二氢叶酸还原酶。胸苷酸合酶把叶酸留成 DHF，DHFR 一被封锁，整个叶酸库就被氧化掉，分裂最快的细胞最先停止 DNA 合成。
· 磺胺类是 PABA 类似物，抑制细菌的二氢蝶酸合酶。人根本没有叶酸合成途径可打——我们从食物吸收叶酸——选择性正来自于此。

cards.en:
B12 (cobalamin) carries a cobalt in a corrin ring and, in humans, serves exactly two enzymes.

1. methylmalonyl-CoA mutase — mitochondrial, adenosylcobalamin
   L-methylmalonyl-CoA → succinyl-CoA, a radical 1,2-rearrangement
   the last step of the odd-chain fatty acid and branched amino acid route into the TCA cycle
   deficiency: methylmalonic acid rises in serum and urine

2. methionine synthase — cytosolic, methylcobalamin
   homocysteine + N5-methyl-THF → methionine + THF
   deficiency: homocysteine rises, and the folate trap opens

The folate trap: reduction of methylene-THF to N5-methyl-THF is effectively irreversible in the cell, and methionine synthase is the only way back out. Without B12 the folate pool drains into N5-methyl-THF, a form no other enzyme can use, so thymidylate and purine synthesis fail.

That is why B12 deficiency produces a megaloblastic anaemia indistinguishable from folate deficiency — and why giving folate alone corrects the blood picture while the subacute combined degeneration of the spinal cord goes on getting worse.
cards.zh:
B12（钴胺素）在咕啉环中心带一个钴，在人体内恰好只服务两个酶。

1. 甲基丙二酰CoA 变位酶 —— 线粒体，腺苷钴胺素
   L-甲基丙二酰CoA → 琥珀酰CoA，一次自由基型 1,2-重排
   这是奇数碳脂肪酸与支链氨基酸进入 TCA 循环的最后一步
   缺乏时：血与尿中甲基丙二酸升高

2. 甲硫氨酸合酶 —— 胞质，甲基钴胺素
   同型半胱氨酸 + N5-甲基-THF → 甲硫氨酸 + THF
   缺乏时：同型半胱氨酸升高，叶酸陷阱打开

叶酸陷阱：亚甲基-THF 还原为 N5-甲基-THF 在细胞内实际上不可逆，而甲硫氨酸合酶是唯一的出口。没有 B12，叶酸库就全部流进 N5-甲基-THF 这一别的酶都用不了的形式，于是胸苷酸与嘌呤合成停摆。

这就是为什么 B12 缺乏会造成与叶酸缺乏无法区分的巨幼细胞性贫血——也是为什么只补叶酸能纠正血象，脊髓亚急性联合变性却在继续恶化。

cards.en:
Vitamin C is not itself the group being transferred. It is the reductant that keeps a metal in its working oxidation state.

Prolyl 4-hydroxylase and lysyl hydroxylase are Fe(II), α-ketoglutarate-dependent dioxygenases. Each turnover splits O2: one oxygen atom hydroxylates the proline or lysine, the other decarboxylates α-KG to succinate. Occasionally the iron is left as Fe(III) and the enzyme is dead. Ascorbate reduces it back to Fe(II).

No hydroxyproline → the interchain hydrogen bonding of the collagen triple helix is lost → procollagen is unstable at body temperature and is degraded rather than secreted.

Scurvy is therefore a disease of every tissue that depends on newly made collagen: bleeding gums and loose teeth, perifollicular haemorrhage, poor wound healing, old wounds reopening.

The same logic elsewhere: dopamine β-hydroxylase (a copper enzyme), and ascorbate reducing dietary Fe(III) to absorbable Fe(II) in the gut.
cards.zh:
维生素C 本身并不是被转移的那个基团。它是把金属维持在工作价态上的还原剂。

脯氨酰 4-羟化酶与赖氨酰羟化酶是 Fe(II)、α-酮戊二酸依赖的双加氧酶。每转一轮就裂解一个 O2：一个氧原子羟化脯氨酸或赖氨酸，另一个把 α-KG 脱羧成琥珀酸。偶尔铁会停在 Fe(III) 上，酶就死了。抗坏血酸把它还原回 Fe(II)。

没有羟脯氨酸 → 胶原三股螺旋的链间氢键丢失 → 前胶原在体温下不稳定，被降解而不是被分泌。

所以坏血病是一切依赖新合成胶原的组织的病：牙龈出血、牙齿松动、毛囊周围出血、伤口难愈、旧伤复裂。

同一套逻辑还出现在别处：多巴胺 β-羟化酶（铜酶），以及抗坏血酸在肠道把食物中的 Fe(III) 还原为可吸收的 Fe(II)。

cards.en:
Vitamin K is a cofactor. It is not an enzyme, it is not a clotting factor, and it is not prothrombin. Say the sentence in full:

reduced vitamin K, the hydroquinone, is the cofactor of γ-glutamyl carboxylase, which adds a second carboxyl to specific glutamate residues of factors II (prothrombin), VII, IX and X and of proteins C and S, converting Glu into γ-carboxyglutamate (Gla).

Why it matters: a Gla residue has two carboxylates side by side and can chelate Ca2+, which docks the factor onto the negatively charged phospholipid exposed on an activated platelet. Without γ-carboxylation the factor is still made, still secreted and still circulates in normal amounts, but cannot be recruited to the membrane — present and useless. Hence a normal immunoassay for prothrombin alongside a prolonged clotting time.

The carboxylation oxidises vitamin K to its epoxide, and vitamin K epoxide reductase recycles it. Warfarin inhibits that reductase — which is why its effect is delayed until the already-carboxylated factors are cleared, and why vitamin K is the antidote.
cards.zh:
维生素K 是辅因子。它不是酶，不是凝血因子，也不是凝血酶原。把整句话说完整：

还原型维生素K，即氢醌型，是 γ-谷氨酰羧化酶的辅因子；该酶在因子 II（凝血酶原）、VII、IX、X 以及蛋白 C、蛋白 S 的特定谷氨酸残基上再加一个羧基，把 Glu 变成 γ-羧基谷氨酸（Gla）。

为什么重要：一个 Gla 残基并排带两个羧基，能螯合 Ca2+，从而把因子锚定到活化血小板暴露出的带负电磷脂上。没有 γ-羧化，因子照样合成、照样分泌、照样以正常水平在血中循环，却无法被招募到膜上——存在而无用。于是出现凝血酶原免疫定量正常、凝血时间却延长的组合。

羧化反应把维生素K 氧化成环氧化物，再由维生素K 环氧化物还原酶回收。华法林抑制的正是这个还原酶——所以它的作用要等已羧化的因子被清除后才显现，也所以维生素K 是它的解毒剂。

cards.en:
Metal ions are cofactors too, and the exam asks them the same way: which metal, which enzyme, which job.

Mg2+ — the true substrate of every kinase is Mg·ATP, not ATP. Mg2+ screens the phosphate charges, fixes one conformation and stabilises the developing negative charge in the transition state. Hexokinase, PFK-1, pyruvate kinase, and both polymerases.

Fe–S clusters (2Fe–2S, 4Fe–4S) — one-electron carriers, no proton taken. Complexes I, II and III, including the Rieske centre; aconitase, where a 4Fe–4S cluster is catalytic rather than redox and binds the citrate hydroxyl directly.

haem iron — reversible O2 binding in myoglobin and haemoglobin; one-electron redox in cytochromes b, c1, c, a and a3; catalase and peroxidase.

copper — CuA and CuB in Complex IV, working with haem a3 to reduce O2 to two molecules of water without releasing partly reduced intermediates; also Cu/Zn superoxide dismutase and dopamine β-hydroxylase.

molybdenum — xanthine oxidase, which oxidises hypoxanthine to xanthine and xanthine to urate; the same enzyme also carries FAD and Fe–S centres.

zinc — a Lewis acid that polarises water or a carbonyl: carbonic anhydrase, carboxypeptidase A, alcohol dehydrogenase; also the structural zinc fingers.

Selenium sits in the selenocysteine of glutathione peroxidase, and cobalt occurs only in B12.
cards.zh:
金属离子同样是辅因子，考法也一样：哪个金属、哪个酶、干什么活。

Mg2+ —— 任何激酶真正的底物都是 Mg·ATP，而不是 ATP。Mg2+ 屏蔽磷酸基的负电荷、固定构象，并稳定过渡态上正在形成的负电荷。己糖激酶、PFK-1、丙酮酸激酶，以及两类聚合酶。

铁硫簇（2Fe–2S、4Fe–4S）—— 单电子载体，不带走质子。Complex I、II、III，其中包括 Rieske 中心；顺乌头酸酶——那里的 4Fe–4S 簇不做氧化还原而是催化性的，直接结合柠檬酸的羟基。

血红素铁 —— 肌红蛋白与血红蛋白中的可逆结合氧；细胞色素 b、c1、c、a、a3 中的单电子氧化还原；过氧化氢酶与过氧化物酶。

铜 —— Complex IV 的 CuA 与 CuB，与血红素 a3 配合，把 O2 一路还原成两分子水而不放出部分还原的中间物；另有 Cu/Zn 超氧化物歧化酶与多巴胺 β-羟化酶。

钼 —— 黄嘌呤氧化酶，把次黄嘌呤氧化为黄嘌呤、再氧化为尿酸；同一个酶还带着 FAD 与铁硫中心。

锌 —— 作为 Lewis 酸极化水分子或羰基：碳酸酐酶、羧肽酶A、醇脱氢酶；还有结构性的锌指。

硒位于谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶的硒代半胱氨酸中，而钴只出现在 B12 里。

quiz.q_en: A chronic alcoholic with a poor diet becomes confused and ataxic; thiamine stores are exhausted. Which group of enzymes is directly stalled, and which metabolite therefore rises in blood?
quiz.q_zh: 一位长期酗酒、进食很差的患者出现意识模糊与共济失调，体内硫胺素储备已经耗竭。下列哪一组酶被直接卡住，因而血中哪种代谢物升高？

options.en: Pyruvate carboxylase and acetyl-CoA carboxylase stall, so ketone bodies rise because oxaloacetate can no longer be replenished.
options.zh: 丙酮酸羧化酶与乙酰CoA 羧化酶被卡住，酮体因此升高，因为草酰乙酸再也无法得到回补。

options.en: Succinate dehydrogenase and acyl-CoA dehydrogenase stall, so free fatty acids rise because the first dehydrogenation of β-oxidation cannot begin.
options.zh: 琥珀酸脱氢酶与脂酰CoA 脱氢酶被卡住，血中的游离脂肪酸因此升高，因为 β-氧化的第一步脱氢反应根本无法启动。

options.en: Methylmalonyl-CoA mutase and methionine synthase stall, so methylmalonic acid rises because propionyl-CoA can no longer be rearranged.
options.zh: 甲基丙二酰CoA 变位酶与甲硫氨酸合酶被卡住，血与尿中的甲基丙二酸因此升高，因为丙酰CoA 再也无法完成向琥珀酰CoA 的重排。

options.en: PDH E1, α-KGDH E1 and transketolase stall, so pyruvate and lactate rise because pyruvate cannot enter the TCA cycle.
options.zh: PDH 的 E1、α-KGDH 的 E1 与转酮酶被卡住，丙酮酸与乳酸因此升高，因为丙酮酸进不了 TCA 循环。

quiz.explain_en: All three stalled enzymes use thiamine pyrophosphate: the E1 subunits of the pyruvate dehydrogenase and α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complexes, and transketolase in the non-oxidative pentose phosphate pathway. With PDH blocked, pyruvate accumulates and is reduced to lactate, giving a lactic acidosis; red-cell transketolase activity is the classical thiamine assay. Succinate dehydrogenase and acyl-CoA dehydrogenase are FAD (B2) enzymes. Methylmalonyl-CoA mutase and methionine synthase are the two B12 enzymes. Pyruvate carboxylase and acetyl-CoA carboxylase are biotin enzymes. None of those three pairs needs thiamine.
quiz.explain_zh: 被卡住的三个酶都用硫胺素焦磷酸：丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体与 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体的 E1 亚基，以及磷酸戊糖途径非氧化支路的转酮酶。PDH 被封锁后丙酮酸堆积并被还原为乳酸，形成乳酸酸中毒；红细胞转酮酶活性正是经典的硫胺素检测。琥珀酸脱氢酶与脂酰CoA 脱氢酶是 FAD（B2）酶；甲基丙二酰CoA 变位酶与甲硫氨酸合酶是仅有的两个 B12 酶；丙酮酸羧化酶与乙酰CoA 羧化酶是生物素酶。这三对都不需要硫胺素。

quiz.q_en: Arsenic is met twice in this course, as two chemical species with two different targets. Which statement pairs each species with the right target?
quiz.q_zh: 砷在本课程里出现两次，是两种价态、两个不同靶点。下列哪一项把价态与靶点配对正确？

options.en: Arsenate oxidises the haem iron of cytochrome c and halts electron flow, while arsenite competes with pyridoxal phosphate for the active site of the transaminases.
options.zh: 砷酸盐氧化细胞色素 c 的血红素铁而中断电子流；亚砷酸盐则与磷酸吡哆醛争夺转氨酶的活性中心。

options.en: Arsenate displaces the biotin from the BCCP domain of pyruvate carboxylase, while arsenite binds the molybdenum centre of xanthine oxidase and drives blood urate upwards.
options.zh: 砷酸盐把生物素从丙酮酸羧化酶的 BCCP 结构域上置换下来；亚砷酸盐则结合黄嘌呤氧化酶的钼中心，使血尿酸升高。

options.en: Arsenate binds the copper centres of Complex IV in the way cyanide does, while arsenite mimics para-aminobenzoate and starves the cell of tetrahydrofolate.
options.zh: 砷酸盐像氰化物那样结合 Complex IV 的铜中心；亚砷酸盐则模拟对氨基苯甲酸，使细胞缺乏四氢叶酸。

options.en: Arsenate substitutes for phosphate at GAPDH and gives an acyl-arsenate that hydrolyses on its own, while arsenite chelates the two thiols of reduced lipoamide and blocks PDH and α-KGDH.
options.zh: 砷酸盐在 GAPDH 处顶替磷酸，生成会自行水解的酰基砷酸酯；亚砷酸盐则螯合还原型硫辛酰胺上的两个巯基，封锁 PDH 与 α-KGDH。

quiz.explain_en: Arsenate, As(V), is a phosphate analogue and enters at GAPDH; the 1-arseno-3-phosphoglycerate formed hydrolyses spontaneously, so that step yields no ATP. Arsenite, As(III), is a dithiol reagent that chelates the two sulfhydryls of reduced lipoamide on E2, which is why arsenic poisoning resembles thiamine deficiency. Cytochrome c and Complex IV are the targets of cyanide, not arsenic; pyridoxal phosphate is displaced by isoniazid-type compounds, not arsenite; biotin is sequestered by avidin; the molybdenum of xanthine oxidase is the target of allopurinol's product; and para-aminobenzoate mimicry belongs to the sulfonamides.
quiz.explain_zh: 砷酸盐 As(V) 是磷酸类似物，作用在 GAPDH；生成的 1-砷酰-3-磷酸甘油酸会自发水解，所以这一步产不出 ATP。亚砷酸盐 As(III) 是二硫醇试剂，螯合 E2 上还原型硫辛酰胺的两个巯基——这正是砷中毒像硫胺素缺乏的原因。细胞色素 c 与 Complex IV 是氰化物的靶点，不是砷的；磷酸吡哆醛被异烟肼一类化合物夺走，与亚砷酸盐无关；生物素是被亲和素扣住的；黄嘌呤氧化酶的钼是别嘌呤醇产物的靶点；模拟对氨基苯甲酸是磺胺类的机制。

quiz.q_en: The FAD of succinate dehydrogenase is covalently attached to a histidine of the enzyme, whereas the NAD+ used by malate dehydrogenase leaves after every turnover. What does that difference make each of them?
quiz.q_zh: 琥珀酸脱氢酶的 FAD 共价连在酶的一个组氨酸上，而苹果酸脱氢酶用的 NAD+ 每转一轮就离开。这个差别使它们各自属于哪一类？

options.en: The FAD is a coenzyme because flavins are electron carriers rather than structural components; the NAD+ is a prosthetic group because it is consumed stoichiometrically by the reaction.
options.zh: FAD 是辅酶，因为黄素是电子的载体而不是结构组分；NAD+ 是辅基，因为它被反应按化学计量整个消耗掉。

options.en: Both count as coenzymes, because a coenzyme is defined by being organic and derived from a vitamin rather than by how tightly the enzyme holds it.
options.zh: 两者都算辅酶，因为辅酶的定义是「有机的、来自维生素」，而不是看酶把它抓得多紧。

options.en: The FAD is a prosthetic group because it stays bound throughout the catalytic cycle; the NAD+ is a coenzyme because it dissociates and is recycled elsewhere.
options.zh: FAD 是辅基，因为它在整个催化循环中都保持结合；NAD+ 是辅酶，因为它会解离并在别处再生。

options.en: Both count as prosthetic groups, because every flavin and every nicotinamide nucleotide reaches the enzyme already bound to its apoprotein.
options.zh: 两者都算辅基，因为任何黄素和任何烟酰胺核苷酸到达时都已与脱辅基蛋白结合在一起。

quiz.explain_en: The classification is about binding, not about chemistry or origin. A prosthetic group stays with the enzyme and is regenerated in place, which is exactly what the covalently bound flavin of Complex II does; a coenzyme dissociates and behaves like a second substrate, which is what NAD+ does. Being organic and vitamin-derived is true of both and settles nothing. Nicotinamide nucleotides are not delivered pre-bound. And being a carrier of electrons, or being consumed stoichiometrically, describes the chemistry rather than the binding. The lecture stated the two definitions the wrong way round.
quiz.explain_zh: 分类看的是结合方式，不是化学性质或来源。辅基留在酶上、就地再生，这正是 Complex II 那个共价黄素的行为；辅酶会解离，行为像第二个底物，这正是 NAD+ 的行为。「有机的、来自维生素」两者都成立，什么也说明不了。烟酰胺核苷酸也不是预先结合好送来的。至于「是电子载体」或「被按计量消耗」，说的是化学而不是结合方式。课上把这两个定义讲反了。

quiz.q_en: A red blood cell is under oxidative attack and nearly all its glutathione is in the oxidised GSSG form. Which supply line must be running for the cell to restore reduced glutathione?
quiz.q_zh: 一个红细胞正遭受氧化攻击，其谷胱甘肽几乎全部处于氧化型 GSSG 状态。要恢复还原型谷胱甘肽，下列哪条供给线必须运转？

options.en: Glycolysis, whose glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase step gives the NADH that glutathione reductase draws on to reduce one GSSG back into two molecules of GSH.
options.zh: 糖酵解——其 3-磷酸甘油醛脱氢酶一步提供 NADH，供谷胱甘肽还原酶取用，把一分子 GSSG 还原回两分子 GSH。

options.en: The TCA cycle, whose isocitrate dehydrogenase step gives the NADH that glutathione reductase would need in order to work in the cytosol of the red cell.
options.zh: TCA 循环——其异柠檬酸脱氢酶一步提供 NADH，谷胱甘肽还原酶需要它才能在红细胞的胞质中工作。

options.en: β-oxidation, whose first dehydrogenation gives the FADH2 that glutathione reductase draws on by way of coenzyme Q in the membrane.
options.zh: β-氧化——其第一次脱氢生成 FADH2，谷胱甘肽还原酶经膜上的辅酶Q 取用这些还原力。

options.en: The oxidative branch of the pentose phosphate pathway, whose glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase step supplies the NADPH that glutathione reductase requires.
options.zh: 磷酸戊糖途径的氧化支路——其葡萄糖-6-磷酸脱氢酶一步提供谷胱甘肽还原酶所需的 NADPH。

quiz.explain_en: Glutathione reductase is specific for NADPH, and in the red cell the only source of NADPH is the oxidative branch of the pentose phosphate pathway. That is why G6PD deficiency causes haemolysis under oxidant stress. Glycolysis and the TCA cycle make NADH, which the reductase cannot use, and a mature red cell has no mitochondria at all, so the isocitrate dehydrogenase and β-oxidation routes are unavailable to it for a second reason as well. FADH2 in the membrane feeds the respiratory chain, not a cytosolic reductase.
quiz.explain_zh: 谷胱甘肽还原酶专一使用 NADPH，而红细胞里 NADPH 的唯一来源就是磷酸戊糖途径的氧化支路。这正是 G6PD 缺乏症在氧化应激下发生溶血的原因。糖酵解与 TCA 循环产生的是 NADH，这个酶用不了；而且成熟红细胞根本没有线粒体，所以异柠檬酸脱氢酶与 β-氧化这两条路对它还有第二重障碍。膜上的 FADH2 供给的是呼吸链，不是胞质中的还原酶。

quiz.q_en: In an exam answer a student writes that palmitate synthesis 「consumes the NADH generated by glycolysis」. What exactly is wrong with the sentence?
quiz.q_zh: 某考生写道：软脂酸的合成「消耗糖酵解产生的 NADH」。这句话究竟错在哪里？

options.en: Fatty acid synthase does use NADH, but it arrives by the malate–aspartate shuttle instead of directly from glycolysis, so only the stated source, not the nucleotide, is at fault.
options.zh: 脂肪酸合酶确实用 NADH，只是它经苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭而来、并非直接来自糖酵解，所以错的只是来源，核苷酸本身没写错。

options.en: Fatty acid synthase uses NADPH rather than NADH; the reductive steps draw on the pentose phosphate pathway and malic enzyme, and the two nucleotides are held at opposite redox ratios on purpose.
options.zh: 脂肪酸合酶用的是 NADPH 而不是 NADH；两步还原取自磷酸戊糖途径与苹果酸酶，而且这两种核苷酸的氧化还原比例是被刻意维持在相反方向的。

options.en: Fatty acid synthase uses FADH2 rather than NADH; the two reduction steps of each elongation round are flavin-dependent, exactly as the corresponding oxidations are when the same chemistry runs backwards in β-oxidation.
options.zh: 脂肪酸合酶用的是 FADH2 而不是 NADH；每一轮延长中的两步还原都依赖黄素，与同样的化学在 β-氧化里反方向进行时对应的两次氧化完全一致。

options.en: Fatty acid synthase needs no reduced nucleotide at all; the carbons arrive already reduced on malonyl-CoA, which is precisely why the preceding step consumes biotin and ATP.
options.zh: 脂肪酸合酶根本不需要还原型核苷酸；碳原子在丙二酰CoA 上已经处于还原态，这正是前一步要消耗生物素与 ATP 的原因。

quiz.explain_en: The two reduction steps of each elongation round in fatty acid synthesis are NADPH-dependent, and the cell deliberately keeps NAD+/NADH oxidised as a catabolic sink while keeping NADP+/NADPH reduced as a biosynthetic source. Flavins do the reverse reaction in β-oxidation, but the synthetic direction does not use them, so the FADH2 claim fails. Malonyl-CoA supplies a carbon that still has to be reduced twice, so the claim that no reduced nucleotide is needed fails. And correcting only the shuttle leaves the real error, which is the missing phosphate that distinguishes the two nucleotides, untouched.
quiz.explain_zh: 脂肪酸合成每一轮延长中的两步还原都依赖 NADPH；细胞刻意把 NAD+/NADH 维持在氧化态作为分解代谢的受体，把 NADP+/NADPH 维持在还原态作为生物合成的供体。黄素做的是 β-氧化中的反向反应，合成方向并不用它，所以 FADH2 那一说不成立。丙二酰CoA 提供的碳仍需被还原两次，所以「不需要还原型核苷酸」也不成立。而只纠正穿梭来源，则完全没有触及真正的错误——区分这两种核苷酸的那个磷酸基。

quiz.q_en: Why is an acyl group carried on coenzyme A described as 「activated」, when the same acyl group on an ordinary oxygen ester is not?
quiz.q_zh: 为什么挂在辅酶A 上的酰基被称为「活化的」，而同一个酰基挂在普通氧酯上却不算？

options.en: Because sulfur overlaps poorly with carbon, the thioester gains little resonance stabilisation, so its carbonyl stays electrophilic and hydrolysis is strongly exergonic.
options.zh: 因为硫与碳的轨道重叠很差，硫酯得不到多少共振稳定，羰基因此保持亲电，水解也强烈放能。

options.en: Because the pantothenate portion of CoA holds the acyl group in a strained ring conformation, and that ring tension is released as soon as it is transferred.
options.zh: 因为 CoA 的泛酸部分把酰基固定在一个张力环构象中，一旦发生转移就释放出这份环张力。

options.en: Because the sulfur of CoA carries a full negative charge that repels the incoming nucleophile and thereby accelerates the transfer step.
options.zh: 因为 CoA 的硫带一个完整负电荷，排斥进攻的亲核试剂，从而加快转移这一步。

options.en: Because CoA contains an adenine nucleotide, so the thioester can be hydrolysed directly by ATP synthase in the membrane and its energy released as ATP.
options.zh: 因为 CoA 含有一个腺嘌呤核苷酸，硫酯可以直接由膜上的 ATP 合酶水解，把能量以 ATP 的形式释放。

quiz.explain_en: An oxygen ester is stabilised by donation of an oxygen lone pair into the carbonyl; sulfur's 3p orbital overlaps poorly with carbon's 2p, so a thioester loses most of that stabilisation. The carbonyl therefore remains electrophilic, the α-carbon is acidic enough to form an enolate for Claisen condensations, and hydrolysis releases a large amount of free energy. Sulfur in a thioester is not negatively charged, and repelling a nucleophile would slow the reaction rather than speed it up. ATP synthase does not hydrolyse thioesters. And there is no strained ring: coenzyme A is a flexible open chain.
quiz.explain_zh: 氧酯靠氧的孤对电子向羰基供电子而被稳定；硫的 3p 轨道与碳的 2p 重叠很差，硫酯因此失去大部分这种稳定。于是羰基保持亲电，α-碳酸到足以形成烯醇负离子以进行 Claisen 缩合，水解也释放大量自由能。硫酯中的硫并不带负电，而且排斥亲核试剂只会让反应变慢而不是变快。ATP 合酶并不水解硫酯。也不存在什么张力环：辅酶A 是柔性的开链分子。

quiz.q_en: Fatty acid synthase carries its growing chain on acyl carrier protein instead of on free CoA. What do the two carriers have in common, and which vitamin lies behind both?
quiz.q_zh: 脂肪酸合酶把正在延长的链挂在酰基载体蛋白上，而不是挂在游离 CoA 上。这两种载体有什么共同之处，背后又是哪种维生素？

options.en: Both hold the chain as a thioester on a phosphopantetheine arm, and both are built from pantothenate, which is vitamin B5.
options.zh: 两者都以硫酯形式挂在一条磷酸泛酰巯基乙胺臂上，且都由泛酸构建，也就是维生素 B5。

options.en: Both hold the chain through an amide to a lysine side chain, and both are built from biotin, the same vitamin that serves the carboxylases.
options.zh: 两者都通过酰胺键连到一个赖氨酸侧链上，且都由生物素构建，也就是为羧化酶服务的那种维生素。

options.en: Both hold the chain as a thioester on a lipoamide arm, and both are built from lipoic acid, the same carrier that swings inside the PDH complex.
options.zh: 两者都以硫酯形式挂在一条硫辛酰胺臂上，且都由硫辛酸构建，也就是在 PDH 复合体内摆动的那个载体。

options.en: Both hold the chain through an ester to a serine hydroxyl, and both are built from riboflavin, the same vitamin that gives rise to FAD and FMN.
options.zh: 两者都通过酯键连到一个丝氨酸羟基上，且都由核黄素构建，也就是生成 FAD 与 FMN 的那种维生素。

quiz.explain_en: The reactive end of coenzyme A is a phosphopantetheine arm ending in a free thiol, and acyl carrier protein carries the very same arm attached through a phosphodiester to one of its serines. Both therefore hold the acyl group as a thioester and both derive from pantothenate. Riboflavin gives the flavins, not an acyl arm. Biotin is attached by an amide to a lysine, but it carries CO2 rather than an acyl chain. Lipoamide is also a swinging thioester carrier, but it belongs to the E2 subunits of the α-ketoacid dehydrogenase complexes, not to fatty acid synthase.
quiz.explain_zh: 辅酶A 的反应端是一条以游离巯基结尾的磷酸泛酰巯基乙胺臂；酰基载体蛋白带的正是同一条臂，通过磷酸二酯键连在它的一个丝氨酸上。因此两者都以硫酯挂住酰基，也都来自泛酸。核黄素给出的是黄素，不是酰基臂。生物素确实通过酰胺连在赖氨酸上，但它运的是 CO2 而不是酰基链。硫辛酰胺同样是摆动的硫酯载体，但它属于 α-酮酸脱氢酶复合体的 E2 亚基，不属于脂肪酸合酶。

quiz.q_en: ALT and AST are reported on every liver panel. What chemistry do these two enzymes perform, and which cofactor sits in their active sites?
quiz.q_zh: ALT 与 AST 出现在每一份肝功能化验单上。这两个酶做的是什么化学，活性中心里坐着哪种辅因子？

options.en: They move an amino group between an amino acid and an α-keto acid, using pyridoxal phosphate, which cycles between its aldehyde and pyridoxamine forms.
options.zh: 它们在氨基酸与 α-酮酸之间搬移氨基，用磷酸吡哆醛，后者在醛型与吡哆胺型之间循环。

options.en: They hydrolyse the peptide bonds of proteins released from damaged hepatocytes, using an active-site zinc ion held in place by two histidines and a glutamate.
options.zh: 它们水解受损肝细胞释出的蛋白质中的肽键，用的是由两个组氨酸和一个谷氨酸固定在活性中心的锌离子。

options.en: They oxidatively deaminate glutamate to α-ketoglutarate plus free ammonia, using NAD+ as the acceptor of the hydride that is removed.
options.zh: 它们把谷氨酸氧化脱氨为 α-酮戊二酸加游离氨，由 NAD+ 接受脱下来的那个氢负离子。

options.en: They decarboxylate amino acids to the corresponding biogenic amines, using thiamine pyrophosphate to stabilise the carbanion that is formed.
options.zh: 它们把氨基酸脱羧成相应的生物活性胺，用硫胺素焦磷酸来稳定反应中生成的碳负离子。

quiz.explain_en: ALT and AST are transaminases: ALT interconverts alanine and pyruvate, AST interconverts aspartate and oxaloacetate, and both use glutamate / α-ketoglutarate as the partner couple. The cofactor is pyridoxal phosphate, which accepts the amino group as pyridoxamine phosphate and then hands it to the incoming keto acid. Peptide-bond hydrolysis by a zinc enzyme describes carboxypeptidase; oxidative deamination of glutamate with NAD+ is glutamate dehydrogenase, a different enzyme that acts after transamination; and decarboxylation to biogenic amines is also PLP-dependent, not thiamine-dependent, which makes that statement wrong twice over.
quiz.explain_zh: ALT 与 AST 是转氨酶：ALT 在丙氨酸与丙酮酸之间互变，AST 在天冬氨酸与草酰乙酸之间互变，二者都以谷氨酸／α-酮戊二酸为搭档对。辅因子是磷酸吡哆醛，它先以磷酸吡哆胺的形式接下氨基，再交给进来的酮酸。锌酶水解肽键说的是羧肽酶；用 NAD+ 把谷氨酸氧化脱氨的是谷氨酸脱氢酶，那是转氨之后另一个酶的工作；而脱羧生成生物活性胺同样依赖 PLP 而非硫胺素，所以那一项错了两处。

quiz.q_en: Several physiologically active amines are made by a single PLP-dependent decarboxylation of an amino acid. Which set of precursor-and-product pairings is correct throughout?
quiz.q_zh: 若干种生理活性胺是由氨基酸经一次 PLP 依赖的脱羧生成的。下列哪一组「前体—产物」配对全部正确？

options.en: Histidine gives serotonin, glutamate gives histamine, and 5-hydroxytryptophan gives dopamine, each losing its α-carboxyl group.
options.zh: 组氨酸生成 5-羟色胺，谷氨酸生成组胺，5-羟色氨酸生成多巴胺，各自失去 α-羧基。

options.en: Tryptophan gives GABA, aspartate gives histamine, and tyrosine gives serotonin directly, each losing its α-carboxyl group.
options.zh: 色氨酸生成 GABA，天冬氨酸生成组胺，酪氨酸直接生成 5-羟色胺，各自失去 α-羧基。

options.en: Glutamine gives histamine, arginine gives GABA, and phenylalanine gives dopamine directly, each losing its α-carboxyl group.
options.zh: 谷氨酰胺生成组胺，精氨酸生成 GABA，苯丙氨酸直接生成多巴胺，各自失去 α-羧基。

options.en: Histidine gives histamine, glutamate gives GABA, and 5-hydroxytryptophan gives serotonin, each losing its α-carboxyl group.
options.zh: 组氨酸生成组胺，谷氨酸生成 GABA，5-羟色氨酸生成 5-羟色胺，各自失去 α-羧基。

quiz.explain_en: Each of these is one PLP-dependent decarboxylation: histidine decarboxylase gives histamine, glutamate decarboxylase gives GABA, and aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase converts 5-hydroxytryptophan to serotonin and DOPA to dopamine. The swapped pairings of histidine with serotonin and of glutamate with histamine are simply mismatched. Tryptophan and tyrosine must first be hydroxylated before decarboxylation, so neither goes to its amine in one step; aspartate is not a histamine precursor. Glutamine, arginine and phenylalanine likewise need earlier steps, so a single decarboxylation cannot produce those amines from them.
quiz.explain_zh: 这里每一步都是一次 PLP 依赖的脱羧：组氨酸脱羧酶生成组胺，谷氨酸脱羧酶生成 GABA，芳香族 L-氨基酸脱羧酶把 5-羟色氨酸变成 5-羟色胺、把 DOPA 变成多巴胺。把组氨酸配 5-羟色胺、谷氨酸配组胺，纯属张冠李戴。色氨酸与酪氨酸必须先羟化再脱羧，都不能一步成胺；天冬氨酸也不是组胺的前体。谷氨酰胺、精氨酸、苯丙氨酸同样需要前置步骤，一次脱羧无法由它们得到那些胺。

quiz.q_en: Which group of enzymes shares biotin as its prosthetic group, and what does each of them do with the carbon dioxide?
quiz.q_zh: 下列哪一组酶共用生物素作为辅基，它们各自又拿二氧化碳做什么？

options.en: Pyruvate carboxylase, acetyl-CoA carboxylase and propionyl-CoA carboxylase, each fixing bicarbonate onto a substrate at the cost of one ATP.
options.zh: 丙酮酸羧化酶、乙酰CoA 羧化酶与丙酰CoA 羧化酶，各自消耗一个 ATP 把碳酸氢根固定到底物上。

options.en: Ornithine transcarbamoylase, carbamoyl phosphate synthetase 1 and arginase, each handling a nitrogen-bearing carbon atom on the way to urea.
options.zh: 鸟氨酸氨甲酰转移酶、氨甲酰磷酸合成酶1 与精氨酸酶，各自处理通向尿素的途中一个带氮的碳原子。

options.en: Pyruvate dehydrogenase, α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase and the branched-chain ketoacid dehydrogenase, each releasing CO2 from the carboxyl of an α-keto acid.
options.zh: 丙酮酸脱氢酶、α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶与支链 α-酮酸脱氢酶，各自从一个 α-酮酸的羧基上把 CO2 放出来。

options.en: Isocitrate dehydrogenase, malic enzyme and 6-phosphogluconate dehydrogenase, each releasing CO2 while reducing a nicotinamide nucleotide.
options.zh: 异柠檬酸脱氢酶、苹果酸酶与 6-磷酸葡萄糖酸脱氢酶，各自在放出 CO2 的同时还原一个烟酰胺核苷酸。

quiz.explain_en: Biotin is the CO2 carrier for carboxylases, and every one of them first makes carboxybiotin from bicarbonate and ATP, then swings it across to the substrate: pyruvate carboxylase makes oxaloacetate, acetyl-CoA carboxylase makes malonyl-CoA, propionyl-CoA carboxylase makes methylmalonyl-CoA. The α-ketoacid dehydrogenase complexes remove CO2 rather than adding it, and they use thiamine pyrophosphate. Isocitrate dehydrogenase, malic enzyme and 6-phosphogluconate dehydrogenase are also decarboxylating, using NAD+ or NADP+. The urea cycle enzymes listed transfer or release nitrogen and none of them carries biotin.
quiz.explain_zh: 生物素是羧化酶的 CO2 载体，每一个羧化酶都先用碳酸氢根和 ATP 生成羧基生物素，再把它摆到底物那边：丙酮酸羧化酶生成草酰乙酸，乙酰CoA 羧化酶生成丙二酰CoA，丙酰CoA 羧化酶生成甲基丙二酰CoA。α-酮酸脱氢酶复合体是脱去 CO2 而不是加上去，用的是硫胺素焦磷酸。异柠檬酸脱氢酶、苹果酸酶与 6-磷酸葡萄糖酸脱氢酶同样是脱羧反应，用 NAD+ 或 NADP+。所列的尿素循环各酶做的是转移或释放氮，都不带生物素。

quiz.q_en: A person eats large amounts of raw egg white over several months and develops dermatitis, hair loss and a mild lactic acidosis. What is the mechanism?
quiz.q_zh: 某人连续数月大量食用生鸡蛋清，出现皮炎、脱发与轻度乳酸酸中毒。机制是什么？

options.en: Egg white contains a thiaminase that destroys dietary thiamine, so pyruvate dehydrogenase stalls and pyruvate is diverted to lactate in every tissue.
options.zh: 蛋清中含有硫胺素酶，破坏食物中的硫胺素，丙酮酸脱氢酶因而停摆，各组织中的丙酮酸被转向乳酸。

options.en: Lysozyme strips the phosphopantetheine arm from acyl carrier protein, so fatty acid synthesis halts and the skin barrier lipids are not renewed.
options.zh: 溶菌酶把磷酸泛酰巯基乙胺臂从酰基载体蛋白上剥离，脂肪酸合成停止，皮肤屏障脂质无法更新。

options.en: Ovalbumin competitively blocks intestinal folate transport, so one-carbon units run short and DNA synthesis fails first in rapidly renewing skin.
options.zh: 卵清蛋白竞争性阻断肠道叶酸转运，一碳单位随之短缺，DNA 合成在更新最快的皮肤中最先失败。

options.en: Avidin binds biotin almost irreversibly in the gut, so the carboxylases lose their prosthetic group and pyruvate carboxylase can no longer replenish oxaloacetate.
options.zh: 亲和素在肠道内几乎不可逆地结合生物素，羧化酶因此失去辅基，丙酮酸羧化酶再也无法回补草酰乙酸。

quiz.explain_en: Avidin, a glycoprotein of raw egg white, binds biotin with extraordinary affinity and prevents its absorption; cooking denatures avidin, so only raw egg white does this. The resulting biotin deficiency disables all the carboxylases, giving the classical dermatitis and alopecia, and the loss of pyruvate carboxylase impairs anaplerosis and gluconeogenesis so lactate accumulates. Ovalbumin is a storage protein and does not block folate transport. Thiaminases occur in raw fish and ferns rather than in egg white. Lysozyme in egg white hydrolyses bacterial cell wall and has no access to acyl carrier protein inside human cells.
quiz.explain_zh: 亲和素是生鸡蛋清中的一种糖蛋白，以极高亲和力结合生物素并阻止其吸收；加热会使亲和素变性，所以只有生蛋清才会如此。由此造成的生物素缺乏使所有羧化酶失活，出现典型的皮炎与脱发；丙酮酸羧化酶的丧失则损害回补反应与糖异生，于是乳酸堆积。卵清蛋白是贮藏蛋白，并不阻断叶酸转运。硫胺素酶存在于生鱼和蕨类中，而不在蛋清里。蛋清中的溶菌酶水解的是细菌细胞壁，根本接触不到人体细胞内的酰基载体蛋白。

quiz.q_en: Thymidylate synthase converts dUMP to dTMP. Which folate species donates the carbon, what happens to that folate, and where does methotrexate act?
quiz.q_zh: 胸苷酸合酶把 dUMP 变成 dTMP。是哪一种叶酸形式提供了这个碳，该叶酸随后变成什么，甲氨蝶呤又作用在哪里？

options.en: N5-formimino-THF donates the carbon and departs as THF; methotrexate inhibits serine hydroxymethyltransferase, the enzyme that loads the one-carbon unit.
options.zh: N5-亚氨甲基-THF 提供该碳并以 THF 形式离去；甲氨蝶呤抑制丝氨酸羟甲基转移酶，即装载一碳单位的那个酶。

options.en: N10-formyl-THF donates the carbon and departs as THF; methotrexate inhibits thymidylate synthase itself and so starves the cell of dTMP.
options.zh: N10-甲酰基-THF 提供该碳并以 THF 形式离去；甲氨蝶呤抑制胸苷酸合酶本身，使细胞缺乏 dTMP。

options.en: N5-methyl-THF donates the carbon and departs as dihydrofolate; methotrexate inhibits methionine synthase, which is what traps the folate pool.
options.zh: N5-甲基-THF 提供该碳并以二氢叶酸形式离去；甲氨蝶呤抑制甲硫氨酸合酶，叶酸库因此被困住。

options.en: N5,N10-methylene-THF donates the carbon and is itself oxidised to dihydrofolate; methotrexate inhibits dihydrofolate reductase, so THF cannot be regenerated at all.
options.zh: N5,N10-亚甲基-THF 提供该碳，自身被氧化成二氢叶酸；甲氨蝶呤抑制二氢叶酸还原酶，THF 因此完全无法再生。

quiz.explain_en: Thymidylate synthase is unusual because the folate is both the carbon donor and the reductant: N5,N10-methylene-THF delivers the methyl group and is itself oxidised to dihydrofolate, which must be reduced by dihydrofolate reductase before it can re-enter the pool. Methotrexate inhibits that reductase, so the pool oxidises out and dTMP synthesis stops. N10-formyl-THF serves the purine ring, not thymidylate. N5-methyl-THF is the substrate of methionine synthase. Serine hydroxymethyltransferase does load one-carbon units, but it is not the methotrexate target, and N5-formimino-THF comes from histidine catabolism.
quiz.explain_zh: 胸苷酸合酶特殊之处在于叶酸既是碳供体又是还原剂：N5,N10-亚甲基-THF 交出甲基，自身被氧化成二氢叶酸，必须经二氢叶酸还原酶还原后才能重新回到叶酸库。甲氨蝶呤抑制的正是这个还原酶，于是叶酸库被氧化耗尽，dTMP 合成停止。N10-甲酰基-THF 服务的是嘌呤环而非胸苷酸。N5-甲基-THF 是甲硫氨酸合酶的底物。丝氨酸羟甲基转移酶确实负责装载一碳单位，但不是甲氨蝶呤的靶点；N5-亚氨甲基-THF 则来自组氨酸的分解。

quiz.q_en: Sulfonamides are antibacterial yet do not poison the patient's own folate-dependent enzymes. Why not?
quiz.q_zh: 磺胺类药物能抗菌，却不会毒害患者自身依赖叶酸的酶。为什么？

options.en: They inhibit dihydrofolate reductase, and the human form of that enzyme differs enough in its active site to bind the drug several orders of magnitude more weakly.
options.zh: 它们抑制二氢叶酸还原酶，而人体内这个酶的活性中心差别足够大，与药物的结合比细菌的酶弱几个数量级。

options.en: They are actively pumped out of human cells by a transporter that bacteria lack, so they never once reach the folate-dependent enzymes of the host.
options.zh: 它们被一种细菌所没有的转运体主动泵出人体细胞，因而根本接触不到宿主体内依赖叶酸的那些酶。

options.en: They are cleaved into inactive fragments by human liver esterases before absorption, whereas bacteria take the intact drug up directly from the gut lumen.
options.zh: 它们在被吸收之前就被人肝的酯酶切成无活性碎片，而细菌则直接从肠腔中把完整的药物摄取进去。

options.en: They mimic para-aminobenzoate and block bacterial folate synthesis, a pathway humans do not possess because we take folate in from the diet.
options.zh: 它们模拟对氨基苯甲酸，阻断细菌的叶酸合成——而人根本没有这条途径，因为我们从食物摄取叶酸。

quiz.explain_en: Selectivity here comes from a pathway that exists only in bacteria. Bacteria build folate from pteridine, para-aminobenzoate and glutamate; sulfonamides are PABA analogues and competitively inhibit dihydropteroate synthase. Humans cannot synthesise folate at all and absorb it as a vitamin, so there is no target to hit. Dihydrofolate reductase is the target of trimethoprim and methotrexate, not of sulfonamides; sulfonamides are not substrates of an efflux pump that spares the host; and they are absorbed intact rather than destroyed by liver esterases before absorption.
quiz.explain_zh: 这里的选择性来自一条只存在于细菌的途径。细菌用蝶啶、对氨基苯甲酸和谷氨酸自行合成叶酸；磺胺是 PABA 类似物，竞争性抑制二氢蝶酸合酶。人根本不能合成叶酸，只能把它当维生素吸收，所以无靶可打。二氢叶酸还原酶是甲氧苄啶与甲氨蝶呤的靶点，不是磺胺的；磺胺也不是某个「放过宿主」的外排泵的底物；而且它是被完整吸收的，并非在吸收前被肝酯酶破坏。

quiz.q_en: Which atoms of the purine ring come from N10-formyl-tetrahydrofolate, and what follows for a cell treated with an antifolate?
quiz.q_zh: 嘌呤环上的哪些原子来自 N10-甲酰基四氢叶酸？细胞被抗叶酸药处理后会有什么后果？

options.en: C4, C5 and N7; de novo purine synthesis stalls and the cell must instead import ready-made inosine monophosphate from the cells around it.
options.zh: C4、C5 与 N7；从头合成停摆，细胞只能改从周围的细胞输入现成的次黄嘌呤核苷酸 IMP。

options.en: C6 and N9; de novo purine synthesis stalls and the cell must obtain the missing carbon from carbamoyl phosphate made by CPS-2 instead.
options.zh: C6 与 N9；从头合成停摆，细胞只能改由 CPS-2 生成的氨甲酰磷酸提供缺失的碳。

options.en: C2 and C8; de novo purine synthesis stalls and the cell must fall back on the salvage route, which joins a preformed base to PRPP.
options.zh: C2 与 C8；从头合成停摆，细胞只能退回补救途径，把现成的碱基接到 PRPP 上。

options.en: N1 and N3; de novo purine synthesis stalls and the cell must fall back on transamination from glutamine to rebuild the ring atoms that are missing.
options.zh: N1 与 N3；从头合成停摆，细胞只能退回由谷氨酰胺转氨的方式来重建那几个缺失的环上原子。

quiz.explain_en: Two formyl transfers from N10-formyl-THF build C8 early in the pathway and C2 near the end, so an antifolate stops the ring from being completed. The remaining atoms come from elsewhere: N1 from aspartate, N3 and N9 from glutamine, C4, C5 and N7 from glycine, and C6 from carbon dioxide. Salvage is the only escape, because it starts from an intact base plus PRPP and needs no one-carbon unit. Cells do not import IMP from neighbours, and the carbamoyl phosphate made by CPS-2 belongs to pyrimidine synthesis rather than to the purine ring.
quiz.explain_zh: 来自 N10-甲酰基-THF 的两次甲酰基转移，先在途径早期造出 C8，再在接近末尾时造出 C2，所以抗叶酸药会让嘌呤环无法闭合。其余原子另有来源：N1 来自天冬氨酸，N3 与 N9 来自谷氨酰胺，C4、C5、N7 来自甘氨酸，C6 来自二氧化碳。唯一的出路是补救途径，因为它从完整碱基加 PRPP 出发，不需要一碳单位。细胞不会从邻居那里输入 IMP，而 CPS-2 生成的氨甲酰磷酸属于嘧啶合成，与嘌呤环无关。

quiz.q_en: Oxidation of an odd-chain fatty acid ends in propionyl-CoA. Which two cofactors carry it into the TCA cycle, and what accumulates if one of them is missing?
quiz.q_zh: 奇数碳脂肪酸的氧化以丙酰CoA 收尾。哪两种辅因子把它送进 TCA 循环？其中一个缺失时会有什么堆积？

options.en: Thiamine pyrophosphate and then lipoamide; if thiamine is short, propionyl-CoA is diverted into the odd-chain lipids of nerve membranes.
options.zh: 先是硫胺素焦磷酸，然后是硫辛酰胺；硫胺素不足时，丙酰CoA 被转向神经膜的奇数碳脂质。

options.en: Biotin for the carboxylation to methylmalonyl-CoA and then B12 for the mutase that rearranges it to succinyl-CoA; without B12, methylmalonic acid accumulates.
options.zh: 先由生物素完成羧化生成甲基丙二酰CoA，再由 B12 供给变位酶将其重排为琥珀酰CoA；缺 B12 时甲基丙二酸堆积。

options.en: Pyridoxal phosphate for a transamination and then NAD+ for an oxidation; if B6 is short, propionate accumulates and is excreted as propionylglycine.
options.zh: 先由磷酸吡哆醛完成转氨，再由 NAD+ 完成氧化；B6 不足时丙酸堆积并以丙酰甘氨酸排出。

options.en: Folate for the addition of a one-carbon unit and then FAD for the dehydrogenation to succinyl-CoA; without folate, methylmalonic acid accumulates in both serum and urine.
options.zh: 先由叶酸加上一个一碳单位，再由 FAD 脱氢生成琥珀酰CoA；叶酸不足时，血与尿中的甲基丙二酸都会堆积起来，成为特异的标志物。

quiz.explain_en: Propionyl-CoA is carboxylated by the biotin enzyme propionyl-CoA carboxylase to D-methylmalonyl-CoA, epimerised to the L form, and then rearranged to succinyl-CoA by methylmalonyl-CoA mutase using adenosylcobalamin. Blocking the mutase makes methylmalonic acid the specific marker of B12 deficiency, which is how it is told apart from folate deficiency. Thiamine and lipoamide belong to the α-ketoacid dehydrogenase complexes and play no part here; there is no transamination of propionyl-CoA; and folate carries one-carbon units but is not involved in this three-carbon route.
quiz.explain_zh: 丙酰CoA 先由生物素酶丙酰CoA 羧化酶羧化为 D-甲基丙二酰CoA，经差向异构成 L 型，再由甲基丙二酰CoA 变位酶用腺苷钴胺素重排为琥珀酰CoA。变位酶被卡住，使甲基丙二酸成为 B12 缺乏的特异标志物——这也正是把它与叶酸缺乏区分开的依据。硫胺素与硫辛酰胺属于 α-酮酸脱氢酶复合体，在这里没有角色；丙酰CoA 也不发生转氨；叶酸虽运一碳单位，却不参与这条三碳路线。

quiz.q_en: A patient with B12 deficiency has a megaloblastic anaemia that looks exactly like folate deficiency, and serum folate is not low. What explains this?
quiz.q_zh: 一位 B12 缺乏的患者出现与叶酸缺乏一模一样的巨幼细胞性贫血，而血清叶酸并不低。如何解释？

options.en: Methionine synthase needs B12 to accept the methyl group, so folate piles up as N5-methyl-THF, a form neither thymidylate nor purine synthesis can use.
options.zh: 甲硫氨酸合酶需要 B12 接收甲基，叶酸因此积成 N5-甲基-THF，而这种形式对胸苷酸与嘌呤合成都无法使用。

options.en: B12 deficiency halts the conversion of homocysteine to cystathionine, and the homocysteine that then builds up chemically destroys tetrahydrofolate inside the marrow.
options.zh: B12 缺乏使同型半胱氨酸无法转变为胱硫醚，而积累起来的同型半胱氨酸随后在骨髓中以化学方式把四氢叶酸破坏掉。

options.en: B12 is a cofactor of dihydrofolate reductase, so without it dihydrofolate is never reduced and the whole pool is stuck at the wrong oxidation level.
options.zh: B12 是二氢叶酸还原酶的辅因子，缺了它二氢叶酸无法被还原，整个叶酸库停在错误的氧化水平上。

options.en: B12 deficiency blocks folate uptake in the terminal ileum, so tissue folate is low even though the serum level, measured before uptake, still reads normal.
options.zh: B12 缺乏阻断回肠末端对叶酸的摄取，组织叶酸偏低，而在摄取之前测得的血清水平仍然正常。

quiz.explain_en: This is the folate trap. Methylenetetrahydrofolate reductase makes N5-methyl-THF essentially irreversibly, and the only exit is methionine synthase, which needs methylcobalamin to take the methyl group onto homocysteine. Without B12 the whole folate pool is sequestered as N5-methyl-THF, so total folate looks normal while the usable forms are absent and DNA synthesis fails. Dihydrofolate reductase needs no B12. Folate is absorbed in the jejunum and its uptake does not depend on B12; it is B12 itself that requires intrinsic factor and the terminal ileum. Homocysteine accumulates but does not chemically degrade folate.
quiz.explain_zh: 这就是叶酸陷阱。亚甲基四氢叶酸还原酶生成 N5-甲基-THF 的反应基本不可逆，唯一的出口是甲硫氨酸合酶，而它需要甲基钴胺素把甲基转给同型半胱氨酸。没有 B12，整个叶酸库就被扣押在 N5-甲基-THF 形式，总叶酸看着正常，可用形式却缺席，DNA 合成随之失败。二氢叶酸还原酶并不需要 B12。叶酸在空肠吸收，其摄取不依赖 B12；需要内因子和回肠末端的是 B12 自己。同型半胱氨酸确实升高，但它并不以化学方式降解叶酸。

quiz.q_en: A sailor months into a voyage without fresh food develops bleeding gums, loose teeth and wounds that will not close. Which enzymatic step has failed, and what does ascorbate actually do there?
quiz.q_zh: 一名出海数月、吃不到新鲜食物的水手出现牙龈出血、牙齿松动与伤口不愈。是哪一步酶促反应失败了，抗坏血酸在那里究竟做什么？

options.en: Lysyl oxidase has failed; ascorbate is the substrate whose own oxidation supplies the aldehyde that cross-links two neighbouring collagen chains.
options.zh: 赖氨酰氧化酶失效；抗坏血酸是底物，其自身氧化提供了把相邻两条胶原链交联起来的醛基。

options.en: Procollagen peptidase has failed; ascorbate is the reductant that keeps the catalytic cysteine of that enzyme from oxidising into a disulfide.
options.zh: 前胶原肽酶失效；抗坏血酸是还原剂，防止该酶的催化半胱氨酸被氧化成二硫键。

options.en: Peptidyl-prolyl isomerase has failed; ascorbate donates the proton that lets a proline flip from the trans to the cis form inside the triple helix.
options.zh: 肽基脯氨酰异构酶失效；抗坏血酸提供质子，使三股螺旋内的脯氨酸由反式翻转为顺式。

options.en: Prolyl and lysyl hydroxylase have failed; ascorbate keeps their active-site iron as Fe(II), so without it hydroxyproline is not made and the triple helix is unstable.
options.zh: 脯氨酰羟化酶与赖氨酰羟化酶失效；抗坏血酸把它们活性中心的铁维持在 Fe(II)，缺了它就造不出羟脯氨酸，三股螺旋因而不稳定。

quiz.explain_en: Prolyl 4-hydroxylase and lysyl hydroxylase are Fe(II) and α-ketoglutarate-dependent dioxygenases; the iron is occasionally left oxidised as Fe(III), and ascorbate reduces it back so the enzyme can turn over again. Without hydroxyproline the interchain hydrogen bonding of the triple helix is lost, procollagen is degraded rather than secreted, and every tissue needing new collagen suffers. Lysyl oxidase is a copper enzyme that oxidises a lysine side chain, not ascorbate itself. Procollagen peptidase is a protease and its defect gives a different disorder. And proline isomerisation involves no ascorbate at all.
quiz.explain_zh: 脯氨酰 4-羟化酶与赖氨酰羟化酶是 Fe(II)、α-酮戊二酸依赖的双加氧酶；铁偶尔会停在氧化态 Fe(III)，抗坏血酸把它还原回去，酶才能继续周转。没有羟脯氨酸，三股螺旋的链间氢键就丢失，前胶原被降解而非分泌，凡是需要新胶原的组织都会受损。赖氨酰氧化酶是铜酶，氧化的是赖氨酸侧链，而不是抗坏血酸本身。前胶原肽酶是蛋白酶，其缺陷引起的是另一种疾病。脯氨酸的顺反异构则完全不涉及抗坏血酸。

quiz.q_en: Which statement about the role of vitamin K in blood clotting is correct?
quiz.q_zh: 关于维生素K 在凝血中的作用，下列哪一项说法正确？

options.en: It is the cofactor of γ-glutamyl carboxylase, which adds a second carboxyl to particular glutamates so the factor can chelate Ca2+ and dock on membrane.
options.zh: 它是 γ-谷氨酰羧化酶的辅因子；该酶在特定谷氨酸上再加一个羧基，使因子能螯合 Ca2+ 并停靠到膜上。

options.en: It is the zymogen prothrombin itself, which factor Xa cleaves into the active protease thrombin, which converts fibrinogen into the fibrin of a clot.
options.zh: 它就是凝血酶原这一酶原本身，由因子 Xa 切割成活性蛋白酶凝血酶，再由后者把纤维蛋白原转变为血凝块中的纤维蛋白。

options.en: It is a protease that activates factor VII directly, and warfarin works by competing with it for the very same active site on that factor.
options.zh: 它本身是一种能直接激活因子 VII 的蛋白酶，而华法林的作用就是与它争夺该凝血因子上的同一个活性中心。

options.en: It is a coenzyme of thrombin that must dissociate after every catalytic cycle, which is why the clotting time tracks the dietary supply closely.
options.zh: 它是凝血酶的辅酶，在每一个催化循环之后都必须解离，所以凝血时间才与每天的膳食供应如此密切相关。

quiz.explain_en: Reduced vitamin K is the cofactor of γ-glutamyl carboxylase, which converts specific glutamates of factors II, VII, IX and X and of proteins C and S into γ-carboxyglutamate. The paired carboxylates of a Gla residue chelate Ca2+ and anchor the factor to the phospholipid of an activated platelet; without them the factor circulates at a normal concentration but cannot be recruited. Vitamin K is neither prothrombin nor any other factor, and it is not a protease. Calling it a coenzyme of thrombin misplaces both the enzyme and the reaction — warfarin acts on vitamin K epoxide reductase, not on a clotting factor active site.
quiz.explain_zh: 还原型维生素K 是 γ-谷氨酰羧化酶的辅因子；该酶把因子 II、VII、IX、X 以及蛋白 C、蛋白 S 上的特定谷氨酸变成 γ-羧基谷氨酸。Gla 残基上并排的两个羧基螯合 Ca2+，把因子锚定到活化血小板的磷脂上；没有它们，因子虽以正常浓度循环却无法被招募。维生素K 既不是凝血酶原也不是任何别的因子，更不是蛋白酶。说它是凝血酶的辅酶，则把酶和反应都放错了位置——华法林作用于维生素K 环氧化物还原酶，而不是某个凝血因子的活性中心。

quiz.q_en: Hexokinase is written as transferring the γ-phosphate of ATP onto glucose. What is the true substrate in the cell, and why?
quiz.q_zh: 己糖激酶通常被写成把 ATP 的 γ-磷酸转移到葡萄糖上。在细胞里真正的底物是什么，为什么？

options.en: Free ATP4-, because the fully deprotonated form is the most reactive species present and the enzyme selects it out of the mixture in the cytosol.
options.zh: 游离的 ATP4-，因为完全去质子化的形式反应性最强，酶会从胞质里的各种形态中把它专门挑出来。

options.en: The Mg·ATP complex, because Mg2+ screens the negative charges, holds the phosphates in one conformation and stabilises the transition state.
options.zh: Mg·ATP 复合物，因为 Mg2+ 屏蔽负电荷、把磷酸基固定在一种构象上，并稳定过渡态。

options.en: ADP together with inorganic phosphate, because the enzyme hydrolyses ATP first and then transfers the phosphate it has released onto the sugar.
options.zh: ADP 加无机磷酸，因为酶先把 ATP 水解掉，再把释放出来的那个磷酸转移到葡萄糖的 6 位羟基上。

options.en: The Zn·ATP complex, because zinc is the divalent metal used by all of the kinases while magnesium is reserved for the phosphatases.
options.zh: Zn·ATP 复合物，因为锌才是所有激酶使用的二价金属，而镁则留给磷酸酶和磷酸二酯酶使用。

quiz.explain_en: ATP in the cell is essentially all chelated by Mg2+, and it is Mg·ATP that binds the kinase active site. The metal neutralises part of the charge on the phosphate chain, locks the triphosphate into the productive geometry and stabilises the negative charge developing in the transition state. Free ATP4- is a minor species and is not the preferred substrate. Kinases transfer the terminal phosphate directly to the acceptor rather than hydrolysing ATP first, which is what makes the reaction a coupled transfer. And zinc serves as a Lewis acid in hydrolases such as carbonic anhydrase, not as the counter-ion for kinase substrates.
quiz.explain_zh: 细胞内的 ATP 基本上全部与 Mg2+ 螯合，结合到激酶活性中心的正是 Mg·ATP。金属中和了磷酸链上的部分电荷，把三磷酸锁定在有效的几何构象上，并稳定过渡态中正在形成的负电荷。游离 ATP4- 只是次要形态，不是首选底物。激酶是把末端磷酸直接转给受体，而不是先水解 ATP——这正是该反应属于偶联转移的原因。至于锌，它在碳酸酐酶一类水解酶中充当 Lewis 酸，而不是激酶底物的配衡离子。

quiz.q_en: Match each metal centre to the enzyme in which this course actually meets it.
quiz.q_zh: 把每个金属中心与本课程中真正出现它的酶对应起来。

options.en: Molybdenum in cytochrome c oxidase, copper in xanthine oxidase, and iron-sulfur clusters in carbonic anhydrase.
options.zh: 钼在细胞色素c 氧化酶中，铜在黄嘌呤氧化酶中，铁硫簇在碳酸酐酶中。

options.en: Copper in xanthine oxidase, zinc in Complex I, and iron-sulfur clusters in the catalytic triad of chymotrypsin.
options.zh: 铜在黄嘌呤氧化酶中，锌在 Complex I 中，铁硫簇在胰凝乳蛋白酶的催化三联体中。

options.en: Molybdenum in xanthine oxidase, copper in Complex IV, and iron-sulfur clusters in Complexes I, II and III.
options.zh: 钼在黄嘌呤氧化酶中，铜在 Complex IV 中，铁硫簇在 Complex I、II、III 中。

options.en: Zinc in xanthine oxidase, molybdenum in Complex IV, and iron-sulfur clusters only in Complex II, which pumps no protons.
options.zh: 锌在黄嘌呤氧化酶中，钼在 Complex IV 中，铁硫簇只在不泵质子的 Complex II 中。

quiz.explain_en: Xanthine oxidase uses a molybdenum centre for both oxidations on the way to urate and additionally carries FAD and iron-sulfur centres. Complex IV, cytochrome c oxidase, uses the copper centres CuA and CuB together with haem a3 to reduce O2 to water. Iron-sulfur clusters are one-electron relays in Complexes I, II and III, including the Rieske centre. Cytochrome c oxidase contains no molybdenum, carbonic anhydrase is a zinc enzyme with no iron-sulfur cluster, Complex I is not a zinc enzyme, and the catalytic triad of chymotrypsin is made of Ser, His and Asp with no metal at all.
quiz.explain_zh: 黄嘌呤氧化酶通向尿酸的两步氧化都用钼中心，此外还带着 FAD 与铁硫中心。Complex IV 即细胞色素c 氧化酶，用铜中心 CuA 与 CuB 联合血红素 a3 把 O2 还原成水。铁硫簇是 Complex I、II、III 中的单电子中继站，其中包括 Rieske 中心。细胞色素c 氧化酶不含钼；碳酸酐酶是锌酶，没有铁硫簇；Complex I 不是锌酶；而胰凝乳蛋白酶的催化三联体由 Ser、His、Asp 组成，根本不含金属。

quiz.q_en: Electrons from NADH and electrons from succinate enter the respiratory chain at different places. Which flavin serves each entry point, and what follows for the ATP yield?
quiz.q_zh: 来自 NADH 与来自琥珀酸的电子在呼吸链的不同位置进入。每个入口用的是哪种黄素？对 ATP 产量又意味着什么？

options.en: Both are oxidised by coenzyme Q directly with no flavin at all involved; the difference in yield comes from where in the mitochondrial matrix each substrate is made.
options.zh: 两者都由辅酶Q 直接氧化，全程根本没有黄素参与；产量上的差异来自各自的底物恰好在线粒体基质的哪个位置生成。

options.en: NADH is oxidised by the FMN of Complex I and succinate by the covalently bound FAD of Complex II; Complex II pumps no protons, so its electrons yield less ATP.
options.zh: NADH 由 Complex I 的 FMN 氧化，琥珀酸由 Complex II 上共价结合的 FAD 氧化；Complex II 不泵质子，其电子产生的 ATP 因此更少。

options.en: NADH is oxidised by the FAD of Complex I and succinate by the FMN of Complex II; both routes pump the same number of protons, so the yields come out equal.
options.zh: NADH 由 Complex I 的 FAD 氧化，琥珀酸由 Complex II 的 FMN 氧化；两条路泵出的质子数相同，产量因此相等。

options.en: NADH is oxidised by the FMN of Complex II and succinate by the FAD of Complex I; the succinate route bypasses one pump and therefore yields more ATP.
options.zh: NADH 由 Complex II 的 FMN 氧化，琥珀酸由 Complex I 的 FAD 氧化；琥珀酸这条路绕过一个质子泵，因而产 ATP 更多。

quiz.explain_en: Complex I begins with FMN, which takes the hydride from NADH and passes single electrons to a chain of iron-sulfur clusters; Complex II is succinate dehydrogenase, whose FAD is covalently bound to a histidine. Both deliver electrons to coenzyme Q, but only Complex I pumps protons on that stretch, which is the structural reason matrix NADH is counted at about 2.5 ATP and FADH2 at about 1.5. Swapping the two flavins is wrong in both directions, succinate yields less rather than more, and coenzyme Q accepts electrons from the flavoproteins rather than oxidising the substrates itself.
quiz.explain_zh: Complex I 以 FMN 开头，由它从 NADH 取走氢负离子，再把单个电子逐一交给一串铁硫簇；Complex II 就是琥珀酸脱氢酶，其 FAD 共价连在一个组氨酸上。两者都把电子送到辅酶Q，但这一段只有 Complex I 泵质子——这正是基质 NADH 按约 2.5 个 ATP、FADH2 按约 1.5 个 ATP 计算的结构原因。把两种黄素对调，两个方向都错；琥珀酸产的是更少而不是更多；而辅酶Q 是从黄素蛋白接收电子，并不自己氧化底物。

quiz.q_en: The E3 subunit is the same polypeptide in the pyruvate dehydrogenase and the α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complexes. Which reaction does it run, and with which two cofactors?
quiz.q_zh: 丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体与 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体的 E3 亚基是同一条多肽。它跑的是哪个反应，用哪两种辅因子？

options.en: It carboxylates the enzyme-bound intermediate using biotin and ATP, releasing NADPH for the next round of the reaction cycle.
options.zh: 它用生物素和 ATP 把酶结合的中间物羧化，并释放 NADPH 供下一轮反应循环使用。

options.en: It decarboxylates the α-keto acid with thiamine pyrophosphate and passes the two-carbon fragment on to the lipoamide arm.
options.zh: 它用硫胺素焦磷酸把 α-酮酸脱羧，并把二碳片段交给硫辛酰胺臂。

options.en: It reoxidises dihydrolipoamide back to lipoamide, sending the electrons through its own FAD and out onto NAD+.
options.zh: 它把二氢硫辛酰胺重新氧化为硫辛酰胺，电子经它自己的 FAD 传出，最终交给 NAD+。

options.en: It transfers the acyl group from lipoamide onto coenzyme A, using biotin to position the thioester for nucleophilic attack.
options.zh: 它把酰基从硫辛酰胺转到辅酶A 上，用生物素把硫酯摆到便于亲核进攻的位置。

quiz.explain_en: E3, dihydrolipoyl dehydrogenase, is the regeneration step: the lipoamide arm is left reduced after handing its acyl group to coenzyme A, and E3 reoxidises it, moving the electrons onto its tightly bound FAD and then onto NAD+, which leaves the complex as NADH. Decarboxylation with thiamine pyrophosphate is the work of E1. Transfer of the acyl group to coenzyme A is the work of E2, and it involves no biotin. No step of either complex carboxylates anything or produces NADPH, so the biotin-and-ATP description belongs to a different family of enzymes altogether.
quiz.explain_zh: E3 即二氢硫辛酰脱氢酶，负责再生：硫辛酰胺臂把酰基交给辅酶A 之后处于还原态，E3 把它重新氧化，电子先转到它紧密结合的 FAD 上，再转给 NAD+，以 NADH 的形式离开复合体。用硫胺素焦磷酸脱羧是 E1 的活。把酰基转给辅酶A 是 E2 的活，而且不涉及生物素。两个复合体的任何一步都不进行羧化，也不产生 NADPH，所以「生物素加 ATP」描述的完全是另一类酶。

sections.title_en: Energy accounting: every ATP, and where the numbers come from
sections.title_zh: 能量核算：每一个 ATP 的来历
sections.blurb_en: Derive the yields instead of memorising them - every ATP from glucose and from palmitate, the arithmetic behind 2.5 and 1.5, and the thermodynamics that decides which way a reaction actually runs inside a cell.
sections.blurb_zh: 把产率推导出来，而不是背下来 —— 葡萄糖与软脂酸的每一个 ATP、2.5 与 1.5 背后的算式，以及决定反应在细胞内实际走向的热力学。

cards.en: Master ledger for one glucose, completely oxidised. Glycolysis: 4 ATP made, 2 spent, net 2 ATP by substrate-level phosphorylation, plus 2 cytosolic NADH. Pyruvate dehydrogenase, running twice: 2 matrix NADH. Citric acid cycle, two turns: 6 NADH, 2 FADH2, 2 GTP. Grand totals: 4 high-energy phosphates made directly, 10 NADH (2 of them cytosolic), 2 FADH2. Everything after this is only a question of what one NADH is worth. Anaerobically the ledger stops at the first line: net 2 ATP, because the 2 NADH must be handed back to pyruvate to regenerate NAD+.
cards.zh: 一分子葡萄糖彻底氧化的总账。糖酵解：生成 4 个 ATP，消耗 2 个，底物水平磷酸化净得 2 个 ATP，外加 2 个胞质 NADH。丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体运行两次：2 个基质 NADH。三羧酸循环转两圈：6 个 NADH、2 个 FADH2、2 个 GTP。总计：直接生成 4 个高能磷酸键、10 个 NADH（其中 2 个在胞质）、2 个 FADH2。此后的一切只剩一个问题：一个 NADH 到底值多少。无氧条件下账目停在第一行：净得 2 个 ATP，因为那 2 个 NADH 必须交还给丙酮酸以再生 NAD+。

cards.en: The non-integer values are a division, and both halves of it are approximate. Numerator: moving 2 electrons from NADH to O2 pumps about 10 H+ (4 at Complex I, 4 at Complex III, 2 at Complex IV); FADH2 enters at ubiquinone and drives about 6 (4 + 2). Denominator: making one ATP and delivering it to the cytosol costs about 4 H+ - roughly 3 through the c-ring of FO, plus about 1 more for transport, because Pi enters by H+ symport and the adenine nucleotide translocase swaps matrix ATP(4-) for cytosolic ADP(3-), which is electrogenic and paid for out of the membrane potential. So 10/4 = 2.5 and 6/4 = 1.5. But the denominator is not a constant: F1 releases 3 ATP per full rotation of the c-ring, so H+ per ATP = c/3, and c is 8 in bovine mitochondria (2.7), 10 in yeast and E. coli (3.3), 14 in chloroplasts (4.7). Mammalian arithmetic therefore gives about 3.7, not exactly 4. Treat 2.5 and 1.5 as rounded consensus figures anchored on measured P/O ratios, say so, and you cannot be marked wrong.
cards.zh: 这两个非整数其实是一个除法，而分子分母都是近似值。分子：把 2 个电子从 NADH 送到 O2，大约泵出 10 个 H+（复合体 I 泵 4 个、复合体 III 泵 4 个、复合体 IV 泵 2 个）；FADH2 从泛醌处进入，只驱动约 6 个（4 + 2）。分母：生成一个 ATP 并把它送到胞质，大约要消耗 4 个 H+ —— 约 3 个经 FO 的 c 环，再加约 1 个用于转运，因为 Pi 靠 H+ 同向转运进入，而腺苷酸转位酶（ANT）用基质里的 ATP(4-) 交换胞质的 ADP(3-)，这是生电过程，代价由膜电位支付。于是 10/4 = 2.5，6/4 = 1.5。但分母并不是常数：c 环每转一整圈 F1 释放 3 个 ATP，所以每个 ATP 的 H+ 数 = c/3，而 c 因物种而异：牛线粒体为 8（2.7）、酵母与大肠杆菌为 10（3.3）、叶绿体为 14（4.7）。因此哺乳动物的算式给出约 3.7，而不是正好 4。把 2.5 和 1.5 当作以实测 P/O 比为锚的取整共识值，并在答题时说明这一点，就不会被判错。
cards.see: L10 · where the 2.5 figure comes from

cards.en: FADH2 is worth less for a structural reason, not a chemical one. Complex II (succinate dehydrogenase) is the only respiratory complex that spans the inner membrane without translocating a single proton. Its electrons are handed to ubiquinone, which sits downstream of Complex I, so they skip Complex I's 4 pumped protons entirely: 10 - 4 = 6, and 6/4 = 1.5. The same applies to every other flavin-linked dehydrogenase that feeds the quinone pool - the electron-transferring flavoprotein-ubiquinone oxidoreductase of beta-oxidation, and the mitochondrial glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase. The rule to carry away: what an electron pair is worth depends only on where it enters the chain, never on which carrier brought it.
cards.zh: FADH2 之所以值钱少，原因在结构而不在化学。复合体 II（琥珀酸脱氢酶）是唯一一个跨内膜却不转运任何质子的呼吸链复合体。它把电子交给泛醌，而泛醌位于复合体 I 的下游，因此这些电子完全跳过了复合体 I 泵出的 4 个质子：10 - 4 = 6，6/4 = 1.5。所有把电子送入醌池的黄素连接脱氢酶都是同样的道理 —— β-氧化中的电子传递黄素蛋白-泛醌氧化还原酶（ETF-QO），以及线粒体甘油-3-磷酸脱氢酶。要带走的规律：一对电子值多少，只取决于它从呼吸链的哪个位置进入，而与是哪个载体把它带来的无关。
cards.see: L9 · Complex I and the proton pumps

cards.en: Two shuttles, two prices. NADH cannot cross the inner mitochondrial membrane, so only its reducing power is carried over. Malate-aspartate shuttle (liver, kidney, heart): malate carries the electrons in and matrix malate dehydrogenase regenerates a genuine matrix NADH, so a cytosolic NADH is still worth 2.5. Glycerol-3-phosphate shuttle (skeletal muscle, brain, insect flight muscle): cytosolic NADH reduces DHAP, and the membrane-bound FAD enzyme on the outer face of the inner membrane passes the electrons straight to ubiquinone, so the same NADH is worth only 1.5. The cheaper shuttle costs 1 ATP per NADH, 2 per glucose - which is the entire difference between 30 and 32.
cards.zh: 两条穿梭途径，两个价格。NADH 不能穿过线粒体内膜，能过去的只有它的还原力。苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭（肝、肾、心）：苹果酸把电子带进基质，基质中的苹果酸脱氢酶再生出一个真正的基质 NADH，所以一个胞质 NADH 仍然值 2.5。甘油-3-磷酸穿梭（骨骼肌、脑、昆虫飞行肌）：胞质 NADH 还原 DHAP，内膜外侧那个膜结合的 FAD 酶把电子直接交给泛醌，于是同一个 NADH 只值 1.5。便宜的那条穿梭每个 NADH 要多花 1 个 ATP、每分子葡萄糖多花 2 个 —— 这正是 30 与 32 之间的全部差别。

cards.en: Why 36-38 became 30-32. Nothing about the pathways changed; only the exchange rate did. The old figures assumed round numbers - 3 ATP per NADH and 2 per FADH2 - taken from early P/O measurements that were rounded up and that ignored the proton cost of importing phosphate and exporting ATP. Old arithmetic: 10x3 + 2x2 + 4 = 38 with the malate-aspartate shuttle, or 36 through the glycerol-3-phosphate shuttle. Modern arithmetic with 2.5 and 1.5: 10x2.5 + 2x1.5 + 4 = 32, or 30. Both sets are internally consistent; what is never acceptable is mixing them. If an examiner writes 38, they are using the old convention - state which convention you are using and either answer is defensible.
cards.zh: 36-38 为什么变成了 30-32。代谢途径本身没有任何改变，改变的只是「汇率」。旧数字假定整数 —— 每个 NADH 产 3 个 ATP、每个 FADH2 产 2 个 —— 这来自早期 P/O 实测值的向上取整，并且没有扣除运入磷酸、运出 ATP 所耗的质子代价。旧算法：走苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭时 10x3 + 2x2 + 4 = 38，走甘油-3-磷酸穿梭时为 36。用 2.5 与 1.5 的新算法：10x2.5 + 2x1.5 + 4 = 32，或 30。两套数字各自自洽，绝不能混用。如果考官写的是 38，说明他用的是旧约定 —— 答题时讲明自己用的是哪一套，两种答案都站得住。

cards.en: Palmitate (C16:0) worked all the way through. Activation: palmitate + CoA + ATP -> palmitoyl-CoA + AMP + PPi, and inorganic pyrophosphatase then hydrolyses the PPi to 2 Pi - so 2 high-energy phosphoanhydride bonds are spent, not 1. Beta-oxidation: 7 cycles, not 8, because the last cycle releases two acetyl-CoA at once; each cycle gives 1 FADH2 and 1 NADH. Then 8 acetyl-CoA x (3 NADH + 1 FADH2 + 1 GTP). Totals: NADH 7 + 24 = 31, FADH2 7 + 8 = 15, GTP 8. Arithmetic: 31 x 2.5 = 77.5; 15 x 1.5 = 22.5; plus 8 = 108; minus 2 for activation = 106 ATP. The lecture's 7n - 6 is this same algebra, not a mnemonic: for a saturated even-chain fatty acid of n carbons, NADH = 2n - 1, FADH2 = n - 1, GTP = n/2, and 2.5(2n-1) + 1.5(n-1) + n/2 - 2 = 7n - 6. Check: n = 16 gives 106, n = 18 (stearate) gives 120. Note that 7n - 6 is built on 2.5 and 1.5 - under the old 3/2 convention palmitate gives 129 instead, so the formula and the 36-38 figure belong to different generations and must never be combined.
cards.zh: 软脂酸（棕榈酸，C16:0）完整算一遍。活化：软脂酸 + CoA + ATP -> 软脂酰CoA + AMP + PPi，随后无机焦磷酸酶把 PPi 水解成 2 个 Pi —— 所以消耗的是 2 个高能磷酸酐键，不是 1 个。β-氧化：7 轮而不是 8 轮，因为最后一轮一次放出两分子乙酰CoA；每轮给出 1 个 FADH2 和 1 个 NADH。然后 8 个乙酰CoA x（3 NADH + 1 FADH2 + 1 GTP）。合计：NADH 7 + 24 = 31，FADH2 7 + 8 = 15，GTP 8。算式：31 x 2.5 = 77.5；15 x 1.5 = 22.5；加 8 得 108；减去活化的 2 = 106 个 ATP。课上的 7n - 6 就是同一套代数，不是口诀：对含 n 个碳的饱和偶数碳脂肪酸，NADH = 2n - 1，FADH2 = n - 1，GTP = n/2，于是 2.5(2n-1) + 1.5(n-1) + n/2 - 2 = 7n - 6。验算：n = 16 得 106，n = 18（硬脂酸）得 120。注意 7n - 6 是建立在 2.5 与 1.5 之上的 —— 按旧的 3/2 约定软脂酸得 129，所以这个公式和 36-38 属于不同世代，绝不能混着用。

cards.en: Per gram, fat wins about twofold - and about sixfold as a store. ATP per gram: palmitate 106 / 256 g per mol = 0.41 mol ATP per gram; glucose 32 / 180 = 0.18 mol ATP per gram; ratio about 2.3. Calorimetry agrees: roughly 9 kcal/g (38 kJ/g) for fat against roughly 4 kcal/g (17 kJ/g) for carbohydrate. The chemical reason is oxidation state - a fatty acyl chain is almost entirely -CH2-, nearly fully reduced, so there is a great deal left to oxidise, whereas glucose carbons already carry oxygen and are part-way there. Then add water: glycogen is stored hydrated, at roughly 2 g of water per gram of glycogen, while triacylglycerol is stored anhydrous in a droplet. Multiply the two effects and the storage advantage is roughly sixfold, which is why the body's long-term fuel reserve is fat and its short-term one is glycogen.
cards.zh: 论每克，脂肪大约赢两倍 —— 论储存，大约赢六倍。每克产 ATP：软脂酸 106 / 256 g·mol⁻¹ = 0.41 mol ATP/g；葡萄糖 32 / 180 = 0.18 mol ATP/g；比值约 2.3。量热法的结果一致：脂肪约 9 kcal/g（38 kJ/g），糖类约 4 kcal/g（17 kJ/g）。化学原因是氧化态 —— 脂酰链几乎全是 -CH2-，处于近乎完全还原的状态，可供氧化的余地很大；而葡萄糖的碳原子已经带着氧，已经氧化了一部分。再加上水：糖原是水合储存的，每克糖原约结合 2 g 水，而三酰甘油以无水形式存在脂滴中。两个因素相乘，储存优势约为六倍 —— 这就是为什么身体的长期燃料储备是脂肪，短期储备是糖原。

cards.en: Substrate-level phosphorylation - the complete list in this course, three reactions and no more. Phosphoglycerate kinase: 1,3-bisphosphoglycerate + ADP -> 3-phosphoglycerate + ATP (an acyl phosphate donating). Pyruvate kinase: PEP + ADP -> pyruvate + ATP (an enol phosphate donating). Succinyl-CoA synthetase: succinyl-CoA + Pi + GDP -> succinate + CoA + GTP (a thioester paying for it), and the GTP is converted to ATP by nucleoside diphosphate kinase, so it counts as one ATP. Per glucose: 2 + 2 + 2 = 6 made, minus the 2 spent by hexokinase and PFK-1 = 4 net. All three run downhill because a high-energy donor was already built in an earlier step - which is why glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase and alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase, the enzymes that build those donors, make no ATP themselves.
cards.zh: 底物水平磷酸化 —— 本课程涉及的完整名单，只有三个反应。磷酸甘油酸激酶：1,3-二磷酸甘油酸 + ADP -> 3-磷酸甘油酸 + ATP（由酰基磷酸供能）。丙酮酸激酶：PEP + ADP -> 丙酮酸 + ATP（由烯醇式磷酸供能）。琥珀酰CoA 合成酶：琥珀酰CoA + Pi + GDP -> 琥珀酸 + CoA + GTP（由硫酯键买单），生成的 GTP 再由核苷二磷酸激酶转成 ATP，所以按一个 ATP 计。每分子葡萄糖：2 + 2 + 2 = 6 个，减去己糖激酶和 PFK-1 消耗的 2 个 = 净得 4 个。这三步都是下坡反应，因为高能供体在更早的一步里已经造好 —— 这也正是造出这些供体的 3-磷酸甘油醛脱氢酶和 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶本身并不产生 ATP 的原因。

cards.en: Substrate-level versus oxidative phosphorylation, four differences worth reciting. Energy source: a discrete high-energy bond on one substrate molecule, versus a delocalised proton gradient across a whole membrane. Oxygen requirement: none at all, versus absolute, because O2 is the terminal electron acceptor and the chain backs up without it. Location: soluble enzymes in the cytosol and the mitochondrial matrix, versus the inner mitochondrial membrane. Coupling mechanism: direct chemical transfer of a phosphoryl group from donor to ADP, versus chemiosmotic coupling through a gradient that no covalent intermediate ever touches. This is why an anaerobic erythrocyte, which has no mitochondria at all, still makes ATP, and why cyanide stops respiration without stopping glycolysis.
cards.zh: 底物水平磷酸化与氧化磷酸化，值得背下来的四点区别。能量来源：某一个底物分子上的具体高能键，对比整张膜上离域的质子梯度。对氧的需求：完全不需要，对比绝对需要 —— 因为 O2 是终末电子受体，没有它整条链就会堵住。发生部位：胞质和线粒体基质中的可溶性酶，对比线粒体内膜。偶联方式：磷酰基从供体到 ADP 的直接化学转移，对比通过质子梯度的化学渗透偶联，后者全程没有任何共价中间物。这解释了为什么完全没有线粒体的无氧红细胞仍能产生 ATP，也解释了为什么氰化物能终止呼吸却不能终止糖酵解。

cards.en: What 'high-energy' means: a large negative standard free energy of hydrolysis, conventionally more negative than about -25 kJ/mol, and it arises because the products are stabilised, not because the bond is unusually strong. The families: phosphoanhydride (ATP, -30.5 kJ/mol), acyl phosphate (1,3-bisphosphoglycerate, -49.3), enol phosphate (PEP, -61.9), thioester (acetyl-CoA, -31.4), and phosphoguanidine (creatine phosphate, -43.0). Compare a plain phosphate ester: glucose-6-phosphate is only -13.8, which is why it is not a phosphoryl donor. PEP is the extreme case and the reason is worth stating exactly: hydrolysis releases enolpyruvate, which cannot stay as an enol - it tautomerises to the far more stable keto form, and that tautomerisation is itself strongly exergonic and contributes roughly half the total. The energy is not in the P-O bond; it is released when the product falls into a structure it could not reach while phosphorylated. Textbooks round these values slightly differently; the ranking is what matters.
cards.zh: 「高能」的含义：水解的标准自由能变为很大的负值，习惯上以负于约 -25 kJ/mol 为界；其根源在于产物被稳定化，而不是这根键特别牢固。几大类：磷酸酐（ATP，-30.5 kJ/mol）、酰基磷酸（1,3-二磷酸甘油酸，-49.3）、烯醇式磷酸（PEP，-61.9）、硫酯（乙酰CoA，-31.4）、磷酸胍（磷酸肌酸，-43.0）。对比普通磷酸酯：6-磷酸葡萄糖只有 -13.8，所以它不能充当磷酰基供体。PEP 是最极端的一个，其原因值得准确说出：水解释放出烯醇式丙酮酸，而烯醇式无法留存 —— 它会互变异构为稳定得多的酮式，这一互变本身就是强放能的，约贡献总量的一半。能量并不储存在 P-O 键里，而是在产物跌入一个「磷酸化时到不了」的更稳定结构时释放出来的。各教材对这些数值的取整略有差别；重要的是排序。

cards.en: The standard free energy alone never tells you which way a reaction runs in a cell. ΔG = ΔG°' + RT ln Q, and the cell holds Q far from 1. At 37 °C, RT = 2.58 kJ/mol and RT ln 10 = 5.9 kJ/mol, so every tenfold displacement of the mass-action ratio moves the real ΔG by about 6 kJ/mol. The worked case is aldolase: ΔG°' = +23.8 kJ/mol, strongly unfavourable on paper, yet in a red cell the measured ΔG is close to zero and the step runs forward, because triose phosphate isomerase and GAPDH keep pulling the products away and hold Q very low. The same effect runs the other way for ATP: ΔG°' of hydrolysis is -30.5 kJ/mol, but the cell maintains a high [ATP]/[ADP][Pi] ratio, so the actual ΔG is around -50 kJ/mol or more negative. Standard conditions - 1 M everything - exist nowhere in biology.
cards.zh: 标准自由能变本身永远无法告诉你反应在细胞里往哪个方向走。ΔG = ΔG°' + RT ln Q，而细胞让 Q 远离 1。37 °C 时 RT = 2.58 kJ/mol，RT ln 10 = 5.9 kJ/mol，所以质量作用比每偏离十倍，真实 ΔG 就移动约 6 kJ/mol。经典例子是醛缩酶：ΔG°' = +23.8 kJ/mol，纸面上极其不利，但在红细胞中实测 ΔG 接近零，这一步照样正向进行 —— 因为磷酸丙糖异构酶和 GAPDH 不断把产物拉走，把 Q 压得很低。对 ATP 则是反方向的同一效应：水解的 ΔG°' 为 -30.5 kJ/mol，但细胞维持很高的 [ATP]/[ADP][Pi] 比值，所以实际 ΔG 约为 -50 kJ/mol 甚至更负。标准状态（各物质浓度均为 1 M）在生物学里根本不存在。
cards.see: L7 · bioenergetics and standard free energy

cards.en: ΔG = ΔH - TΔS. Spontaneity is decided by ΔG and by nothing else - state this cleanly, because the lecture treated 'entropy increases' as though it were the criterion, and it is not. A positive ΔS does not make a reaction go, and a negative ΔS does not stop one. Aldolase splits one molecule into two, so ΔS is clearly positive, and ΔG°' is still +23.8 kJ/mol because ΔH is unfavourable enough to outweigh it. Protein folding is the mirror image: the chain loses a great deal of conformational entropy, so ΔS for the polypeptide is strongly negative, and folding is spontaneous anyway because of favourable ΔH and the entropy gained by the ordered water released from hydrophobic surfaces. At 310 K the temperature is fixed, so the sign of ΔG is always a contest between two terms, and reporting only one of them decides nothing.
cards.zh: ΔG = ΔH - TΔS。自发性由 ΔG 决定，且只由它决定 —— 这一点要说清楚，因为课上把「熵增加」当成了判据，而它并不是。ΔS 为正不能让反应发生，ΔS 为负也不能阻止反应发生。醛缩酶把一分子裂成两分子，ΔS 显然为正，而 ΔG°' 仍然是 +23.8 kJ/mol，因为不利的 ΔH 足以压倒它。蛋白质折叠则是镜像的例子：肽链损失大量构象熵，多肽本身的 ΔS 强烈为负，但折叠依然自发，因为有利的 ΔH 以及疏水表面释放出的有序水所带来的熵增占了上风。310 K 下温度是固定的，所以 ΔG 的正负永远是两项之间的较量，只报告其中一项什么也决定不了。

cards.en: P/O ratio: ATP made per atom of oxygen reduced, that is per pair of electrons passed down the chain. Measured values are frankly non-integral - about 2.5 for NADH-linked substrates such as malate or glutamate, and about 1.5 for succinate. These measurements are the direct experimental root of the 2.5 and 1.5 used in every yield calculation; the proton arithmetic is the explanation, not the source. Proton-motive force: Δp = Δψ - (2.3RT/F)ΔpH, and at 37 °C the conversion factor 2.3RT/F is about 61.5 mV per pH unit. In a respiring mitochondrion Δψ is roughly 150-180 mV with the matrix negative, while a ΔpH of about 0.5-0.75 units (matrix alkaline) contributes only about 30-45 mV, for a total near 200 mV.
