The membrane potential is clearly the larger term. In the chloroplast thylakoid the arrangement is reversed: the lumen becomes strongly acidic, ΔpH dominates and Δψ is small. Energy per proton: F x Δp = 96.5 kJ per volt per mol x 0.2 V, about 19-20 kJ/mol, so 4 H+ deliver about 77 kJ - comfortably more than the roughly 50-60 kJ/mol needed to make ATP at cellular concentrations.
cards.zh: P/O 比：每还原一个氧原子（即每对电子通过呼吸链）生成的 ATP 数。实测值确实不是整数 —— NADH 连接的底物（如苹果酸、谷氨酸）约为 2.5，琥珀酸约为 1.5。这些测定值才是所有产率计算中 2.5 与 1.5 的直接实验来源；质子算术是解释，不是出处。质子动力势：Δp = Δψ - (2.3RT/F)ΔpH，37 °C 时换算系数 2.3RT/F 约为每个 pH 单位 61.5 mV。在进行呼吸的线粒体中，Δψ 约为 150-180 mV（基质为负），而约 0.5-0.75 个单位的 ΔpH（基质偏碱）只贡献约 30-45 mV，总计接近 200 mV。膜电位显然是较大的那一项。叶绿体类囊体则正好相反：腔内强烈酸化，ΔpH 占主导而 Δψ 很小。每个质子的能量：F x Δp = 96.5 kJ·V⁻¹·mol⁻¹ x 0.2 V，约 19-20 kJ/mol，所以 4 个 H+ 提供约 77 kJ —— 明显超过细胞内浓度下合成 ATP 所需的约 50-60 kJ/mol。
cards.see: L10 · P/O ratio and the proton-motive force

cards.en: Uncoupler versus inhibitor - the discriminating measurement is oxygen consumption, and it moves in opposite directions. An uncoupler (DNP, FCCP, or the physiological UCP1) puts a proton leak into the inner membrane. The gradient collapses, the back-pressure on the pumps disappears, so electron transport and oxygen consumption run faster than ever, while ATP synthesis stops and the free energy leaves as heat. An oxidative-phosphorylation inhibitor (oligomycin) plugs the FO proton channel. Protons cannot return, the gradient builds until the pumps can no longer work against it, so electron transport slows and oxygen consumption falls - this is respiratory control. Both abolish ATP synthesis; only one raises oxygen consumption. The classic demonstration: add oligomycin and respiration stops, then add DNP and it resumes at full rate, proving the block was at the synthase and not in the chain.
cards.zh: 解偶联剂与抑制剂 —— 区分二者的关键测量是耗氧量，而它们的变化方向相反。解偶联剂（DNP、FCCP，或生理性的 UCP1）在内膜上开出一条质子漏。梯度塌陷，质子泵的反压消失，于是电子传递与耗氧比任何时候都快，而 ATP 合成停止，自由能以热的形式散失。氧化磷酸化抑制剂（寡霉素）则堵住 FO 的质子通道。质子无法回流，梯度不断累积，直到质子泵无法再逆着它做功，于是电子传递减慢、耗氧下降 —— 这就是呼吸控制。两者都终止 ATP 合成，但只有一个使耗氧升高。经典演示：先加寡霉素，呼吸停止；再加 DNP，呼吸恢复到全速，证明阻断点在合酶而不在呼吸链上。

cards.en: Where each poison stops the chain, and what it does to a patient. Complex I: rotenone (also amytal and piericidin A) blocks electron transfer from the iron-sulfur centres to ubiquinone; NADH-linked oxidation stops, but adding succinate restores respiration because those electrons enter downstream. Complex II: not a target for these agents, but malonate is a classic competitive inhibitor of succinate dehydrogenase, being a structural analogue of succinate. Complex III: antimycin A blocks the Qi site of cytochrome b, and nothing rescues it because everything upstream backs up. Complex IV: cyanide binds the ferric form of heme a3, carbon monoxide binds the ferrous form, and azide also acts here; the chain stops absolutely, tissues cannot use oxygen despite normal arterial saturation, and death is rapid. Note the split personality of carbon monoxide - it poisons at Complex IV here, and it also poisons haemoglobin by competing with O2 at the heme iron. Separately, 2,4-dinitrophenol was sold as a slimming drug in the 1930s and killed by uncontrolled hyperthermia; UCP1 in brown adipose tissue is the same trick under regulation, generating heat in newborns and in cold adaptation.
cards.zh: 每种毒物阻断在哪里，以及对病人意味着什么。复合体 I：鱼藤酮（还有阿米妥、杀粉蝶菌素）阻断电子由铁硫中心向泛醌的传递；NADH 连接的氧化停止，但加入琥珀酸后呼吸可以恢复，因为那些电子从下游进入。复合体 II：不是这些药物的靶点，但丙二酸是琥珀酸脱氢酶的经典竞争性抑制剂，因为它是琥珀酸的结构类似物。复合体 III：抗霉素 A 阻断细胞色素 b 的 Qi 位点，无法用任何底物挽救，因为上游全部堵死。复合体 IV：氰化物结合血红素 a3 的三价铁形式，一氧化碳结合二价铁形式，叠氮化物也作用于此；呼吸链彻底停止，尽管动脉血氧饱和度正常，组织却无法利用氧，死亡迅速。注意一氧化碳的双重身份 —— 它在这里毒害复合体 IV，同时还在血红素铁上与 O2 竞争而毒害血红蛋白。另外，2,4-二硝基酚（DNP）曾在 1930 年代作为减肥药出售，因失控的高热而致死；棕色脂肪组织中的 UCP1 是同一套把戏的受控版本，用于新生儿产热和冷适应。

quiz.q_en: A tissue oxidises glucose completely but uses the glycerol-3-phosphate shuttle rather than the malate-aspartate shuttle. What is the yield per glucose, and why?
quiz.q_zh: 某组织完全氧化葡萄糖，但使用甘油-3-磷酸穿梭而非苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭。每分子葡萄糖的产率是多少，为什么？

options.en: 34 ATP - the FAD-linked shuttle enzyme delivers electrons upstream of Complex I, adding four extra pumped protons.
options.zh: 34 个 ATP —— FAD 连接的穿梭酶把电子送到复合体 I 的上游，因而多泵出四个质子。

options.en: 30 ATP - the two cytosolic NADH are delivered to ubiquinone as FADH2-equivalents, so each is worth 1.5 rather than 2.5.
options.zh: 30 个 ATP —— 两个胞质 NADH 以 FADH2 当量交给泛醌，每个只值 1.5 而非 2.5。

options.en: 32 ATP - the shuttle regenerates NADH inside the matrix, so the reducing power arrives intact and is oxidised at Complex I.
options.zh: 32 个 ATP —— 该穿梭在基质内再生 NADH，还原力完整送达并在复合体 I 处被氧化。

options.en: 28 ATP - the shuttle itself hydrolyses one ATP for each NADH it carries, so two more are subtracted from the total.
options.zh: 28 个 ATP —— 该穿梭本身每运送一个 NADH 就水解一个 ATP，因此总数还要再减去两个。

quiz.explain_en: The glycerol-3-phosphate shuttle passes electrons from cytosolic NADH to a membrane-bound FAD enzyme that reduces ubiquinone directly, bypassing Complex I and its 4 pumped protons: 6 H+ divided by 4 H+ per ATP = 1.5. Two NADH losing 1 ATP each takes 32 down to 30. The 32 answer describes malate-aspartate, which really does regenerate matrix NADH. The 28 answer invents an ATP cost the shuttle does not have. The 34 answer has electrons entering upstream of Complex I, which is precisely what a quinone-linked flavoprotein cannot do.
quiz.explain_zh: 甘油-3-磷酸穿梭把胞质 NADH 的电子交给一个膜结合的 FAD 酶，后者直接还原泛醌，绕过复合体 I 及其泵出的 4 个质子：6 H+ 除以每个 ATP 的 4 H+ = 1.5。两个 NADH 各损失 1 个 ATP，32 降为 30。给出 32 的说法描述的是苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭，它确实在基质内再生 NADH。给出 28 的说法凭空捏造了一项该穿梭并不存在的 ATP 开销。给出 34 的说法让电子进入复合体 I 的上游，而这恰恰是醌连接的黄素蛋白做不到的事。

quiz.q_en: The value 2.5 ATP per NADH is not measured as a whole number of ATP molecules. Which division produces it?
quiz.q_zh: 每个 NADH 产 2.5 个 ATP 这个数值，并不是以整数个 ATP 分子测出来的。它由哪个除法得出？

options.en: About 5 H+ are pumped per NADH, and 2 of them pass through the c-ring of FO for every ATP that F1 releases.
options.zh: 每个 NADH 泵出约 5 个 H+，其中每 2 个经 FO 的 c 环通过时 F1 释放一个 ATP。

options.en: About 10 H+ are pumped per NADH, and about 4 H+ are consumed for each ATP made and delivered to the cytosol.
options.zh: 每个 NADH 泵出约 10 个 H+，而每生成一个 ATP 并送至胞质约消耗 4 个 H+。

options.en: About 3 ATP are made per NADH, and this is corrected downwards for the electrons that leak to superoxide en route.
options.zh: 每个 NADH 生成约 3 个 ATP，再针对途中漏向超氧阴离子的电子向下修正。

options.en: About 30 kJ/mol is released per NADH oxidised, and about 12 kJ/mol is needed to phosphorylate one molecule of ADP.
options.zh: 每氧化一个 NADH 释放约 30 kJ/mol，而磷酸化一分子 ADP 约需 12 kJ/mol。

quiz.explain_en: Ten protons per NADH is 4 at Complex I, 4 at Complex III and 2 at Complex IV; four protons per exported ATP is roughly 3 through the c-ring plus about 1 for phosphate symport and the electrogenic ATP/ADP exchange by the adenine nucleotide translocase. 10 divided by 4 is 2.5. The 30-over-12 answer uses free energies that are not the accounting used here, and the cellular ΔG of ATP synthesis is nearer 50 kJ/mol. The 5-proton answer halves the true pumping. Electron leak to superoxide is real but amounts to a few per cent, and is not the origin of the fractional value.
quiz.explain_zh: 每个 NADH 泵 10 个质子 = 复合体 I 泵 4 个、复合体 III 泵 4 个、复合体 IV 泵 2 个；每输出一个 ATP 耗 4 个质子 = 约 3 个经 c 环，再加约 1 个用于磷酸同向转运和腺苷酸转位酶的生电性 ATP/ADP 交换。10 除以 4 等于 2.5。用 30 除以 12 的说法采用的自由能不是这里的记账方式，而且细胞内合成 ATP 的 ΔG 更接近 50 kJ/mol。说泵 5 个质子的答案把真实泵出量减半了。电子漏向超氧阴离子确有其事，但只占百分之几，并非这个小数的来源。
quiz.see: L10 · where the 2.5 figure comes from

quiz.q_en: Why is one FADH2 produced by succinate dehydrogenase worth less ATP than one NADH?
quiz.q_zh: 为什么琥珀酸脱氢酶产生的一个 FADH2 比一个 NADH 值更少的 ATP？

options.en: FADH2 donates a single electron to the chain where NADH donates two, so half as many protons are translocated per molecule.
options.zh: FADH2 只向呼吸链提供一个电子，而 NADH 提供两个，因此每分子转运的质子数减半。

options.en: Complex II reduces FAD rather than NAD+, and the gap in standard reduction potential is worth exactly one ATP at Complex IV.
options.zh: 复合体 II 还原的是 FAD 而不是 NAD+，二者标准还原电位之差在复合体 IV 处恰好折合一个 ATP。

options.en: Complex II pumps no protons at all, and its electrons enter at ubiquinone, downstream of Complex I's four pumped protons.
options.zh: 复合体 II 完全不泵质子，而且它的电子从泛醌处进入，位于复合体 I 泵出的四个质子的下游。

options.en: FADH2 is a covalently bound prosthetic group, so one ATP equivalent must be spent releasing it from succinate dehydrogenase.
options.zh: FADH2 是共价结合的辅基，因此必须消耗一个 ATP 当量才能把它从琥珀酸脱氢酶上释放下来。

quiz.explain_en: The reason is topological. Complex II is the only respiratory complex that crosses the inner membrane without translocating protons, and it hands its electrons to ubiquinone, which is past Complex I; 10 - 4 = 6 protons, and 6/4 = 1.5. The reduction-potential answer confuses a thermodynamic difference with a pumping site. The FAD in Complex II is indeed covalently bound, but it is never released and nothing is spent doing so. And FADH2 carries two electrons, not one.
quiz.explain_zh: 原因是拓扑学上的。复合体 II 是唯一一个跨内膜却不转运质子的呼吸链复合体，而且它把电子交给位于复合体 I 之后的泛醌；10 - 4 = 6 个质子，6/4 = 1.5。用还原电位解释的说法把热力学差异与泵质子位点混为一谈。复合体 II 中的 FAD 确实是共价结合的，但它从不被释放，也不为此消耗任何能量。而且 FADH2 携带的是两个电子，不是一个。
quiz.see: L9 · Complex I and the proton pumps

quiz.q_en: Older textbooks give 36-38 ATP per glucose and current ones give 30-32. What changed?
quiz.q_zh: 旧教材给出每分子葡萄糖 36-38 个 ATP，现行教材给出 30-32。改变的是什么？

options.en: The old count included the GTP from succinyl-CoA synthetase, now known to be used by ribosomes and never converted to ATP.
options.zh: 旧算法把琥珀酰CoA 合成酶产生的 GTP 计入其中，现已知它被核糖体直接使用、从不转化为 ATP。

options.en: The old count assumed the malate-aspartate shuttle everywhere, whereas most tissues are now known to use the other shuttle.
options.zh: 旧算法假定所有组织都走苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭，而现已知大多数组织用的其实是另一条穿梭途径。

options.en: The old count omitted the two ATP invested in the preparatory phase, which are now subtracted from the gross figure.
options.zh: 旧算法漏掉了糖酵解准备阶段投入的那两个 ATP，现在要从总产量中把它们逐一减去。

options.en: The old count used integers, 3 ATP per NADH and 2 per FADH2; the modern one uses 2.5 and 1.5, which include the transport cost.
options.zh: 旧算法用整数：NADH 产 3 个、FADH2 产 2 个；新算法用 2.5 与 1.5，已含转运代价。

quiz.explain_en: Only the exchange rate changed. 10x3 + 2x2 + 4 = 38 becomes 10x2.5 + 2x1.5 + 4 = 32, and the shuttle choice gives the 36 and 30 variants within each convention. The GTP has always been counted as an ATP equivalent through nucleoside diphosphate kinase. The shuttle difference explains 38 versus 36, or 32 versus 30, but not the shift between the two eras. The two invested ATP were always subtracted, which is why the net glycolytic yield has always been quoted as 2.
quiz.explain_zh: 改变的只是「汇率」。10x3 + 2x2 + 4 = 38 变成 10x2.5 + 2x1.5 + 4 = 32，而穿梭途径的选择在每一套约定内分别给出 36 和 30 这两个变体。GTP 一直通过核苷二磷酸激酶按一个 ATP 当量计入。穿梭途径的差别解释的是 38 与 36、或 32 与 30 的关系，而不是两个时代之间的落差。准备阶段投入的两个 ATP 始终是被减掉的，这正是糖酵解净产率一直被写作 2 的原因。

quiz.q_en: Work out the yield from complete oxidation of one palmitate (C16:0) using 2.5 and 1.5. Which set of intermediate counts and which total are correct?
quiz.q_zh: 用 2.5 与 1.5 计算一分子软脂酸（C16:0）完全氧化的产率。哪一组中间产物计数与总数是正确的？

options.en: 31 NADH, 15 FADH2 and 8 GTP, minus 1 for activation: 77.5 + 22.5 + 8 - 1 = 107 ATP.
options.zh: 31 个 NADH、15 个 FADH2、8 个 GTP，活化扣 1：77.5 + 22.5 + 8 - 1 = 107 个 ATP。

options.en: 31 NADH, 15 FADH2 and 8 GTP, minus 2 for activation: 77.5 + 22.5 + 8 - 2 = 106 ATP.
options.zh: 31 个 NADH、15 个 FADH2、8 个 GTP，活化扣 2：77.5 + 22.5 + 8 - 2 = 106 个 ATP。

options.en: 32 NADH, 16 FADH2 and 8 GTP, minus 1 for activation: 80 + 24 + 8 - 1 = 111 ATP.
options.zh: 32 个 NADH、16 个 FADH2、8 个 GTP，活化扣 1：80 + 24 + 8 - 1 = 111 个 ATP。

options.en: 24 NADH, 8 FADH2 and 8 GTP, minus 2 for activation: 60 + 12 + 8 - 2 = 78 ATP.
options.zh: 24 个 NADH、8 个 FADH2、8 个 GTP，活化扣 2：60 + 12 + 8 - 2 = 78 个 ATP。

quiz.explain_en: Seven cycles of beta-oxidation, not eight, because the final cycle releases two acetyl-CoA at once: 7 NADH + 7 FADH2 + 8 acetyl-CoA. Each acetyl-CoA in the cycle gives 3 NADH, 1 FADH2 and 1 GTP, so 24 + 8 + 8. Totals 31, 15 and 8. Activation costs two high-energy bonds rather than one, because ATP goes to AMP + PPi and pyrophosphatase then hydrolyses the PPi - that is what makes 107 wrong. The 111 answer uses eight cycles. The 78 answer counts only the citric acid cycle and forgets the cofactors made during beta-oxidation itself. Cross-check with 7n - 6: 7x16 - 6 = 106.
quiz.explain_zh: β-氧化是 7 轮而不是 8 轮，因为最后一轮一次放出两分子乙酰CoA：7 个 NADH + 7 个 FADH2 + 8 个乙酰CoA。每个乙酰CoA 在循环中给出 3 个 NADH、1 个 FADH2 和 1 个 GTP，即 24 + 8 + 8。合计 31、15、8。活化消耗的是两个高能键而不是一个，因为 ATP 变成 AMP + PPi，随后焦磷酸酶再水解 PPi —— 这正是 107 这个答案错的地方。给出 111 的答案用了 8 轮。给出 78 的答案只算了三羧酸循环，漏掉了 β-氧化本身产生的辅酶。用 7n - 6 复核：7x16 - 6 = 106。

quiz.q_en: Acyl-CoA synthetase activates a fatty acid using a single molecule of ATP, yet the energy ledger subtracts two. Why?
quiz.q_zh: 脂酰CoA 合成酶活化脂肪酸只用了一分子 ATP，但能量总账却要扣掉两个。为什么？

options.en: ATP is cleaved to AMP + PPi, and inorganic pyrophosphatase then hydrolyses the PPi, so two phosphoanhydride bonds are lost altogether.
options.zh: ATP 裂解为 AMP + PPi，随后无机焦磷酸酶再水解 PPi，因此总共损失两个磷酸酐键。

options.en: The AMP produced is degraded to IMP and lost from the nucleotide pool, so its full biosynthetic cost of two ATP is charged.
options.zh: 生成的 AMP 被降解为 IMP 而脱离核苷酸池，因此要按其两个 ATP 的完整生物合成代价计费。

options.en: One ATP is spent forming the thioester bond and a second is spent regenerating the free CoA that thiolysis consumes each cycle.
options.zh: 一个 ATP 用于形成硫酯键，第二个用于再生每轮硫解所消耗的游离 CoA。

options.en: A second ATP is spent by carnitine palmitoyltransferase I when the acyl group is transferred onto carnitine for mitochondrial import.
options.zh: 肉碱脂酰转移酶 I 在把脂酰基转移到肉碱上以运入线粒体时又消耗了第二个 ATP。

quiz.explain_en: ATP is cleaved at the alpha-beta position, giving AMP and pyrophosphate; the immediate hydrolysis of PPi by inorganic pyrophosphatase is what makes activation effectively irreversible, and it costs the second high-energy bond. The carnitine shuttle moves the acyl group across the membrane but consumes no ATP directly. AMP is recovered by adenylate kinase, not degraded to IMP. And free CoA is released intact by thiolysis and recycled without any ATP being spent.
quiz.explain_zh: ATP 在 α-β 位断裂，生成 AMP 和焦磷酸；无机焦磷酸酶随即水解 PPi，这正是活化实际上不可逆的原因，也正是第二个高能键的去处。肉碱穿梭只是把脂酰基运过膜，并不直接消耗 ATP。AMP 由腺苷酸激酶回收，而不是被降解为 IMP。游离 CoA 在硫解中被完整释放并循环利用，不消耗任何 ATP。

quiz.q_en: Why does a gram of fat yield roughly twice the ATP of a gram of carbohydrate, and why is its advantage as a store larger still?
quiz.q_zh: 为什么每克脂肪产生的 ATP 约为每克糖类的两倍，而作为储存形式它的优势还要更大？

options.en: Fatty acids are oxidised in the matrix where the gradient is steepest, and triacylglycerol droplets are stored bound to structural protein.
options.zh: 脂肪酸在梯度最陡的基质中被氧化，而三酰甘油脂滴以结合结构蛋白的形式储存。

options.en: Fatty acids bypass glycolysis and so avoid its two-ATP investment, and triacylglycerol has a much higher molecular weight than glucose.
options.zh: 脂肪酸绕过糖酵解从而免去其两个 ATP 的投入，而三酰甘油的分子量远高于葡萄糖。

options.en: Fatty-acid carbons are nearly fully reduced -CH2- with more left to give, and triacylglycerol is stored anhydrous while glycogen carries water.
options.zh: 脂肪酸的碳几乎完全还原为 -CH2-，可供氧化的余地更大，而三酰甘油以无水形式储存，糖原却结合着水。

options.en: Fatty acids yield more acetyl-CoA per carbon atom than glucose does, and triacylglycerol is stored in adipocytes rather than in muscle and liver.
options.zh: 脂肪酸每个碳原子产生的乙酰CoA 比葡萄糖多，而三酰甘油储存在脂肪细胞而非肌肉和肝脏中。

quiz.explain_en: Oxidation state is the whole story for the twofold factor: palmitate gives 106/256 = 0.41 mol ATP per gram against glucose 32/180 = 0.18, a ratio near 2.3, matching the 9 versus 4 kcal/g measured by calorimetry. Hydration supplies the rest of the storage advantage, since glycogen carries roughly 2 g of water per gram. Fatty acids do not bypass any glycolytic investment - they pay their own two-bond activation instead. Both fuels give one acetyl-CoA per two carbons. And where a fuel is stored does not change its energy density at all.
quiz.explain_zh: 两倍这个因子完全由氧化态决定：软脂酸 106/256 = 0.41 mol ATP/g，葡萄糖 32/180 = 0.18，比值约 2.3，与量热法测得的 9 对 4 kcal/g 吻合。储存优势的其余部分来自水合，因为糖原每克约结合 2 g 水。脂肪酸并没有省掉什么糖酵解投入 —— 它自己要付两个高能键的活化代价。两种燃料都是每两个碳给出一个乙酰CoA。而燃料储存在哪里丝毫不改变它的能量密度。

quiz.q_en: Which set names every substrate-level phosphorylation in the complete aerobic oxidation of glucose as covered in this course?
quiz.q_zh: 下列哪一组列出了本课程所涉及的、葡萄糖完全有氧氧化中全部的底物水平磷酸化？

options.en: Phosphoglycerate kinase, pyruvate kinase and isocitrate dehydrogenase - two in glycolysis, one in the citric acid cycle.
options.zh: 磷酸甘油酸激酶、丙酮酸激酶与异柠檬酸脱氢酶 —— 两个在糖酵解，一个在三羧酸循环。

options.en: Phosphoglycerate kinase, pyruvate kinase and succinyl-CoA synthetase - two in glycolysis, one in the citric acid cycle.
options.zh: 磷酸甘油酸激酶、丙酮酸激酶与琥珀酰CoA 合成酶 —— 两个在糖酵解，一个在三羧酸循环。

options.en: Hexokinase, phosphofructokinase-1 and pyruvate kinase - the three irreversible and regulated steps of glycolysis.
options.zh: 己糖激酶、磷酸果糖激酶-1 与丙酮酸激酶 —— 糖酵解中三个不可逆的受调控步骤。

options.en: Glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase, phosphoglycerate kinase and succinyl-CoA synthetase - two in glycolysis, one in the cycle.
options.zh: 3-磷酸甘油醛脱氢酶、磷酸甘油酸激酶与琥珀酰CoA 合成酶 —— 两个在糖酵解，一个在循环。

quiz.explain_en: Substrate-level phosphorylation means a phosphoryl group is transferred directly from a high-energy substrate to ADP or GDP. Phosphoglycerate kinase uses the acyl phosphate of 1,3-BPG, pyruvate kinase uses the enol phosphate of PEP, and succinyl-CoA synthetase uses the thioester of succinyl-CoA to make GTP. Hexokinase and PFK-1 consume ATP rather than making it. Glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase builds the high-energy donor but transfers nothing to ADP. Isocitrate dehydrogenase produces NADH and CO2 and no nucleoside triphosphate at all.
quiz.explain_zh: 底物水平磷酸化指磷酰基由高能底物直接转移给 ADP 或 GDP。磷酸甘油酸激酶利用 1,3-BPG 的酰基磷酸，丙酮酸激酶利用 PEP 的烯醇式磷酸，琥珀酰CoA 合成酶利用琥珀酰CoA 的硫酯键生成 GTP。己糖激酶和 PFK-1 是消耗 ATP 而不是生成 ATP。3-磷酸甘油醛脱氢酶造出了高能供体，但并未向 ADP 转移任何东西。异柠檬酸脱氢酶产生的是 NADH 和 CO2，完全没有任何核苷三磷酸。

quiz.q_en: Glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase is often mistaken for an ATP-producing step. What does it actually do, and where does that ATP appear?
quiz.q_zh: 3-磷酸甘油醛脱氢酶常被误认为是产 ATP 的一步。它实际做了什么，那个 ATP 又在哪里出现？

options.en: It oxidises the aldehyde to a carboxylate and releases the energy as heat, so glycolysis makes ATP only at pyruvate kinase.
options.zh: 它把醛基氧化成羧基并以热的形式释放能量，所以糖酵解只在丙酮酸激酶处产生 ATP。

options.en: It phosphorylates ADP directly using inorganic phosphate, so the ATP appears at this step alongside the NADH that is formed.
options.zh: 它用无机磷酸直接磷酸化 ADP，所以 ATP 就在这一步与生成的 NADH 一同出现。

options.en: It builds the acyl phosphate 1,3-BPG from Pi and NAD+, and phosphoglycerate kinase then transfers that phosphate onto ADP.
options.zh: 它用 Pi 和 NAD+ 造出酰基磷酸 1,3-BPG，随后磷酸甘油酸激酶把这个磷酸转移到 ADP 上。

options.en: It moves the C1 phosphate of fructose-1,6-bisphosphate onto ADP, so the ATP appears one step before phosphoglycerate kinase.
options.zh: 它把 1,6-二磷酸果糖的 C1 磷酸转移到 ADP 上，所以 ATP 出现在磷酸甘油酸激酶的前一步。

quiz.explain_en: The oxidation of the aldehyde is coupled to the attachment of inorganic phosphate, trapping the released free energy in an acyl phosphate instead of losing it; phosphoglycerate kinase then cashes that bond in. No ADP is a substrate at the dehydrogenase step, so it cannot phosphorylate ADP. The C1 phosphate of fructose-1,6-bisphosphate is carried into DHAP and is never handed to ADP. And the energy is not lost as heat - avoiding exactly that is the entire point of the coupling.
quiz.explain_zh: 醛基的氧化与无机磷酸的连接相偶联，把释放的自由能截留在一个酰基磷酸里而不是白白散失；随后磷酸甘油酸激酶把这个键兑现。脱氢酶这一步没有 ADP 作为底物，因此不可能磷酸化 ADP。1,6-二磷酸果糖的 C1 磷酸随 DHAP 带走，从未交给 ADP。能量也没有以热的形式散失 —— 避免的正是这一点，这就是偶联的全部意义。

quiz.q_en: Hydrolysis of PEP has a standard free-energy change near -61.9 kJ/mol, about twice that of ATP. Where does the extra energy come from?
quiz.q_zh: PEP 水解的标准自由能变约为 -61.9 kJ/mol，大约是 ATP 的两倍。多出来的能量从哪里来？

options.en: The enolpyruvate released tautomerises to the much more stable keto form, and that tautomerisation is itself strongly exergonic.
options.zh: 释放出的烯醇式丙酮酸互变异构为稳定得多的酮式，而这一互变本身就是强放能的。

options.en: The phosphorus-oxygen bond of an enol phosphate is intrinsically weaker than a phosphoanhydride bond and needs less energy to break.
options.zh: 烯醇式磷酸的磷氧键本身就比磷酸酐键弱，断裂时需要的能量更少。

options.en: PEP carries three negative charges at pH 7 against ATP's four, so relief of electrostatic repulsion on hydrolysis is greater.
options.zh: PEP 在 pH 7 带三个负电荷而 ATP 带四个，因此水解时电荷排斥的缓解更为显著。

options.en: The pyruvate is consumed at once by lactate dehydrogenase, and this pull is incorporated into the standard free-energy value.
options.zh: 丙酮酸随即被乳酸脱氢酶消耗，这一拉力被计入了标准自由能变数值。

quiz.explain_en: The energy is released by the product falling into a structure it could not reach while phosphorylated: the enol is locked by the phosphate, and once free it tautomerises to the keto form, contributing roughly half the total. A weak-bond explanation is the classic misconception - free energy of hydrolysis is about product stabilisation, not bond strength. More charge, not less, increases repulsion relief, so the charge argument runs backwards. And a standard free-energy change is defined at fixed 1 M concentrations, so no downstream consumption can be built into it.
quiz.explain_zh: 能量的释放来自产物跌入一个「磷酸化时到不了」的结构：烯醇式被磷酸锁住，一旦游离便互变为酮式，约贡献总量的一半。用「键弱」来解释是经典的误解 —— 水解自由能取决于产物的稳定化，而不是键的强度。电荷越多而非越少，排斥缓解才越大，所以电荷那个论证方向反了。而标准自由能变是在各物质浓度固定为 1 M 时定义的，下游的消耗不可能被计入其中。

quiz.q_en: The aldolase reaction has ΔG°' = +23.8 kJ/mol, yet glycolysis runs briskly through it. Which explanation is correct?
quiz.q_zh: 醛缩酶反应的 ΔG°' = +23.8 kJ/mol，但糖酵解仍然顺畅地通过这一步。哪种解释是正确的？

options.en: ΔG = ΔG°' + RT ln Q, and the cell keeps the triose phosphates so low that the real ΔG is near zero or slightly negative.
options.zh: ΔG = ΔG°' + RT ln Q，细胞把磷酸丙糖压得很低，真实 ΔG 接近零或略负。

options.en: Aldolase lowers the activation energy enough to turn the reaction exergonic, which is what distinguishes a catalyst from a reagent.
options.zh: 醛缩酶把活化能降低到足以使该反应变为放能，这正是催化剂与普通反应物之间的区别所在。

options.en: The reaction is coupled to hydrolysis of the ATP invested at phosphofructokinase-1, which pays off the positive standard value.
options.zh: 该反应与磷酸果糖激酶-1 那一步投入的 ATP 的水解相偶联，从而抵消掉为正的标准自由能变。

options.en: At body temperature the TΔS term outweighs ΔH because one molecule becomes two, which reverses the sign of the standard value.
options.zh: 在体温下 TΔS 项超过 ΔH，因为一分子变成了两分子，从而使标准自由能变的符号发生反转。

quiz.explain_en: Mass action is the answer: triose phosphate isomerase and GAPDH remove the products continuously, holding Q far below 1, and at 37 °C each tenfold change in Q is worth about 5.9 kJ/mol. A catalyst changes rate and never the sign of ΔG - that is a definitional error. There is no chemical coupling between the PFK-1 step and the aldolase step; the ATP was spent earlier and separately. And ΔG°' is already a value measured at a defined temperature, so its sign cannot be flipped by invoking TΔS at that same temperature.
quiz.explain_zh: 答案是质量作用：磷酸丙糖异构酶和 GAPDH 不断移走产物，把 Q 压得远低于 1，而在 37 °C 下 Q 每变化十倍约折合 5.9 kJ/mol。催化剂改变的是速率，绝不改变 ΔG 的符号 —— 那是定义上的错误。PFK-1 那一步与醛缩酶那一步之间不存在化学偶联；ATP 是更早、独立地花掉的。而且 ΔG°' 本就是在确定温度下测得的数值，不可能靠在同一温度下援引 TΔS 来翻转它的符号。

quiz.q_en: A reaction splits one molecule into two, so its ΔS is positive. What does that fact alone tell you about whether it will proceed?
quiz.q_zh: 某反应把一分子裂成两分子，因此 ΔS 为正。仅凭这一事实能判断它是否会进行吗？

options.en: It will not proceed in a cell, because living systems maintain order and must couple every entropy-increasing step to ATP.
options.zh: 在细胞中不会进行，因为活体系统必须维持有序，任何增熵的步骤都必须与 ATP 水解偶联。

options.en: It will proceed, because an increase in the disorder of the system is the thermodynamic criterion for a spontaneous process.
options.zh: 它一定会进行，因为体系无序度的增加正是判断一个过程是否自发的热力学判据。

options.en: It will proceed only above a threshold temperature, since TΔS must first grow larger than the activation energy of the step.
options.zh: 只有在超过某个阈值温度之后才会进行，因为 TΔS 必须先增长到大于该步骤的活化能。

options.en: By itself nothing, since ΔG = ΔH - TΔS and a positive ΔS can still be outweighed by an unfavourable ΔH, as aldolase shows.
options.zh: 什么也说明不了：ΔG = ΔH - TΔS，为正的 ΔS 可能被不利的 ΔH 压倒。

quiz.explain_en: Spontaneity is decided by ΔG and nothing else; ΔS is only one of two competing terms. Aldolase is the demonstration - one molecule becomes two, ΔS is positive, and ΔG°' is still +23.8 kJ/mol. Calling disorder the criterion is exactly the conflation to avoid, and in that form it holds only for the entropy of the universe, not of the system. Activation energy belongs to kinetics and appears nowhere in ΔG = ΔH - TΔS. And cells run entropy-increasing reactions constantly without coupling them to anything.
quiz.explain_zh: 自发性由 ΔG 决定，仅由它决定；ΔS 只是两个相互竞争的项之一。醛缩酶就是明证 —— 一分子变两分子，ΔS 为正，而 ΔG°' 仍然是 +23.8 kJ/mol。把无序度当作判据正是要避免的混淆，而且那种表述只对宇宙的熵成立，对体系的熵并不成立。活化能属于动力学，在 ΔG = ΔH - TΔS 中根本不出现。细胞每时每刻都在进行增熵反应，并不需要与任何东西偶联。

quiz.q_en: Oligomycin is added to actively respiring mitochondria. What happens to oxygen consumption and to the proton gradient?
quiz.q_zh: 向正在活跃呼吸的线粒体中加入寡霉素。耗氧量和质子梯度会发生什么变化？

options.en: Oxygen consumption falls and the gradient collapses, because oligomycin binds the heme a3 site and halts electron transfer.
options.zh: 耗氧下降且梯度塌陷，因为寡霉素结合血红素 a3 位点并终止电子传递。

options.en: Oxygen consumption falls and the gradient builds, because blocking the FO channel leaves the pumps working against back-pressure.
options.zh: 耗氧下降而梯度累积，因为堵住 FO 通道后质子泵只能逆着反压做功。

options.en: Oxygen consumption rises and the gradient collapses, because protons re-enter the matrix by a route that bypasses the F1 head.
options.zh: 耗氧升高而梯度塌陷，因为质子经由绕开 F1 头部的途径回流入基质。

options.en: Oxygen consumption is unchanged and the gradient collapses, because F1 is detached from FO while electron transfer carries on.
options.zh: 耗氧不变而梯度塌陷，因为 F1 与 FO 脱离，而电子传递照常进行。

quiz.explain_en: Oligomycin plugs the proton channel of the FO sector. Protons cannot return, the gradient rises until the pumps can no longer work against it, and electron transport slows - this is respiratory control. Rising oxygen consumption with a collapsing gradient describes an uncoupler such as DNP, not oligomycin. Nothing detaches F1 from FO here. And the heme a3 site is the target of cyanide at Complex IV, an entirely different class of poison; oligomycin touches no part of the electron transport chain.
quiz.explain_zh: 寡霉素堵住 FO 部分的质子通道。质子无法回流，梯度不断升高直到质子泵无法再逆之做功，于是电子传递减慢 —— 这就是呼吸控制。耗氧升高伴随梯度塌陷描述的是 DNP 之类的解偶联剂，而不是寡霉素。这里并不存在 F1 与 FO 的脱离。血红素 a3 位点是氰化物在复合体 IV 上的靶点，属于完全不同的一类毒物；寡霉素不接触电子传递链的任何部分。

quiz.q_en: A patient has taken 2,4-dinitrophenol as a slimming agent and presents with severe hyperthermia. What is happening in the mitochondria?
quiz.q_zh: 一名患者把 2,4-二硝基酚当作减肥药服用，出现严重高热。线粒体里发生了什么？

options.en: DNP binds the F1 head and prevents rotary catalysis, so the gradient rises and the energy stored in it is dissipated as heat.
options.zh: DNP 结合 F1 头部并阻止旋转催化，梯度升高，其中储存的能量以热的形式散失。

options.en: DNP inhibits the adenine nucleotide translocase, so ATP accumulates inside the matrix and its hydrolysis there releases heat.
options.zh: DNP 抑制腺苷酸转位酶，ATP 在基质内累积，其在基质中的水解释放出热量。

options.en: DNP is a lipid-soluble weak acid that ferries protons back across the inner membrane, so oxidation runs fast and uncoupled.
options.zh: DNP 是脂溶性弱酸，能把质子摆渡回内膜另一侧，因此氧化高速运转且处于解偶联状态。

options.en: DNP inhibits Complex IV in the manner of cyanide, so electron transfer halts and the unused substrate is burned as heat instead.
options.zh: DNP 像氰化物一样抑制复合体 IV，电子传递停止，未被利用的底物转而以产热方式燃烧。

quiz.explain_en: DNP is protonated in the acidic intermembrane space, crosses the membrane as a neutral molecule, and releases the proton in the alkaline matrix - a chemical proton leak. The gradient collapses, back-pressure disappears, substrate oxidation and oxygen consumption accelerate, and essentially all the free energy leaves as heat, which is why the fatal sign is hyperthermia. Inhibiting Complex IV would stop oxidation rather than accelerate it. Binding F1 describes oligomycin-like inhibition, which raises the gradient instead of dissipating it. And blocking the translocase would stop export, not uncouple the membrane.
quiz.explain_zh: DNP 在酸性的膜间隙被质子化，以中性分子形式穿过膜，再在碱性的基质中释放质子 —— 这是一条化学性的质子漏。梯度塌陷，反压消失，底物氧化和耗氧加速，几乎全部自由能以热的形式散失，所以致命的表现是高热。抑制复合体 IV 会终止氧化而不是加速氧化。结合 F1 描述的是寡霉素式的抑制，那会使梯度升高而非消散。阻断转位酶会阻止 ATP 输出，而不会使膜解偶联。

quiz.q_en: Rotenone is added to mitochondria oxidising malate and respiration stops. Succinate is then added and respiration resumes. Why?
quiz.q_zh: 向氧化苹果酸的线粒体中加入鱼藤酮，呼吸停止；再加入琥珀酸，呼吸恢复。为什么？

options.en: Succinate is oxidised by a soluble matrix dehydrogenase that reduces NAD+, and rotenone blocks only membrane-bound flavoproteins.
options.zh: 琥珀酸由一个可溶的基质脱氢酶氧化并还原 NAD+，而鱼藤酮只阻断膜结合的黄素蛋白。

options.en: Rotenone blocks Complex I, but succinate donates its electrons at Complex II, which feeds ubiquinone well downstream of the block.
options.zh: 鱼藤酮阻断复合体 I，而琥珀酸在复合体 II 处交出电子，从阻断点下游进入泛醌。

options.en: Succinate reduces cytochrome c directly, bypassing both the site of the rotenone block and the entire ubiquinone pool as well.
options.zh: 琥珀酸直接还原细胞色素 c，既绕过鱼藤酮的阻断位点，也绕过整个泛醌池。

options.en: Rotenone is a competitive inhibitor at Complex I and succinate displaces it from the quinone-binding site of that same complex.
options.zh: 鱼藤酮是复合体 I 的竞争性抑制剂，琥珀酸把它从该复合体的醌结合位点上置换下来。

quiz.explain_en: Rotenone blocks electron transfer from the iron-sulfur centres of Complex I to ubiquinone. Succinate enters through Complex II, past the block, so electrons still reach Complexes III and IV and oxygen is still consumed - but only 6 protons are pumped, so the yield is 1.5 ATP rather than 2.5. Succinate dehydrogenase is Complex II itself, membrane-bound, and it reduces FAD and not NAD+. Succinate does not reduce cytochrome c directly; it goes through the quinone pool. And succinate is not a structural analogue of rotenone and cannot displace it.
quiz.explain_zh: 鱼藤酮阻断电子从复合体 I 的铁硫中心向泛醌的传递。琥珀酸经复合体 II 进入，越过了阻断点，因此电子仍能到达复合体 III 和 IV，氧仍被消耗 —— 但只泵出 6 个质子，所以产率是 1.5 而不是 2.5 个 ATP。琥珀酸脱氢酶本身就是复合体 II，是膜结合的，而且它还原的是 FAD 而不是 NAD+。琥珀酸并不直接还原细胞色素 c，它要经过醌池。琥珀酸也不是鱼藤酮的结构类似物，无法把它置换下来。

quiz.q_en: Match each inhibitor to the complex at which it stops the respiratory chain.
quiz.q_zh: 把每种抑制剂与它阻断呼吸链的复合体对应起来。

options.en: Rotenone at Complex III, antimycin A at Complex IV, and cyanide together with carbon monoxide at Complex I.
options.zh: 鱼藤酮作用于复合体 III，抗霉素 A 作用于复合体 IV，氰化物与一氧化碳作用于复合体 I。

options.en: Rotenone at Complex I, antimycin A at Complex III, and cyanide together with carbon monoxide at Complex IV.
options.zh: 鱼藤酮作用于复合体 I，抗霉素 A 作用于复合体 III，氰化物与一氧化碳作用于复合体 IV。

options.en: Rotenone at Complex I, antimycin A at Complex IV, and cyanide together with carbon monoxide at Complex III.
options.zh: 鱼藤酮作用于复合体 I，抗霉素 A 作用于复合体 IV，氰化物与一氧化碳作用于复合体 III。

options.en: Rotenone at Complex II, antimycin A at Complex I, and cyanide together with carbon monoxide at Complex III.
options.zh: 鱼藤酮作用于复合体 II，抗霉素 A 作用于复合体 I，氰化物与一氧化碳作用于复合体 III。

quiz.explain_en: Rotenone blocks the iron-sulfur to ubiquinone step in Complex I; antimycin A blocks the Qi site of cytochrome b in Complex III; cyanide binds ferric heme a3 and carbon monoxide binds the ferrous form, both in Complex IV, cytochrome c oxidase. Any arrangement placing antimycin A at Complex IV or cyanide at Complex III inverts those two, and rotenone never acts at Complex II or III. Complex II has no inhibitor in this list at all - the classic one there is malonate, a competitive analogue of succinate.
quiz.explain_zh: 鱼藤酮阻断复合体 I 内由铁硫中心到泛醌的这一步；抗霉素 A 阻断复合体 III 中细胞色素 b 的 Qi 位点；氰化物结合三价铁形式的血红素 a3，一氧化碳结合二价铁形式，两者都作用于复合体 IV，即细胞色素 c 氧化酶。任何把抗霉素 A 放在复合体 IV、或把氰化物放在复合体 III 的组合都是把这两者颠倒了，而鱼藤酮从不作用于复合体 II 或 III。这份名单里根本没有复合体 II 的抑制剂 —— 那里的经典抑制剂是丙二酸，琥珀酸的竞争性类似物。

quiz.q_en: What exactly does a P/O ratio of 2.5 mean, and what is the P/O ratio when succinate is the substrate?
quiz.q_zh: P/O 比等于 2.5 究竟是什么意思？以琥珀酸为底物时 P/O 比又是多少？

options.en: 2.5 ATP per proton translocated by Complex I; with succinate the ratio is 1.5 because Complex II translocates fewer protons.
options.zh: 复合体 I 每转运一个质子生成 2.5 个 ATP；以琥珀酸为底物时比值为 1.5，因为复合体 II 转运的质子更少。

options.en: 2.5 ATP per molecule of O2 reduced to two waters; with succinate the ratio is 1.5 because one fewer NADH is generated.
options.zh: 每还原一分子 O2 生成两分子水时产生 2.5 个 ATP；以琥珀酸为底物时比值为 1.5，因为少生成了一个 NADH。

options.en: 2.5 ATP per complete turn of the c-ring of the FO sector; with succinate the ratio is 1.5 because the ring turns more slowly.
options.zh: FO 部分的 c 环每完整转一圈生成 2.5 个 ATP；以琥珀酸为底物时比值为 1.5，因为 c 环转得更慢。

options.en: 2.5 ATP per atom of oxygen reduced, that is per electron pair through the chain; with succinate the ratio is 1.5.
options.zh: 每还原一个氧原子（即每对电子通过呼吸链）生成 2.5 个 ATP；以琥珀酸为底物时比值为 1.5。

quiz.explain_en: P/O is phosphate esterified per atom of oxygen reduced, and since reducing one oxygen atom to water takes two electrons, it is equally ATP per electron pair. NADH-linked substrates give about 2.5 and succinate about 1.5, and these measurements are the experimental basis for the yield figures. Counting per O2 would double both numbers. Protons translocated is the quantity you divide by when explaining the ratio, not the denominator of P/O itself. And the rate at which the c-ring turns changes the flux, never the stoichiometry.
quiz.explain_zh: P/O 是每还原一个氧原子所酯化的磷酸数；由于把一个氧原子还原成水需要两个电子，它同时也等于每对电子生成的 ATP 数。NADH 连接的底物约为 2.5，琥珀酸约为 1.5，这些实测值正是产率数字的实验基础。若按每分子 O2 计，两个数都要翻倍。转运的质子数是解释这个比值时用来做除法的量，而不是 P/O 本身的分母。c 环转动的快慢改变的是通量，绝不改变化学计量比。

quiz.q_en: The proton-motive force across the inner mitochondrial membrane is about 200 mV. How is it split between its two components, and which one dominates?
quiz.q_zh: 线粒体内膜两侧的质子动力势约为 200 mV。它在两个组分之间如何分配，哪一项占主导？

options.en: Δψ of roughly 30 mV with the matrix positive, plus a ΔpH of about 2.8 units worth 170 mV; the pH gradient carries most of the energy.
options.zh: Δψ 约 30 mV（基质为正），加上约 2.8 个单位、折合 170 mV 的 ΔpH；pH 梯度承载了大部分能量。

options.en: Δψ of roughly 150-180 mV with the matrix negative, plus a ΔpH of 0.5-0.75 units worth 30-45 mV; the membrane potential dominates.
options.zh: Δψ 约 150-180 mV（基质为负），加上 0.5-0.75 个单位、折合 30-45 mV 的 ΔpH；膜电位占主导。

options.en: ΔpH of roughly 3 units worth about 180 mV with the matrix acidic, plus a Δψ near 20 mV; the pH gradient dominates as in the thylakoid.
options.zh: ΔpH 约 3 个单位、折合约 180 mV（基质为酸性），加上约 20 mV 的 Δψ；如同类囊体一样，pH 梯度占主导。

options.en: Δψ and ΔpH contribute about 100 mV each, matrix negative and alkaline, so neither term dominates and both must be measured.
options.zh: Δψ 与 ΔpH 各贡献约 100 mV，基质为负且偏碱，因此两项都不占主导，必须分别测定。

quiz.explain_en: Δp = Δψ - (2.3RT/F)ΔpH, and at 37 °C the conversion is about 61.5 mV per pH unit, so 0.5-0.75 units is only 30-45 mV against a membrane potential of 150-180 mV. Pumping protons out leaves the matrix negative and alkaline, so any answer with the matrix acidic or positive has the polarity backwards. The chloroplast thylakoid is the genuine ΔpH-dominated case, which is why it is a useful contrast and not a description of mitochondria. An even split understates how much of the mitochondrial force is electrical.
quiz.explain_zh: Δp = Δψ - (2.3RT/F)ΔpH，37 °C 下换算约为每个 pH 单位 61.5 mV，所以 0.5-0.75 个单位只有 30-45 mV，而膜电位为 150-180 mV。把质子泵出去会使基质变负、变碱，因此任何说基质为酸性或为正的答案都把极性弄反了。叶绿体类囊体才是真正由 ΔpH 主导的情形，所以它是一个有用的对照，而不是对线粒体的描述。说两项各半则低估了线粒体中电学部分所占的比重。

quiz.q_en: A muscle fibre is working anaerobically. What is the ATP yield per glucose, and what sets that limit?
quiz.q_zh: 一条肌纤维在无氧条件下工作。每分子葡萄糖产多少 ATP，是什么设定了这个上限？

options.en: 2 ATP per glucose, and the limit is that NADH must be reoxidised by lactate dehydrogenase, so its reducing power is discarded.
options.zh: 每分子葡萄糖 2 个 ATP，上限来自 NADH 必须由乳酸脱氢酶重新氧化，其还原力因此被丢弃。

options.en: 6 ATP per glucose, since the two cytosolic NADH can still be oxidised through the glycerol-3-phosphate shuttle without oxygen.
options.zh: 每分子葡萄糖 6 个 ATP，因为无氧时两个胞质 NADH 仍可经甘油-3-磷酸穿梭被氧化。

options.en: 4 ATP per glucose, since both substrate-level steps run twice and nothing is invested in the preparatory phase without oxygen.
options.zh: 每分子葡萄糖 4 个 ATP，因为两个底物水平磷酸化步骤各运行两次，而无氧时准备阶段无需投入。

options.en: 2 ATP per glucose, and the limit is that lactate dehydrogenase consumes one ATP for each pyruvate it reduces to lactate.
options.zh: 每分子葡萄糖 2 个 ATP，上限来自乳酸脱氢酶每还原一个丙酮酸为乳酸就消耗一个 ATP。

quiz.explain_en: Only substrate-level phosphorylation is available: 4 made, 2 invested, net 2. The two NADH are not a bonus but a liability - NAD+ must be regenerated or glycolysis stops at the dehydrogenase step, so the electrons are dumped onto pyruvate to make lactate. That is roughly one sixteenth of the aerobic 32. Lactate dehydrogenase consumes NADH, not ATP. The preparatory phase costs its two ATP whether oxygen is present or not. And the glycerol-3-phosphate shuttle ends at ubiquinone, which cannot be reoxidised without a terminal electron acceptor.
quiz.explain_zh: 能用的只有底物水平磷酸化：生成 4 个，投入 2 个，净得 2 个。那两个 NADH 不是红利而是负担 —— 必须再生 NAD+，否则糖酵解会停在脱氢酶那一步，所以电子被倾倒给丙酮酸生成乳酸。这大约是有氧条件下 32 个的十六分之一。乳酸脱氢酶消耗的是 NADH，不是 ATP。准备阶段无论有氧无氧都要花掉两个 ATP。而甘油-3-磷酸穿梭终止于泛醌，没有终末电子受体就无法把它重新氧化。

quiz.q_en: Brown adipose tissue expresses UCP1 (thermogenin). How does it work, and what does tissue oxygen consumption do when it is activated?
quiz.q_zh: 棕色脂肪组织表达 UCP1（解偶联蛋白/产热素）。它如何工作？被激活时组织耗氧量会怎样？

options.en: It is an ATP synthase isoform with a wider c-ring, so more protons are spent per ATP and the surplus energy appears as heat.
options.zh: 它是一种 c 环更宽的 ATP 合酶同工型，每生成一个 ATP 消耗更多质子，多余的能量表现为热。

options.en: It is an inner-membrane protein that conducts protons back into the matrix, short-circuiting the gradient; oxygen consumption rises.
options.zh: 它是一种内膜蛋白，把质子导回基质、使梯度短路；耗氧量随之升高。

options.en: It inhibits the adenine nucleotide translocase so that ATP cannot leave the matrix; oxygen consumption falls and heat is produced.
options.zh: 它抑制腺苷酸转位酶，使 ATP 无法离开基质；耗氧量下降并产生热量。

options.en: It transfers electrons from FADH2 straight to oxygen without the complexes; oxygen consumption rises and no gradient is formed.
options.zh: 它把电子从 FADH2 直接传给氧而不经过各复合体；耗氧量升高且不形成梯度。

quiz.explain_en: UCP1 is a regulated proton channel - physiologically what DNP does chemically. Substrate oxidation continues at full speed with no back-pressure, so oxygen consumption rises while ATP output falls and the free energy leaves as heat; this warms newborns and cold-adapted adults. It is not an ATP synthase and makes no ATP. Blocking the translocase would be an inhibitor of oxidative phosphorylation and would lower oxygen consumption, the opposite direction. And nothing bypasses the complexes to reduce oxygen directly.
quiz.explain_zh: UCP1 是一条受调控的质子通道 —— DNP 用化学方式做的事，它用生理方式做。底物氧化在没有反压的情况下全速进行，所以耗氧升高而 ATP 产出下降，自由能以热的形式散失；这为新生儿和冷适应的成人供暖。它不是 ATP 合酶，也不生成任何 ATP。阻断转位酶属于氧化磷酸化抑制剂，会使耗氧下降，方向正好相反。也不存在绕过各复合体直接还原氧的途径。

quiz.q_en: Why can the number of protons needed to make one ATP not be stated as a single universal integer?
quiz.q_zh: 为什么生成一个 ATP 所需的质子数不能写成一个通用的整数？

options.en: Because the number required depends on the ATP/ADP ratio, which sets how far the F1 head must rotate to release each ATP.
options.zh: 因为所需的数目取决于 ATP/ADP 比值，而该比值决定了 F1 头部要转多远才会释放一个 ATP。

options.en: Because a proportion of protons leaks back across the inner membrane, and that proportion varies with the lipid composition.
options.zh: 因为总有一部分质子会漏回内膜的另一侧，而漏回的比例随膜的脂质组成不同而变化。

options.en: Because F1 makes 3 ATP per full rotation of the c-ring while c itself varies - 8 in cattle, 10 in yeast, 14 in chloroplasts.
options.zh: 因为 c 环每转一圈 F1 生成 3 个 ATP，而 c 值各异：牛 8、酵母 10、叶绿体 14。

options.en: Because Complex I pumps four protons in some tissues and two in others, so the numerator of the ratio varies with the tissue.
options.zh: 因为复合体 I 在某些组织中泵四个质子、在另一些组织中泵两个，比值的分子随组织而变。

quiz.explain_en: H+ per ATP made by the synthase is c/3, so 2.7 in bovine mitochondria, 3.3 in yeast, 4.7 in chloroplasts; add roughly 1 H+ for phosphate symport and the electrogenic ATP/ADP exchange and mammalian arithmetic lands near 3.7, not exactly 4. Complex I pumps 4 protons wherever it is found. The ATP/ADP ratio changes the thermodynamic driving force, not the mechanical gear ratio - the c-ring always turns 360 degrees for 3 ATP. Proton leak is real and does waste protons, but it is a loss term rather than the reason the stoichiometry is fractional.
quiz.explain_zh: 合酶每生成一个 ATP 所需的 H+ 数为 c/3，即牛线粒体 2.7、酵母 3.3、叶绿体 4.7；再加上约 1 个 H+ 用于磷酸同向转运和生电性 ATP/ADP 交换，哺乳动物的算式落在约 3.7 而不是正好 4。复合体 I 在任何来源中都泵 4 个质子。ATP/ADP 比值改变的是热力学驱动力，而不是机械传动比 —— c 环永远是转 360 度对应 3 个 ATP。质子漏确实存在、也确实浪费质子，但那是一个损失项，而不是化学计量比呈分数的原因。

sections.title_en: Redox logic — NADH, NADPH, and why electrons go where they go
sections.title_zh: 氧化还原的逻辑 —— NADH、NADPH，以及电子为什么往那里走
sections.blurb_en: A corrective and a first-principles account: one phosphate separates two chemically identical cofactors into an oxidised catabolic pool and a reduced biosynthetic one, and standard reduction potential — through DeltaG°' = -nF·DeltaE°' — then decides everything from why succinate dehydrogenase uses FAD, to why Complex II cannot pump, to why a fava bean can destroy the red cells of a G6PD-deficient child.
sections.blurb_zh: 一节纠错课，也是一次从第一性原理出发的推导：仅一个磷酸就把两个化学上完全相同的辅因子分成了氧化态的分解代谢池与还原态的生物合成池；而标准还原电位——通过 DeltaG°' = -nF·DeltaE°'——随后决定了一切：为什么 succinate dehydrogenase 用 FAD、为什么 Complex II 不能泵质子、以及为什么一颗蚕豆能摧毁一个 G6PD 缺乏症儿童的红细胞。

cards.en: NAD+ and NADP+ differ by one phosphate group, esterified to the 2'-hydroxyl of the ribose that carries the adenine. Everything else — the nicotinamide ring, the pyrophosphate bridge, the second ribose — is identical, and so is the chemistry: both carry two electrons and one proton as a hydride (H-) delivered to or taken from C4 of the nicotinamide ring, and both have a standard reduction potential of about -0.32 V. The extra phosphate is therefore not an energetic modification at all. It is a recognition tag: a handle far from the reacting ring that lets an enzyme decide which of two chemically equivalent pools it is allowed to touch.
cards.zh: NAD+ 与 NADP+ 的差别只有一个磷酸基团，酯化在携带 adenine 的那个 ribose 的 2'-羟基上。其余部分——nicotinamide 环、pyrophosphate 桥、第二个 ribose——完全相同，化学性质也完全相同：两者都以 hydride（H-）的形式，把两个电子加一个质子交给 nicotinamide 环的 C4 或从 C4 取走，标准还原电位都约为 -0.32 V。所以这个额外的磷酸根本不是一种能量学上的修饰，它是一个识别标签：一个远离反应环的把手，让酶去决定自己被允许动用两个化学上等价的池子中的哪一个。

cards.en: Enzymes read the 2'-phosphate electrostatically, at the C-terminal end of the second beta-strand of the Rossmann dinucleotide-binding fold. NAD-dependent enzymes place an acidic residue (usually Asp, sometimes Glu) there, which hydrogen-bonds the free 2'-OH and 3'-OH of NAD and would clash electrostatically with a phosphate. NADP-dependent enzymes replace it with basic residues — an Arg or Lys, often two — that form a salt bridge to the 2'-phosphate. Swapping that one acidic residue for a basic one has been enough, in several published experiments, to invert an enzyme's cofactor preference. This is why the two pools stay separate even though they share a compartment.
cards.zh: 酶是通过静电作用读取这个 2'-磷酸的，读取位点在 Rossmann 二核苷酸结合折叠中第二条 beta 链的 C 端。依赖 NAD 的酶在该处放一个酸性残基（通常是 Asp，有时是 Glu），它与 NAD 游离的 2'-OH 和 3'-OH 形成氢键，而与一个磷酸基团会发生静电排斥。依赖 NADP 的酶则把它换成碱性残基——一个 Arg 或 Lys，常常是两个——与 2'-磷酸形成盐桥。在多篇已发表的实验里，仅仅把这一个酸性残基换成碱性残基，就足以颠倒一个酶的辅因子偏好。这就是为什么两个池子共处同一区室却仍然彼此分开。

cards.en: Because the two standard potentials are nearly identical, the difference between the pools is made entirely by the ratio the cell holds them at. The Nernst equation, E = E°' + (RT/nF) ln([oxidised]/[reduced]), says a couple held oxidised has a more positive actual potential (a better electron acceptor) and a couple held reduced a more negative one (a better electron donor). The commonly quoted liver-cytosol figures are [NAD+]/[NADH] around 700 and [NADPH]/[NADP+] around 75. Put those into the Nernst equation and the NADP couple ends up roughly 0.1 V more negative than the NAD couple in the same cytosol. Same molecule, same chemistry, two different jobs, achieved by concentration alone.
cards.zh: 由于两者的标准电位几乎相同，两个池子的差别完全由细胞把它们维持在什么比例上决定。Nernst 方程 E = E°' + (RT/nF) ln([氧化型]/[还原型]) 说明：被维持在氧化态的电对，其实际电位更正（是更好的电子受体）；被维持在还原态的电对，其实际电位更负（是更好的电子供体）。肝细胞胞质中常被引用的数值是 [NAD+]/[NADH] 约 700，[NADPH]/[NADP+] 约 75。把这两个比值代入 Nernst 方程，同一份胞质中 NADP 电对的实际电位大约比 NAD 电对负 0.1 V。同一个分子、同一种化学反应、两种不同的任务，仅靠浓度就实现了。

cards.en: 'NADH and NADPH are interchangeable reducing power' is the single most common error in this material, and it is wrong twice over. First, kinetically: an NADP-specific reductase simply will not turn over with NADH, because the binding pocket is built for the phosphate. Second, thermodynamically: even if an enzyme were promiscuous, the cytosolic NAD pool is held about 700-fold oxidised, so there is very little NADH available to donate. The only genuine bridge between the pools is mitochondrial nicotinamide nucleotide transhydrogenase, and it is not free — it spends the proton-motive force to push hydride from NADH to NADP+, i.e. it is paid for with ATP the cell did not make.
cards.zh: 「NADH 和 NADPH 是可以互换的还原力」是这部分内容中最常见的错误，而且它错了两次。第一，从动力学上讲：一个 NADP 专一的还原酶用 NADH 根本无法周转，因为结合口袋是为那个磷酸而建的。第二，从热力学上讲：即使某个酶不挑剔，胞质中的 NAD 池被维持在约 700 倍的氧化态，可供给出的 NADH 本来就极少。两个池子之间唯一真正的桥梁是线粒体的 nicotinamide nucleotide transhydrogenase，而且它并不免费——它消耗质子动力势把 hydride 从 NADH 推给 NADP+，也就是说，用细胞本可以生成却没有生成的 ATP 来支付。

cards.en: Where NADPH actually comes from, in order of importance. The oxidative branch of the pentose phosphate pathway is the main cytosolic source and gives two NADPH per glucose 6-phosphate, at two of its three steps: glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD), which is the committed and rate-limiting step and is activated by a high NADP+/NADPH ratio, and 6-phosphogluconate dehydrogenase, an oxidative decarboxylation that also releases the CO2 and leaves ribulose 5-phosphate. The intervening step, 6-phosphogluconolactonase, is a hydrolysis and yields nothing. Secondary sources: malic enzyme (malate + NADP+ -> pyruvate + CO2 + NADPH) and cytosolic NADP-linked isocitrate dehydrogenase. Inside mitochondria, transhydrogenase and NADP-linked IDH2 supply the matrix pool. Keep the arithmetic attached: at 2 NADPH per G6P, the 14 NADPH needed for one palmitate means 7 molecules of glucose 6-phosphate routed through the PPP, which is why lipogenic tissues carry high G6PD activity.
cards.zh: NADPH 究竟从哪里来，按重要性排列。磷酸戊糖途径的氧化分支是胞质中的主要来源，每分子 glucose 6-phosphate 产生两个 NADPH，来自它三步中的两步：glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase（G6PD），这是关键的定向步骤和限速步骤，被高的 NADP+/NADPH 比值激活；以及 6-phosphogluconate dehydrogenase，这是一次氧化脱羧，同时放出那个 CO2 并留下 ribulose 5-phosphate。夹在中间的那一步 6-phosphogluconolactonase 是一次水解，什么也不产生。次要来源：malic enzyme（malate + NADP+ -> pyruvate + CO2 + NADPH）与胞质中依赖 NADP 的 isocitrate dehydrogenase。在线粒体内，transhydrogenase 与依赖 NADP 的 IDH2 供应基质中的池子。把算术一并记住：每分子 G6P 产 2 个 NADPH，而合成一分子 palmitate 需要 14 个 NADPH，这意味着要有 7 分子 glucose 6-phosphate 走磷酸戊糖途径，这也是脂肪合成活跃的组织 G6PD 活性很高的原因。

cards.en: The division of labour follows from the ratios. NADH, produced by catabolic dehydrogenases (GAPDH, pyruvate dehydrogenase, three TCA dehydrogenases, beta-oxidation's hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenase) goes to Complex I of the respiratory chain and is cashed in as ATP. NADPH goes to reductive biosynthesis and to defence: the two reduction steps of each fatty acid synthase cycle (ketoacyl reductase and enoyl reductase), HMG-CoA reductase in cholesterol synthesis, the endoplasmic reticulum desaturase and cytochrome P450 systems, thioredoxin reductase (and hence ribonucleotide reductase), and glutathione reductase. One honest caveat on the desaturases: the electron relay runs through cytochrome b5 and its flavoprotein reductase, and textbooks differ over the donor — the enzyme is formally named NADH-cytochrome b5 reductase, yet many biochemistry texts draw NADPH feeding the desaturase system. Quote the relay, not the donor, unless your course has committed to one. Otherwise, reading the direction is a reliable exam heuristic: taking hydrogens off a substrate usually means NAD+; putting hydrogens on usually means NADPH.
cards.zh: 分工是由比例决定的。NADH 由分解代谢的脱氢酶产生（GAPDH、pyruvate dehydrogenase、TCA 中的三个脱氢酶、beta-氧化中的 hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenase），送往呼吸链的 Complex I，兑现为 ATP。NADPH 则送往还原性生物合成与防御：脂肪酸合酶每一轮中的两个还原步骤（ketoacyl reductase 与 enoyl reductase）、胆固醇合成中的 HMG-CoA reductase、内质网的去饱和酶与 cytochrome P450 系统、thioredoxin reductase（并因而支持 ribonucleotide reductase），以及 glutathione reductase。关于去饱和酶有一点需要如实说明：其电子传递经由 cytochrome b5 及其黄素蛋白还原酶，而各教材对供体的写法并不一致——该酶的正式名称是 NADH-cytochrome b5 reductase，但许多生物化学教材画的却是 NADPH 供给这套去饱和系统。除非你的课程已经明确采纳某一种说法，否则答题时讲这条传递链而不要咬定供体。除此之外，看反应方向是一个可靠的应试判断法：从底物上脱下氢通常意味着 NAD+，往底物上加氢通常意味着 NADPH。

cards.en: Standard reduction potential decides direction: electrons flow spontaneously from the couple with the more negative E°' to the couple with the more positive E°'. Now apply it to succinate. The fumarate/succinate couple sits at about +0.03 V, while NAD+/NADH sits at about -0.32 V. Asking succinate to reduce NAD+ means moving electrons uphill by roughly 0.35 V, which by DeltaG°' = -nF·DeltaE°' is about +68 kJ/mol — thoroughly forbidden. So succinate dehydrogenase does not use NAD+. It uses a covalently attached FAD whose potential, tuned by the protein, sits close to succinate's own, and passes the electrons on to ubiquinone. The cofactor is not an arbitrary choice; it is dictated by the potential of the substrate couple.
cards.zh: 标准还原电位决定方向：电子自发地从 E°' 较负的电对流向 E°' 较正的电对。把它用到 succinate 上。fumarate/succinate 电对约为 +0.03 V，而 NAD+/NADH 约为 -0.32 V。要求 succinate 去还原 NAD+，意味着让电子上坡约 0.35 V，按 DeltaG°' = -nF·DeltaE°' 计算约为 +68 kJ/mol——完全不可行。所以 succinate dehydrogenase 不用 NAD+。它用一个共价连接的 FAD，其电位被蛋白质调节到接近 succinate 自身的电位，再把电子交给 ubiquinone。辅因子不是随意的选择，而是由底物电对的电位所规定的。

cards.en: DeltaG°' = -nF·DeltaE°', with n the number of electrons transferred and F the Faraday constant, 96.5 kJ per mole per volt. This one equation tells you whether a step can power a pump. Complex I spans NAD+/NADH (-0.32 V) to ubiquinone (about +0.05 V): DeltaE°' about 0.36 V, n = 2, so DeltaG°' is about -70 kJ/mol — ample for the four protons it moves, since translocating one proton against the gradient costs on the order of 20 kJ/mol. Complex II spans succinate (+0.03 V) to the same ubiquinone: DeltaE°' about 0.01 V, giving only a couple of kJ/mol. That is the quantitative reason Complex II pumps no protons, and it is why FADH2 entering at ubiquinone yields less ATP than NADH entering at Complex I.
cards.zh: DeltaG°' = -nF·DeltaE°'，其中 n 是转移的电子数，F 是 Faraday 常数，96.5 kJ·mol⁻¹·V⁻¹。仅这一个公式就能告诉你某一步能否驱动质子泵。Complex I 跨越 NAD+/NADH（-0.32 V）到 ubiquinone（约 +0.05 V）：DeltaE°' 约 0.36 V，n = 2，因此 DeltaG°' 约为 -70 kJ/mol——对它泵出的四个质子而言绰绰有余，因为逆梯度转运一个质子的代价在 20 kJ/mol 量级。Complex II 跨越 succinate（+0.03 V）到同一个 ubiquinone：DeltaE°' 仅约 0.01 V，只有区区几 kJ/mol。这就是 Complex II 不泵质子的定量原因，也是为什么从 ubiquinone 进入的 FADH2 产生的 ATP 少于从 Complex I 进入的 NADH。

cards.see: L9 · Complex I to Complex IV
cards.en: The respiratory chain is simply the carriers sorted in order of increasing standard reduction potential, so that every handover is downhill: NADH (-0.32 V) -> FMN and the iron-sulfur clusters of Complex I -> ubiquinone (about +0.05 V) -> cytochrome b, an Fe-S centre and cytochrome c1 in Complex III -> cytochrome c (about +0.25 V) -> cytochromes a and a3 with their copper centres in Complex IV -> O2 (+0.82 V). Succinate and the other FAD-linked dehydrogenases (acyl-CoA dehydrogenase, glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase) all feed in at ubiquinone because their own potentials sit in that region. The total span, -0.32 to +0.82 V, is about 1.14 V and gives roughly -220 kJ/mol per pair of electrons.
cards.zh: 呼吸链无非就是把各个载体按标准还原电位递增的顺序排好，使每一次传递都是下坡：NADH（-0.32 V）-> Complex I 中的 FMN 与铁硫簇 -> ubiquinone（约 +0.05 V）-> Complex III 中的 cytochrome b、一个 Fe-S 中心与 cytochrome c1 -> cytochrome c（约 +0.25 V）-> Complex IV 中带铜中心的 cytochrome a 与 a3 -> O2（+0.82 V）。succinate 和其他依赖 FAD 的脱氢酶（acyl-CoA dehydrogenase、glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase）都在 ubiquinone 处汇入，因为它们自身的电位正落在那个区间。总跨度从 -0.32 到 +0.82 V，约 1.14 V，每传递一对电子约给出 -220 kJ/mol。

cards.en: G6PD deficiency is the commonest human enzymopathy, X-linked, and its distribution overlaps historical malaria — the trait is partially protective. The mature red cell has no nucleus and no mitochondria, so it cannot resynthesise the enzyme and the pentose phosphate pathway is its only route to NADPH. Without NADPH, glutathione reductase cannot regenerate GSH from GSSG, peroxide is no longer removed, haemoglobin thiols oxidise and the protein precipitates as Heinz bodies visible on a supravital stain; the spleen bites out the inclusions, leaving 'bite cells', and acute intravascular haemolysis follows. Between exposures patients are usually well, which is why the diagnosis is easy to miss.
cards.zh: G6PD 缺乏症是人类最常见的酶病，X 连锁遗传，其分布与历史上的疟疾流行区重叠——该性状具有部分保护作用。成熟红细胞没有细胞核也没有线粒体，因此既不能重新合成这个酶，磷酸戊糖途径又是它获得 NADPH 的唯一途径。没有 NADPH，glutathione reductase 就无法把 GSSG 还原回 GSH，过氧化物不再被清除，血红蛋白的巯基被氧化、蛋白质沉淀形成 Heinz 小体（活体染色可见）；脾脏把这些包涵体「咬」掉，留下所谓的咬痕细胞（bite cells），随后发生急性血管内溶血。在两次暴露之间患者通常无症状，所以这个诊断很容易被漏掉。

cards.en: The triggers are all oxidant loads, not inhibitors of the enzyme. Fava beans contain the glycosides vicine and convicine, whose aglycones divicine and isouramil redox-cycle with oxygen and generate a burst of superoxide and peroxide — hence 'favism', classically in a Mediterranean-variant child hours after a meal of broad beans. The 8-aminoquinoline antimalarial primaquine (and tafenoquine) produces redox-cycling metabolites, which is why G6PD status must be checked before prescribing it; dapsone, nitrofurantoin, sulfonamides, methylene blue and naphthalene mothballs do the same. Infection alone can trigger an episode, through the phagocyte respiratory burst. The lesson is general: the defect is not in making peroxide but in the capacity to reduce it.
cards.zh: 这些诱因全都是氧化负荷，而不是这个酶的抑制剂。蚕豆含有 vicine 与 convicine 两种糖苷，其苷元 divicine 与 isouramil 与氧发生氧化还原循环，产生一阵超氧阴离子和过氧化物——这就是「蚕豆病」，典型病例是携带地中海型变异的儿童在吃蚕豆后数小时发病。8-氨基喹啉类抗疟药 primaquine（以及 tafenoquine）会生成参与氧化还原循环的代谢物，所以开药前必须先查 G6PD 状态；dapsone、nitrofurantoin、磺胺类、亚甲蓝与樟脑丸中的萘也是如此。单是感染就可以通过吞噬细胞的呼吸爆发诱发一次发作。这里的道理是普遍的：缺陷不在于产生过氧化物，而在于还原它的能力。

cards.en: Reactive oxygen species are a by-product of the chain leaking single electrons onto O2. The two principal sites are Complex I — at its flavin and at the quinone site, releasing superoxide into the matrix — and the Qo site of Complex III, whose semiquinone intermediate releases superoxide to both sides of the inner membrane. Complex IV, counter-intuitively, leaks very little, because it holds its oxygen intermediates tightly until all four electrons have arrived. Superoxide dismutase then disproportionates superoxide to H2O2 and O2 (a manganese enzyme, SOD2, in the matrix; a Cu/Zn enzyme, SOD1, in cytosol). Catalase, a haem enzyme concentrated in peroxisomes, turns H2O2 into water and O2; glutathione peroxidase, a selenocysteine enzyme, does the same at low peroxide concentrations using two GSH.
cards.zh: 活性氧是呼吸链把单个电子漏给 O2 的副产物。两个主要漏点是 Complex I——在其黄素位点和醌位点，把超氧阴离子释放到基质中——以及 Complex III 的 Qo 位点，其半醌中间物向内膜两侧都释放超氧阴离子。与直觉相反，Complex IV 几乎不漏，因为它把氧的中间物牢牢扣住，直到四个电子全部到齐。随后 superoxide dismutase 把超氧阴离子歧化为 H2O2 与 O2（基质中是含锰的 SOD2，胞质中是含铜锌的 SOD1）。catalase 是一种富集于过氧化物酶体的血红素酶，把 H2O2 变成水与 O2；glutathione peroxidase 是一种含硒代半胱氨酸的酶，在过氧化物浓度较低时用两个 GSH 做同一件事。

cards.en: Glutathione closes the loop back to the pentose phosphate pathway. It is the tripeptide gamma-Glu-Cys-Gly — the gamma linkage through glutamate's side-chain carboxyl is what makes it resistant to ordinary aminopeptidases — and its cysteine thiol is the working group. Glutathione peroxidase spends two GSH to reduce H2O2 to water, producing the disulfide GSSG. Glutathione reductase, an FAD flavoenzyme, then reduces GSSG back to two GSH at the expense of one NADPH. So every peroxide removed by this route is ultimately paid for by glucose 6-phosphate entering the oxidative branch of the PPP, and a cell's antioxidant capacity is only as large as its NADPH supply.
cards.zh: 谷胱甘肽把这条链路重新接回磷酸戊糖途径。它是三肽 gamma-Glu-Cys-Gly——经谷氨酸侧链羧基形成的 gamma 键正是它能抵抗普通氨肽酶的原因——其半胱氨酸的巯基是发挥作用的基团。glutathione peroxidase 消耗两个 GSH 把 H2O2 还原成水，生成二硫化物 GSSG。随后 glutathione reductase 这个含 FAD 的黄素酶以一个 NADPH 为代价，把 GSSG 还原回两个 GSH。因此，凡是通过这条途径清除的过氧化物，最终都由进入磷酸戊糖途径氧化分支的 glucose 6-phosphate 买单，而一个细胞的抗氧化能力上限，就等于它的 NADPH 供应能力。

cards.en: Photosynthesis is the same machinery run against the gradient. Respiration lets electrons fall from NADH (-0.32 V) to O2 (+0.82 V) and banks the released energy as a proton gradient; the light reactions take electrons from water (the O2/H2O couple, +0.82 V, the worst donor in the scheme) and lift them to ferredoxin, at around -0.4 V, so that NADP+ can be reduced by ferredoxin-NADP+ reductase at photosystem I. That climb is not thermodynamically spontaneous and is paid for by two photons per electron, one at each photosystem — the two vertical jumps of the Z-scheme. The photo-oxidised P680+ formed at photosystem II is a stronger oxidant than O2 itself, which is the only reason a manganese cluster can prise electrons out of water. Note the final acceptor of the light reactions is NADP+, not NAD+: even here the reduced pool is the biosynthetic one, spent by the Calvin cycle.
cards.zh: 光合作用是同一套机器逆着梯度运行。呼吸作用让电子从 NADH（-0.32 V）跌落到 O2（+0.82 V），把释放的能量存成质子梯度；光反应则从水（O2/H2O 电对，+0.82 V，整个体系中最差的供体）取走电子，把它们提升到约 -0.4 V 的 ferredoxin，使 NADP+ 能够在光系统 I 上被 ferredoxin-NADP+ reductase 还原。这个爬升在热力学上并不自发，代价是每个电子两个光子，两个光系统各一个——这就是 Z 型传递的两次纵跳。光系统 II 上生成的光氧化态 P680+ 是比 O2 本身更强的氧化剂，这是锰簇能够从水中撬出电子的唯一原因。注意光反应的最终受体是 NADP+ 而不是 NAD+：即使在这里，被还原的那个池子仍然是用于生物合成的那一个，由 Calvin 循环消费。

quiz.q_en: A hepatocyte is signalled to make fatty acids after a carbohydrate-rich meal, but its pentose phosphate pathway oxidative branch is pharmacologically blocked. What fails, and why can the abundant NADH not stand in?
quiz.q_zh: 一个肝细胞在高糖膳食后被信号指令去合成脂肪酸，但它的磷酸戊糖途径氧化分支被药物阻断了。什么会失败，而丰富的 NADH 为什么顶替不了？

options.en: Elongation stalls at the two reduction steps of fatty acid synthase, whose ketoacyl and enoyl reductase sites carry basic residues that require NADPH's 2'-phosphate; NADH is also held about 700-fold oxidised in cytosol, so little is free to donate.
options.zh: 延长反应停在脂肪酸合酶的两个还原步骤上，其 ketoacyl reductase 与 enoyl reductase 位点带有需要 NADPH 那个 2'-磷酸的碱性残基；而且胞质中的 NADH 被维持在约 700 倍的氧化态，本来就没多少可供给出。

options.en: Synthesis stops at the carboxylation step, because acetyl-CoA carboxylase must reduce bicarbonate with NADPH before its biotin arm can carry the carboxyl group to acetyl-CoA.
options.zh: 合成停在羧化这一步，因为 acetyl-CoA carboxylase 必须先用 NADPH 还原碳酸氢根，其 biotin 臂才能把羧基送给 acetyl-CoA。

options.en: Nothing fails, because malic enzyme and cytosolic isocitrate dehydrogenase together cover the full 14-NADPH requirement of palmitate synthesis in every tissue.
options.zh: 什么都不会失败，因为在所有组织中，malic enzyme 与胞质 isocitrate dehydrogenase 合起来即可满足合成 palmitate 所需的全部 14 个 NADPH。

options.en: Synthesis continues to C16 but yields a trans-unsaturated product, because only the dehydratase step of each cycle draws on pentose phosphate pathway reducing power.
options.zh: 合成仍能进行到 C16 但产物是反式不饱和的，因为每一轮中只有脱水这一步需要动用磷酸戊糖途径提供的还原力。

quiz.explain_en: The two reductions per elongation cycle are strictly NADPH-dependent, and both reasons matter: the binding pocket physically selects the 2'-phosphate, and the cytosolic NAD pool is deliberately held oxidised so that catabolic dehydrogenases keep running. Acetyl-CoA carboxylase uses ATP and biotin to fix CO2 and needs no reducing power at all. Malic enzyme and cytosolic IDH are real but secondary sources that cannot cover 14 NADPH per palmitate in most tissues. And the dehydratase step is a dehydration, not a reduction, so blocking NADPH supply does not produce a trans-unsaturated fatty acid.
quiz.explain_zh: 每一轮延长中的两次还原严格依赖 NADPH，而且两个理由都成立：结合口袋在物理上选择那个 2'-磷酸，而胞质 NAD 池被刻意维持在氧化态，以保证分解代谢的脱氢酶持续运转。acetyl-CoA carboxylase 用 ATP 和 biotin 固定 CO2，完全不需要还原力。malic enzyme 与胞质 IDH 确实是来源，但属次要来源，在多数组织中无法承担每分子 palmitate 所需的 14 个 NADPH。而脱水步骤是脱水而非还原，因此阻断 NADPH 供应并不会产生反式不饱和脂肪酸。

quiz.q_en: Exactly what is the structural difference between NAD+ and NADP+, and where does it sit?
quiz.q_zh: NAD+ 与 NADP+ 之间的结构差异究竟是什么，它位于何处？

options.en: An extra phosphate esterified to C3 of the nicotinamide-bearing ribose, which sterically blocks approach to C4 and slows hydride transfer.
options.zh: 一个额外的磷酸酯化在携带 nicotinamide 的 ribose 的 C3 上，它在空间上阻挡对 C4 的接近，从而减慢 hydride 的转移。

options.en: A third phosphate inserted into the pyrophosphate bridge, lengthening the linker and raising the standard reduction potential of the nicotinamide ring.
options.zh: 在 pyrophosphate 桥中插入第三个磷酸，加长了连接臂并提高了 nicotinamide 环的标准还原电位。

options.en: An extra phosphate esterified to the 2'-hydroxyl of the adenosine ribose, well away from the nicotinamide ring where the chemistry happens.
options.zh: 一个额外的磷酸酯化在 adenosine 那一侧 ribose 的 2'-羟基上，远离真正发生化学反应的 nicotinamide 环。

options.en: An amide replaced by a carboxylate on the pyridine ring, which is what makes the reduced form a stronger reducing agent in biosynthesis.
options.zh: 吡啶环上的酰胺基被羧基取代，正是这一点使还原型成为生物合成中更强的还原剂。

quiz.explain_en: The phosphate sits on the 2'-OH of the adenosine ribose, deliberately far from the reacting nicotinamide C4. Placing it on the nicotinamide ribose or in the pyrophosphate bridge would interfere with the chemistry, which is exactly what evolution avoided; and the standard potential of NADP+/NADPH is essentially the same as NAD+/NADH, about -0.32 V, so no version of this modification changes the intrinsic reducing power. Replacing the amide with a carboxylate would give nicotinic acid, a different compound altogether.
quiz.explain_zh: 这个磷酸位于 adenosine 那一侧 ribose 的 2'-OH 上，刻意远离发生反应的 nicotinamide C4。把它放在 nicotinamide 一侧的 ribose 上或 pyrophosphate 桥中都会干扰化学反应，而进化恰恰避开了这一点；并且 NADP+/NADPH 的标准电位与 NAD+/NADH 基本相同，约为 -0.32 V，所以这种修饰的任何版本都不会改变其内在还原能力。把酰胺换成羧基得到的是 nicotinic acid，那完全是另一种化合物。

quiz.q_en: An NAD-dependent dehydrogenase is engineered into an NADPH-dependent one. Which single change at the Rossmann fold is the classic way to do it, and why does it work?
quiz.q_zh: 要把一个依赖 NAD 的脱氢酶改造成依赖 NADPH 的酶，在 Rossmann 折叠上做哪一处改动是经典做法，为什么它有效？

options.en: Introduce a catalytic histidine next to the nicotinamide C4, since NADPH transfers a proton where NADH transfers a hydride and the extra proton needs a relay.
options.zh: 在 nicotinamide C4 旁引入一个催化性组氨酸，因为 NADPH 转移的是质子而 NADH 转移的是 hydride，多出来的质子需要一个传递站。

options.en: Add a covalent FAD attachment site, so that electrons from NADPH are relayed through flavin before reaching the substrate as they are in succinate dehydrogenase.
options.zh: 加上一个 FAD 共价连接位点，使来自 NADPH 的电子像在 succinate dehydrogenase 中那样先经黄素中转再到达底物。

options.en: Mutate the glycine-rich GXGXXG phosphate-binding loop at the end of the first beta-strand into a proline-rich one, which reorients the entire dinucleotide within the binding cleft and presents the nicotinamide ring to the substrate from its opposite face.
options.zh: 把第一条 beta 链末端富含甘氨酸的 GXGXXG 磷酸结合环改造成富含脯氨酸的环，从而使整个二核苷酸在结合裂隙中重新定向，并让 nicotinamide 环以相反的一面朝向底物。

options.en: Replace the acidic residue at the end of the second beta-strand, which hydrogen-bonds the free 2'- and 3'-hydroxyls of NAD, with an arginine or lysine that salt-bridges the 2'-phosphate.
options.zh: 把第二条 beta 链末端那个酸性残基——它与 NAD 游离的 2'- 和 3'-羟基形成氢键——换成一个能与 2'-磷酸形成盐桥的精氨酸或赖氨酸。

quiz.explain_en: Specificity is electrostatic and local: an Asp or Glu at the C-terminal end of the second beta-strand reads NAD's free 2'-OH and 3'-OH and repels a phosphate, while Arg or Lys in the same position pairs with NADP's 2'-phosphate. Swapping that one residue has repeatedly been enough to invert preference. The GXGXXG loop binds the pyrophosphate of both cofactors and is not the discriminating element. NADPH and NADH transfer chemistry is identical — a hydride to or from C4 — so no proton relay is needed. And a covalent FAD is a feature of succinate dehydrogenase's own chemistry, unrelated to nicotinamide cofactor selection.
quiz.explain_zh: 专一性是静电性的、局部的：第二条 beta 链 C 端的 Asp 或 Glu 读取 NAD 游离的 2'-OH 与 3'-OH，并排斥磷酸；而同一位置上的 Arg 或 Lys 则与 NADP 的 2'-磷酸配对。仅换这一个残基就多次足以颠倒偏好。GXGXXG 环结合的是两种辅因子共有的 pyrophosphate，并不是识别元件。NADPH 与 NADH 的转移化学完全相同——向 C4 给出或从 C4 取走一个 hydride——因此不需要什么质子传递站。而共价连接的 FAD 是 succinate dehydrogenase 自身化学的特点，与 nicotinamide 辅因子的选择无关。

quiz.q_en: The standard reduction potentials of NAD+/NADH and NADP+/NADPH are both about -0.32 V. Given that, how can one pool be an electron sink for catabolism and the other an electron source for biosynthesis?
quiz.q_zh: NAD+/NADH 与 NADP+/NADPH 的标准还原电位都约为 -0.32 V。既然如此，一个池子怎么会是分解代谢的电子受纳者，而另一个是生物合成的电子供体？

options.en: Because NADP+ cannot be reduced by any dehydrogenase and therefore accumulates in the reduced form by default, while NAD+ turns over continuously.
options.zh: 因为 NADP+ 不能被任何脱氢酶还原，因而默认以还原型积累，而 NAD+ 则持续周转。

options.en: Because the mitochondrial inner membrane is permeable to NAD+ but not to NADP+, so compartmentation rather than chemistry sets the two ratios.
options.zh: 因为线粒体内膜对 NAD+ 通透而对 NADP+ 不通透，所以决定这两个比值的是区室化而不是化学性质。

options.en: Because the 2'-phosphate withdraws electron density from the nicotinamide ring and lowers the NADP couple's standard potential by roughly 0.3 V, making NADPH intrinsically the stronger reductant.
options.zh: 因为那个 2'-磷酸从 nicotinamide 环上吸走电子密度，使 NADP 电对的标准电位降低约 0.3 V，从而使 NADPH 本身就是更强的还原剂。

options.en: Because actual potential follows the mass-action ratio through the Nernst equation, and the cell holds NAD largely oxidised and NADP largely reduced using enzymes specific to each pool.
options.zh: 因为实际电位通过 Nernst 方程随质量作用比值而变，细胞用各自专一的酶把 NAD 维持在大部分氧化、把 NADP 维持在大部分还原的状态。

quiz.explain_en: Standard potential is defined at equal concentrations of oxidised and reduced forms; the cell does not operate there. Holding NAD oxidised makes its actual potential more positive (a good acceptor for dehydrogenases), while holding NADP reduced makes its actual potential more negative (a good donor for reductases). NADP+ is readily reduced — by G6PD, 6-phosphogluconate dehydrogenase, malic enzyme and NADP-linked IDH — so it is not passively accumulating. Both nucleotides are effectively confined to their compartments, so permeability does not explain the difference. And the 2'-phosphate is remote from the ring and does not shift the standard potential.
quiz.explain_zh: 标准电位是在氧化型与还原型浓度相等时定义的，而细胞并不工作在那个点上。把 NAD 维持在氧化态使其实际电位更正（对脱氢酶而言是好的受体），把 NADP 维持在还原态使其实际电位更负（对还原酶而言是好的供体）。NADP+ 很容易被还原——由 G6PD、6-phosphogluconate dehydrogenase、malic enzyme 与依赖 NADP 的 IDH 完成——所以它并非被动积累。两种核苷酸实际上都被限制在各自的区室内，所以通透性无法解释这一差别。而那个 2'-磷酸远离环，并不会改变标准电位。

quiz.q_en: Every other dehydrogenase of the citric acid cycle reduces NAD+. Why does succinate dehydrogenase use a covalently bound FAD instead?
quiz.q_zh: 柠檬酸循环中其他每一个脱氢酶都还原 NAD+。为什么 succinate dehydrogenase 偏偏用一个共价结合的 FAD？

options.en: Because the fumarate/succinate couple at about +0.03 V is far too positive to reduce NAD+ at -0.32 V, an uphill step of roughly +68 kJ/mol, whereas the protein-tuned FAD sits near succinate's own potential.
options.zh: 因为 fumarate/succinate 电对约为 +0.03 V，正得太多，无法还原 -0.32 V 的 NAD+，那是一个约 +68 kJ/mol 的上坡步骤；而被蛋白质调节过的 FAD 电位接近 succinate 自身的电位。

options.en: Because the enzyme is embedded in the inner membrane and NAD+ is confined to the intermembrane space, so it never reaches the active site.
options.zh: 因为该酶嵌在内膜上，而 NAD+ 被限制在膜间隙，因此根本到不了活性中心。

options.en: Because a covalent flavin is the only cofactor able to pass electrons to ubiquinone, which is why Complex I must also use FAD at its entry point.
options.zh: 因为共价黄素是唯一能把电子交给 ubiquinone 的辅因子，这也是 Complex I 在其入口处同样必须使用 FAD 的原因。

options.en: Because succinate releases two hydrogen atoms rather than a hydride, and NAD+ is chemically incapable of accepting two hydrogen atoms in any reaction.
options.zh: 因为 succinate 脱下的是两个氢原子而不是一个 hydride，而 NAD+ 在任何反应中都不可能接受两个氢原子。

quiz.explain_en: This is a pure thermodynamic argument: electrons flow to the more positive couple, and succinate's couple is already more positive than NAD+'s, so reducing NAD+ with succinate would be uphill by about 0.35 V, or +68 kJ/mol for two electrons. NAD+ does accept two electrons — as a hydride plus a released proton — so the hydrogen-atom counting argument is not the reason. NAD+ is present in the matrix where the succinate site faces, so access is not the problem. And Complex I's entry flavin is FMN, not FAD, and it receives electrons from NADH rather than being forced on the enzyme by ubiquinone.
quiz.explain_zh: 这是一个纯粹的热力学论证：电子流向更正的电对，而 succinate 的电对已经比 NAD+ 的更正，所以用 succinate 还原 NAD+ 要上坡约 0.35 V，对两个电子而言是 +68 kJ/mol。NAD+ 确实接受两个电子——以一个 hydride 加一个释放的质子的形式——所以数氢原子的说法不是原因。NAD+ 存在于基质中，而 succinate 的结合位点正朝向基质，因此不存在接触不到的问题。而 Complex I 入口处的黄素是 FMN 而不是 FAD，它从 NADH 接受电子，并非被 ubiquinone 强加于该酶。

quiz.q_en: Using DeltaG°' = -nF·DeltaE°' with F = 96.5 kJ per mole per volt, why can Complex I pump protons while Complex II cannot, even though both deliver two electrons to ubiquinone?
quiz.q_zh: 用 DeltaG°' = -nF·DeltaE°'（F = 96.5 kJ·mol⁻¹·V⁻¹）来看，为什么 Complex I 能泵质子而 Complex II 不能，尽管两者都向 ubiquinone 交出两个电子？

options.en: Complex I spans about 0.36 V, releasing roughly 70 kJ/mol, ample for four protons at around 20 kJ/mol each; Complex II spans only about 0.01 V and releases a few kJ/mol.
options.zh: Complex I 跨越约 0.36 V，释放约 70 kJ/mol，足以支付每个约 20 kJ/mol 的四个质子；Complex II 只跨越约 0.01 V，释放区区几 kJ/mol。

options.en: Complex I transfers four electrons per turnover while Complex II transfers two, so it releases twice the free energy over the identical potential span.
options.zh: Complex I 每次周转转移四个电子而 Complex II 转移两个，因此在完全相同的电位跨度上释放两倍的自由能。

options.en: Complex II is the only respiratory complex that does not span the inner membrane but is merely anchored to its matrix-facing surface, so the free energy it releases is entirely real yet has no structural route by which it could reach a proton half-channel.
options.zh: Complex II 是唯一不跨越内膜、而仅仅锚定在内膜面向基质那一侧表面上的呼吸链复合体，所以它在这一步释放出来的自由能完全是真实的，却在结构上没有任何可以抵达质子半通道的路径可走，泵送在这里是拓扑问题而不是能量问题。

options.en: Complex II donates its electrons to cytochrome c rather than to ubiquinone, bypassing the segment of the chain in which pumping occurs.
options.zh: Complex II 把电子交给的是 cytochrome c 而不是 ubiquinone，从而绕过了发生质子泵送的那一段链。

quiz.explain_en: The arithmetic is the whole answer: -2 x 96.5 x 0.36 is about -70 kJ/mol for Complex I, against -2 x 96.5 x 0.01, only a couple of kJ/mol, for Complex II. Both complexes pass two electrons per turnover, so electron count is not the difference. Complex II is indeed anchored in the membrane rather than spanning it, but the reason it does not pump is energetic, not architectural — a complex with 70 kJ/mol available would have evolved a route. And Complex II reduces ubiquinone, exactly as Complex I does; that shared acceptor is what makes the comparison so clean.
quiz.explain_zh: 算术本身就是全部答案：Complex I 是 -2 x 96.5 x 0.36，约 -70 kJ/mol；Complex II 是 -2 x 96.5 x 0.01，只有几 kJ/mol。两个复合体每次周转都传递两个电子，所以电子数不是差别所在。Complex II 确实是锚定在膜上而非跨膜，但它不泵质子的原因是能量学上的而非结构上的——一个手里有 70 kJ/mol 的复合体自会进化出一条通路。而且 Complex II 还原的正是 ubiquinone，与 Complex I 完全一样；正是这个共同的受体使得这一对比如此干净。

quiz.see: L9 · Complex I to Complex IV
quiz.q_en: Which sequence lists respiratory-chain carriers in the order dictated by increasing standard reduction potential?
quiz.q_zh: 下面哪一个序列是按标准还原电位递增的顺序排列呼吸链载体的？

options.en: NADH -> ubiquinone -> the FMN and Fe-S clusters of Complex I -> cytochromes a and a3 -> cytochrome c -> O2
options.zh: NADH -> ubiquinone -> Complex I 的 FMN 与铁硫簇 -> cytochrome a 与 a3 -> cytochrome c -> O2

options.en: NADH -> cytochrome c -> ubiquinone -> the FMN and Fe-S clusters of Complex I -> cytochromes a and a3 -> O2
options.zh: NADH -> cytochrome c -> ubiquinone -> Complex I 的 FMN 与铁硫簇 -> cytochrome a 与 a3 -> O2

options.en: O2 -> cytochromes a and a3 -> cytochrome c -> ubiquinone -> the FMN and Fe-S clusters of Complex I -> NADH
options.zh: O2 -> cytochrome a 与 a3 -> cytochrome c -> ubiquinone -> Complex I 的 FMN 与铁硫簇 -> NADH

options.en: NADH -> the FMN and Fe-S clusters of Complex I -> ubiquinone -> cytochrome c -> cytochromes a and a3 -> O2
options.zh: NADH -> Complex I 的 FMN 与铁硫簇 -> ubiquinone -> cytochrome c -> cytochrome a 与 a3 -> O2

quiz.explain_en: Potentials rise monotonically from NADH at -0.32 V through ubiquinone at about +0.05 V and cytochrome c at about +0.25 V to O2 at +0.82 V, and the physical order of the complexes matches. Putting cytochrome c before ubiquinone, or the Complex I flavin after ubiquinone, would require electrons to run uphill mid-chain. The reversed sequence starting at O2 lists exactly the right carriers in exactly the wrong direction: that is the path of electrons in photosynthesis-like uphill flow, not respiration, and it would need an energy input at every step.
quiz.explain_zh: 电位从 NADH 的 -0.32 V 单调升高，经 ubiquinone 约 +0.05 V、cytochrome c 约 +0.25 V，直到 O2 的 +0.82 V，而各复合体的物理排列顺序与之吻合。把 cytochrome c 排在 ubiquinone 之前，或把 Complex I 的黄素排在 ubiquinone 之后，都会要求电子在链的中途上坡。那个从 O2 开始的倒序把正确的载体排成了完全错误的方向：那是类似光合作用的上坡电子流，不是呼吸作用，而且每一步都需要输入能量。

quiz.q_en: The oxidative branch of the pentose phosphate pathway has three steps. Which of them generate NADPH?
quiz.q_zh: 磷酸戊糖途径的氧化分支有三步。其中哪些步骤产生 NADPH？

options.en: Transketolase and transaldolase, the two steps that rearrange carbon skeletons and release the reducing equivalents as the ring reopens.
options.zh: transketolase 与 transaldolase，这两步重排碳骨架并在开环时释放还原当量。

options.en: Glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase alone, which transfers two hydrides in one turnover and therefore accounts for both NADPH per glucose 6-phosphate.
options.zh: 只有 glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase，它在一次周转中转移两个 hydride，因而独自贡献每分子 glucose 6-phosphate 的两个 NADPH。

options.en: Glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase and 6-phosphogluconate dehydrogenase; the lactonase between them is a hydrolysis and yields none.
options.zh: glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase 与 6-phosphogluconate dehydrogenase；夹在两者之间的内酯酶是一次水解，什么也不产生。

options.en: 6-phosphogluconolactonase and 6-phosphogluconate dehydrogenase; glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase only commits the sugar to the pathway without redox chemistry.
options.zh: 6-phosphogluconolactonase 与 6-phosphogluconate dehydrogenase；glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase 只是把糖定向进入该途径，不涉及氧化还原化学。

quiz.explain_en: G6PD oxidises the C1 aldehyde to a lactone and is the committed, rate-limiting, NADP+-activated step; 6-phosphogluconate dehydrogenase performs an oxidative decarboxylation that releases the CO2 and leaves ribulose 5-phosphate. The lactonase merely opens the ring by hydrolysis, with no change in oxidation state. Transketolase and transaldolase belong to the non-oxidative branch, which is fully reversible and produces no NADPH at all. And no dehydrogenase transfers two hydrides in one turnover — each of the two NADPH comes from a separate enzyme.
quiz.explain_zh: G6PD 把 C1 的醛基氧化成内酯，是关键的定向、限速、受 NADP+ 激活的步骤；6-phosphogluconate dehydrogenase 进行一次氧化脱羧，放出那个 CO2 并留下 ribulose 5-phosphate。内酯酶只是通过水解把环打开，氧化态没有变化。transketolase 与 transaldolase 属于非氧化分支，该分支完全可逆且根本不产生 NADPH。而且没有哪个脱氢酶会在一次周转中转移两个 hydride——那两个 NADPH 分别来自两个不同的酶。

quiz.q_en: A boy develops jaundice and dark urine two days after starting primaquine. Why does the mature red cell suffer while his hepatocytes do not?
quiz.q_zh: 一个男孩在开始服用 primaquine 两天后出现黄疸和酱油色尿。为什么受害的是成熟红细胞而他的肝细胞却没事？

options.en: The red cell has no nucleus and no mitochondria: it cannot resynthesise the unstable variant enzyme, and the pentose phosphate pathway is its only NADPH source for regenerating GSH.
options.zh: 红细胞既无细胞核也无线粒体：它既不能重新合成那个不稳定的变异酶，磷酸戊糖途径又是它再生 GSH 所需 NADPH 的唯一来源。

options.en: Haemoglobin binds primaquine metabolites at the distal histidine of each subunit and is converted to methaemoglobin, a reaction that hepatocyte cytochromes prevent by sequestering the drug before it ever reaches the circulating red cell mass.
options.zh: 血红蛋白在每个亚基的远端组氨酸处结合 primaquine 的代谢物并转变为高铁血红蛋白，而肝细胞的细胞色素通过在药物到达循环中的红细胞群之前就将其扣押，阻止了这一反应。

options.en: Only the red cell expresses glutathione peroxidase, so only it generates the GSSG that a deficient glutathione reductase then fails to reduce back.
options.zh: 只有红细胞表达 glutathione peroxidase，因此只有它会生成 GSSG，而有缺陷的 glutathione reductase 无法把它还原回去。

options.en: The red cell lacks mitochondria, so it cannot run the respiratory chain and dies of ATP starvation once primaquine inhibits Complex III.
options.zh: 红细胞没有线粒体，因此无法运行呼吸链，一旦 primaquine 抑制了 Complex III 就会因 ATP 匮乏而死亡。

quiz.explain_en: Two properties of the mature erythrocyte combine: no nucleus means the short-lived G6PD variant cannot be replaced as the cell ages, and no mitochondria means there is no NADP-linked IDH2 or transhydrogenase to fall back on. Hepatocytes have both alternatives and a continuous supply of fresh enzyme. Primaquine does not inhibit Complex III, and the red cell has no respiratory chain to inhibit; its ATP comes from glycolysis. Methaemoglobin can form during these episodes, but through general oxidant stress, not by drug binding at the distal histidine. And glutathione peroxidase is ubiquitous, while in G6PD deficiency the reductase itself is normal — what is missing is its NADPH substrate.
quiz.explain_zh: 成熟红细胞的两个特性叠加在一起：没有细胞核意味着随着细胞老化，寿命很短的 G6PD 变异体无法被替换；没有线粒体意味着没有依赖 NADP 的 IDH2 或 transhydrogenase 可以退而求其次。肝细胞两条后路都有，而且能持续合成新酶。primaquine 并不抑制 Complex III，红细胞也没有呼吸链可供抑制，它的 ATP 来自糖酵解。高铁血红蛋白在这类发作中确实可能形成，但那是通过整体氧化应激，而不是药物结合在远端组氨酸上。glutathione peroxidase 则普遍存在，而在 G6PD 缺乏症中还原酶本身是正常的——缺的是它的底物 NADPH。

quiz.q_en: What do fava beans, primaquine, dapsone and an intercurrent infection have in common as triggers of haemolysis in G6PD deficiency?
quiz.q_zh: 蚕豆、primaquine、dapsone 与并发感染，作为 G6PD 缺乏症溶血的诱因，它们的共同点是什么？

options.en: Each chelates the iron of haemoglobin and releases it as free Fe(II), which drives Fenton chemistry inside the cell.
options.zh: 每一种都螯合血红蛋白中的铁并把它以游离 Fe(II) 的形式释放出来，从而在细胞内驱动 Fenton 化学反应。

options.en: Each is a direct competitive inhibitor at the glucose 6-phosphate site of the dehydrogenase, so that whatever residual activity the variant enzyme still had is abolished altogether and the oxidative branch of the pathway stops.
options.zh: 每一种都是该脱氢酶 glucose 6-phosphate 结合位点上的直接竞争性抑制剂，使变异酶本来还残存的那点活性被彻底消除，该途径的氧化分支随之停摆。

options.en: Each raises the oxidant load beyond what the cell's NADPH-limited glutathione system can reduce — the defect is in reducing peroxide, not in producing it.
options.zh: 每一种都把氧化负荷提高到超过细胞中受 NADPH 限制的谷胱甘肽系统所能还原的程度——缺陷在于还原过氧化物的能力，而不在于产生过氧化物。

options.en: Each acts as a hapten adsorbed onto the red cell membrane and provokes an antibody-mediated immune haemolysis, which is why the episode is self-limiting once the drug has been cleared and why G6PD-normal cells are spared.
options.zh: 每一种都作为半抗原吸附在红细胞膜上，激发抗体介导的免疫性溶血，这也解释了为什么药物被清除后发作会自行终止，以及为什么 G6PD 正常的细胞得以幸免。

quiz.explain_en: The unifying mechanism is oxidant load exceeding reducing capacity. Fava beans supply divicine and isouramil, which redox-cycle with oxygen; primaquine and dapsone generate redox-cycling metabolites; infection recruits the phagocyte respiratory burst. None of them inhibits G6PD directly — the enzyme is genetically variant, and its residual activity is adequate at baseline, which is why patients are well between episodes. Immune haemolysis is a different mechanism entirely and would not depend on G6PD genotype. And iron chelation is not how any of these agents work.
quiz.explain_zh: 统一的机制是氧化负荷超过了还原能力。蚕豆提供 divicine 与 isouramil，它们与氧发生氧化还原循环；primaquine 与 dapsone 生成参与氧化还原循环的代谢物；感染则调动吞噬细胞的呼吸爆发。它们都不直接抑制 G6PD——该酶是遗传性变异体，其残存活性在基础状态下是够用的，这正是患者在两次发作之间安然无恙的原因。免疫性溶血是完全不同的机制，也不会取决于 G6PD 基因型。而螯合铁并不是这些物质中任何一种的作用方式。

quiz.q_en: Mitochondria need NADPH in the matrix for their own glutathione and thioredoxin systems, yet the matrix is full of NADH. How is that NADPH actually obtained, and what does it cost?
quiz.q_zh: 线粒体基质需要 NADPH 来维持自身的谷胱甘肽与硫氧还蛋白系统，而基质里充满的却是 NADH。这份 NADPH 究竟是怎么得到的，代价是什么？

options.en: A matrix NAD kinase converts NADH directly into NADPH using one ATP, which is why the two mitochondrial pools track each other closely.
options.zh: 基质中的一个 NAD kinase 用一个 ATP 把 NADH 直接转变成 NADPH，这正是线粒体两个池子彼此紧密同步的原因。

options.en: There is no route between the pools; matrix NADPH is imported wholesale from the cytosol through a dedicated inner-membrane carrier.
options.zh: 两个池子之间没有任何通路；基质中的 NADPH 是通过内膜上一个专门的转运蛋白整分子地从胞质输入的。

options.en: Nicotinamide nucleotide transhydrogenase in the inner membrane drives hydride from NADH to NADP+ using the proton-motive force, so it is paid for in ATP not made; NADP-linked IDH2 contributes as well.
options.zh: 内膜上的 nicotinamide nucleotide transhydrogenase 利用质子动力势把 hydride 从 NADH 推给 NADP+，代价是没能生成的 ATP；依赖 NADP 的 IDH2 也有贡献。
