options.en: Complex I runs in reverse under high membrane potential and reduces NADP+ at its flavin site, which is also the main source of matrix superoxide.
options.zh: 在高膜电位下 Complex I 反向运转，在其黄素位点还原 NADP+，这同时也是基质中超氧阴离子的主要来源。

quiz.explain_en: Transhydrogenase is the genuine bridge, and the important point for an exam is that it is not free: it consumes the same proton-motive force that would otherwise turn ATP synthase, so mitochondrial antioxidant defence is bought with ATP forgone. NAD kinase is real but phosphorylates NAD+ to NADP+ — it makes the oxidised cofactor, not the reduced one, and transfers no hydride. Neither nicotinamide nucleotide crosses the inner membrane, so wholesale import is impossible. Complex I can indeed run in reverse and make superoxide, but its nicotinamide site is NADH-specific and this does not supply NADPH.
quiz.explain_zh: transhydrogenase 是真正的桥梁，而应试上重要的一点是它并不免费：它消耗的正是本可以驱动 ATP 合酶的那份质子动力势，所以线粒体的抗氧化防御是用放弃的 ATP 买来的。NAD kinase 确实存在，但它把 NAD+ 磷酸化成 NADP+——生成的是氧化型辅因子而不是还原型，并且不转移任何 hydride。两种 nicotinamide 核苷酸都不能穿过内膜，所以整分子输入是不可能的。Complex I 确实能反向运转并产生超氧阴离子，但它的 nicotinamide 位点对 NADH 专一，这并不提供 NADPH。

quiz.see: L9 · Complex I to Complex IV
quiz.q_en: Where does the respiratory chain leak most of its superoxide, and why is the complex that actually handles oxygen not the main culprit?
quiz.q_zh: 呼吸链的超氧阴离子主要漏在哪里，而真正处理氧气的那个复合体为什么反倒不是主犯？

options.en: At Complex IV, which necessarily releases partially reduced oxygen species into the matrix each time it splits the O-O bond of dioxygen, since its four electrons cannot possibly arrive at the same instant.
options.zh: 在 Complex IV 上，它每次断开 O2 的 O-O 键时都必然向基质释放部分还原的氧物种，因为它需要的四个电子不可能在同一瞬间到达，中间态必定有机会脱离。

options.en: At the proton channel of ATP synthase, where returning protons combine with dissolved oxygen to give hydrogen peroxide directly.
options.zh: 在 ATP 合酶的质子通道处，回流的质子与溶解氧结合直接生成过氧化氢。

options.en: At cytochrome c in the intermembrane space, whose single haem iron autoxidises readily whenever the chain is inhibited downstream of it and the carrier therefore accumulates in the ferrous state.
options.zh: 在膜间隙的 cytochrome c 处，只要它下游的链被抑制、该载体因而以亚铁态积累起来，它那个单一的血红素铁就很容易发生自动氧化。

options.en: At the flavin and quinone sites of Complex I and the Qo semiquinone of Complex III; Complex IV holds its oxygen intermediates bound until all four electrons have been delivered.
options.zh: 在 Complex I 的黄素位点与醌位点，以及 Complex III 的 Qo 半醌处；Complex IV 把氧的中间物一直扣住，直到四个电子全部交付。

quiz.explain_en: Superoxide is made where a one-electron carrier sits long enough in a reduced state to hand a single electron to O2 — the reduced flavin and quinone site of Complex I, and the ubisemiquinone of the Complex III Qo site. Complex IV is the counter-intuitive part: it reduces oxygen all the way to water without releasing intermediates, precisely because its binuclear haem-copper centre stores electrons and keeps the partially reduced species bound. ATP synthase performs no redox chemistry. Cytochrome c does carry a single electron, but its haem iron is buried and autoxidation is not a significant source in the intact chain.
quiz.explain_zh: 超氧阴离子产生于那些以还原态停留足够久、能把单个电子交给 O2 的单电子载体处——Complex I 的还原态黄素与醌位点，以及 Complex III Qo 位点上的泛半醌。Complex IV 才是反直觉的部分：它把氧一路还原到水而不释放中间物，恰恰因为它的双核血红素-铜中心储存电子并把部分还原的物种扣住。ATP 合酶不进行任何氧化还原化学。cytochrome c 确实携带单个电子，但其血红素铁被包埋在内部，在完整的呼吸链中自动氧化并非重要来源。

quiz.q_en: Trace one superoxide molecule generated in the mitochondrial matrix through to a harmless product. Which account is correct?
quiz.q_zh: 追踪一个在线粒体基质中生成的超氧阴离子，直到它变成无害产物。哪一种描述是正确的？

options.en: Superoxide is exported from the matrix to the peroxisome by a dedicated inner-membrane anion carrier, where catalase, needing no cofactor of any kind, converts it directly to water and molecular oxygen at one of the highest turnover numbers in biology.
options.zh: 超氧阴离子由内膜上一个专门的阴离子转运蛋白从基质输出到过氧化物酶体，在那里 catalase 不需要任何辅因子，就以生物学中最高的周转数之一把它直接转化为水与分子氧。

options.en: Catalase reduces superoxide to water using one NADPH for every molecule of radical it handles, and the NADP+ so produced is recycled by the matrix glutathione reductase drawing on electrons from mitochondrial NADH.
options.zh: catalase 每处理一个自由基分子就消耗一个 NADPH 把超氧阴离子直接还原成水，而这样生成出来的 NADP+ 再由基质中的 glutathione reductase 利用来自线粒体 NADH 的电子加以再循环，整个过程不经过过氧化氢这一中间物。

options.en: Superoxide dismutase reduces superoxide using GSH as the electron donor, and the GSSG formed is reduced again by NADPH from the pentose phosphate pathway.
options.zh: superoxide dismutase 以 GSH 作电子供体还原超氧阴离子，生成的 GSSG 再由磷酸戊糖途径来的 NADPH 还原。

options.en: The manganese superoxide dismutase of the matrix disproportionates it to H2O2 and O2; glutathione peroxidase reduces that H2O2 using two GSH, and glutathione reductase restores the GSH at the cost of one NADPH.
options.zh: 基质中的含锰 superoxide dismutase 把它歧化为 H2O2 与 O2；glutathione peroxidase 用两个 GSH 还原 H2O2；glutathione reductase 再以一个 NADPH 为代价恢复 GSH。

quiz.explain_en: The pathway is dismutation followed by peroxide removal followed by NADPH-driven regeneration, and the matrix isoform of the dismutase is the manganese enzyme SOD2. Catalase acts on hydrogen peroxide, never on superoxide, and consumes no NADPH as substrate; it also lives in peroxisomes, not the matrix. Superoxide dismutase is not a glutathione-dependent enzyme: it is a dismutation, oxidising one superoxide while reducing another, requiring no external donor. And superoxide is a short-lived charged radical that is not shuttled between organelles by a carrier.
quiz.explain_zh: 路径是先歧化、再清除过氧化物、最后由 NADPH 驱动再生，而基质中的歧化酶同工酶是含锰的 SOD2。catalase 作用于过氧化氢而绝不作用于超氧阴离子，也不以 NADPH 为底物；而且它位于过氧化物酶体而非基质。superoxide dismutase 不是依赖谷胱甘肽的酶：它进行的是歧化反应，氧化一个超氧阴离子的同时还原另一个，不需要外来的供体。而超氧阴离子是寿命很短的带电自由基，不会由转运蛋白在细胞器之间穿梭。

quiz.q_en: A neutrophil kills an ingested bacterium by deliberately making superoxide. What supplies the electrons, and what does this imply for a patient with G6PD deficiency?
quiz.q_zh: 中性粒细胞通过刻意产生超氧阴离子来杀死吞入的细菌。电子由什么提供，这对一位 G6PD 缺乏症患者意味着什么？

options.en: Catalase is run backwards in the phagosome to convert water and oxygen into peroxide, a reaction driven by the acid pH inside the vesicle.
options.zh: 在吞噬体内 catalase 反向运转，把水和氧变成过氧化物，该反应由囊泡内的酸性 pH 驱动。

options.en: NADPH oxidase transfers electrons from NADPH to O2, drawing on the same pentose phosphate pathway pool that fuels glutathione reductase; severe G6PD deficiency can therefore impair killing as well as antioxidant defence.
options.zh: NADPH oxidase 把电子从 NADPH 转给 O2，动用的正是同一个供给 glutathione reductase 的磷酸戊糖途径池子；因此严重的 G6PD 缺乏既可能损害杀菌，也损害抗氧化防御。

options.en: Glycolytic NADH is oxidised by a membrane flavoprotein, which is why the burst continues normally in G6PD deficiency and only the red cells are affected.
options.zh: 糖酵解产生的 NADH 被一个膜黄素蛋白氧化，这正是为什么在 G6PD 缺乏症中呼吸爆发照常进行、只有红细胞受累。

options.en: The neutrophil's own respiratory chain is uncoupled so that Complex III leaks superoxide into the phagosome, an effect independent of any cytosolic cofactor pool.
options.zh: 中性粒细胞自身的呼吸链被解偶联，使 Complex III 把超氧阴离子漏进吞噬体，这一效应与任何胞质辅因子池无关。

quiz.explain_en: The phagocyte NADPH oxidase is the striking case where reactive oxygen species are the product rather than the accident, and its substrate is the same NADPH the cell uses for defence; a burst of PPP flux accompanies phagocytosis. Loss of the oxidase itself causes chronic granulomatous disease, while severe G6PD deficiency can produce a similar functional defect by starving it. The oxidase is NADPH-specific, so glycolytic NADH cannot substitute. Neutrophils rely heavily on glycolysis and do not use mitochondrial leakage as a weapon. And catalase cannot be driven backwards by pH; its reaction is strongly exergonic in the direction of removing peroxide.
quiz.explain_zh: 吞噬细胞的 NADPH oxidase 是一个引人注目的例子：活性氧在这里是产物而不是事故，而它的底物正是细胞用于防御的那份 NADPH；吞噬过程伴随着磷酸戊糖途径通量的爆发。该氧化酶本身的缺失导致慢性肉芽肿病，而严重的 G6PD 缺乏可以通过断其粮草造成类似的功能缺陷。该氧化酶对 NADPH 专一，所以糖酵解来的 NADH 无法替代。中性粒细胞高度依赖糖酵解，也不会拿线粒体的电子渗漏当武器。而 catalase 不可能被 pH 驱动而反向运转，其反应在清除过氧化物的方向上是强放能的。

quiz.q_en: In respiration electrons fall from NADH to O2. In the light reactions of photosynthesis, what is the direction of flow and what pays for it?
quiz.q_zh: 在呼吸作用中电子从 NADH 跌落到 O2。在光合作用的光反应中，电子流的方向是什么，由什么支付？

options.en: Electrons are lifted uphill from water at +0.82 V to ferredoxin at around -0.4 V and thence to NADP+, paid for by two photons per electron, one absorbed at each photosystem.
options.zh: 电子被从 +0.82 V 的水提升到约 -0.4 V 的 ferredoxin，再交给 NADP+，代价是每个电子两个光子，两个光系统各吸收一个。

options.en: NADPH is the donor and water is the terminal acceptor, which is why oxygen has to be supplied to the chloroplast in the light and released in the dark.
options.zh: NADPH 是供体而水是末端受体，这正是为什么叶绿体必须在光下获得氧、在暗中放出氧。

options.en: Light generates the thylakoid proton gradient directly by warming the membrane and raising its proton permeability, while the NADPH spent by the Calvin cycle is supplied by the chloroplast's own pentose phosphate pathway.
options.zh: 光通过加热类囊体膜、提高其质子通透性来直接产生质子梯度，而 Calvin 循环所消费的 NADPH 则由叶绿体自身的磷酸戊糖途径提供。

options.en: Electrons flow downhill exactly as in respiration, but NADP+ replaces O2 as a thermodynamically superior terminal acceptor, so light is needed only to excite the pigments and the transfer itself requires no energy input.
options.zh: 电子像呼吸作用中一样下坡流动，只是 NADP+ 取代 O2 成为热力学上更优越的末端受体，所以光只是用来激发色素，电子传递本身并不需要输入任何能量。

quiz.explain_en: The whole point of the light reactions is to run electrons against the potential gradient: water is the worst electron donor in the scheme and ferredoxin one of the best, and the climb is powered by absorbed photons in the two vertical jumps of the Z-scheme. Reduction of NADP+ by ferredoxin-NADP+ reductase is the only downhill step at the end. Calling NADP+ a superior acceptor to O2 has the thermodynamics backwards, since O2 has the far more positive potential. Water is the donor, oxidised to O2, not the acceptor. And chloroplasts make their proton gradient by electron transport across the thylakoid membrane, not by heating; the NADPH is made on the spot and spent by the Calvin cycle.
quiz.explain_zh: 光反应的全部意义就在于让电子逆着电位梯度运行：水是整个体系中最差的电子供体，ferredoxin 则是最好的供体之一，这个爬升由 Z 型传递两次纵跳中吸收的光子提供动力。由 ferredoxin-NADP+ reductase 还原 NADP+ 是末尾唯一的下坡步骤。把 NADP+ 说成比 O2 更优越的受体是把热力学弄反了，因为 O2 的电位正得多。水是供体，被氧化成 O2，而不是受体。而叶绿体是靠跨类囊体膜的电子传递而不是靠加热来建立质子梯度的；NADPH 就地生成，由 Calvin 循环消费。

quiz.q_en: Oxidising water to O2 requires a potential more positive than +0.82 V. Which species in the light reactions is strong enough to do it?
quiz.q_zh: 把水氧化成 O2 需要比 +0.82 V 更正的电位。光反应中哪一个物种强到足以做这件事？

options.en: Plastocyanin, the small copper protein that shuttles electrons from the cytochrome b6f complex across to photosystem I through the thylakoid lumen, which is the compartment where oxygen evolution takes place.
options.zh: plastocyanin，那个在类囊体腔中把电子从 cytochrome b6f 复合体摆渡到光系统 I 的小铜蛋白，而放氧化学恰恰就发生在类囊体腔这一侧。

options.en: Photo-oxidised P700+ at photosystem I, which stands at the end of the entire non-cyclic pathway and must therefore be the most strongly oxidising species anywhere in the Z-scheme.
options.zh: 光系统 I 上被光氧化的 P700+，它位于整条非循环途径的末端，因此必定是 Z 型传递中氧化性最强的那个物种。

options.en: Reduced ferredoxin, whose strongly negative potential gives it the largest driving force anywhere in the scheme and lets it push the manganese cluster in the oxidising direction.
options.zh: 还原态的 ferredoxin，其强负电位使它拥有整个体系中最大的驱动力，足以把锰簇一路推向氧化的方向。

options.en: Photo-oxidised P680+ at photosystem II, one of the strongest oxidants known in biology, which pulls electrons from water through the manganese-calcium cluster.
options.zh: 光系统 II 上被光氧化的 P680+，它是生物学中已知最强的氧化剂之一，通过锰钙簇从水中夺取电子。

quiz.explain_en: Charge separation at photosystem II leaves P680+, whose potential exceeds that of the O2/H2O couple; the Mn4CaO5 oxygen-evolving complex accumulates four oxidising equivalents before releasing O2 from two waters. P700+ at photosystem I is far less oxidising and is re-reduced by plastocyanin, not by water. Plastocyanin is a mobile carrier of intermediate potential and cannot touch water. And ferredoxin is at the reducing end of the scheme, around -0.4 V — it is the strongest reductant in the chain, the opposite of what oxidising water requires.
quiz.explain_zh: 光系统 II 上的电荷分离留下 P680+，其电位超过 O2/H2O 电对；Mn4CaO5 放氧复合体先积累四个氧化当量，再从两分子水中放出 O2。光系统 I 上的 P700+ 氧化能力弱得多，而且是由 plastocyanin 而不是由水来再还原的。plastocyanin 是电位居中的可移动载体，根本碰不了水。而 ferredoxin 位于整个体系的还原端，约 -0.4 V——它是链中最强的还原剂，与氧化水所需的条件正好相反。

quiz.q_en: DNP is added to isolated mitochondria. Besides collapsing ATP synthesis, what happens to the matrix NADPH-dependent antioxidant system, and why?
quiz.q_zh: 向分离的线粒体中加入 DNP。除了使 ATP 合成崩溃之外，基质中依赖 NADPH 的抗氧化系统会怎样，为什么？

options.en: It is unaffected, because matrix NADPH comes entirely from the cytosolic pentose phosphate pathway and is imported across the inner membrane by a carrier that runs on the concentration gradient alone, so an uncoupler that touches only proton flux cannot reach it.
options.zh: 不受影响，因为基质中的 NADPH 全部来自胞质中磷酸戊糖途径的氧化分支，并由内膜上一个仅仅依靠自身浓度梯度工作、与膜电位毫无关系的专门转运蛋白整分子地输入进来，所以一个只作用于质子流动、并不改变浓度梯度的解偶联剂，根本触及不到这条供应路线。

options.en: It is strengthened, because uncoupling accelerates electron transport and the faster flux through Complex I regenerates NADPH at its flavin site.
options.zh: 反而增强，因为解偶联加速了电子传递，通过 Complex I 的更快通量会在其黄素位点再生 NADPH。

options.en: Transhydrogenase loses the proton-motive force that drives it and can even run backwards, so NADPH supply to glutathione and thioredoxin reductases falls just as respiration is running at maximum rate.
options.zh: transhydrogenase 失去了驱动它的质子动力势，甚至可能反向运转，于是恰在呼吸以最大速率运行之时，供给 glutathione reductase 与 thioredoxin reductase 的 NADPH 反而下降。

options.en: It is unaffected, because DNP acts on ATP synthase itself rather than on the lipid bilayer, leaving the proton gradient across the inner membrane fully intact and still available to every gradient-driven transporter sitting in it.
options.zh: 不受影响，因为 DNP 作用的对象是 ATP 合酶本身而不是脂双层，内膜两侧的质子电化学梯度完全保持不变，仍然可以供膜上每一个依赖该梯度工作的转运蛋白照常使用。

quiz.explain_en: Transhydrogenase is a proton-motive-force-driven pump, so an uncoupler removes its driving force and can reverse it, draining matrix NADPH. This is the practical significance of knowing that the mitochondrial NADPH supply is gradient-dependent. Neither NADPH nor NADH crosses the inner membrane, so cytosolic supply cannot make up the shortfall. Complex I's nicotinamide site handles NADH, not NADPH, and faster flux there produces no NADPH. And DNP is a protonophore that dissipates the gradient; the inhibitor that acts on ATP synthase itself is oligomycin, which does the opposite by preserving the gradient.
quiz.explain_zh: transhydrogenase 是一个由质子动力势驱动的泵，所以解偶联剂夺走它的驱动力，甚至可使其反转，抽干基质中的 NADPH。这正是「线粒体 NADPH 供应依赖梯度」这一知识的实际意义。NADPH 与 NADH 都不能穿过内膜，因此胞质的供应无法弥补这一缺口。Complex I 的 nicotinamide 位点处理的是 NADH 而不是 NADPH，那里通量再快也产不出 NADPH。而 DNP 是质子载体，会耗散梯度；真正作用于 ATP 合酶本身的抑制剂是 oligomycin，它的效果恰恰相反，会保住梯度。

quiz.q_en: The lecture mentions that there are two kinds of isocitrate dehydrogenase. What distinguishes them functionally?
quiz.q_zh: 课上提到 isocitrate dehydrogenase 有两种。它们在功能上的区别是什么？

options.en: The cytosolic NADP-linked enzyme performs the citric acid cycle step after isocitrate has been exported by the tricarboxylate carrier, while the mitochondrial NAD-linked form serves purely as an anaplerotic reaction topping up the cycle.
options.zh: 胞质中依赖 NADP 的酶在 isocitrate 经三羧酸转运蛋白输出之后才执行柠檬酸循环的那一步，而线粒体中依赖 NAD 的形式纯粹充当一个填补循环的回补反应。

options.en: The NAD-linked mitochondrial enzyme carries out the citric acid cycle step and is allosterically regulated; the NADP-linked enzymes are a source of NADPH for biosynthesis and defence rather than cycle steps.
options.zh: 依赖 NAD 的线粒体酶执行柠檬酸循环的那一步并受别构调节；依赖 NADP 的那些酶则是为生物合成与防御提供 NADPH 的来源，而不是循环的步骤。

options.en: Both are NAD-linked, but one decarboxylates isocitrate all the way to alpha-ketoglutarate while the other merely dehydrogenates it and releases oxalosuccinate as a free product, which a separate cytosolic decarboxylase then has to handle.
options.zh: 两者都依赖 NAD，但其中一个把 isocitrate 一直脱羧到 alpha-ketoglutarate，另一个只对它脱氢并把 oxalosuccinate 作为游离产物放出，再由另一个胞质脱羧酶来收拾。

options.en: Both are NADP-linked, and the difference is that only the cytosolic form releases the lost carbon as free CO2, whereas the mitochondrial form keeps that carbon inside the cycle as part of the alpha-ketoglutarate skeleton.
options.zh: 两者都依赖 NADP，区别在于只有胞质型把丢掉的那个碳以游离 CO2 放出，而线粒体型则把那个碳作为 alpha-ketoglutarate 骨架的一部分保留在循环之内。

quiz.explain_en: The NAD-linked enzyme (IDH3) is the cycle's rate-influencing oxidative decarboxylation, activated by ADP and inhibited by ATP and NADH; the NADP-linked enzymes, cytosolic IDH1 and mitochondrial IDH2, run the same chemistry but exist to supply NADPH, which is why IDH2 matters for mitochondrial glutathione. Both forms are oxidative decarboxylases, so the idea that one stops at oxalosuccinate as a released product is wrong — oxalosuccinate is a transient enzyme-bound intermediate. And the cycle step happens in the matrix, so no cytosolic enzyme performs it and the mitochondrial NAD-linked reaction is a cycle step, not anaplerosis.
quiz.explain_zh: 依赖 NAD 的那个酶（IDH3）是循环中影响速率的氧化脱羧步骤，受 ADP 激活、受 ATP 与 NADH 抑制；依赖 NADP 的那些酶，即胞质的 IDH1 与线粒体的 IDH2，进行相同的化学反应，但其存在是为了供给 NADPH，这也是 IDH2 对线粒体谷胱甘肽系统重要的原因。两种形式都是氧化脱羧酶，所以「其中一个停在 oxalosuccinate 并把它作为产物释放」的说法是错的——oxalosuccinate 是短暂的酶结合中间物。而循环的这一步发生在基质中，所以没有哪个胞质酶执行它，线粒体中依赖 NAD 的那个反应正是循环步骤而非回补反应。

quiz.q_en: The citrate shuttle carries acetyl units out of the mitochondrion for fatty acid synthesis. What else does it accomplish on the return leg?
quiz.q_zh: 柠檬酸穿梭把乙酰基单位运出线粒体供脂肪酸合成使用。它在返程上还完成了什么？

options.en: It converts part of the cytosolic NADH into NADPH: oxaloacetate from ATP-citrate lyase is reduced to malate by NADH, and malic enzyme then oxidatively decarboxylates malate to pyruvate with NADP+.
options.zh: 它把一部分胞质 NADH 转换成 NADPH：由 ATP-citrate lyase 产生的 oxaloacetate 被 NADH 还原为 malate，随后 malic enzyme 用 NADP+ 把 malate 氧化脱羧为 pyruvate。

options.en: It exports GSSG from the matrix so that cytosolic glutathione reductase can regenerate GSH at the expense of pentose phosphate pathway NADPH.
options.zh: 它把 GSSG 从基质输出，使胞质的 glutathione reductase 能够消耗磷酸戊糖途径的 NADPH 来再生 GSH。

options.en: It returns free carnitine to the matrix, which is what allows the carnitine shuttle to keep importing acyl groups during active lipogenesis.
options.zh: 它把游离肉碱送回基质，正是这一点使肉碱穿梭能在活跃的脂肪合成期间持续输入脂酰基。

options.en: It carries reduced coenzyme Q into the cytosol, where a soluble oxidase regenerates the ubiquinone needed by cytosolic dehydrogenases.
options.zh: 它把还原型辅酶 Q 带入胞质，在那里一个可溶性氧化酶再生胞质脱氢酶所需的 ubiquinone。

quiz.explain_en: The return leg is a neat piece of redox accounting: cytosolic malate dehydrogenase spends an NADH, malic enzyme produces an NADPH, and the net effect is that reducing equivalents arrive in the currency fatty acid synthase can actually use, while the carbon returns as pyruvate. Coenzyme Q is a lipid-soluble carrier confined to the inner membrane and is not shuttled. Glutathione export is unrelated to citrate. And the carnitine shuttle serves beta-oxidation, which is suppressed during lipogenesis because malonyl-CoA inhibits carnitine acyltransferase I.
quiz.explain_zh: 返程是一段漂亮的氧化还原记账：胞质 malate dehydrogenase 花掉一个 NADH，malic enzyme 产出一个 NADPH，净效果是还原当量以脂肪酸合酶真正能用的货币形式抵达，而碳则以 pyruvate 的形式返回。辅酶 Q 是局限于内膜的脂溶性载体，不会被穿梭运输。谷胱甘肽的输出与柠檬酸无关。而肉碱穿梭服务于 beta-氧化，在脂肪合成期间它是被抑制的，因为 malonyl-CoA 抑制 carnitine acyltransferase I。

quiz.q_en: Ribonucleotide reductase reduces the 2'-OH of a ribonucleoside diphosphate. Where do the electrons ultimately come from?
quiz.q_zh: ribonucleotide reductase 还原核糖核苷二磷酸的 2'-OH。这些电子最终来自哪里？

options.en: From NADPH, by way of thioredoxin reductase and thioredoxin (or glutaredoxin and glutathione), which regenerate the enzyme's active-site dithiol.
options.zh: 来自 NADPH，经 thioredoxin reductase 与 thioredoxin（或 glutaredoxin 与谷胱甘肽）传递，从而使该酶活性中心的二硫醇再生。

options.en: From NADH, delivered through the same cytochrome b5 system that serves the endoplasmic reticulum desaturases.
options.zh: 来自 NADH，经由服务于内质网去饱和酶的同一个 cytochrome b5 系统传递。

options.en: From FADH2 generated by succinate dehydrogenase, which is why the reaction is confined to cells with an active citric acid cycle.
options.zh: 来自 succinate dehydrogenase 生成的 FADH2，这就是该反应只限于具有活跃柠檬酸循环的细胞的原因。

options.en: From the tyrosyl radical of the enzyme's own R2 subunit, which is consumed stoichiometrically and then rebuilt from molecular oxygen and the di-iron centre at every turnover.
options.zh: 来自该酶自身 R2 亚基上的那个酪氨酰自由基，它按化学计量被消耗掉，并在每一次周转时都重新利用分子氧与双核铁中心把自己建立起来，因此这个还原反应完全不需要来自任何辅因子池的外部还原当量。

quiz.explain_en: Each turnover leaves a disulfide at the active site, and it is reduced by thioredoxin, which is in turn reduced by the flavoenzyme thioredoxin reductase at the expense of NADPH; the glutaredoxin route also traces back to NADPH through glutathione reductase. So making DNA precursors competes for the same pool as antioxidant defence and lipid synthesis. The cytochrome b5 system serves desaturation, not ribonucleotide reduction. Succinate-derived FADH2 goes to ubiquinone in the membrane and is not a cytosolic reductant. And the tyrosyl radical is a catalytic radical initiator that is regenerated, not the stoichiometric source of the two electrons.
quiz.explain_zh: 每次周转都会在活性中心留下一个二硫键，它由 thioredoxin 还原，而 thioredoxin 又由黄素酶 thioredoxin reductase 以 NADPH 为代价还原；glutaredoxin 那条路线也经 glutathione reductase 追溯回 NADPH。所以合成 DNA 前体与抗氧化防御、脂质合成争夺的是同一个池子。cytochrome b5 系统服务于去饱和作用，而不是核苷酸还原。来自 succinate 的 FADH2 在膜内交给 ubiquinone，不是胞质中的还原剂。而酪氨酰自由基是会被再生的催化性自由基引发剂，并不是那两个电子按化学计量的来源。

quiz.q_en: You are given an unfamiliar enzyme and told only that it removes two hydrogens from its substrate in a catabolic pathway. Which cofactor should you predict, and on what reasoning?
quiz.q_zh: 给你一个不熟悉的酶，只告诉你它在一条分解代谢途径中从底物上脱去两个氢。你应该预测哪种辅因子，依据是什么？

options.en: It cannot be predicted at all, because the choice between the two nicotinamide cofactors is a historical accident of each enzyme family, fixed early in evolution and carrying no metabolic logic a student could reason from.
options.zh: 根本无法预测，因为在两种 nicotinamide 辅因子之间的选择只是各个酶家族的历史偶然，在进化早期就已固定，背后没有任何学生可以据以推理的代谢逻辑。

options.en: NADPH, because reduced cofactors are always the more abundant form inside a living cell, and a dehydrogenase will simply bind whichever nicotinamide nucleotide happens to be present at the higher concentration in that compartment.
options.zh: NADPH，因为在活细胞内还原型辅因子总是较丰富的那一种形式，而脱氢酶只会去结合该区室中恰好浓度较高的那种 nicotinamide 核苷酸。

options.en: NAD+, because the cytosolic and mitochondrial NAD pools are held oxidised precisely so that catabolic dehydrogenases have an acceptor available; NADP is held reduced and serves reductive steps.
options.zh: NAD+，因为胞质与线粒体的 NAD 池被维持在氧化态，正是为了让分解代谢的脱氢酶随时有受体可用；NADP 被维持在还原态，服务于还原性步骤。

options.en: FAD in every case, because removing two hydrogens rather than a hydride is chemically possible only for flavins.
options.zh: 任何情况下都是 FAD，因为脱去两个氢而不是一个 hydride 在化学上只有黄素才能做到。

quiz.explain_en: Direction is the heuristic: oxidations in catabolism take NAD+, reductions in biosynthesis give up NADPH, and the reason is the ratio each pool is held at rather than any difference in chemistry. Predicting NADPH on grounds of abundance inverts the logic, since NAD is deliberately kept oxidised and is the abundant acceptor. Flavins do handle two hydrogens and are used where the substrate couple is too positive for NAD+ — succinate dehydrogenase and acyl-CoA dehydrogenase — but that is a special case, not the rule for all two-hydrogen removals. And the choice is anything but arbitrary: it is what keeps catabolic and biosynthetic fluxes thermodynamically independent of each other.
quiz.explain_zh: 方向就是判断依据：分解代谢中的氧化反应用 NAD+，生物合成中的还原反应交出 NADPH，其原因在于每个池子被维持的比例，而非化学性质上的任何差异。以「丰度」为理由预测 NADPH 是把逻辑弄反了，因为 NAD 是被刻意维持在氧化态的、丰富的那个受体。黄素确实处理两个氢，用在底物电对对 NAD+ 而言过正的场合——succinate dehydrogenase 与 acyl-CoA dehydrogenase——但那是特例，不是所有脱两个氢反应的通则。而这一选择绝非任意：正是它使分解代谢与生物合成的通量在热力学上彼此独立。

sections.title_en: Where the biochemistry shows up — enzyme defects, poisons and drugs
sections.title_zh: 生化在哪里露面——酶缺陷、毒物与药物
sections.blurb_en: Every entry here is a lever on a pathway the course already taught: name the enzyme, name the step, say what piles up upstream and what is missing downstream, and the clinical picture follows from exactly that.
sections.blurb_zh: 这一节里的每一条，都是作用在课程已经讲过的某条通路上的一个「把手」：说出酶、说出那一步、说出上游堆什么、下游缺什么，临床表现就正好从这里推出来。

cards.en: G6PD is the first and committed step of the oxidative branch of the pentose phosphate pathway, and its product is NADPH. NADPH is what glutathione reductase uses to turn GSSG back into two GSH, and GSH is what glutathione peroxidase spends to destroy H2O2. A mature red cell has no nucleus and no mitochondria, so the PPP is its only NADPH source and there is no backup. When G6PD activity is low and an oxidant load arrives — fava beans, an oxidising drug, an infection — the GSH pool is not regenerated, haemoglobin is oxidised and precipitates as Heinz bodies, the membrane is damaged, and the cell haemolyses. The defect is in the supply of reducing power, not in oxygen transport.
cards.zh: G6PD 是磷酸戊糖途径氧化支路的第一步、也是关键步骤，产物是 NADPH。NADPH 供谷胱甘肽还原酶把 GSSG 变回两分子 GSH，而 GSH 又被谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶消耗掉去清除 H2O2。成熟红细胞没有细胞核也没有线粒体，PPP 是它唯一的 NADPH 来源，没有任何备份。当 G6PD 活性低、又遇上氧化负荷——蚕豆、具氧化性的药物、感染——GSH 池补不回来，血红蛋白被氧化并沉淀成 Heinz 小体，膜受损，细胞溶血。缺陷在还原力的供应上，不在氧的运输上。

cards.en: NADPH and NADH differ by one phosphate and are used for opposite purposes, and almost every deficiency in this section is a failure on one side or the other. NADH is catabolic currency: made by GAPDH, the PDH complex, three TCA dehydrogenases and β-oxidation, and spent at Complex I. NADPH is reductive-biosynthetic and antioxidant currency: made by the PPP oxidative branch and the malic enzyme, and spent on fatty-acid synthesis, cholesterol synthesis at HMG-CoA reductase, and glutathione reductase. This is why G6PD deficiency shows up as haemolysis and not as an energy failure — ATP production never depended on that branch.
cards.zh: NADPH 与 NADH 只差一个磷酸，用途却相反，而这一节里几乎每个缺陷都是其中一侧掉链子。NADH 是分解代谢的通货：由 GAPDH、丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体、TCA 里三个脱氢酶和 β-氧化生成，在复合体 I 处花掉。NADPH 是还原性合成与抗氧化的通货：由 PPP 氧化支路和苹果酸酶生成，花在脂肪酸合成、HMG-CoA 还原酶那一步的胆固醇合成、以及谷胱甘肽还原酶上。这就是为什么 G6PD 缺乏表现为溶血而不是能量衰竭——产 ATP 本来就不依赖这条支路。

cards.en: Phenylketonuria is a defect of phenylalanine hydroxylase, the enzyme that puts a hydroxyl on the ring of phenylalanine to give tyrosine, using O2 and the cofactor tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4). Two things follow from the one block. Upstream, phenylalanine accumulates and is pushed into a normally minor route — transamination to phenylpyruvate, which is what appears in the urine and gives the disease its name. Downstream, tyrosine can no longer be made from phenylalanine, so a normally non-essential amino acid becomes dietarily essential. A smaller group of patients have normal hydroxylase but cannot make or recycle BH4, which is the standard reason to check the cofactor as well as the enzyme.
cards.zh: 苯丙酮尿症是苯丙氨酸羟化酶的缺陷。这个酶用 O2 和辅因子四氢生物蝶呤（BH4）在苯丙氨酸的苯环上加一个羟基，生成酪氨酸。一处阻断带来两个后果。上游：苯丙氨酸堆积，被挤进平时很次要的一条路——转氨生成苯丙酮酸，这就是尿里出现、并给这个病命名的那个化合物。下游：酪氨酸不能再从苯丙氨酸做出来，于是一个本来的非必需氨基酸变成了膳食必需氨基酸。还有一小部分病人羟化酶本身正常，却不能合成或再生 BH4，这正是要连辅因子一起查、而不只查酶的原因。

cards.en: Three urinary findings from three different lectures are routinely run together, and they share nothing but the syllable. Phenylketonuria: phenylpyruvate in the urine, from a block at phenylalanine hydroxylase — an inborn error of one amino acid. Diabetic ketoacidosis: acetoacetate, β-hydroxybutyrate and acetone, made in liver mitochondria by the HMG-CoA route when fat mobilisation floods the matrix with acetyl-CoA and oxaloacetate has been drained into gluconeogenesis — a fuel-partitioning problem, not an enzyme defect. Uraemia: urea and other nitrogenous waste retained because the kidney cannot clear them — the urea cycle itself is working. Different molecule, different step, different lecture.
cards.zh: 有三个尿里的发现来自三讲不同的内容，常被混成一团，其实除了字面相近毫无关系。苯丙酮尿症：尿中是苯丙酮酸，来自苯丙氨酸羟化酶这一步的阻断——某一个氨基酸的先天代谢缺陷。糖尿病酮症酸中毒：是乙酰乙酸、β-羟丁酸和丙酮，在肝线粒体经 HMG-CoA 路线生成，因为脂肪动员让基质里灌满乙酰CoA，同时草酰乙酸被抽去做糖异生——这是燃料分配问题，不是酶缺陷。尿毒症：是尿素等含氮废物因肾脏清除不了而潴留——尿素循环本身是好的。分子不同、步骤不同、讲次也不同。

cards.en: MCAD deficiency sits at the first of the four β-oxidation steps — the FAD-dependent dehydrogenation of acyl-CoA to trans-Δ2-enoyl-CoA — in the isoform that handles medium chains. Long chains are shortened normally until the chain reaches roughly C10, and then the spiral stalls, so C6–C10 acyl groups accumulate and leave as acylcarnitines. Fed, the child is well. Fasting, two supplies fail at once: the acetyl-CoA that should have fed the TCA cycle and the hepatic HMG-CoA route, and the NADH and FADH2 that pay for gluconeogenesis. The classic picture is a fast that ends in hypoglycaemia with ketones far lower than the length of the fast would predict.
cards.zh: MCAD 缺乏落在 β-氧化四步中的第一步——依赖 FAD 把脂酰CoA 脱氢生成反式-Δ²-烯脂酰CoA——出问题的是负责中链的那个同工酶。长链能正常缩短到大约 C10，然后这个螺旋就卡住，于是 C6–C10 的酰基堆积，以酰基肉碱的形式排出。进食状态下孩子完全正常。禁食时两路供应同时中断：本该进 TCA 循环、也本该供肝内 HMG-CoA 路线的乙酰CoA，以及为糖异生买单的 NADH 与 FADH2。典型表现就是一次禁食后出现低血糖，而酮体水平远低于这个禁食时长应有的程度。

cards.en: Ornithine transcarbamylase is the second step of the urea cycle, in the mitochondrial matrix: it hands the carbamoyl group from carbamoyl phosphate onto ornithine to give citrulline. Lose it and two things appear together. Nitrogen cannot be committed to urea, so ammonia rises. And carbamoyl phosphate, still being made by CPS-1 upstream, accumulates in the matrix, escapes to the cytosol, and is picked up by the pyrimidine pathway — which normally gets its own carbamoyl phosphate from CPS-2 — and driven on to orotate. Hyperammonaemia plus orotic aciduria is therefore a statement about which side of the mitochondrial membrane the block sits on.
cards.zh: 鸟氨酸氨甲酰转移酶是尿素循环的第二步，位于线粒体基质：它把氨甲酰磷酸上的氨甲酰基交给鸟氨酸，生成瓜氨酸。这个酶一丢，两件事同时出现。氮不能被送进尿素这条路，于是血氨升高。同时，上游 CPS-1 仍在不停生产的氨甲酰磷酸在基质里堆积、漏到胞质，被嘧啶合成途径接手——这条途径平时用的是 CPS-2 自己产的氨甲酰磷酸——一路推到乳清酸。所以「高氨血症 + 乳清酸尿」这个组合，说的其实是阻断点位于线粒体膜的哪一侧。

cards.en: The two carbamoyl phosphate synthetases are the cleanest compartment contrast in the nucleotide chapter. CPS-1: mitochondrial matrix, takes its nitrogen from free ammonia, requires N-acetylglutamate as an obligatory allosteric activator, and opens the urea cycle. CPS-2: cytosolic, takes its nitrogen from the amide of glutamine, needs no N-acetylglutamate, and is the committed and regulated step of pyrimidine ring synthesis. They make the same molecule in two places for two purposes, which is precisely why a matrix block can spill product into the cytosolic pathway.
cards.zh: 两个氨甲酰磷酸合成酶是核苷酸这一章里最干净的一组区室对比。CPS-1：线粒体基质，氮来自游离氨，必须有 N-乙酰谷氨酸作为别构激活剂，开启尿素循环。CPS-2：胞质，氮来自谷氨酰胺的酰胺基，不需要 N-乙酰谷氨酸，是嘧啶环合成的关键调控步骤。同一个分子在两个地方为两个目的而造——这也正是为什么基质里的阻断能把产物溢流进胞质那条路。

cards.en: Lesch–Nyhan syndrome is the loss of HGPRT, the salvage enzyme that takes hypoxanthine or guanine and PRPP and makes IMP or GMP in a single step. Two consequences push urate up together. The bases that cannot be salvaged go straight on to xanthine oxidase and out as uric acid. And PRPP, no longer consumed by salvage, accumulates and drives the de novo pathway harder, so more purine is made only to be degraded. Hyperuricaemia in a young child, with a severe neurological picture, is the classic presentation, and it shows that salvage is not a minor economy but the main route in some tissues, brain included.
cards.zh: Lesch–Nyhan 综合征是 HGPRT 的缺失。这个补救酶把次黄嘌呤或鸟嘌呤与 PRPP 一步合成 IMP 或 GMP。缺了它，有两条路同时把尿酸推高。补救不了的碱基直接交给黄嘌呤氧化酶，变成尿酸排掉；同时 PRPP 因为不再被补救途径消耗而堆积，反过来把从头合成推得更快，于是造出更多嘌呤、只为了再降解掉。幼儿期出现高尿酸血症并伴严重神经系统表现，是它的经典面貌，也说明补救途径不是可有可无的节约手段，在包括脑在内的一些组织里它才是主路。

cards.en: Glucose-6-phosphatase is the last of the four gluconeogenic bypasses and it lives in the ER lumen of liver, kidney and intestine only. Muscle does not have it. That single absence explains two separate exam points. Muscle glycogen can never raise blood glucose, because the G6P released from it is charged and trapped inside the fibre — muscle exports carbon as lactate for the Cori cycle or as alanine instead. And in von Gierke disease, where the liver enzyme is missing, glycogen and gluconeogenic substrate are both present but neither can leave as free glucose: fasting hypoglycaemia with an enlarged liver, and lactate and urate pushed up because the trapped G6P is diverted into glycolysis and the PPP.
cards.zh: 葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶是糖异生四个绕行步骤中的最后一个，只存在于肝、肾和肠的内质网腔内。肌肉没有这个酶。仅此一项缺席就解释了两个考点。肌糖原永远抬不高血糖，因为分解出的 G6P 带电、被锁在肌纤维内——肌肉只能以乳酸（走 Cori 循环）或丙氨酸的形式把碳输出去。而在 von Gierke 病里，肝脏的这个酶缺失，糖原和糖异生底物都在，却都不能以游离葡萄糖的形式出去：表现为禁食低血糖伴肝大，同时乳酸和尿酸升高，因为被困住的 G6P 被分流进糖酵解和磷酸戊糖途径。

cards.en: The red cell has no mitochondria, so glycolysis is its entire ATP supply and a glycolytic enzyme defect is a haemolytic disease. Pyruvate kinase deficiency blocks the last ATP-yielding step, so intermediates pile up above it — including 2,3-BPG, which binds in the central cavity of deoxyhaemoglobin, stabilises the T state and shifts the oxygen curve right, so these patients unload oxygen unusually well for their haemoglobin level. Hexokinase deficiency blocks the very first step instead, so nothing accumulates behind it, 2,3-BPG falls, and the curve shifts left. Same tissue, same pathway, opposite effect on oxygen delivery, decided entirely by where in the line the block sits.
cards.zh: 红细胞没有线粒体，糖酵解就是它 ATP 的全部来源，所以糖酵解酶的缺陷就是溶血性疾病。丙酮酸激酶缺乏阻断最后一个产 ATP 的步骤，中间产物在它上游堆积——其中包括 2,3-BPG，它结合在脱氧血红蛋白的中央空腔里，稳定 T 态，把氧解离曲线右移，因此这类病人在同样血红蛋白水平下卸氧反而格外好。己糖激酶缺乏阻断的是最开头那一步，后面没有东西可堆，2,3-BPG 下降，曲线左移。同一组织、同一条通路，对供氧的影响却相反，完全取决于阻断落在这条线的什么位置。

cards.en: β-oxidation attacks the β carbon: dehydrogenate, hydrate, dehydrogenate again, then cleave. Phytanic acid, from the chlorophyll side chain in the diet, carries a methyl branch on that very carbon, so the chemistry cannot start. This is what peroxisomal α-oxidation is for — it removes one carbon from the carboxyl end so the branch now sits on the α carbon and ordinary β-oxidation can proceed. Refsum disease is loss of that α-oxidation step: phytanic acid accumulates in membranes and nervous tissue, giving retinitis pigmentosa, peripheral neuropathy and ataxia. It is the clearest illustration of why the course's brief mention of α-oxidation is there at all.
cards.zh: β-氧化攻击的是 β 碳：脱氢、水合、再脱氢、然后裂解。植烷酸来自膳食中叶绿素的侧链，恰好在这个碳上带一个甲基分支，所以这套化学根本启动不了。过氧化物酶体的 α-氧化就是为此存在的——它从羧基端先切掉一个碳，使分支落到 α 碳上，随后普通的 β-氧化就能进行。Refsum 病就是这一步 α-氧化的缺失：植烷酸在膜和神经组织中蓄积，表现为视网膜色素变性、周围神经病和共济失调。它最清楚地说明了课上那句一带而过的 α-氧化究竟为什么存在。

cards.en: The respiratory chain has one lever per station, and knowing which station tells you the whole redox pattern. Rotenone blocks Complex I; antimycin A blocks Complex III at the Qi site; cyanide, azide and carbon monoxide block Complex IV; oligomycin plugs the FO proton channel of ATP synthase; DNP and FCCP carry protons across the inner membrane and uncouple. The rule for a blocker: everything upstream of the block stays reduced, everything downstream is oxidised. The rule for the two ATP-side agents is what separates them: an uncoupler makes oxygen consumption rise while ATP falls, whereas oligomycin makes both fall — and an uncoupler added after oligomycin restores respiration, while one added after antimycin A does nothing.
cards.zh: 呼吸链上每一站都有一个「把手」，知道是哪一站，整个氧化还原格局就出来了。鱼藤酮阻断复合体 I；抗霉素 A 阻断复合体 III 的 Qi 位点；氰化物、叠氮和 CO 阻断复合体 IV；寡霉素堵住 ATP 合酶的 FO 质子通道；DNP 与 FCCP 携带质子跨过内膜，起解偶联作用。阻断剂的规律：阻断点上游全部保持还原态，下游全部被氧化。而区分 ATP 一侧那两个试剂的，正是下面这条：解偶联剂让耗氧升高而 ATP 下降，寡霉素则让两者一起下降——并且在寡霉素之后加解偶联剂能恢复呼吸，在抗霉素 A 之后加则毫无作用。

cards.en: Cyanide and carbon monoxide are taught together but they act on different proteins and on iron in different oxidation states. Cyanide binds the ferric (Fe3+) iron of haem a3 in the binuclear centre of Complex IV, stopping the reduction of O2 to water — electron transport halts although oxygen is plentiful, which is why the venous blood stays oxygenated. Carbon monoxide binds the ferrous (Fe2+) iron of haemoglobin and myoglobin, at the same site oxygen uses and with far higher affinity, so it competes oxygen off the carrier; the distal histidine that sterically disfavours CO in normal haem is what keeps that affinity from being higher still. One is a chain poison, the other a transport poison.
cards.zh: 氰化物与一氧化碳总是一起讲，但它们作用于不同的蛋白，作用的铁也处于不同的氧化态。氰化物结合的是复合体 IV 双核中心里血红素 a3 的三价铁（Fe³⁺），使 O2 不能被还原成水——氧并不缺，电子传递却停了，所以静脉血仍是含氧的。一氧化碳结合的是血红蛋白和肌红蛋白上的二价铁（Fe²⁺），位点与氧相同而亲和力高得多，因此把氧从载体上竞争下来；正常血红素中远端组氨酸对 CO 的位阻不利，正是这一点使它的亲和力没有更高。一个是呼吸链毒物，一个是运输毒物。
cards.see: L1 · heme and CO / L10 · Complex IV

cards.en: Arsenate and arsenite are two oxidation states of arsenic with two entirely different targets. Arsenate (AsO4 3−) is a phosphate analogue: at the GAPDH step it substitutes for inorganic phosphate, and the 1-arseno-3-phosphoglycerate that results hydrolyses spontaneously before phosphoglycerate kinase can use it. Oxidation still happens and NADH is still made, but that substrate-level ATP is never collected — oxidation has been uncoupled from phosphorylation at the level of one enzyme. Arsenite (AsO3 3−) instead binds pairs of neighbouring thiols, and the reduced lipoamide arm of E2 is exactly such a pair, so it shuts down both the pyruvate dehydrogenase and the α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complexes and those two keto acids accumulate.
cards.zh: 砷酸盐与亚砷酸盐是砷的两种氧化态，靶点完全不同。砷酸盐（AsO4³⁻）是磷酸的类似物：在 GAPDH 这一步它顶替无机磷酸，生成的 1-砷酸-3-磷酸甘油酸还没等磷酸甘油酸激酶用上就自发水解了。氧化照样发生、NADH 照样产生，但那一次底物水平磷酸化的 ATP 收不到——在单个酶的层面上，氧化与磷酸化被解偶联了。亚砷酸盐（AsO3³⁻）则结合成对的相邻巯基，而 E2 上还原态硫辛酰胺的摆臂恰好就是这样一对，于是丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体和 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体一起停摆，这两个酮酸随之堆积。

cards.en: Three drugs hit the same one-carbon supply line at three different points, and they only make sense together. Sulfonamides are PABA analogues at bacterial dihydropteroate synthase, the step that builds folate — selectivity comes from humans not making folate at all but taking it as a vitamin, so there is no human counterpart of the target. Methotrexate inhibits dihydrofolate reductase, which regenerates THF from DHF. 5-Fluorouracil is converted to FdUMP, which traps thymidylate synthase in a covalent complex with methylene-THF. Thymidylate synthase is the one reaction that leaves folate oxidised as DHF, which is exactly why blocking DHFR starves it, and why both drugs end at the same place: no dTMP.
cards.zh: 三种药打在同一条一碳单位供应线上的三个不同点，只有放在一起看才讲得通。磺胺是 PABA 的类似物，作用于细菌的二氢蝶酸合酶，也就是构建叶酸的那一步——它的选择性来自人根本不合成叶酸、而是把叶酸当维生素摄入，所以人体内不存在这个靶酶的对应物。甲氨蝶呤抑制二氢叶酸还原酶，也就是把 DHF 再生成 THF 的那个酶。5-氟尿嘧啶被转化为 FdUMP，把胸苷酸合酶与亚甲基-THF 一起锁进一个共价复合物。胸苷酸合酶是唯一一个把叶酸留在氧化态 DHF 上的反应，这正是阻断 DHFR 会把它饿死的原因，也是这两种药最终落到同一个结果上的原因：没有 dTMP。
cards.see: L6 · folate and one-carbon units / L12 · sulfonamides

cards.en: Allopurinol is worth revisiting from the kinetics lecture rather than the purine lecture. It is an isomer of hypoxanthine, so xanthine oxidase accepts it as a substrate and oxidises it — to oxypurinol, which then stays bound to the reduced molybdenum centre. That is mechanism-based (suicide) inhibition: the enzyme makes its own inhibitor, and no amount of extra xanthine relieves it, so it does not belong in the competitive / non-competitive / uncompetitive scheme at all. Downstream, urate production falls; upstream, hypoxanthine and xanthine rise, and being far more soluble than urate they are handled better, with some of the hypoxanthine recovered by HGPRT back into the salvage pathway.
cards.zh: 别嘌呤醇值得从酶动力学那一讲、而不是嘌呤那一讲，再看一遍。它是次黄嘌呤的异构体，所以黄嘌呤氧化酶把它当底物接收并氧化——生成氧嘌呤醇，后者随即牢牢结合在还原态的钼中心上。这属于机制依赖性（自杀性）抑制：酶自己造出了抑制自己的分子，再多的黄嘌呤也解除不了，因此它根本不属于竞争性／非竞争性／反竞争性这套分类。下游看，尿酸生成减少；上游看，次黄嘌呤与黄嘌呤升高，而它们比尿酸易溶得多，因而更容易被处理，其中一部分次黄嘌呤还能被 HGPRT 收回补救途径。
cards.see: L12 · xanthine oxidase / L4 · inhibitor classes

quiz.q_en: A man with G6PD deficiency eats fava beans and becomes anaemic within days. Which supply chain has failed?
quiz.q_zh: 一位 G6PD 缺乏的男性吃了蚕豆，几天内出现贫血。是哪一条供应链断了？

options.en: G6PD makes the NADH that lactate dehydrogenase needs to regenerate NAD+, and NAD+ lets glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase keep running
options.zh: G6PD 生成 NADH，乳酸脱氢酶靠它把 NAD+ 再生出来，而 NAD+ 使 3-磷酸甘油醛脱氢酶得以继续运转

options.en: G6PD makes the ATP that the Na+/K+ pump needs to hold cell volume, and stable volume lets the membrane resist osmotic lysis
options.zh: G6PD 生成 ATP，钠钾泵靠它维持细胞体积，而体积稳定使细胞膜得以抵抗渗透性溶解

options.en: G6PD makes the FADH2 that catalase needs to regenerate its haem iron, and that haem lets catalase dismutate superoxide
options.zh: G6PD 生成 FADH2，过氧化氢酶靠它再生血红素铁，而这个血红素使过氧化氢酶得以歧化超氧阴离子

options.en: G6PD makes the NADPH that glutathione reductase needs to regenerate GSH, and GSH lets glutathione peroxidase destroy H2O2
options.zh: G6PD 生成 NADPH，谷胱甘肽还原酶靠它把 GSH 再生出来，而 GSH 使谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶得以清除 H2O2

quiz.explain_en: G6PD is the entry step of the oxidative branch of the PPP and its output is NADPH, which glutathione reductase spends to keep glutathione reduced; the mature red cell has no other NADPH source. The lactate dehydrogenase answer describes NADH recycling in anaerobic glycolysis, a different nicotinamide cofactor and a pathway G6PD does not feed. The Na+/K+ pump answer names a real ATP consumer, but the PPP oxidative branch yields no ATP. The catalase answer is wrong twice over: catalase uses no FADH2, and superoxide is dismutated by superoxide dismutase, not catalase.
quiz.explain_zh: G6PD 是 PPP 氧化支路的入口步骤，产物是 NADPH，谷胱甘肽还原酶用它维持谷胱甘肽处于还原态；成熟红细胞没有别的 NADPH 来源。提到乳酸脱氢酶的那个说的是无氧糖酵解里 NADH 的再生，用的是另一种烟酰胺辅酶，而且这条路不由 G6PD 供应。提到钠钾泵的那个点出了一个真实的 ATP 消耗者，但 PPP 氧化支路根本不产 ATP。提到过氧化氢酶的那个错了两处：过氧化氢酶不用 FADH2，而超氧阴离子由超氧化物歧化酶歧化，不是过氧化氢酶。

quiz.q_en: An infant is found to have a phenylalanine hydroxylase defect. Which compound appears in the urine, and where does it come from?
quiz.q_zh: 一名婴儿被查出苯丙氨酸羟化酶缺陷。尿中出现的是哪一个化合物，它从哪里来？

options.en: Homogentisate, an intermediate of tyrosine breakdown that accumulates when its own dioxygenase is missing
options.zh: 尿黑酸，酪氨酸分解的中间产物，在它自己的双加氧酶缺失时堆积

options.en: Orotate, formed when carbamoyl phosphate escapes the mitochondrion and is drawn into pyrimidine synthesis
options.zh: 乳清酸，由氨甲酰磷酸逸出线粒体、被吸入嘧啶合成途径而生成

options.en: Phenylpyruvate, formed by transaminating the phenylalanine that piles up behind the blocked hydroxylase
options.zh: 苯丙酮酸，由堵在羟化酶之前堆积起来的苯丙氨酸经转氨作用生成

options.en: Acetoacetate, formed in liver mitochondria when surplus acetyl-CoA is routed down the HMG-CoA branch
options.zh: 乙酰乙酸，在肝线粒体中由过剩的乙酰CoA 经 HMG-CoA 支路生成

quiz.explain_en: With the hydroxylase blocked, phenylalanine accumulates and a normally minor transamination route becomes significant, giving phenylpyruvate — the compound the disease is named for. Homogentisate accumulates in alkaptonuria, a block further down the tyrosine degradation pathway, not at the hydroxylase. Orotate belongs to the urea-cycle spill-over seen in OTC deficiency. Acetoacetate is a ketone body from hepatic ketogenesis and has nothing to do with phenylalanine — that is exactly the confusion between ketonuria and phenylketonuria to avoid.
quiz.explain_zh: 羟化酶被阻断后苯丙氨酸堆积，平时次要的转氨路线变得可观，生成苯丙酮酸——这个病就是以它命名的。尿黑酸堆积见于尿黑酸尿症，阻断点在酪氨酸降解通路更下游，而不在羟化酶。乳清酸属于 OTC 缺乏时尿素循环的溢流产物。乙酰乙酸是肝脏生酮作用产生的酮体，与苯丙氨酸毫无关系——这正是要避免的酮尿与苯丙酮尿之间的混淆。

quiz.q_en: A child is well when fed but after an illness stops them eating becomes hypoglycaemic, with ketones far lower than the fast predicts and C6–C10 acylcarnitines raised. Which step is blocked?
quiz.q_zh: 一名儿童进食时一切正常，但一次疾病使他停止进食后出现低血糖，酮体远低于该禁食时长应有的水平，且 C6–C10 酰基肉碱升高。被阻断的是哪一步？

options.en: The first, FAD-dependent dehydrogenation of β-oxidation, in the isoform that handles medium-chain acyl-CoA
options.zh: β-氧化第一步、依赖 FAD 的脱氢反应，出问题的是处理中链脂酰CoA 的那个同工酶

options.en: The thiolysis step of β-oxidation, so each round stalls before acetyl-CoA is cut off the shortened chain
options.zh: β-氧化的硫解步骤，于是每一轮都在乙酰CoA 从缩短的链上被切下来之前停住

options.en: HMG-CoA lyase in the liver matrix, so acetyl-CoA reaches HMG-CoA but is never cleaved to acetoacetate
options.zh: 肝基质中的 HMG-CoA 裂解酶，于是乙酰CoA 能走到 HMG-CoA，却始终切不成乙酰乙酸

options.en: The carnitine shuttle, so acyl groups of every chain length are stopped at the inner mitochondrial membrane
options.zh: 肉碱穿梭，于是各种链长的酰基都被挡在线粒体内膜之外

quiz.explain_en: The acylcarnitine profile is the discriminator: chains are shortened normally until they reach medium length and then stall, which places the defect at the medium-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase, the FAD step that opens each round. A carnitine shuttle block would stop long chains too and give a quite different acylcarnitine pattern. A thiolysis block would not release acetyl-CoA at all and is not chain-length selective in this way. An HMG-CoA lyase block does give hypoketotic hypoglycaemia, but it sits in ketogenesis after β-oxidation and would not raise C6–C10 acylcarnitines.
quiz.explain_zh: 酰基肉碱谱是鉴别点：链能正常缩短到中等长度才卡住，这就把缺陷定位在中链脂酰CoA 脱氢酶，也就是每一轮开头的那个 FAD 步骤。肉碱穿梭被阻断的话长链同样过不去，酰基肉碱谱会很不一样。硫解被阻断则根本放不出乙酰CoA，也不会有这种链长选择性。HMG-CoA 裂解酶缺陷确实会造成低酮性低血糖，但它位于 β-氧化之后的生酮环节，不会使 C6–C10 酰基肉碱升高。

quiz.q_en: OTC deficiency gives hyperammonaemia together with orotic acid in the urine. Why does the orotate appear?
quiz.q_zh: OTC 缺乏时高氨血症与尿中乳清酸同时出现。乳清酸是怎么来的？

options.en: Carbamoyl phosphate from CPS-1 backs up in the matrix, reaches the cytosol and is drawn into pyrimidine synthesis
options.zh: CPS-1 产生的氨甲酰磷酸在基质中积压，进入胞质后被吸入嘧啶合成途径

options.en: Arginase fails, so arginine accumulates and is diverted through a decarboxylase into the orotate ring
options.zh: 精氨酸酶失活，精氨酸堆积并经一个脱羧酶被转入乳清酸环

options.en: Argininosuccinate lyase fails, so aspartate accumulates and is condensed directly onto ribose-5-phosphate
options.zh: 精氨酸代琥珀酸裂解酶失活，天冬氨酸堆积并被直接缩合到 5-磷酸核糖上

options.en: Ammonia derepresses carbamoyl phosphate synthetase II, so the cytosolic enzyme simply runs faster than usual
options.zh: 氨解除了对氨甲酰磷酸合成酶 II 的抑制，于是这个胞质酶只是比平时跑得更快

quiz.explain_en: OTC is the consumer of matrix carbamoyl phosphate; without it, CPS-1 keeps producing and the product spills into the cytosol, where the pyrimidine pathway takes it on to orotate. Arginase and argininosuccinate lyase act on later urea-cycle intermediates, downstream of the carbamoyl phosphate pool, and neither builds a pyrimidine ring. The CPS-2 derepression answer has the direction wrong: the cytosolic enzyme is not what is driving this — the substrate arriving from the matrix is.
quiz.explain_zh: OTC 是基质中氨甲酰磷酸的消费者；没有它，CPS-1 照旧生产，产物溢流进胞质，嘧啶合成途径把它一路带到乳清酸。精氨酸酶与精氨酸代琥珀酸裂解酶作用于尿素循环更靠后的中间物，位于氨甲酰磷酸池的下游，而且都不构建嘧啶环。说 CPS-2 被解除抑制的那个方向反了：推动这件事的不是那个胞质酶，而是从基质送来的底物。

quiz.q_en: Which description of the two carbamoyl phosphate synthetases is correct?
quiz.q_zh: 关于两个氨甲酰磷酸合成酶，下面哪一种描述是正确的？

options.en: CPS-1 sits in the mitochondrial matrix, takes nitrogen from free ammonia, and requires N-acetylglutamate as activator
options.zh: CPS-1 位于线粒体基质，氮取自游离氨，并需要 N-乙酰谷氨酸作为激活剂

options.en: CPS-1 sits in the cytosol, takes its nitrogen from the amide of glutamine, and is allosterically inhibited by N-acetylglutamate
options.zh: CPS-1 位于胞质，氮取自谷氨酰胺的酰胺基，并受 N-乙酰谷氨酸抑制

options.en: CPS-2 sits in the mitochondrial matrix, takes nitrogen from free ammonia, and is the committed step of the urea cycle
options.zh: CPS-2 位于线粒体基质，氮取自游离氨，是尿素循环的关键步骤

options.en: CPS-2 sits in the cytosol, takes nitrogen from aspartate, and is the committed step of purine ring assembly
options.zh: CPS-2 位于胞质，氮取自天冬氨酸，是嘌呤环装配的关键步骤

quiz.explain_en: CPS-1 is the matrix, free-ammonia, N-acetylglutamate-activated enzyme that opens the urea cycle; CPS-2 is cytosolic, uses the glutamine amide nitrogen, and commits to pyrimidine synthesis. The version placing CPS-1 in the cytosol on glutamine swaps the two enzymes wholesale and inverts the role of N-acetylglutamate, which activates rather than inhibits. Putting CPS-2 in the matrix on the urea cycle is the same swap in the other direction. The aspartate/purine version is wrong on both counts: aspartate donates nitrogen elsewhere, and CPS-2 belongs to the pyrimidine, not the purine, pathway.
quiz.explain_zh: CPS-1 是位于基质、用游离氨、受 N-乙酰谷氨酸激活、开启尿素循环的那个酶；CPS-2 位于胞质，用谷氨酰胺的酰胺氮，是嘧啶合成的关键步骤。把 CPS-1 说成在胞质、用谷氨酰胺的那个，是把两个酶整体调换，还把 N-乙酰谷氨酸的作用说反了，它是激活而非抑制。把 CPS-2 放进基质、放进尿素循环的那个，是同一种调换的反方向。写天冬氨酸与嘌呤的那个两处都错：天冬氨酸供氮是在别的环节，而 CPS-2 属于嘧啶而非嘌呤途径。

quiz.q_en: In Lesch–Nyhan syndrome HGPRT is lost. Why does urate rise so far above normal?
quiz.q_zh: Lesch–Nyhan 综合征中 HGPRT 缺失。为什么尿酸会升得这么高？

options.en: Xanthine oxidase is overproduced, so an unchanged purine load is oxidised to urate much faster than normal
options.zh: 黄嘌呤氧化酶产量过高，于是同样的嘌呤负荷被远快于正常地氧化成尿酸

options.en: Urate is filtered as usual but the proximal tubule transporter is lost, so far less of it is reabsorbed
options.zh: 尿酸照常被滤过，但近端小管的转运体缺失，因而被重吸收的比例大幅减少

options.en: PRPP is no longer consumed by salvage, so it accumulates and drives de novo purine synthesis harder
options.zh: PRPP 不再被补救途径消耗，于是堆积起来，把从头合成推得更快

options.en: Adenosine deaminase is lost as well, so adenosine builds up and is converted straight through to urate
options.zh: 腺苷脱氨酶一并缺失，于是腺苷堆积并被直接一路转化为尿酸

quiz.explain_en: Two effects add: the bases that cannot be salvaged go on to xanthine oxidase, and the PRPP they would have consumed accumulates and pushes de novo synthesis, so more purine is made only to be degraded. Xanthine oxidase levels are not the lesion — the enzyme is normal and simply has more substrate. A urate transporter defect describes under-reabsorption, which would lower serum urate rather than raise it. Adenosine deaminase loss is a separate disease, SCID, and it is not part of the HGPRT defect.
quiz.explain_zh: 两个效应叠加：补救不了的碱基交给黄嘌呤氧化酶，而本该被它们消耗掉的 PRPP 堆积起来，把从头合成推上去，于是造出更多嘌呤只为了再降解。黄嘌呤氧化酶的水平不是病变所在——这个酶是正常的，只是底物变多了。写尿酸转运体缺陷的那个描述的是重吸收减少，那会让血尿酸降低而不是升高。腺苷脱氨酶缺失是另一个疾病（SCID），与 HGPRT 缺陷无关。

quiz.q_en: Muscle holds a large store of glycogen, yet it can never raise blood glucose. Why not?
quiz.q_zh: 肌肉储存着大量糖原，却永远抬不高血糖。为什么？

options.en: Muscle has no hexokinase, so glucose entering the fibre is never trapped and simply diffuses back out
options.zh: 肌肉没有己糖激酶，进入肌纤维的葡萄糖从未被锁住，只是又扩散出去

options.en: Muscle has no glucose transporter anywhere in its sarcolemma, so free glucose made inside the fibre can never reach the blood
options.zh: 肌肉的肌膜上根本没有葡萄糖转运体，因此肌纤维内部生成的游离葡萄糖永远到不了血液里

options.en: Muscle has no glycogen phosphorylase, so its glycogen can only be degraded by lysosomal acid maltase
options.zh: 肌肉没有糖原磷酸化酶，其糖原只能靠溶酶体酸性麦芽糖酶降解

options.en: Muscle has no glucose-6-phosphatase, so the phosphate stays on and the charged G6P cannot leave the fibre
options.zh: 肌肉没有葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶，磷酸留在原处，带电的 G6P 无法离开肌纤维

quiz.explain_en: Only liver, kidney and intestine have glucose-6-phosphatase; muscle keeps the phosphate on, and a charged phosphate ester cannot cross the membrane — which is also the reason muscle exports carbon as lactate for the Cori cycle or as alanine. Muscle glycogen phosphorylase is abundant, and it is the enzyme that produces G1P in the first place. Muscle hexokinase is likewise present and is exactly what traps glucose. Muscle does have GLUT4 in the sarcolemma; the problem is that no free glucose is ever made inside for it to carry.
quiz.explain_zh: 只有肝、肾和肠有葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶；肌肉把磷酸留着，而带电的磷酸酯不能跨膜——这也正是肌肉只能以乳酸（走 Cori 循环）或丙氨酸的形式输出碳的原因。肌肉的糖原磷酸化酶含量很高，本来就是它生成 G1P 的。肌肉的己糖激酶同样存在，而且正是它把葡萄糖锁住的。肌膜上确实有 GLUT4；问题在于内部根本没有游离葡萄糖可供它转运。

quiz.q_en: In pyruvate kinase deficiency the glycolytic intermediates above the block accumulate, 2,3-BPG among them. What happens to the oxygen dissociation curve, and why?
quiz.q_zh: 丙酮酸激酶缺乏时，阻断点之上的糖酵解中间产物堆积，其中包括 2,3-BPG。氧解离曲线会怎样变化，为什么？

options.en: It shifts right: 2,3-BPG oxidises the haem iron to Fe3+, and methaemoglobin cannot bind oxygen at all
options.zh: 曲线右移：2,3-BPG 把血红素铁氧化为 Fe³⁺，而高铁血红蛋白根本不能结合氧

options.en: It does not shift: 2,3-BPG acts only on myoglobin, whose hyperbolic curve has no T-to-R transition to alter
options.zh: 曲线不变：2,3-BPG 只作用于肌红蛋白，而其双曲线型曲线并没有可改变的 T→R 转变

options.en: It shifts right: 2,3-BPG binds in the central cavity of deoxyhaemoglobin, stabilises the T state and lowers affinity
options.zh: 曲线右移：2,3-BPG 结合在脱氧血红蛋白的中央空腔内，稳定 T 态，降低亲和力

options.en: It shifts left: 2,3-BPG binds the haem pocket beside the oxygen, stabilises the R state and raises affinity
options.zh: 曲线左移：2,3-BPG 结合在血红素口袋中氧气旁边，稳定 R 态，提高亲和力

quiz.explain_en: 2,3-BPG binds a positively charged pocket in the centre of the deoxy tetramer, cross-linking the β chains and holding the T state, so affinity falls and the curve shifts right — these patients unload oxygen well for their haemoglobin level. The left-shift version puts 2,3-BPG in the haem pocket, which is where oxygen itself binds and where 2,3-BPG never goes. Oxidising the iron to Fe3+ describes methaemoglobin formation, a different chemistry that 2,3-BPG does not perform. Myoglobin is monomeric, binds no 2,3-BPG, and is not the carrier in question here.
quiz.explain_zh: 2,3-BPG 结合在脱氧四聚体中央一个带正电的口袋里，把两条 β 链交联起来、锁住 T 态，于是亲和力下降、曲线右移——这类病人在其血红蛋白水平下卸氧反而不错。说左移的那个把 2,3-BPG 放进了血红素口袋，那是氧自己结合的地方，2,3-BPG 从不去那里。把铁氧化成 Fe³⁺ 描述的是高铁血红蛋白的形成，是另一套化学，2,3-BPG 并不这样做。肌红蛋白是单体，不结合 2,3-BPG，也不是这里讨论的载体。

quiz.q_en: Phytanic acid must be shortened by peroxisomal α-oxidation before ordinary β-oxidation can touch it. What makes β-oxidation unable to start on it?
quiz.q_zh: 植烷酸必须先经过氧化物酶体的 α-氧化缩短，普通的 β-氧化才动得了它。是什么让 β-氧化无法在它身上启动？

options.en: Phytanic acid is methylated at the β carbon, so the dehydrogenation and hydration of β-oxidation cannot proceed
options.zh: 植烷酸在 β 碳上带甲基，β-氧化的脱氢与水合反应无法进行

options.en: Phytanic acid is too long for the carnitine shuttle, so α-oxidation trims it until CPT-1 will accept it
options.zh: 植烷酸对肉碱穿梭来说太长，α-氧化把它修短到 CPT-1 肯接收为止

options.en: Phytanic acid is a trans fatty acid, so the enoyl-CoA isomerase of β-oxidation cannot set up its double bond
options.zh: 植烷酸是反式脂肪酸，β-氧化的烯脂酰CoA 异构酶无法为它安排双键

options.en: Phytanic acid carries an ω-hydroxyl group, so it must be oxidised to a dicarboxylic acid before any thiolysis can occur
options.zh: 植烷酸带有一个 ω-羟基，必须先被氧化成二羧酸，才谈得上任何硫解

quiz.explain_en: β-oxidation works on the β carbon, and a methyl branch there blocks the dehydrogenation and hydration chemistry; α-oxidation removes one carbon from the carboxyl end so the branch ends up on the α carbon instead. Chain length is not the obstacle — phytanic acid is a C20 branched chain, well within the carnitine shuttle's range. The trans/isomerase answer describes the handling of naturally cis unsaturated fatty acids, and phytanic acid is saturated. ω-Hydroxylation is a separate minor oxidation route and is not what phytanic acid requires.
quiz.explain_zh: β-氧化作用于 β 碳，而该位置上的甲基分支使脱氢与水合的化学无法进行；α-氧化从羧基端切掉一个碳，分支便落到 α 碳上。链长不是障碍——植烷酸是 C20 的支链脂肪酸，完全在肉碱穿梭的处理范围内。写反式与异构酶的那个描述的是天然顺式不饱和脂肪酸的处理，而植烷酸是饱和的。ω-羟化是另一条次要的氧化途径，不是植烷酸所需要的。

quiz.q_en: Rotenone is added to mitochondria oxidising NADH. What is the redox state of the chain?
quiz.q_zh: 向正在氧化 NADH 的线粒体中加入鱼藤酮。此时呼吸链各组分处于什么氧化还原状态？

options.en: Coenzyme Q stays reduced and Complex I stays oxidised, because rotenone blocks the exit from Q rather than the entry
options.zh: 辅酶 Q 保持还原态而复合体 I 保持氧化态，因为鱼藤酮阻断的是 Q 的出口而非入口

options.en: Everything from NADH through to cytochrome c stays reduced, and only the copper centres of Complex IV are oxidised
options.zh: 从 NADH 一直到细胞色素 c 全部保持还原态，只有复合体 IV 的铜中心被氧化

options.en: Everything from NADH through to cytochrome c stays oxidised, because electrons are trapped on the flavin of Complex II
options.zh: 从 NADH 一直到细胞色素 c 全部保持在氧化态，因为电子被困在复合体 II 的黄素辅基上出不来

options.en: NADH and the flavin and Fe-S centres of Complex I stay reduced, while Q, Complex III and everything after are oxidised
options.zh: NADH 与复合体 I 的黄素和铁硫中心保持还原态，而 Q、复合体 III 及其之后全部被氧化

quiz.explain_en: A blocker leaves everything upstream of it reduced and everything downstream oxidised, and rotenone acts at the Q-binding exit of Complex I, so NADH, FMN and the Fe-S clusters stay reduced while Q onwards runs out of electrons — which is also why succinate can still restore flow through Complex II. Keeping cytochrome c reduced would require a block at Complex IV, as with cyanide. The version with everything oxidised has the pattern inverted and misplaces the flavin. The last version names the right region but reverses which side of Complex I is blocked.
quiz.explain_zh: 阻断剂使其上游全部保持还原、下游全部被氧化；鱼藤酮作用在复合体 I 与 Q 结合的出口处，因此 NADH、FMN 和铁硫簇保持还原态，而 Q 及其后没有电子可拿——这也正是加琥珀酸仍能经复合体 II 恢复电子流的原因。让细胞色素 c 保持还原态需要在复合体 IV 处阻断，那是氰化物的情形。说全部处于氧化态的那个把格局整个反了，还把黄素放错了位置。最后那个点到了正确的区域，却把复合体 I 被阻断的一侧说反了。

quiz.q_en: Mitochondria respiring on succinate are given one inhibitor and oxygen consumption almost stops. Adding an uncoupler afterwards restores it. Which inhibitor was used, and why does the uncoupler rescue it?
quiz.q_zh: 以琥珀酸为底物呼吸的线粒体加入某一种抑制剂后耗氧几乎停止，随后加入解偶联剂又恢复了。用的是哪种抑制剂，解偶联剂为什么能救回来？

options.en: Rotenone: it blocks Complex I, and the uncoupler restores flow by letting succinate feed its electrons in through FAD
options.zh: 鱼藤酮：它阻断复合体 I，解偶联剂通过让琥珀酸经 FAD 送入电子来恢复电子流

options.en: Antimycin A: it blocks Complex III at the Qi site, and the uncoupler restores flow by offering Q an alternative electron acceptor
options.zh: 抗霉素 A：它阻断复合体 III，解偶联剂通过给 Q 提供另一个电子受体来恢复电子流

options.en: Oligomycin: it plugs the FO proton channel, and the uncoupler gives protons another way back, relieving respiratory control
options.zh: 寡霉素：它堵住 FO 质子通道，解偶联剂给质子另开一条回路，从而解除呼吸控制

options.en: Cyanide: it blocks Complex IV, and the uncoupler restores flow by lowering the gradient the proton pumps work against
options.zh: 氰化物：它阻断复合体 IV，解偶联剂通过降低质子泵所要对抗的梯度来恢复电子流

quiz.explain_en: Oligomycin does not touch the chain; it stops proton return, the gradient builds up, and respiration slows by respiratory control — so an uncoupler that lets protons back in restores oxygen consumption immediately. This rescue is the standard way to tell an ATP-synthase inhibitor from a chain blocker. Antimycin A and cyanide sever the electron path itself, and an uncoupler cannot supply a new acceptor for oxygen or for Q. Rotenone is doubly wrong here: with succinate as substrate, electrons enter at Complex II and rotenone would not have stopped respiration in the first place.
quiz.explain_zh: 寡霉素不碰呼吸链；它挡住质子回流，梯度累积，呼吸因呼吸控制而变慢——所以让质子重新回来的解偶联剂能立刻恢复耗氧。这一「解救」正是区分 ATP 合酶抑制剂与呼吸链阻断剂的标准方法。抗霉素 A 与氰化物切断的是电子通路本身，解偶联剂无法为氧或为 Q 另找一个受体。鱼藤酮在这里错得更彻底：以琥珀酸为底物时电子从复合体 II 进入，鱼藤酮本来就不会让呼吸停下来。

quiz.q_en: DNP is added to actively respiring mitochondria. What happens to oxygen consumption, the proton gradient, ATP synthesis and the energy released?
quiz.q_zh: 向正在活跃呼吸的线粒体中加入 DNP。耗氧、质子梯度、ATP 合成以及释放出的能量各会怎样？

options.en: Oxygen consumption falls, the gradient collapses, ATP synthesis rises, and the energy leaves as heat
options.zh: 耗氧下降，梯度崩塌，ATP 合成升高，能量以热的形式散失

options.en: Oxygen consumption rises, the gradient collapses, ATP synthesis falls, and the energy leaves as heat
options.zh: 耗氧升高，梯度崩塌，ATP 合成下降，能量以热的形式散失

options.en: Oxygen consumption falls, the gradient rises, ATP synthesis falls, and the energy stays stored in the gradient
options.zh: 耗氧下降，梯度升高，ATP 合成下降，能量以梯度的形式储存下来

options.en: Oxygen consumption rises, the gradient rises, ATP synthesis rises, and the surplus energy leaves as heat
options.zh: 耗氧升高，梯度升高，ATP 合成升高，多余的能量以热的形式散失

quiz.explain_en: An uncoupler is a lipid-soluble weak acid that ferries protons across the inner membrane, so the gradient cannot build, respiratory control is lost and the chain runs flat out — oxygen consumption up, ATP synthesis down, and the free energy of oxidation dissipated as heat. UCP1 in brown fat is the regulated physiological version of the same trick. The combinations claiming the gradient rises contradict what uncoupling means, and any answer with ATP synthesis rising misses the point that the gradient is the only thing driving ATP synthase.
quiz.explain_zh: 解偶联剂是脂溶性弱酸，把质子摆渡过内膜，于是梯度建立不起来，呼吸控制丧失，呼吸链全速运转——耗氧上升、ATP 合成下降，氧化释放的自由能以热散失。棕色脂肪中的 UCP1 就是同一招受调控的生理版本。凡是说梯度升高的组合都与「解偶联」的含义矛盾；凡是说 ATP 合成升高的都没抓住要点：驱动 ATP 合酶的只有那个梯度。

quiz.q_en: Cyanide and carbon monoxide are both taught as haem poisons. Which pairing of target and iron oxidation state is right?
quiz.q_zh: 氰化物与一氧化碳都被当作血红素毒物来讲。靶点与铁的氧化态，哪一种搭配是对的？

options.en: Cyanide binds the ferrous Fe2+ of haem a3 in Complex IV, and carbon monoxide binds the ferric Fe3+ of haemoglobin
options.zh: 氰化物结合复合体 IV 中血红素 a3 的二价铁 Fe²⁺，一氧化碳结合血红蛋白的三价铁 Fe³⁺

options.en: Cyanide binds the ferric Fe3+ of haem a3 in Complex IV, and carbon monoxide binds the ferrous Fe2+ of haemoglobin
options.zh: 氰化物结合复合体 IV 中血红素 a3 的三价铁 Fe³⁺，一氧化碳结合血红蛋白的二价铁 Fe²⁺

options.en: Both bind ferrous Fe2+; cyanide takes the haemoglobin site while carbon monoxide takes the Complex IV site
options.zh: 两者都结合二价铁 Fe²⁺；氰化物占据血红蛋白的位点，一氧化碳占据复合体 IV 的位点

options.en: Both bind ferric Fe3+; carbon monoxide takes the haemoglobin site while cyanide takes the Complex IV site
options.zh: 两者都结合三价铁 Fe³⁺；一氧化碳占据血红蛋白的位点，氰化物占据复合体 IV 的位点

quiz.explain_en: Cyanide binds the oxidised, ferric haem a3 of the binuclear centre and freezes Complex IV, so electron transport stops with oxygen still abundant; carbon monoxide binds the reduced, ferrous iron of haemoglobin at the very site oxygen uses, competing oxygen off the carrier. The two answers that put both ligands on the same oxidation state erase the distinction the question turns on. The remaining version keeps the right proteins but swaps the oxidation states, and a ferric haemoglobin — methaemoglobin — is precisely the form that cannot carry oxygen or bind CO.
quiz.explain_zh: 氰化物结合双核中心里处于氧化态的三价血红素 a3，把复合体 IV 冻住，于是在氧仍充足的情况下电子传递停止；一氧化碳结合血红蛋白处于还原态的二价铁，位点正是氧所用的那个，把氧从载体上竞争下来。把两个配体放在同一氧化态上的那两个答案，抹掉了本题的关键区别。剩下那个蛋白配对正确却把氧化态调换了，而三价铁的血红蛋白——高铁血红蛋白——恰恰是既不能带氧也不能结合 CO 的那种形式。
quiz.see: L1 · heme and CO / L10 · Complex IV

quiz.q_en: Arsenate is added to a working glycolytic extract. Glucose is still consumed and NADH is still made, but the ATP yield of the payoff phase drops. What happened at the GAPDH step?
quiz.q_zh: 向一份正在运转的糖酵解抽提液中加入砷酸盐。葡萄糖照常被消耗，NADH 照常生成，但放能阶段的 ATP 产量下降。GAPDH 这一步发生了什么？

options.en: Arsenate replaces Pi, and the 1-arseno-3-phosphoglycerate formed hydrolyses before the kinase can use it
options.zh: 砷酸盐顶替无机磷酸，生成的 1-砷酸-3-磷酸甘油酸在激酶用上它之前就水解了

options.en: Arsenate inhibits phosphoglycerate kinase directly, so the acyl phosphate accumulates and is hydrolysed later
options.zh: 砷酸盐直接抑制磷酸甘油酸激酶，于是酰基磷酸堆积，随后被水解掉

options.en: Arsenate replaces NAD+ as the hydrogen acceptor, so the oxidation runs but no reducing power is stored
options.zh: 砷酸盐顶替 NAD+ 作为受氢体，于是氧化照常进行，却没有还原力被储存下来

options.en: Arsenate binds the active-site cysteine of GAPDH, so no thioester forms and the aldehyde is never oxidised
options.zh: 砷酸盐结合 GAPDH 活性中心的半胱氨酸，于是硫酯中间体不能形成，醛基也就始终没有被氧化

quiz.explain_en: Arsenate is a phosphate analogue, so GAPDH accepts it in place of Pi; the resulting acyl arsenate is far less stable than the acyl phosphate and hydrolyses spontaneously, so the high-energy bond is lost before phosphoglycerate kinase can convert it into ATP. Oxidation and NADH formation are unaffected — that is the definition of uncoupling at this step. Blocking the active-site cysteine would stop NADH formation, which the stem says still happens. Direct inhibition of the kinase and substitution for NAD+ both contradict the observation that NADH is still being made and the reaction still runs.
quiz.explain_zh: 砷酸盐是磷酸的类似物，GAPDH 会拿它顶替无机磷酸；生成的酰基砷酸远不如酰基磷酸稳定，会自发水解，于是那个高能键在磷酸甘油酸激酶把它变成 ATP 之前就丢掉了。氧化与 NADH 的生成不受影响——这正是这一步上「解偶联」的含义。封住活性中心半胱氨酸会让 NADH 也停止生成，而题干说 NADH 照常产生。直接抑制激酶、以及顶替 NAD+，都与「NADH 仍在生成、反应仍在进行」这一观察相矛盾。

quiz.q_en: Arsenite acts somewhere quite different from arsenate. Which target does it attack, and with what consequence?
quiz.q_zh: 亚砷酸盐作用的地方与砷酸盐很不一样。它攻击的是哪个靶点，后果是什么？

options.en: It binds the two neighbouring thiols of dihydrolipoamide on E2, halting the PDH and α-KGDH complexes
options.zh: 它结合 E2 上二氢硫辛酰胺的两个相邻巯基，使 PDH 与 α-KGDH 复合体停摆

options.en: It oxidises the thiamine pyrophosphate of E1, so the two-carbon unit can no longer be carried off pyruvate
options.zh: 它氧化 E1 上的硫胺素焦磷酸，于是两碳单位再也无法从丙酮酸上被带走

options.en: It replaces inorganic phosphate at GAPDH, giving an unstable acyl arsenate that hydrolyses spontaneously
options.zh: 它在 GAPDH 处顶替无机磷酸，生成不稳定的酰基砷酸并自发水解

options.en: It chelates the Mg2+ that hexokinase needs to position the γ-phosphate of ATP for transfer onto glucose
options.zh: 它螯合掉己糖激酶用来摆放 ATP γ-磷酸、以便转移到葡萄糖上的 Mg²⁺

quiz.explain_en: Arsenite has a high affinity for pairs of vicinal thiols, and the reduced lipoamide swinging arm on E2 presents exactly such a pair; both the pyruvate dehydrogenase and α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complexes use that arm, so both stop and pyruvate and α-ketoglutarate accumulate. Replacing Pi at GAPDH is arsenate's action, the trap this question is built around. Magnesium chelation at hexokinase is not how arsenic acts. TPP on E1 does carry the two-carbon unit, but arsenite binds thiols rather than oxidising the thiazolium ring.
quiz.explain_zh: 亚砷酸盐对成对的相邻巯基有很高亲和力，而 E2 上还原态硫辛酰胺的摆臂恰好提供这样一对；丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体与 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体都用这条摆臂，于是双双停摆，丙酮酸与 α-酮戊二酸随之堆积。在 GAPDH 处顶替无机磷酸是砷酸盐的作用，正是本题设下的陷阱。在己糖激酶处螯合镁离子不是砷的作用方式。E1 上的 TPP 确实携带两碳单位，但亚砷酸盐是结合巯基，而不是氧化噻唑环。

quiz.q_en: Fluoroacetate is described as a case of lethal synthesis. What does the cell do to it, and where does the block land?
quiz.q_zh: 氟乙酸被称为「致死性合成」的例子。细胞对它做了什么，阻断最后落在哪里？

options.en: Fluoroacetyl-CoA displaces succinyl-CoA at the synthetase, so the cycle's only substrate-level phosphorylation stops
options.zh: 氟乙酰CoA 在合成酶处顶替琥珀酰CoA，于是循环中唯一一次底物水平磷酸化停止

options.en: Citrate synthase condenses fluoroacetyl-CoA with oxaloacetate to fluorocitrate, which then blocks aconitase
options.zh: 柠檬酸合酶把氟乙酰CoA 与草酰乙酸缩合成氟柠檬酸，后者随即阻断顺乌头酸酶

options.en: Aconitase defluorinates the compound itself, and the released fluoride ion then inactivates isocitrate dehydrogenase
options.zh: 顺乌头酸酶本身把该化合物脱氟，释出的氟离子随即使异柠檬酸脱氢酶失活

options.en: Fluoroacetate is a direct competitive inhibitor of citrate synthase, so citrate is never formed in the first place
options.zh: 氟乙酸是柠檬酸合酶的直接竞争性抑制剂，于是柠檬酸从一开始就没能生成

quiz.explain_en: The toxin itself is harmless; the cell activates it to fluoroacetyl-CoA and citrate synthase then does the damage by building it into fluorocitrate, a tight-binding inhibitor of aconitase — hence lethal synthesis, and hence citrate accumulating while the cycle stalls. Aconitase does not defluorinate the compound, and free fluoride is not the toxic species. Calling it a direct competitive inhibitor of citrate synthase misses the whole point, since the enzyme must run for the poison to be made. Succinyl-CoA synthetase is a later step that fluoroacetate never reaches.
quiz.explain_zh: 毒物本身是无害的；细胞先把它活化成氟乙酰CoA，柠檬酸合酶再把它装配成氟柠檬酸，而氟柠檬酸是顺乌头酸酶的紧密结合抑制剂——这就是「致死性合成」，也因此柠檬酸堆积而循环停转。顺乌头酸酶并不给它脱氟，游离氟离子也不是致毒物种。说它是柠檬酸合酶的直接竞争性抑制剂完全错失要点，因为这个酶必须运转，毒物才造得出来。琥珀酰CoA 合成酶是更靠后的一步，氟乙酸根本走不到那里。

quiz.q_en: A patient takes a sulfonamide, which acts as a PABA analogue. Which account of why the drug can be selective for bacteria is correct?
quiz.q_zh: 一位病人服用磺胺，它作为 PABA 的类似物起作用。关于这种药为什么能对细菌有选择性，哪一种说法是正确的？

options.en: Human cells make folate but import PABA from the diet, so a PABA analogue cannot compete at the human enzyme
options.zh: 人的细胞会合成叶酸，但 PABA 是从饮食摄取的，所以 PABA 类似物在人的酶上竞争不过

options.en: Human dihydrofolate reductase is the very same enzyme, and selectivity comes only from the drug entering bacterial cells faster
options.zh: 人的二氢叶酸还原酶就是同一个酶，选择性只来自药物进入细菌更快

options.en: Humans do not synthesise folate at all and take it as a vitamin, so the target enzyme simply does not exist in them
options.zh: 人根本不合成叶酸，而是把它当维生素摄入，所以这个靶酶在人体内根本不存在

options.en: Human dihydropteroate synthase exists but has a much shallower PABA pocket that the sulfonamide cannot enter
options.zh: 人的二氢蝶酸合酶是存在的，只是 PABA 口袋浅得多，磺胺进不去

quiz.explain_en: Selectivity here is absolute rather than a matter of degree: folate synthesis from PABA is a bacterial capability, humans obtain preformed folate from the diet, and an inhibitor of dihydropteroate synthase therefore has no human counterpart to inhibit. The shallow-pocket version assumes humans have the enzyme, which they do not. The version having human cells make folate while importing PABA contradicts the vitamin requirement itself. Human DHFR is a real and druggable target, but it is methotrexate's target, not a sulfonamide's, and it is a different enzyme in a different reaction.
quiz.explain_zh: 这里的选择性是绝对的，而不是程度问题：由 PABA 合成叶酸是细菌才有的本事，人是从饮食中获得现成的叶酸，因此二氢蝶酸合酶的抑制剂在人体内根本没有对应的酶可抑制。说口袋浅的那个预设了人有这个酶，而人并没有。说人会合成叶酸却从饮食摄取 PABA 的那个，与叶酸本身是维生素这一点自相矛盾。人的 DHFR 确实是一个真实且可成药的靶点，但那是甲氨蝶呤的靶点而非磺胺的，而且是另一个反应里的另一个酶。

quiz.q_en: Methotrexate and 5-fluorouracil act on different enzymes yet share a downstream consequence. What is it, and by which route?
quiz.q_zh: 甲氨蝶呤与 5-氟尿嘧啶作用于不同的酶，却有一个共同的下游后果。是什么后果，各自经由哪条路？

options.en: Both empty the SAM pool: DHFR and thymidylate synthase each hand their methyl group on to methionine synthase
options.zh: 两者都耗空 SAM 池：DHFR 与胸苷酸合酶各自把自己的甲基交给甲硫氨酸合酶

options.en: Both starve the cell of dTMP: one blocks THF regeneration, the other traps thymidylate synthase as FdUMP
options.zh: 两者都让细胞缺 dTMP：一个阻断 THF 的再生，另一个以 FdUMP 的形式把胸苷酸合酶锁死

options.en: Both stop purine ring assembly at the PRPP step, and neither of them touches the pyrimidine side of the pathway
options.zh: 两者都在 PRPP 这一步阻断嘌呤环的装配，而且都不触及通路的嘧啶一侧

options.en: Both block ribonucleotide reductase, so no ribonucleoside diphosphate can be reduced to its deoxy form
options.zh: 两者都阻断核糖核苷酸还原酶，于是没有核糖核苷二磷酸能被还原成脱氧形式

quiz.explain_en: Thymidylate synthase is the one folate reaction that leaves the cofactor oxidised as DHF, so it depends on DHFR to hand THF back; methotrexate cuts that regeneration off, while FdUMP traps the synthase itself in a covalent complex, and both routes end with no dTMP and dUMP piling up. The SAM answer has the traffic backwards, since methionine synthase gives its methyl group to homocysteine rather than receiving one from these enzymes. PRPP and purine ring assembly are a different branch that neither drug targets directly. Ribonucleotide reductase makes dUDP and the other deoxy forms and is not inhibited by either drug.
quiz.explain_zh: 胸苷酸合酶是唯一一个把辅因子留在氧化态 DHF 上的叶酸反应，因此它依赖 DHFR 把 THF 还回来；甲氨蝶呤切断这一再生，而 FdUMP 把这个合酶本身锁进共价复合物，两条路的终点都是没有 dTMP、dUMP 堆积。写 SAM 的那个方向反了，甲硫氨酸合酶是把甲基交给同型半胱氨酸，而不是从这两个酶那里接收甲基。PRPP 与嘌呤环装配属于另一条分支，两种药都不直接作用于它。核糖核苷酸还原酶负责生成 dUDP 等脱氧形式，也不被这两种药抑制。
quiz.see: L12 · dTMP and the T branch

quiz.q_en: Why does allopurinol sit awkwardly in the competitive / non-competitive / uncompetitive scheme of the kinetics lecture?
quiz.q_zh: 为什么别嘌呤醇很难被塞进酶动力学那一讲的竞争性／非竞争性／反竞争性分类里？

options.en: Because it binds the enzyme's substrate rather than the enzyme, so neither an EI nor an ESI complex is ever formed
options.zh: 因为它结合的是酶的底物而不是酶，所以既不形成 EI 也不形成 ESI 复合物

options.en: Because it strips the molybdenum out of the active site, so the enzyme loses a cofactor rather than losing a site
options.zh: 因为它把钼从活性中心里剥走，于是酶失去的是一个辅因子而不是一个位点

options.en: Because the enzyme oxidises it to oxypurinol, which then stays bound to the reduced molybdenum centre
options.zh: 因为酶把它氧化成氧嘌呤醇，后者随即牢牢结合在还原态的钼中心上

options.en: Because it lowers urate by blocking renal reabsorption, so the effect is on transport, not on any enzyme at all
options.zh: 因为它是通过阻断肾小管重吸收来降尿酸的，作用在转运而根本不在任何酶上

quiz.explain_en: Allopurinol is a hypoxanthine isomer that xanthine oxidase accepts as a substrate and converts into oxypurinol, which then locks onto the reduced molybdenum — mechanism-based, effectively irreversible inhibition, so extra substrate does not relieve it and none of the three reversible categories applies. It does not bind the substrate; it is one. It is not a chelator, and describing it that way is the standard misreading of a metal-dependent target. And its action is on the enzyme, not on renal urate transport, which is the mechanism of a different class of urate-lowering drug.
quiz.explain_zh: 别嘌呤醇是次黄嘌呤的异构体，黄嘌呤氧化酶把它当底物接收并转化为氧嘌呤醇，后者随即锁在还原态的钼上——属机制依赖性、实际上不可逆的抑制，所以增加底物解除不了，三种可逆分类一个都套不上。它不是结合底物，它本身就是底物。它也不是螯合剂，把它说成螯合是对含金属靶酶的常见误读。而且它作用在酶上，不在肾脏的尿酸转运上，那是另一类降尿酸药的机制。
quiz.see: L12 · xanthine oxidase / L4 · inhibitor classes

quiz.q_en: HMG-CoA turns up in two places the course taught. Which one does a statin act on, and what follows?
quiz.q_zh: HMG-CoA 在课程讲过的两个地方都出现过。他汀作用在哪一个上，随之而来的是什么？

options.en: On HMG-CoA synthase in the liver matrix, so HMG-CoA is never assembled from the three acetyl-CoA units
options.zh: 作用于肝线粒体基质中的 HMG-CoA 合酶，于是 HMG-CoA 根本无法由生酮路线上的那三个乙酰CoA 单位一步步装配出来

options.en: On thiolase in the liver matrix, so the two acetyl-CoA that begin the HMG-CoA route never condense at all
options.zh: 作用于肝基质中的硫解酶，于是开启 HMG-CoA 路线的那两个乙酰CoA 根本不发生缩合

options.en: On HMG-CoA reductase at the ER, so the NADPH-dependent step to mevalonate, cholesterol's slow step, stops
options.zh: 作用于内质网上的 HMG-CoA 还原酶，于是通向甲羟戊酸、依赖 NADPH 的那一步——胆固醇合成的限速步骤——被阻断

options.en: On HMG-CoA lyase in the liver matrix, so acetoacetate output falls and hepatic ketogenesis is suppressed
options.zh: 作用于肝基质中的 HMG-CoA 裂解酶，于是乙酰乙酸的产出下降，肝脏生酮被抑制

quiz.explain_en: The two HMG-CoA enzymes are in different compartments doing different jobs: HMG-CoA reductase sits on the ER and reduces HMG-CoA to mevalonate using NADPH, the rate-limiting step of cholesterol synthesis and the statin target. HMG-CoA lyase, HMG-CoA synthase and thiolase all belong to the mitochondrial ketogenesis route in the liver — the branch that makes acetoacetate — and a statin does not act on any of them, which is why ketone body production is not what statins suppress.
quiz.explain_zh: 两个与 HMG-CoA 有关的酶位于不同区室、做不同的事：HMG-CoA 还原酶在内质网上，用 NADPH 把 HMG-CoA 还原为甲羟戊酸，是胆固醇合成的限速步骤，也是他汀的靶点。HMG-CoA 裂解酶、HMG-CoA 合酶和硫解酶都属于肝线粒体的生酮路线——也就是生成乙酰乙酸的那条支路——他汀不作用于其中任何一个，所以他汀抑制的并不是酮体的生成。
